entries.description:
Pokémon 30th anniversary memorial charms (20 types), Uma Musume's new Ruler Ship training, Dragon Ball DUAL BURST figures, Madoka Magica prizes, stunning cosplay of Nakiri Ayame & Daughter of Evil – all the hottest otaku news from the third week of July 2026!

# 週間JOI通信 ── 2026年7月第3週のヲタ界隈ホットトピック！

真夏の暑さに負けず、今週もヲタク界隈は話題が盛りだくさん！ゲーム、フィギュア、グッズ、コスプレと、各方面からアツいニュースが飛び込んできました。今週の注目トピックをまとめてお届けします。

---

## 🎮 ゲーム＆アニメ──今週のアツかった話題

### ウマ娘に「ルーラーシップ」参戦！クールだけどメンタルよわよわ

『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー』に新たな育成ウマ娘「ルーラーシップ」が登場！クールなビジュアルとは裏腹にメンタルが弱いというギャップ萌えキャラで、モチーフ馬がゲート難（出遅れ癖）で有名だったことを踏まえた設定もファン心をくすぐります。育成シナリオでどんなドラマが待っているのか、トレーナー諸氏は要チェック。

### 『FGO』グレイ・リリィのクラス投票が予想外の結末に

『Fate/Grand Order』では「グレイ・リリィ」のセイバー派 vs ランサー派という投票企画が話題に。結果が予想外すぎる展開だったとのことで、マスター界隈がざわついた一週間でした。

### 新作ラッシュ！『パールインブルー』＆『アストラエ・オラティオ』

恋愛体験とRPGを融合させた「月刊ラブコメ」コンセプトの新作『パールインブルー』がキービジュアル初公開、ティザーサイトと公式Xもオープン。さらに注目の新作『アストラエ・オラティオ』も「港区少女たちのまほ活」「清蘭同友会」などキャラクターが続々とお披露目され、期待が高まっています。

### 夏にぴったり！"海ゲー"特集が話題

猛暑のお供にぴったりな特集記事も登場。『あつ森』や『スプラトゥーン レイダース』など、画面の中で海を満喫できるおすすめゲーム5選が紹介されていました。エアコンの効いた部屋でバーチャル海水浴、最高では？

### 推理ADV『Staffer Retro: 超能力推理クエスト』7月23日発売

日本語レビューで「圧倒的に好評」のシリーズ最新作がSteam/スイッチ向けに7月23日リリース予定。推理ゲーム好きは見逃し厳禁です。

---

## 🏆 フィギュア＆グッズ──予約・発売の注目ピックアップ

### ポケモン30周年メモリアルチャーム全20種がエモすぎる

『ポケモン』30周年を記念したメモリアルチャームが発表！歴代御三家から幻のポケモンまで揃った全20種というボリュームで、初代から追いかけてきたファンにはたまらないラインナップ。さらにガチャ「ポケピース きらめきハートキーホルダー」（ハートを持ったピカチュウたちがかわいい！）も8月中旬発売と、ポケモングッズが豊作です。

### 『ドラゴンボール DUAL BURST』──名バトルを再現した新フィギュアシリーズ

孫悟空 vs フリーザなど、ドラゴンボールの名バトルシーンを再現した新フィギュアシリーズ「DUAL BURST」が発表。対決の臨場感をそのまま立体化した造形が激アツと話題になっています。

### 『刃牙』一番くじがオンラインに！烈海王のグルグルパンチ時計って何

「刃牙」新作一番くじがオンライン販売開始。最終形態ピクルら4体のフィギュアに加え、「烈海王のグルグルパンチ時計」というパワーワードすぎるアイテムも。どう考えても欲しい。

### 『まどマギ ワルプルギスの廻天』からキュゥべえドームクッション

『劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ〈ワルプルギスの廻天〉』からキュゥべえのドームクッションやちびぐるみがバンプレストプライズに登場。あの無表情なキュゥべえがクッションになると思うと、なんとも言えない気持ちになりますね。

### その他注目グッズ一気出し

- **ちいかわ「キャラマグネッツ5」** ── 漫画コマがマグネットに！レア3種も収録
- **名探偵コナン 刺繍缶バッジビスケット** ── 「コナン＆怪盗キッド」「新一＆毛利蘭」など全11種
- **しまじろう めじるしアクセサリー** ── 雨合羽姿のとりっぴいたち全5種がガシャポン展開
- **パペットスンスン モバイルアイテム** ── ふわふわマルチケースやクリーナーなど便利グッズ3種
- **ONE PIECEチケットライクコレクション** ── 集めると背景がつながる新シリーズ初登場
- **艦これ「Reincarnation 島風」** ── フィギュアレビューが公開中
- **呪術廻戦 秤金次プライズフィギュア** ── 死滅回游バトルポーズで立体化
- **キルアオ 大狼十三フィギュア** ── 中学生姿でハンドガンを構えた立ち姿

ワンフェス2026[夏]の事前情報として、ダイキ工業の限定PVCガレージキット「冬萌 桜」も発表されており、夏のイベントシーズンに向けてフィギュア界隈の盛り上がりが加速中です。

---

## 📸 コスプレ＆現地系トピック──今週の映えレイヤーたち

今週もハイクオリティなコスプレが続々！特に注目だったのはこの2つ。

### 「悪ノ娘」リリアンヌのコスプレが圧巻

ボカロ楽曲「悪ノ娘」のリリアンヌを再現した超ゴージャスなドレスコスプレが話題に。強気な表情と美しいシルエットが織りなす優雅な世界観は写真7枚にわたって堪能できます。

### 「ホロライブ」百鬼あやめのコスプレがかわいすぎる

艶やかなミニ丈和装スタイルで「ホロライブ」百鬼あやめを再現したコスプレも大きな反響。くりっとした大きな瞳の再現度が高く、VTuberファンからも絶賛の声が。

### 今週のコスプレ作品まとめ

その他にも、『崩壊：スターレイル』姫子、『鳴潮』千咲、「デスノート」ミサミサ、『ゼンゼロ』イドリー、「にじさんじ」栞葉るり、『東方Project』十六夜咲夜、『NIKKE』D：キラーワイフ、『アークナイツ』ハルカ、『着せ恋』喜多川海夢など、ジャンル横断で美しいコスプレ作品が今週も豊作でした。

---

## 🎲 ちょっと気になるコラム＆特集

- **"悪趣味"を愛するゲーマー座談会** ── バッドエンド、尊厳破壊、後味の悪さ…なぜわざわざ嫌な気持ちになりにいくのか？という深掘り座談会が面白い
- **レトロゲームのディスク盤面デザイン特集** ── ケースを開けたら見える「もうひとつのゲーム美術」に注目した粋な企画
- **ドリキャス版『リング』がなぜ『バイオ』だったのか** ── Jホラーとサバイバルホラーの交差点を考察する特集記事も
- **フィルムカメラ特集** ── 70年前のカメラで撮った台湾の風景がまるで記憶のようで美しい

---

## 🔮 来週の注目ポイント

1. **『Staffer Retro: 超能力推理クエスト』が7月23日発売** ── 圧倒的好評シリーズの最新作、発売日レビューに注目
2. **ワンフェス2026[夏]関連情報がさらに加速** ── ダイキ工業の限定キットなど事前情報が出始めており、来週以降さらに新作フィギュアの発表ラッシュが予想されます
3. **ポケモン30周年グッズの続報に期待** ── メモリアルチャームに続き、30周年関連の新展開がまだまだありそう。歴代ファンは財布の紐をしっかり握って

---

暑い日が続きますが、ヲタ活のアツさも負けてません。来週もお楽しみに！

entries.article_markdown_en:
# Weekly JOI Dispatch – Hottest Otaku Topics from the 3rd Week of July 2026!

The midsummer heat is on, but the otaku world keeps delivering scorching-hot news! From games and figures to goods and cosplay, here's your roundup of this week's must-know topics.

---

## 🎮 Games & Anime – This Week's Hottest Buzz

### Uma Musume Welcomes Ruler Ship – Cool Looks, Fragile Mentality

*Uma Musume Pretty Derby* has added a new trainable character: Ruler Ship! She sports a cool exterior but is famously weak on the mental side – a delightful gap-moe trait inspired by the real racehorse's notorious gate troubles (a tendency to get left behind at the start). Trainers, get ready for an interesting scenario!

### FGO's Grey Lily Class Vote Ends in a Surprise

*Fate/Grand Order* ran a poll pitting Saber fans against Lancer fans over Grey Lily's preferred class, and the results turned out to be unexpectedly dramatic. Masters were buzzing about it all week.

### New Titles Unveiled: Pearl in Blue & Astrae Oratio

The rom-com-meets-RPG newcomer *Pearl in Blue* (billed as a playable monthly love comedy) debuted its key visual, teaser site, and official X account. Meanwhile, *Astrae Oratio* revealed a parade of characters – including groups like the Minato Ward Girls and the Seiran Fellowship – building anticipation for this promising new IP.

### Beat the Heat with These Ocean-Themed Games

A timely feature rounded up five sea-themed games perfect for surviving the summer swelter, including *Animal Crossing* and *Splatoon Raiders*. Virtual beach trips from the comfort of air conditioning? Yes, please.

### Staffer Retro: Psychic Detective Quest Launches July 23

The latest entry in this Japanese-review-acclaimed mystery ADV series arrives on Steam and Switch on July 23. Mystery fans, mark your calendars.

---

## 🏆 Figures & Goods – Notable Releases and Pre-Orders

### Pokémon 30th Anniversary Memorial Charms – All 20 Types!

A stunning set of memorial charms celebrating Pokémon's 30th anniversary has been announced, featuring starter Pokémon from every generation plus Mythical Pokémon across 20 designs. On top of that, the Poképeace Sparkling Heart Keychains gacha (adorable Pikachu holding hearts!) is set for a mid-August release. It's a golden age for Pokémon collectors.

### Dragon Ball DUAL BURST – Legendary Battles in Figure Form

A brand-new figure series called Dragon Ball DUAL BURST was revealed, recreating iconic battle scenes like Goku vs. Frieza. The dynamic two-character compositions have fans already calling them must-haves.

### Baki Ichiban Kuji Goes Online – Plus a Retsu Kaioh Spinning Punch Clock!?

The new *Baki* lottery went live online with four figures including Pickle in his final form. The standout oddity? A Retsu Kaioh Spinning Punch Clock. We don't know exactly what it looks like yet, but we already need it.

### Madoka Magica: Walpurgis Rising – Kyubey Dome Cushion & Chibi Plushies

From *Madoka Magica: Walpurgis Rising*, Banpresto prizes include a Kyubey dome cushion and chibi plush figures of Madoka and friends. Having Kyubey stare at you from cushion form is a uniquely unsettling comfort.

### Quick-Fire Goods Roundup

- **Chiikawa Chara Magnets 5** – Manga panels turned magnets, with 3 rare types
- **Detective Conan Embroidered Badge Biscuits** – 11 designs including Conan & Kid, Shinichi & Ran
- **Shimajiro Landmark Accessories** – Raincoat Torippii and friends in gashapon
- **Puppet Sunsun Mobile Items** – Fluffy multi-case and cleaner goods
- **ONE PIECE Ticket-Like Collection** – Backgrounds connect when you collect them all
- **KanColle Reincarnation Shimakaze** – Figure review now live
- **Jujutsu Kaisen Hakari Kinji Prize Figure** – Battle action pose from the Culling Game
- **Kill Ao Oogami Juzo Figure** – Middle schooler form with handgun

Wonder Festival 2026 [Summer] pre-event info is also picking up, with Daiki Kogyo's limited PVC garage kit Tomoe Sakura already announced. The figure scene is heating up ahead of summer event season!

---

## 📸 Cosplay & On-Site Topics – This Week's Stunning Creations

### Daughter of Evil's Riliane Cosplay Is Breathtaking

A gorgeous cosplay recreation of Riliane from the Vocaloid song Daughter of Evil featured an ultra-luxurious gown, commanding expression, and an elegant silhouette that dominated all seven photos.

### Hololive's Nakiri Ayame Cosplay Is Too Cute

A mini-length traditional Japanese outfit brought Hololive's Nakiri Ayame to life with stunning accuracy, particularly in recreating her signature large, sparkling eyes. VTuber fans were captivated.

### More Cosplay Highlights

The week also delivered beautiful cosplay works spanning *Honkai: Star Rail* (Himeko), *Wuthering Waves* (Changli), *Death Note* (Misa), *Zenless Zone Zero* (Idris), Nijisanji's Shioriha Ruri, *Touhou* (Sakuya), *NIKKE* (D: Killer Wife), *Arknights* (Haruka), and *My Dress-Up Darling* (Kitagawa Marin) – a truly cross-genre showcase.

---

## 🎲 Interesting Features & Columns

- **Gamer Roundtable: Why We Love Bad Endings** – A deep dive into why some players actively seek out despair, dignity destruction, and bitter aftertastes
- **The Hidden Art of Retro Game Disc Designs** – A charming feature about the artwork you only see after opening the case
- **Why Dreamcast's Ring Became a Resident Evil Clone** – An exploration of where J-horror meets survival horror
- **Film Camera Feature** – Gorgeous Taiwan scenery shot on a 70-year-old camera, with light leaks that look like memories

---

## 🔮 What to Watch Next Week

1. **Staffer Retro: Psychic Detective Quest launches July 23** – Keep an eye on day-one reviews for this acclaimed mystery ADV series
2. **Wonder Festival 2026 [Summer] info accelerates** – With pre-event reveals already rolling in, expect a barrage of new figure announcements in the coming days
3. **More Pokémon 30th anniversary reveals likely** – The memorial charms are just the beginning; longtime fans should brace their wallets for what's coming

---

The summer heat rages on, but otaku passion burns even hotter. See you next week!

entries.title: "Kura Sushi" and "3COINS" are teaming up! A total of nine items—including "Conveyor Belt Sushi at Home" and "Bikkura Pon! at Home," which let you enjoy the Kura Sushi experience right at home—will go on sale on Friday, October 16, 2026!

entries.description: Collaboration items between “Kura Sushi” and “3COINS,” themed around “Kura Sushi at Home,” will go on sale starting Friday, October 16, at 3COINS stores nationwide and other locations! The lineup includes a total of 9 products, such as “Conveyor Belt Sushi at Home” and “Bikkura Pon!® at Home”! #KuraSushi #3COINS

entries.title: Pre-orders for the “IMS 1/100 Siren Type F = Calamity Godders 2989/3112=” plastic model kit from “Five Star Stories” begin on October 21! Exclusive to Volks “GL/VS/VIP” members.
entries.title_ja: 「ファイブスター物語」よりプラキット「IMS 1/100 サイレンF型 =カラミティ・ゴーダース 2989/3112=」が10月21日から予約開始！ボークス「GL/VS/VIP」会員限定販売
entries.description: Volks announced that it will begin accepting pre-orders for the injection-molded plastic kit “IMS 1/100 Siren F-Type = Calamity Godders 2989/3112 = (Limited Edition)” starting October 21. The kit is scheduled for release in December, and the price is 15,400 yen.

entries.title: "Jurassic World: Tumble and Fall Figures" Gacha Set to Launch in Early October; Lineup Includes 4 Varieties, Including Tyrannosaurus Rex
entries.title_ja: ガチャ「ジュラシック・ワールド すってんころりんフィギュア」10月上旬発売ティラノサウルス・レックスなど全4種がラインナップ
entries.description: Takara Tomy Arts will release the gacha product "Jurassic World: Tumble-and-Fall Figures" in early October. The price is 400 yen per play.

entries.title: New Developments for "Magic: The Gathering" × "Marvel"! New "Secret Lair" Products, Including "Marvel: Darkhold Destiny," Are Coming
entries.title_ja: 「マジック：ザ・ギャザリング」×「マーベル」に新たな展開！　「マーベル：ダークホールド・デスティニー」をはじめ「Secret Lair」新製品が登場
entries.description: Wizards of the Coast, the manufacturer and distributor of the trading card game "Magic: The Gathering," announced a new Marvel product at New York Comic Con.

entries.title: The "S.H.Figuarts (True Bone Sculpting Method) Borucancer" action figure from *Kamen Rider Ryuki* is now available for a second round of lottery sales! It also comes with the "Cracked Card Deck" that sealed Kamen Rider Scissors' fate!
entries.title_ja: 『仮面ライダー龍騎』アクションフィギュア「S.H.Figuarts（真骨彫製法）ボルキャンサー」が抽選2次販売！仮面ライダーシザースの最期を決定づけた「割れたカードデッキ」も付属！
entries.description: The "S.H.Figuarts" (Shinkotsubou) action figure set featuring Borcanser & Kamen Rider Scissors from *Kamen Rider Ryuki* is now available for a second round of lottery sales! Applications are being accepted until 11:00 PM on Sunday, November 29! #KamenRiderRyuki #Shinkotsubou

entries.title: Hasegawa's 1/350 Scale Plastic Model Kit "Imperial Japanese Navy Type A Destroyer Nozomi: 'Battle of the Marianas'" Begins Shipping Today!
entries.title_ja: ハセガワ、1/350プラモデル「日本海軍 甲型駆逐艦 野分 “マリアナ沖海戦”」本日出荷開始！
entries.description: Hasegawa will begin shipping its plastic model kit, “Imperial Japanese Navy Type A Destroyer Nozomi: ‘Battle of the Marianas,’” on October 14. The price is 6,820 yen.

entries.title: New Coca-Cola BE@RBRICK Collection! Two items inspired by bottles and cans are being released in sets of two sizes—100% and 400%!
entries.title_ja: コカ・コーラのBE@RBRICK新作！ボトルと缶をイメージした2種のアイテムがそれぞれ100％＆400％の2サイズセットで発売！
entries.description: A new BE@RBRICK featuring "Coca-Cola," an icon of American culture, is here! Two designs inspired by bottles and cans are available in a set of two sizes: 100% and 400%! #CocaCola #BE@RBRICK

entries.title: Surugaya is currently accepting pre-orders for the re-release of the "30MS Tiasha (Dahlia Wear) [Color B]" bishoujo plastic model kit!
entries.title_ja: 駿河屋にて美少女プラモ「30MS ティアーシャ（ダリアウエア）[カラーB]」の再販予約が実施中！
entries.description: Surugaya is currently accepting pre-orders for the plastic model kit “30MS Tiasha (Dahlia Wear) [Color B].”

entries.title: The TV anime *I Want to Be in Love Until You Die* is joining the new "CHILLfigg Relax" series of "CHILLfigg" trading figures!
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい』がトレーディングフィギュア「CHILLfigg」の新シリーズ「CHILLfigg Relax」にエントリー！
entries.description: The TV anime *I Want to Fall in Love Until You Die* is coming to "CHILLfigg," the trading figure series from VISION! The painted prototypes are now complete, so let's take a look right away! #KimiShinuAnime #Chillfigg #PR

entries.title: The Gunpla models "MG 1/100 Zeong" and "HG 1/144 Gyaplan" are back on sale at Preban!
entries.title_ja: プレバンにてガンプラ「MG 1/100 ジオング」と「HG 1/144 ギャプラン」が販売再開中！
entries.description: Sales of the Gunpla models “MG 1/100 Z'Gok” and “HG 1/144 Gyaplan” have resumed on Premium Bandai.

entries.title: An online lottery featuring newly drawn merchandise based on the "Champagne Fight" theme from the TV anime *Osomatsu-san* is now available on "Kujibiki-do"! The Grand Prize is a Character Fine Graph!
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『おそ松さん』より、シャンパンファイトをテーマにした新規描き下ろしイラストグッズが当たるオンラインくじが「くじ引き堂」に登場！S賞はキャラファイングラフ！
entries.description: An online raffle featuring newly drawn merchandise themed around the "Champagne Fight" scene from the TV anime *Osomatsu-san* is now live on "Kujibiki-do"! The lineup includes a variety of fantastic prizes, such as Character Fine Graph prints and BIG Acsta figures! #KujibikiDo #OsomatsuSan

entries.title: The "To LOVE-Ru -Trouble- Darkness" Darkness Ver. Ryoko Mikado Figure Is Being Re-released! Now Available for Pre-order on Amazon!!
entries.title_ja: 『To LOVEる-とらぶる-ダークネス』ダークネスVer.の御門涼子先生フィギュアが再販！Amazonで予約受付中!!
entries.description: Experience her mature allure! The 1/6-scale "Ryoko Mikado" figure in her Darkness outfit from *To LOVE-Ru Darkness* is back in stock!! Now available for pre-order on Amazon! #toloveru_d

entries.title: [Why You Should Read This Today] Chapter 1: “A Hokkaido Hunter Gets Thrown into Another World: A Hunting Adventure in Another World with My Elf Wife”
entries.title_ja: 【今日、読む理由。】第1話『北海道の現役ハンターが異世界に放り込まれてみた 〜エルフ嫁と巡る異世界狩猟ライフ〜』
entries.description:
In manga, there are “chapters you’ll want to read today, of all days.” In “Reasons to Read Today,” we select and feature just one chapter every day. A Hokkaido Hunter Gets Thrown into Another World ~A Hunting Life in Another World with My Elf Wife~ Volume 1, Chapter 1  […]
The post [“Reasons to Read Today.”] Chapter 1: “A Hokkaido Hunter Gets Thrown into Another World: A Hunting Life in Another World with My Elf Wife” first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: The free-roam sandbox RPG *Hytale* has received its first major update, packed with plenty of “RPG elements.” From magic to handy gadgets, the adventure is finally in full swing.
entries.title_ja: 自由サンドボックスRPG『Hytale』に初の大型アプデで“RPG成分”たっぷり実装。魔法に便利ガジェットに、冒険がいよいよ本格化
entries.description: On October 12, Hypixel Studios released "Chapter I: Out of the Breach," the first major content update for *Hytale*.

entries.title: “AAA-Grade Minesweeper,” *Triple-A Minesweeper*, is causing a stir with its ironic humor. True to the “big-name game” trope, it bombards players with a barrage of brand logos right after launch, and gameplay consists simply of following the yellow guide.
entries.title_ja: “AAA級のマインスイーパー”『Triple-A Minesweeper』が皮肉を振り撒き反響呼ぶ。「大型ゲームあるある」な起動直後にブランドロゴ連発、プレイは黄色いガイドに従うだけ
entries.description: On October 7, Mike Lacher released “Triple-A Minesweeper.” The game can be played for free in a web browser. The satire embedded in this title—developed under the concept of a “AAA-scale Minesweeper”—has drawn a strong response.

entries.title: The robot biker gang battle game *Yokohama Mobile Biker Gang: ROCK’N ROLL SUICIDE* has been officially announced. Biker gang members piloting giant robots engage in epic, high-stakes one-on-one robot battles set against the backdrop of “live-action Yokohama.”
entries.title_ja: ロボットツッパリ抗争ゲーム『横浜機動暴走族 ROCK’N ROLL SUICIDE』正式発表。巨大ロボを駆る暴走族たちが、“実写の横浜”で超スケールの夜露死苦青春タイマンロボバトル
entries.description: On October 10, independent developer FUJII.Production announced the action-adventure game *Yokohama Mobile Bōsōzoku: ROCK'N ROLL SUICIDE*. The game will be available on PC (Steam) and is scheduled for release in March 2027.

entries.title: "Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster" for Steam Receives a Quiet Update for the First Time in 7 Years. Has the Infamous "Screen Turns Completely Green at the Worst Possible Moment" Bug Finally Been Fixed?
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーX/X-2 HD リマスター』Steam版、7年ぶりにひっそりアプデ。悪名高い“いいところで画面が緑一色”バグがとうとう修正か
entries.description: On October 1, Square Enix released an update—the first in seven years—for the Steam version of *Final Fantasy X/X-2 HD Remaster*.

entries.title: Exploration horror game featuring a young girl, *The Girl Possessed by Impurity: Ryuya Narumi’s Strange Chronicles*, announced. Unravel the mystery of cursed objects in a midnight investigation lit by a single flashlight.
entries.title_ja: 少女と一緒に探索ホラー『穢れ憑きの少女　鳴海龍也の回奇録』発表。呪物の謎を解き明かすライト1本真夜中調査
entries.description: On October 12, BogeymanGames announced *The Girl Possessed by Impurity: The Strange Chronicles of Tatsuya Narumi*.

entries.title: The CEO of Epic Games, the developer of Unreal Engine, has declared that the company will “make full use of generative AI” in game development. Both code and art will be entirely “AI-first.”
entries.title_ja: Unreal Engine手がけるEpic Gamesのボス、ゲーム開発に「生成AI全力活用」を宣言。コードもアートも、全面的に“AIファースト”
entries.description: On October 13, Tim Sweeney, CEO of Epic Games, announced the company's plan to accelerate the use of generative AI in its game development.

entries.title: The Challenge of “Screen Size Liberalization” Facing iPhone/iPad App Developers: They Can’t Escape by “Dropping Support for the iPad.” We Ask Developers About the Reality and Hardships of Choosing Between Updating or Giving Up
entries.title_ja: iPhone/iPad向けアプリ開発者に迫る「画面サイズ自由化」の難題、“iPad切り捨て”では逃げられない。更新か諦めるか、開発者に実態としんどさを訊く
entries.description: On the iPad, users can freely adjust the display size of compatible apps. We spoke with game developer Mr. Otsuka to find out what kind of adjustments were necessary.

entries.title: The “real-life based on statistics” simulator *1 in 8 Billion* is all the rage. Your birth is determined by a random draw, but how you live is up to you—a trend of watching these raw, realistic lives unfold is taking off.
entries.title_ja: “統計に基づくリアル人生”シミュレーター『80億分の1』大流行中。生まれはガチャで生き方は自分次第、生々しい人生見守りブーム
entries.description: On October 5, Jin Hwi-eus released the life simulator “1 in 8 Billion.” It has become a major talking point on social media.

entries.title: The otome game brand "MintLip+" has officially announced its new "crime investigation" romance adventure game, *PROJECT SIGN: Astraea*. Under the guise of justice, truth and love begin to spiral out of control.
entries.title_ja: 乙女ゲームブランド「MintLip+」新作“犯罪捜査”恋愛ADV『PROJECT SIGN：Astraea』正式発表。正義の下で、真実と愛が狂いだす
entries.description: On October 13, MintLip+ officially announced "PROJECT SIGN: Astraea." To coincide with the announcement, a teaser site has been launched.

entries.title: "Dyping Working: The Work Surveillance Game," a horror game designed to boost PC work efficiency through "eye surveillance," has been announced. The eye inside your PC will instantly catch you slacking off—it’s a grim, no-nonsense companion.
entries.title_ja: “目玉の監視”で効率を上げるPC作業用ホラー『Dyping Working: 作業監視ゲーム』発表。PCの中の目玉にはサボり即バレ、チルじゃない殺伐お供
entries.description: On October 13, PLAYISM announced "Dyping Working: The Work Surveillance Game," a work-themed horror adventure game developed by Heaviside Creations.

entries.title: A game from seven years ago suddenly saw "170,000 concurrent players" flood in on Steam. Why all of a sudden?
entries.title_ja: Steamにて7年前のゲームに突如「同接17万人」押し寄せる。急にどうして
entries.description: The number of concurrent players on Steam for *UBERMOSH:OMEGA*, developed by Walter Machado, suddenly surpassed 170,000. This surge appears to be due to the implementation of Steam trading cards.

entries.title: The Nintendo Switch version of "Niconico" will end service at the end of March next year. There are also no plans for compatibility with the "Switch 2."
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch版「ニコニコ」来年3月末でサービス終了へ。“Switch 2向けの対応予定”もなし
entries.description: On October 13, Dwango announced that it will discontinue the "Niconico" app for Nintendo Switch as of March 31, 2027.

entries.title: "Oomi’s Nook," a sticker-based mini-garden game, is set to launch on December 7. Leisurely stick over 8,000 stickers, and once you’re done, cute and fluffy creatures will come to live there.
entries.title_ja: ステッカーで箱庭づくりゲーム『Oomi’s Nook』12月7日配信へ。8000枚以上のステッカーをのんびりペタペタ、完成したらゆるふわ生物が暮らしてくれる
entries.description: On October 13, Find the Lamp Games announced that "Oomi’s Nook" will be released on December 7.

entries.title: SNK Co., Ltd. is hiring mid-career professionals. The company is seeking a wide range of candidates—including designers, engineers, and planners—who are passionate about games and the company’s intellectual property.
entries.title_ja: 株式会社SNKが中途採用を実施。ゲームや自社IPへの情熱を持つデザイナー、エンジニア、プランナーなどを幅広く募集
entries.description: SNK Co., Ltd. is actively recruiting mid-career professionals.

entries.title: It has been confirmed that the Steam version of *Ace Combat Zero*, a pre-order bonus for *Ace Combat 8*, will include a standalone app. Players will be able to play the game without installing *Ace Combat 8*, which is over 140 GB.
entries.title_ja: 『エースコンバット8』予約特典の『エースコンバット・ゼロ』Steam版、“単独起動できる”アプリ追加決定。140GB超の『8』をインストールせずに遊べる
entries.description: On October 13, Bandai Namco Entertainment announced that the pre-order bonus for the Steam version of *Ace Combat 8* is now expected to be available as a standalone *Ace Combat Zero* application.

entries.title: A crowdfunding campaign for the board game version of “Satisfactory” has launched on Gamefound. Build a factory on your tabletop and aim to construct a space elevator!
entries.title_ja: ボードゲーム版「Satisfactory」のクラファンがGamefoundでスタート。卓上で工場を組み上げ，宇宙エレベーターの建設を目指す！
entries.description: On October 13, 2026, MOODPublishing launched a crowdfunding campaign on Gamefound to produce “Satisfactory: The Board Game,” a board game based on the factory-building video game “Satisfactory.” The funding goal was 25,000 euros. As of this writing, the goal has already been met. The campaign will run until 12:00 a.m. on November 11 (Japan Standard Time).

entries.title: The 2D visual novel "COME TO MY PARTY!" will release Demo Version 2.0 on October 16. The update incorporates player feedback to improve the gameplay experience.
entries.title_ja: 2Dビジュアルノベル「COME TO MY PARTY!」，デモ2.0版を10月16日にリリース。プレイヤーからの意見を反映しプレイ体験を改善
entries.description: LINEGames announced today (October 13, 2026) that it will release version 2.0 of the demo for its new PC title, “COMETOMYPARTY!,” on October 16. The company also confirmed its participation in “TheMix Fall Showcase,” which will take place on October 16, and “SteamNextFest,” which will run for approximately one week starting October 20.

entries.title: Did you know that if you see a blue Beetle, you’re allowed to tap the person next to you? “Caravana 2000” [BGS2026], a first-person van-life documentary packed with typical Brazilian moments.
entries.title_ja: 青いビートルを見たら隣の人を叩いていいって知ってた？ブラジルあるある満載の一人称ヴァンサバ「Caravana 2000」［BGS2026］
entries.description: At the BrasilGameShow 2026 venue in Brazil, Pedro Oliveira and Pablo Ortolan of 2Wedges introduced us to their PC action game, “Caravana 2000.” This first-person game features costumed dancers who dance their way through the city while chasing a light-up truck, and is packed with inside jokes familiar to every Brazilian, incorporated into enemies and items.

entries.title: Set in the underworld inspired by Greek mythology, the game unravels the truth behind a mystery by piecing together the memories of the dead. "The River Lethe," an adventure game centered on memory and judgment, is now available as a demo.
entries.title_ja: ギリシャ神話をモチーフにした冥界を舞台に，死者の記憶をつなぎ合わせることで，事件の真相を明らかにしていく。記憶と裁きをめぐるADV「レテの河」，体験版配信中
entries.description: Meisomi is offering a demo version of the story-driven adventure game *The River Lethe* on Steam. Set in the underworld inspired by Greek mythology, the game involves reconstructing events from the memories of the dead and proving the defendant’s guilt and the severity of their crime during a trial.

entries.title: "Dyping Working: The Work Surveillance Game," a horror adventure game where players work while being watched by "eyes," has launched its Steam store page
entries.title_ja: “目玉”に監視されながら作業をするホラーADV「Dyping Working: 作業監視ゲーム」，Steamストアページを公開
entries.description: Today (October 13, 2026), PLAYISM announced its new title, “DypingWorking: A Work Surveillance Game,” and launched its Steam store page. This title is a work-themed horror adventure game and a spin-off of “DypingEscape,” a horror typing game in which players type while following the instructions of an eerie “eye.”

entries.title: The protagonist, who serves as the cult leader, continues to eat meat. The gloomy, lovey-dovey meat-themed visual novel “La Vie en Viande” is now available on Novel Game Collection.
entries.title_ja: 教主を務める主人公が肉を食べ続ける。陰鬱ノロケ肉ノベル「ラ・ヴィ・アン・ヴィアンド」，ノベルゲームコレクションで公開
entries.description: Today, Momo released the visual novel "La Vie en Viande" on Novel Game Collection. It is available for free. This title is a dark, romantic visual novel that depicts a slightly horror-tinged, immoral story between a man and a woman. It is rated R15.

entries.title: "Defense Against the Undead," which blends the strategic depth of tower defense with incremental progression elements, launches today on Steam.
entries.title_ja: タワーディフェンスの戦略性にインクリメンタルの成長要素を融合させた「対死霊防衛線」，本日Steamで配信開始
entries.description: LevelUpGaming and GamerskyGames released “Defense Against the Undead,” a tower defense/incremental game, on Steam today (October 13, 2026). The price is 900 yen (tax included). Players start as an apprentice wizard who can use only one spell and must hold the defensive line against an endless onslaught of undead hordes on a battlefield that continues to expand.

entries.title: "Street Fighter 6": "Arjun," the second character in Year 4's roster expansion, joins the fight today. He's a tricky fighter who makes full use of positioning moves and projectiles.
entries.title_ja: 「ストリートファイター6」，Year 4追加キャラ第2弾「アルジュン」が本日参戦。設置技や飛び道具を駆使するトリッキーなファイター
entries.description: Capcom today added "Arjun," the second Year 4 character, to *Street Fighter 6*. He is a fighter who excels at powerful strikes, as well as stun moves and projectiles that utilize yoga and breathing techniques, and a dedicated story for him has also been added to Arcade Mode.

entries.title: Working, cooking, and sometimes slacking off. “Rhythm Animal Cafe,” where the animals’ everyday lives become a rhythm game, is out today.
entries.title_ja: 働く，料理する，ときにはサボる。動物たちの何気ない日常がリズムゲームになる「リズムアニマルカフェ」，本日発売
entries.description: SaltGameStudio released the rhythm game "Rhythm Animal Cafe" on Steam today. The game depicts the casual daily lives of animals—working at the office, cooking, and sometimes slacking off—through the medium of a rhythm game.

entries.title: "BLEACH Mirrors High" SPECIAL BROADCAST to be released on YouTube on October 27 at 7:00 p.m. Featuring Seiichi Morita, Fumiko Orikasa, and others
entries.title_ja: 「BLEACH Mirrors High」，SPECIAL BROADCASTをYouTubeで10月27日19：00に公開。森田成一さん，折笠富美子さんらが出演
entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced today that it will release the "SPECIAL BROADCAST" program for the smartphone game "BLEACH Mirrors High" on October 27, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. During the program, the guests will reveal new information about the app.

entries.title: From the game *Honkai: Star Rail*, the Gift+ series figure “Yao Guang” is now available as a 1/8-scale figure!
entries.title_ja: ゲーム『崩壊：スターレイル』より、Gift+シリーズ「爻光」が1/8スケールフィギュア化！
entries.description:
From the game *Honkai: Star Rail*, “Yao Guang” makes her debut in a long dress featuring a beautiful gradient. She is scheduled for release in September 2027. The following is an excerpt from the press release: “Nice to meet you. I am General Rong Tao of the Xianzhou ‘Yu Dian,’ Yao Guang. Feel free to call me by my first name […]
The post “Yao Guang” from the “Gift+” series in the game *Honkai: Star Rail* is getting an 1/8 scale figure! first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title_ja: Lucrea(ルクリア) 『無職転生Ⅲ ～異世界行ったら本気だす～』 エリス 完成品フィギュア[メガハウス]

entries.title: From the TV anime *That Dress-Up Doll Is in Love*, a "Nendoroid Plus Rubber Mascot" figure of Kikawagawa Miu is set to be released!
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『その着せ替え人形は恋をする』より、喜多川海夢の「ねんどろいどぷらす らばーますこっと」が発売決定！

entries.description: General ticket sales for the concert “Lilia Game Music Selection Vol. 3: Kenji Ito with Tsutomu Narita,” to be held on March 13, 2027, at the Kawaguchi General Cultural Center Lilia, began today (October 10) at 10:00 a.m. Tickets are 8,000 yen (tax included) for all reserved seats.

entries.title: The hugely popular 100-player FPS "WARDOGS" is set to shake things up for the Blue Team—which has been suspected of being the "weakest"—in the new season. Players who join the Blue Team will also receive a small bonus.
entries.title_ja: 大盛況100人対戦FPS『WARDOGS』、新シーズンでは“最弱疑惑”の青チームにテコ入れ実施へ。青チームに入ればちょっとボーナスも出る
entries.description: On October 10, BULKHEAD posted a video introducing elements of Season 2 of “WARDOGS.” It appears that adjustments will be made to the Lonestar faction, which has long been considered “weak,” in Season 2.

entries.title: "Comet Bloom," a survival-adventure conversation game featuring "a girl with plants growing from her body," has been announced. Players live out their days as "the end" draws near while interacting with "people who feel strangely familiar even though it’s the first time meeting them."
entries.title_ja: “身体から植物が生える少女“の生存探索会話ゲーム『彗星ブルーム』発表。「初対面なのになぜか懐かしい人たち」と交流しつつ、“終わり”の近づく日々を生きる
entries.description: On October 10, MITOH launched the Steam store page for *Comet Bloom*. The game is a story-driven adventure game centered on the themes of space and plants.

entries.title: Prologue video for “Shikai” released. A brand-new occult suspense film from the staff behind the “Science Adventure” series.
entries.title_ja: 「覗怪（しかい）」のプロローグムービー公開。科学アドベンチャーシリーズのスタッフによる完全新作オカルトサスペンス
entries.description: MAGES. has released a prologue video for its new adventure game, *Shikai*, scheduled for release in the winter of 2026. This unique title comes from the team behind the “Science Adventure” series—which has explored the world’s mysteries through “logic and science” in titles such as “STEINS;GATE”—and delves into “supernatural phenomena” that cannot be explained by science.

entries.title: Just three dice can unleash tens of millions of power. “DiceVaders” is a “dice roguelike” that takes board-game-style engine-building to the digital extreme [Play Report]
entries.title_ja: たった3つのダイスが数千万のパワーに化ける。「DiceVaders」は，ボドゲ的なエンジンビルドをデジタルで極めた“ダイスローグライク”［プレイレポ］
entries.description: "DiceVaders," developed by Pengonauts, is a roguelike dice game set in the same universe as "StarVaders." Players roll three dice and chain their effects together to achieve a high score. Let’s take a look at what makes this game so appealing—it lets you experience the fun of board-game-style engine-building in a digital format.

entries.title: "Sonic Racing Cross World" Reaches New Heights of Chaos with the Addition of "Ayanami," "Asuka," "Godzilla," "Bayonetta," and "Aegis." New Features Revealed in the Early Access Trial
entries.title_ja: 『ソニックレーシング クロスワールド』に「綾波」「アスカ」「ゴジラ」「ベヨネッタ」「アイギス」参戦でさらにカオス極まる。先行体験でわかった新要素
entries.description: "Ayanami," "Asuka," "Godzilla," "Bayonetta," and "Aegis" are joining the lineup in *Sonic Racing Cross World*. I got to try it out.

entries.title: The terror of navigating the darkness by candlelight and the psychological unease that creeps up on you. A hands-on report on “Kindling Hour,” a click-based psychological horror adventure game [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: ろうそくの火で暗闇を進む恐怖と，じわじわ忍び寄る精神的不安。クリックで紡ぐサイコホラーADV「Kindling Hour」試遊レポート［OIGS2026］
entries.description: At the “OSAKA INDIE GAME SUMMIT 2026,” held on October 3 and 4, a demo version of “Kindling Hour,” a psychological horror adventure by game sound designer KuwaPon, was showcased. Here, we’ll share the unique feel of this unconventional title—in which you encounter strange phenomena as you make your way through the darkness—along with comments from the developer.

entries.title: "Kick," a physics-based 2D dribbling school commute action game, is set for release on November 3. Race along your commute route while kicking a soccer ball, and use your dribbling skills to overcome obstacles along the way.
entries.title_ja: 物理演算・2Dドリブル通学アクション『Kick』11月3日配信へ。サッカーボールを蹴りつつ通学路を快走、道中の障害もドリブルで解決
entries.description: On October 10, Shoreline Games announced that it will release "Kick," developed by nospacelost, on November 3 (local time). The game is a 2D side-scrolling soccer game in which players dribble their way through their commute to school.

entries.title: "Coloratis," a collection of color-based puzzle games, has been announced. It features plenty of puzzles that "give your brain just the right amount of exercise," such as "Rolling Colored Dice" and "Mixing Paints in a Single Stroke."
entries.title_ja: 色を操るパズルゲーム集『Coloratis』発表。「色付きダイス転がし」「絵の具混ぜ混ぜ一筆書き」など、“ほどよく頭を使う”パズルがたくさん
entries.description: On October 9, the game's developer, Leo, launched the Steam store page for *Coloratis*. The game features three different types of color-themed puzzles.

entries.title: New escape-the-prison sandbox game *The Escapists 3* announced. The latest entry in the series—the first in nine years—features 3D graphics and lets players freely escape from “five prisons.”
entries.title_ja: 脱獄サンドボックス新作『The Escapists 3』発表。9年ぶりのシリーズ最新作は3Dに、“5つの刑務所”から自由に脱獄
entries.description: On October 9, Team17 announced *The Escapists 3*. This title is the latest installment in *The Escapists* series, a prison-break sandbox game.

entries.title: An exclusive look inside Scopely, the company that has transformed Barcelona into a major development hub in Southern Europe. Introducing a mobile game company that’s actually quite familiar to Japanese audiences.
entries.title_ja: バルセロナを南ヨーロッパの重要開発拠点へと進化させたScopelyに初潜入。日本にもわりと身近なモバイルゲーム企業を紹介
entries.description: Barcelona is buzzing with excitement as it hosts “SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026.” Scopely is one of the companies supporting this city’s growth as a hub for game development. Let’s take a look at this company, which operates “ScopelyExplore”—a service you may have seen in “Pokémon GO.”

entries.title: Chief, it’s time to board! Let’s look back on the journey of “18TRIP” as we head to “HAMA TRANSIT CHECK-IN to Season 2,” where 30 district chiefs await us [PR]
entries.title_ja: 主任，搭乗のお時間です！　「18TRIP」の歩みを振り返り，区長30人が待つ「HAMA TRANSIT CHECK-IN to Season2」へ【PR】
entries.description: Chief, the flight to Season 2 is about to depart! The “HAMATRANSITCHECK-INtoSeason2” promotional campaign for “18TRIP” is currently on display at Minatomirai Station through October 12. From an exhibition looking back on Season 1 to full-body panels of 30 ward mayors, here’s our report on the venue, which has been transformed into an “airport.”

entries.title: Passing on the story of a tragedy that occurred in their hometown through a game. “ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave,” developed by a studio in Bahia [BGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 故郷で起きた悲劇をゲームで語り継ぐ。バイーアのスタジオが作る「ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave」［BGS2026］
entries.description: At the “BrasilGameShow 2026,” which opened on October 9, 2026, AocaGameLab’s “ARIDA 2: Rise of the Brave” was on display. This marked the company’s second appearance following “gamescomlatam 2026” in May, and the demo version available this time could be played in Japanese. Filipe Pereira, CEO and producer, spoke about why he decided to turn the history of his hometown into a game.

entries.title: Survive hell in a game of rigged poker. “Hell Hold’em,” where “666” is the strongest hand, is a highly anticipated title that masterfully blends roguelike elements with Texas Hold’em.
entries.title_ja: イカサマポーカーで地獄を生き残れ。“666”が最強の役になる「Hell Hold'em」はローグライクとテキサス・ホールデムが見事に融合した注目作だ
entries.description: At the “SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026” gaming event, numerous indie titles are on display, drawing attention with their original ideas. Among them, “HellHold’em”—a deck-building roguelike set in Hell—is capturing the interest of attendees with its unique world and robust gameplay.

entries.title: "Naki-goe," a horror game where players satisfy their hunger with insects, debuts on Steam. A terrifying journey through a Japanese-style otherworld that shares its setting with a real-life horror attraction.

entries.title: "Order of the Sinking Star," the first new game in 10 years from the creator of *The Witness*, has already earned a "97% Positive" rating on Steam. With "over 1,000 puzzles," this overwhelmingly dense labyrinth is a true test of endurance.

entries.title: A game developer who generated approximately 88.5 million yen in sales on Steam has candidly revealed that only “13 percent of the revenue” actually ended up in their pocket. However, a heated debate has erupted over the “tricks” hidden behind the numbers.

entries.title: Credit added to your Steam Wallet will actually expire if you don't use it within "six months." Valve quietly updated its "Steam Terms of Service" for Japan.

entries.description: Norsfell announced its new title, “Aftergods,” today (October 9, 2026). You’ll use divine powers to survive, such as gathering resources through storms and summoning temples.

entries.description: I played the first closed beta test (CBT) of *Astrae Oratio*, a new fantasy magic RPG developed by Dynamis One. In this article, I’ll introduce the story where “magic” and “civil service” intersect, the unique turn-based battle system that makes full use of counters and substitutions, and the “Free Time” feature where you can interact with other mages. While the game’s stunning visuals are certainly appealing, there are also areas regarding battle balance and game flow that we hope will be refined in future updates.

entries.title: Kento Nakajima, AKB48, Shoko Nakagawa, Kizuna Ai, Pompompurin, and Kimi Onoda were honored at the “1st Annual Japan Oshi-katsu Awards 2026.” Here’s a report on the inaugural awards ceremony.

entries.description: The “1st Japan Oshikatsu Awards 2026,” which honors individuals and characters who have helped energize the “oshi-katsu” culture, was held on October 7, 2026. Six groups and individuals received awards: Kento Nakajima, AKB48, Shoko Nakagawa, Kizuna Ai, Pompompurin, and Kimi Onoda. On the day of the event, the award recipients took the stage to share their thoughts on what it means to “support” their favorites.

entries.title: Race through mountain passes in battles reminiscent of "Metro Battle." The public road battle RPG "Ghosts of the Mountain Pass" has launched its Steam store page.

Set in Italy in the late 1990s, the game features a series of one-on-one battles where the health bar of the trailing car decreases as the gap between vehicles widens, and players can upgrade their cars using parts earned from victories.

entries.description: The release date for the dungeon-crawling RPG *The Hero Party Has Been Wiped Out* has been set for November 10, 2026. A demo version allowing players to experience the early stages of the game is scheduled to be released soon.

entries.description: Good Smile Company will release the "G.S. Collection Hatsune Miku Cheerleading Ver." figure in November 2027. The pre-order period runs through November 18. The price is 27,800 yen.

entries.title: Get ready to swoon over her captivating swimsuit look! A 1/7-scale figure of Seia from "Blue Archive" is here! Pre-orders are now open at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 魅惑的な水着姿にときめく！『ブルーアーカイブ』セイアが1/7スケールフィギュア化！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: From *Blue Archive*, Seia is now available as a 1/7 scale figure! From her distinctive expression and forehead to her laid-back pose and alluring swimsuit, this figure fully captures that carefree vacation vibe! Now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books! #BlueArchive

entries.title: Pre-orders are now being accepted on Amazon for the second batch of the "30MP Madoka Kaname/Homura Akemi (Walpurgis Reversal Ver.)" bishoujo plastic model kit!

entries.description: Amazon is currently accepting pre-orders for the plastic model kits “30MP Madoka Kaname (Walpurgis Kaiten Ver.)” and “30MP Homura Akemi (Walpurgis Kaiten Ver.)”.

entries.title: A style that epitomizes the original Tifa—like a white sleeveless shirt and black miniskirt! Pre-orders are now open at AmiAmi for the "FF7" Tifa plastic model kit!

entries.description: Tifa from the original *Final Fantasy VII* is now available as an articulated plastic model in the “STRUCTURE ARTS” series! Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi! #FF7

entries.title: Miniature charms featuring Snow Brand Megmilk desserts—such as “Smooth Pudding”—are coming to Gashapon in October!

entries.title: "Makina," the cyborg from "Galaxy Express Milky☆Subway," is being released as a plastic model. It will go on sale in April 2027.
entries.title_ja: 「銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ」よりサイボーグの「マキナ」がプラモデル化。2027年4月に発売
entries.description: Kotobukiya will release the "Makina" plastic model kit in April 2027. The price is 9,900 yen.

entries.title: Hot Toys Releases a 1/6 Scale Figure of the Riddler (played by Jim Carrey) from *Batman Forever*! Features an intricately detailed head, movable eyes, and a light-up mind-control device!
entries.title_ja: 『バットマン フォーエヴァー』ジム・キャリー演じるリドラーをホットトイズが1/6スケールフィギュア化！精巧なヘッド、眼球可動＆洗脳装置の発光ギミックを搭載！
entries.description: The Riddler from *Batman Forever* is coming to Hot Toys as a 1/6 scale figure! Check out the head sculpt—which has cleared Jim Carrey’s likeness rights—and the wealth of accessories, including an LED-illuminated mind-control device! The lineup also includes a Toy Sapiens Limited Edition that comes with a riddle box. #HotToys #Batman

entries.title: "Saiki Kusuo's Ψ-Trouble": Saiki Kusuo is getting a chibi figure in the "Nendoroid" series! You can recreate him with a happy expression holding coffee jelly! A snake and other accessories are included! Pre-orders are now being accepted on Amazon.
entries.title_ja: 『斉木楠雄のΨ難』斉木楠雄が「ねんどろいど」シリーズにてデフォルメフィギュア化！幸せ顔でコーヒーゼリーを持った姿を再現可能！サイなども付属！Amazonにて予約受付中
entries.description: "Saiki Kusuo's Ψ-Incident": Saiki Kusuo is now a Nendoroid! Includes expression parts such as a serious face, a troubled face, and a happy face, as well as optional parts like glasses, coffee jelly, a spoon, and a rhino—allowing you to recreate scenes like him holding coffee jelly with a happy expression! Now available for pre-order on Amazon #SaikiKusuoNoΨNan #Nendoroid

entries.title: "Ichiban Kuji HUNTER×HUNTER Phantom Troupe Vol. 1" is scheduled to go on sale starting Friday, March 12, 2027! The lineup features figures of the Phantom Troupe members!
entries.title_ja: 「一番くじ HUNTER×HUNTER 幻影旅団 ①」が2027年3月12日（金）より順次発売予定！幻影旅団メンバーのフィギュアがラインナップ！
entries.description: "Ichiban Kuji HUNTER×HUNTER Phantom Troupe Vol. 1," featuring figures of Chrollo, Nobunaga, Uboo-gin, Machi, Pakunoda, Coltpi, and Hisoka, is scheduled to go on sale sequentially starting Friday, March 12, 2027! #HunterHunter #IchibanKuji

entries.title: The Ultimate Super Beast U-Killerzaurus from the theatrical film “Ultraman Mebius & the Ultra Brothers” is being released as a figure in the “Movie Monster Series Gika” line. Pre-orders will begin on Preban at 4:00 PM on October 6.
entries.title_ja: 劇場版「ウルトラマンメビウス＆ウルトラ兄弟」究極超獣Uキラーザウルスが「ムービーモンスターシリーズ戯華」で立体化プレバンにて10月6日16時より予約受付を開始
entries.description: Bandai will begin accepting pre-orders for the soft vinyl figure “Movie Monster Series Gika: Ultimate Super Beast U-Killerzaurus” on its online store “Premium Bandai” starting at 4:00 p.m. on October 6. Shipping is scheduled for February 2027, and the price is 12,000 yen.

entries.title: "Homura Akemi" and "Mami Tomoe" from *Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Walpurgis Night* are now available as non-scale figures!
entries.title_ja: 「劇場版 魔法少女まどか☆マギカ〈ワルプルギスの廻天〉」より「暁美ほむら」と「巴マミ」がノンスケールフィギュアで登場！
entries.description: Krenel will release the "Homura Akemi Non-Scale Figure" and the "Mami Tomoe Non-Scale Figure" in September 2027. Each will be priced at 8,800 yen.

entries.title: DAISO’s official mascot, “Daizou,” is making an appearance in the amusement toy market. The line will be available as capsule toys and prize items.
entries.title_ja: DAISOの公式キャラクター「だいぞう」がアミューズメントトイに登場。カプセルトイ、プライズで展開
entries.description: Daiso Industries announced that it will release merchandise featuring "Daizo," the official DAISO mascot, as capsule toys and crane game prizes in October.

entries.title: Hasegawa Begins Shipping Today the Reissue of Its 1/72 Scale Plastic Model Kit, “F-14A Tomcat ‘Atlantic Carrier Air Wing’”!
entries.title_ja: ハセガワ、1/72プラモデル「F-14A トムキャット “大西洋空母航空団”」再販分を本日出荷開始！
entries.description: On October 7, Hasegawa will begin shipping the re-release of its "F-14A Tomcat 'Atlantic Carrier Air Wing'" plastic model kit. The price is 2,860 yen.

entries.title: The LEGO Group and Sanrio have entered into a multi-year partnership. "LEGO Sanrio" sets are scheduled to go on sale starting in 2027.
entries.title_ja: レゴグループとサンリオ、複数年にわたるパートナーシップを締結。2027年より「レゴ サンリオ」セットを発売予定
entries.description: On October 6, LEGO Japan announced that the LEGO Group and Sanrio had entered into a new multi-year partnership.

entries.title: "Avengers: Age of Ultron" Black Widow is now available as a 1/6-scale figure with hair implantation from Hot Toys! Exclusive to Toy Sapiens!
entries.title_ja: 『アベンジャーズ／エイジ・オブ・ウルトロン』ブラック・ウィドウが植毛仕様の1/6スケールフィギュアとなってホットトイズから登場！トイサピエンス限定販売！
entries.description: "Avengers: Age of Ultron" Black Widow Makes Her Debut as a Hot Toys Articulated Figure with Hair Implant Design! The head realistically recreates her reddish-brown bob, and the figure has secured the likeness rights for Scarlett Johansson! The battle suit features LED lighting. #HotToys #BlackWidow

entries.title: Hexagear × MOSHOWTOYS Collaboration: The pre-painted, articulated figure “V-Toll: Base Assault Type ‘Jirei’” will be released in February 2027.
entries.title_ja: ヘキサギア×MOSHOWTOYSコラボ。塗装済み可動フィギュア「ブイトール 陣地突撃型　“疾雷（ジィレイ）”」を2027年2月に発売
entries.description: Kotobukiya will release the "V-Toll Base Assault Type 'Jirei'" by MOSHOWTOYS in February 2027. The price is 25,300 yen.

entries.title: The "Kirby: Chocolate Box Figure Collection" food toy set will be released in March 2027
entries.title_ja: 食玩「星のカービィ チョコボックス ボックスフィギュアコレクション」が2027年3月に発売
entries.description: Bandai will release the "Kirby: Chocolate Box Box Figure Collection" toy-in-food series in March 2027. The price is 385 yen per piece.

entries.title: Must-Have Items for "FF" Fans! Figures of Yuna from "Final Fantasy X" and Zack from "Final Fantasy VII Rebirth" Are Now Available for Pre-order on Amazon!
entries.title_ja: 『FF』ファン注目アイテム！『ファイナルファンタジーX』ユウナ、『ファイナルファンタジーVII リバース』ザックスのフィギュアがAmazonで予約受付中！
entries.description: Figures of Yuna from *Final Fantasy X* and Zack from *Final Fantasy VII Rebirth* are now available for pre-order on Amazon! #FFX #FF7R

entries.title: Prime 1 Studio Releases 1/4-Scale Statues of Guts and Griffith from "Berserk"
entries.title_ja: プライム1スタジオ、「ベルセルク」よりガッツとグリフィスが1/4スケールスタチューで立体化
entries.description: Prime 1 Studio has begun accepting pre-orders on October 6 via the Prime 1 Studio official online store for the statue “Legacy Art ‘Kentaro Miura’ Berserk Guts 1/4 Scale Bonus Edition” and the “Legacy Art ‘Kentaro Miura’ Berserk Griffith 1/4 Scale Bonus Edition” on October 6 via the Prime 1 Studio official online store. The statues are scheduled for release between February and May 2028, and each is priced at 208,890 yen.

entries.title: She looks great in her black bunny suit! Mai Sakurajima from the *A Bite of Youth* series is now available as a prize figure from Taito!
entries.title_ja: 黒のバニースーツが映える！『青春ブタ野郎』シリーズの桜島麻衣がプライズフィギュアになってタイトーから登場！
entries.description: From the "Seishun Buta Yarō" series, Mai Sakurajima in a bunny girl outfit is now available as a prize figure! A Tykle-exclusive edition featuring a different costume color is also part of the lineup and is scheduled to be released in early October! #SeishunButaYarō #MaiSakurajima

entries.title: The third installment of the "Star Wars Pura Pura Mascot" gacha series is themed after Episode I! Featuring a total of five characters, including Qui-Gon Jinn, it will go on sale in mid-October.
entries.title_ja: ガチャ「スター・ウォーズ プラプラマスコット」第3弾はエピソード1がテーマ！ クワイ＝ガン・ジンなど全5種で10月中旬発売
entries.description: Takara Tomy Arts will release the "Star Wars Pura Pura Mascot Part 3" capsule toy in mid-October. The price is 400 yen per play.

entries.title: "DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH"—Tomorrow, the mysterious girl who wields tar, is now available as a 1/6-scale articulated figure in the "Video Game Masterpiece Artisan" series featuring hair implantation!
entries.title_ja: 『DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH』タールを操る謎の少女・トゥモロウが植毛仕様の「ビデオゲーム・マスターピース アルチザン」にて1/6スケールで可動フィギュア化！
entries.description: Hot Toys is releasing a 1/6-scale articulated action figure of “Tomorrow” from *DEATH STRANDING 2: ON THE BEACH*! As part of the “Artisan” series featuring real hair, it will be available exclusively at the flagship store, Toy Sapience! #DeathStranding2

entries.title: The second Trigger from “Infinite Encounter: Megalomaria,” “Sana Akahishi,” makes her debut in Marionette Style! “Metamorphose Unit: Pregeton/Criminal Buster,” scheduled for release in March 2027, will also be released that same month.
entries.title_ja: 「無限邂逅メガロマリア」より二人目のトリガー「赤菱 サナ」がマリオネットスタイルで登場！2027年3月発売「メタモルフォーゼユニット プレゲトーン/クリミナルバスター」も同月発売
entries.description: Kotobukiya will release the "Aka-Hishi Sana [Combat Outfit]" plastic model kit in March 2027. The price is 10,780 yen.

entries.title: "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba" Upper Moon Two, "Doma," is coming as a non-scale figure! To be released by Krenel in July 2027.
entries.title_ja: 「鬼滅の刃」より上弦の弐「童磨」がノンスケールフィギュアで登場！クレーネルから2027年7月発売
entries.description: Krenel will release the "Doma Non-Scale Figure" in July 2027. The price is 6,800 yen.

entries.title: The Day “Apex Legends” and “VRChat” Suddenly Stopped Launching. I Spent “Two Months” Thoroughly Investigating the Mysterious Driver That Was Blocked by the “Easy Anti-Cheat” Anti-Cheat Software
entries.title_ja: 『Apex Legends』『VRChat』が突然起動しなくなった日。アンチチート「Easy Anti-Cheat」に弾かれた謎のドライバを“2か月間”徹底調査してみた
entries.description: A legacy of old software that runs quietly in the background. The manufacturer that distributed it had already withdrawn from the gaming business.

entries.title: "Arknights: Endfield" New Version Introduces New Operators "Su (Voiced by Atsumi Tanizaki)" and "Minho (Voiced by Yuichi Nakamura)." Packed with Content Like "Inn Management and Farming Life"—A Summary of the Special Program
entries.title_ja: 『アークナイツ：エンドフィールド』新バージョンでは新オペレーター「スー（CV種﨑敦美）」「ミンホ（CV中村悠一 ）」実装。“宿屋経営農業ライフ”など盛りだくさん、特別番組まとめ
entries.description: Details have been announced for the new version "Tansei Watari" for *Arknights: Endfield*.

entries.title: "Arknights: Endfield" for Steam Set for Release on October 15. Finally...
entries.title_ja: 『アークナイツ：エンドフィールド』Steam版、10月15日リリースへ。ついに
entries.description: The Steam version of *Arknights: Endfield* will be released on October 15.

entries.title: "Arknights: Endfield" Finally Announces the Arrival of "Rhodos." Exciting Teasers Include a "Driver's Seat View" and What Appears to Be "Warfarin."
entries.title_ja: 『アークナイツ：エンドフィールド』ついに「ロドス」登場告知。“運転席視点”や“ワルファリン”らしき姿など熱いチラ見せ
entries.description: A special preview program for the new version of *Arknights: Endfield*, titled “Danqingdu,” was streamed. During the program, it was announced that Rodos will appear in a future version.

entries.title: The development team behind *Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6)* reportedly filmed on location alongside “local police and gangs.” Even the “dangerous neighborhoods” were inspired by real-life Florida.
entries.title_ja: 『グランド・セフト・オート6（GTA 6）』開発陣は「地元警察やギャング」と一緒に現地ロケしたらしい。“治安悪いとこ”も本場フロリダ仕込み
entries.description: It is said that, in order to depict the fictional state where the story is set, the production team conducted on-site research in Florida, which served as the model.

entries.title: With the evolution of generative AI, mods like “Elden Ring: Mario Edition” and “Fallout: New York Edition” are popping up one after another. Rights holders aren’t staying silent—the line between “creativity” and “infringement” is being called into question.
entries.title_ja: 生成AIの進化で“エルデンリングをマリオ化Mod”や“ニューヨーク版Fallout”など続々と出現。権利元も黙ってない、問われる「創作と侵害」の線引き
entries.description: With the use of generative AI, user-generated content—such as mods based on existing games and IPs—is appearing one after another. There have also been cases where rights holders have requested the removal of such content.

entries.title: "High-Freedom Bouquet Creation": Flower Shop Sim 'Panda Flora' Announced. Grow Flowers and Run a Shop—Pay Meticulous Attention to Every Detail, from a Single Stem to the Wrapping
entries.title_ja: 「自由度高めブーケ作り」花屋シム『Panda Flora』発表。花も育てるし店も経営、花1本からラッピングまでこだわり尽くす
entries.description: On October 6, PandaFlora announced the flower shop management simulation game *Panda Flora*.

entries.title: The high-octane racing game *Star Wars: Galactic Racer* is out today. Featuring multiplayer for up to 12 players, the race with the worst law and order—from the original *Burnout* development team—is on!
entries.title_ja: 激突破壊レース『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』本日発売。最大12人マルチ対応、元『バーンアウト』開発陣が放つ治安最悪レース開幕
entries.description: On October 6, Secret Mode released the racing game *Star Wars: Galactic Racer*.

entries.title: "Escape from Tarkov": Today's new update brings a major overhaul to "PvE Mode." Prestige is finally implemented, PMC bots are less likely to "die in the wilderness," and gear has been upgraded to match your level.
entries.title_ja: 『Escape from Tarkov』本日の新アプデで「PvEモード」がっつり刷新。プレステージついに実装＆PMCボットは“野垂れ死に”減少、装備もレベルにあわせて豪華に
entries.description: On October 6, Battlestate Games began server maintenance to implement Patch 1.2.0.0 for *Escape from Tarkov*.

entries.title: iPhone app developers must submit screenshots compatible with iPhone Duo starting in April 2027. Submissions of compatible builds are already being accepted.
entries.title_ja: iPhone向けアプリ開発者、2027年4月以降はiPhone Duo対応スクリーンショットの提出が必須に。対応済ビルドの提出は既に受付開始
entries.description: On October 5, with the launch of the iPhone Duo scheduled for October 23, Apple provided guidance to app developers regarding preparations for the device.

entries.title: According to the developers, the roguelike RPG *Dead Account* features “short daily playthroughs and deep gameplay.” It’s a brilliant fusion of elements from the original work and high replayability, brought to life by “Denno.”
entries.title_ja: 『デッドアカウント』のローグライトRPGは開発者いわく「毎日の周回は短く、攻略は奥深く」。「電能」が導き出した、原作要素とリプレイ性の華麗なる融合
entries.description: We conducted an interview with Kim Byung-gi, the project director for *Dead Account: Two Blue Flames*. We asked him about user reactions during the early access test and the connection between the original work and the roguelike elements.

entries.title: Market analysis suggests that “free-to-play games are not in decline.” RPGs such as “Narushio” are performing well, though the issue of players juggling multiple games remains a hurdle.
entries.title_ja: 「基本プレイ無料ゲームは衰退していない」との市場分析。『鳴潮』などRPG系が健闘、ただし“掛け持ち”事情がネックに
entries.description: It was noted that playtime for free-to-play games has remained relatively stable, with no significant decline observed. On the other hand, changes appear to be occurring in terms of their content and revenue.

entries.title: "How to Use," a game where you operate a "mysterious device" through sheer determination, has been announced. With no instruction manual and over 15,000 possible actions to try, players must keep experimenting through trial and error until they figure it out.
entries.title_ja: “使い方が謎な装置”を気合で操作ゲーム『How to Use』発表。説明書なし、試せる操作は1万5000通り以上、ひらめくまでひたすら試行錯誤
entries.description: On October 6, RENGAME announced “How to Use,” an intuitive experimental puzzle game in which players must operate a device that comes with absolutely no instructions.

entries.title: In the new version of *Arknights: Endfield*, you can place facilities “directly” from the warehouse. Features like “automatic conversion of expired Rationality Restoratives” have been introduced, making the game much more accessible.
entries.title_ja: 『アークナイツ：エンドフィールド』新バージョンでは倉庫から“直接”設備を置ける。「期限切れ理性回復剤の自動変換」導入など、ぐっと遊びやすく
entries.description: A special preview program for the new version of *Arknights: Endfield*, titled “Danqingdu,” has been released. In addition to new features, the program also highlights various improvements.

entries.title: The mystery horror film *Only Four People Live in This House*, which explores a house where “something” lurks, is now available for free. Beneath the peaceful life of this family of four, something strange is lurking.
entries.title_ja: “なにか”のいる家を見る推理ホラー『この家には4人しか住んでいません』無料公開。4人家族の平和な暮らしには、異常が潜んでいる
entries.description: KAERU has released *Only Four People Live in This House*.

entries.title: "Escape from Tarkov" releases Update 1.2.0.0 today, adding PvE Prestige and significantly revamping PMC bots
entries.title_ja: 「Escape from Tarkov」，PvEプレステージの追加やPMCボットの大幅な刷新を行うアップデート1.2.0.0を本日配信
entries.description: BattlestateGames is releasing Update 1.2.0.0 for the looter-shooter "Escape from Tarkov" today (October 6, 2026). This update introduces major changes to the PvE mode, including a revamp of PMC bots and the addition of PvE Prestige.

entries.title: "Football Manager 27," a soccer club management simulation, has released an explanatory video titled "Tactical Adjustments and the Evolution of the Match Engine"
entries.title_ja: サッカークラブ経営シミュレーション「Football Manager 27」，解説動画「戦術調整とマッチエンジンの進化」を公開
entries.description: Sega released a video today (October 6, 2026) titled “Tactical Adjustments and the Evolution of the Match Engine” for the soccer club management simulation game “Football Manager 27.” The video highlights improvements to player movements and the new “Tactical Adjustments” feature, among other things.

entries.title: Aim to be the fastest in the galaxy in this life-or-death race. “Star Wars: Galactic Racer” is out today, and the launch trailer has been released.
entries.title_ja: 命がけのレースで銀河最速を目指せ。「スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー」本日発売，ローンチトレイラー公開
entries.description: FuseGames and SecretMode released "Star Wars: Galactic Racer," a run-based racing adventure game set in the "Star Wars" galaxy, today (October 6, 2026). They also released a launch trailer.

entries.title: "PSO2 NGS" Official Program Roundup. Level cap raised to 125 starting October 7. New information revealed all at once, including the new equipment category "Amulet" and the ultra-high-difficulty "Star-Shattering Rampage" Rank 3.
entries.title_ja: 「PSO2 NGS」公式番組まとめ。10月7日よりレベル上限が125へ開放。新装備カテゴリ「アミュレット」や超高難度「星砕の暴進」Rank.3などの新情報を一挙公開
entries.description: Sega today streamed "NGSHeadlineWAVE," the official information program for the online RPG "PSO2 New Genesis ver.2." During the program, details were announced regarding the October 2026 update and a collaboration with "Don Quijote: The Hall of Amazing Bargains."

entries.title: "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4" Reveals Various Details About "DMZ," a PvPvE Extraction Shooter Mode
entries.title_ja: 「Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4」，PvPvE形式のエクストラクションシューターモード“DMZ”に関するさまざまな情報を公開
entries.description: Activision Blizzard Japan announced today (October 6, 2026) the latest details regarding the upcoming title “Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4,” scheduled for release on October 23. The information revealed this time pertains to “DMZ,” one of the game’s modes.

entries.title: Pre-orders for "The Ascent Ultimate Edition," a Nintendo Switch 2 game, are now open on the Nintendo eShop
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch 2用ソフト「The Ascent Ultimate Edition」，予約受付をニンテンドーeショップで開始
entries.description: Today (October 6, 2026), KRAFTON began accepting pre-orders for "The Ascent: Ultimate Edition" for the Switch 2 on the Nintendo eShop. The price is 3,500 yen (tax included). A new trailer showcasing solo and co-op gameplay was also released.

entries.title: "Aren't You Curious About What's Inside Your Favorite VTuber?", a document-checking adventure game where you play as a security guard at a VTuber agency and screen visitors, is now available as a demo on Steam.
entries.title_ja: VTuber事務所の警備員となり，来訪者をチェックする書類審査ADV「推しの中身、気になりませんか？」，体験版をSteamで配信開始
entries.description: NEOLAVI began distributing a demo version of its PC game, “Aren’t You Curious About What’s Inside Your Favorite VTuber?” today. In this document-screening adventure, players take on the role of a rookie security guard tasked with manning the entrance to the VTuber agency “Stellaria,” where they must decide whether to grant or deny visitors entry.

entries.title: "HUNGER," a PvPvE horror escape action RPG, will begin its closed beta test on October 19. Fight for survival in a desolate 19th-century Europe.
entries.title_ja: PvPvE型ホラー脱出アクションRPG「HUNGER」，クローズドβテストが10月19日より開催。19世紀の荒廃したヨーロッパで生き残りをかけて戦おう
entries.description: GOODFUNCORPORATION announced that it will hold a closed beta test for “HUNGER,” a PvPvE horror escape action RPG, from 6:00 p.m. on October 19, 2026, through 6:00 p.m. on October 26, 2026. Set in the desolate 19th-century Europe following the Napoleonic Wars, the game challenges players to embark on an adventure to survive in a harsh environment.

entries.title: "Reshine," a simulation game where players beautifully restore treasures that have deteriorated over time, will release a demo version on October 19.
entries.title_ja: 経年劣化した宝物を美しく修復するシミュレーションゲーム「Reshine」，デモ版を10月19日に配信決定
entries.description: On October 5, 2026, QuiteOKGames announced that it will release a demo version of its upcoming title, “Reshine,” on Steam on October 19. This restoration simulation game involves breathing new life into objects that have deteriorated over the years, such as rusty gramophones, old telephones, and weathered toys.

entries.title: Play a survival simulation set in the bitter cold right on your console. The Switch version of “Frostpunk” is set to launch on October 19.
entries.title_ja: 極寒のサバイバルシミュレーションが手元で遊べる。Switch版「Frostpunk」，10月19日に配信決定
entries.description: 11bitstudios announced that it will release the Switch version of the survival simulation game “Frostpunk” on October 19. Featuring touch controls and a dedicated UI, this social simulation—set on a Earth frozen solid by a massive cold wave—lets you enjoy the game right in the palm of your hand as you strive to keep your city alive while managing the discontent of people relying on steam engines to survive.

entries.title: A promotional video highlighting the key features of “Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition” has been released
entries.title_ja: 「トータルウォー：ショーグン2 コンプリートエディション」の見どころにフォーカスした紹介動画が公開に
entries.description: Sega has released a promotional video for "Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition," set for release on October 14, 2026, on its official YouTube channel. The video highlights the game's key features through gameplay footage and developer commentary.

entries.title: "Record of Dorathia," a turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG developed by rdein, the creator of the "Momodora" series, has been announced.
entries.title_ja: 「Momodora」シリーズの開発者rdein氏が手掛ける，ターン制ダンジョン探索RPG「Record of Dorathia」が発表に
entries.description: rdein, the developer of the “Momodora” series, has announced a new title, “Record of Dorathia.” This turn-based dungeon-crawling RPG lets players form a party of four from eight different classes to explore a labyrinthine world. A Steam store page and trailer are scheduled to be released soon.

entries.title: [Game Review] In “GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT,” the protagonist’s mobile suit can be customized to look anything from a classic Gundam to a mass-produced unit. We also experienced boss battles where you can destroy as many body parts as you want.
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］「GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT」の主人公機は，カスタマイズ次第でガンダム顔から量産機風まで変化。部位破壊し放題のボス戦も体験
entries.description: At a media hands-on event for the new Gundam game “GUNDAMROGUEORBIT,” details about the “Assemble” feature were revealed. Players can create a wide variety of mobile suits, ranging from those with “Gundam-style faces” to more understated, mass-produced models. In battles against bosses that regenerate their body parts, players can destroy as many parts as they like.

entries.title: Let's Make Hamburgers Together! "Werewolf Burger," a deduction game where you must uncover the spy hiding among the staff, is now available as a demo on Steam

entries.description: Game developer uracon began distributing a demo version of the PC game "Werewolf Burger" on Steam today. This game is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal in which players build—or shatter—friendships while making hamburgers.

This title is an adventure game in which players drive Thomas and his friends around Sodor Island, and it includes multiple game modes as well as DLC that adds James.

The new additions are the first-person shooter “DOOM,” released by Bethesda Softworks in 2016, and the horror game “Five Nights at Freddy’s: Into the Pit,” released by MegaCat Studios in 2024.

entries.title: Become a streamer targeted by a serial killer and go live as you open the suspicious packages that arrive every day. Gather clues and uncover the truth behind the case in the story-driven horror adventure game “Bet You Won’t”—the demo is now available.

entries.description: TastyPotato has released a demo version of its upcoming title, “BetYouWon’t,” which is currently in development. In this horror adventure game, players take on the role of a streamer targeted by a serial killer. By live-streaming the unboxing of suspicious packages that arrive daily, players gather clues and uncover the truth behind the case.

entries.title: The cross-world MMORPG "AION2" has launched its official service. Explore a world rendered in Unreal Engine 5 with free flight and eight classes.

entries.description: NC launched the official service for the cross-world MMORPG "AION2" today. Featuring visuals and action powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game offers a variety of content, including 8 classes, over 200 customization options, exploration via free flight, solo content, and dungeons.

entries.title: [Game Review] "AION 2" boasts a world approximately 36 times larger than its predecessor. It’s a classic MMORPG that captivates players with its smooth gameplay and high-quality graphics.

entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターアウトランダーズ』は10月29日リリース。新作MMO『AION 2』が正式リリース前から大盛況。『American Truck Simulator』が過去最大の盛り上がり。今週の見逃せないゲーム記事7選

entries.title: Now is the perfect time to play *The Witch of Ihanashi*, a classic, straight-forward "boy-meets-girl" visual novel. At its core lies the question: "How can people who are different from one another learn to live together?"
entries.title_ja: ド直球王道ボーイミーツガールなADV『イハナシの魔女』を今こそ遊んでみよう。核にあるのは「違う人間同士が、どうすれば一緒に生きていけるのか」という問い
entries.description: "The Witch of Ihanashi" is a straightforward "boy-meets-girl" story, yet through the relationship between Hikaru and Lilu—both of whom are "outsiders"—it raises the question of how people with different values can live together.

entries.title: Battle with cute model kits tailored to your taste. We spoke with the developers of the 3D action game “Custom Mecha Girls Fighters” about the fun of customization and combat [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 自分好みの美少女プラモで対戦。3Dアクション「カスタムメカ娘ファイターズ」の開発者に，カスタマイズとバトルの楽しさを聞いた［OIGS2026］
entries.description: "Custom Mecha Girl Fighters" is a game where players create mecha girls by combining their favorite bodies and weapons to engage in one-on-one battles. After trying it out at OIGS2026, I felt that customizing the mecha looked like a lot of fun. We spoke with Director Carbuncle and programmer Yuki Yamada about the project’s origins, the mechanics behind the customization, and future plans.

entries.title: Using kunai as footholds and stopping time to clear a path: How is the satisfying gameplay of the 2D exploration-action game *The Ninja of the Eternal Night* achieved? [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: クナイを足場に，時間を止めて道を開く。2D探索型アクション「常夜渡りの忍」の手触りのよさはどう生まれるのか［OIGS2026］
entries.description: At OIGS2026, I played a demo of the 2D exploration action game *The Ninja Who Crosses the Eternal Night*. You ride kunai thrown into walls and use time-stopping abilities to create footholds in midair. Even for me—someone who isn’t great at action games—it was easy to play, and the dashing and jumping felt satisfying. I spoke with the developer, Cass, about the efforts made to refine the game’s feel and the reasoning behind combining kunai with time-stopping mechanics.

entries.title: A popular series with a 16-year history has evolved into an open-world game. At the Japanese launch event for “Roco Kingdom,” we experienced the ecosystems thriving across the world. [PR]
entries.title_ja: 16年の歴史を持つ人気作がオープンワールドに進化した。「Roco Kingdom（ロコキングダム）」の日本版発表会で，世界に息づく生態系を体験してきた【PR】
entries.description: A press conference and hands-on demo event for the Japanese version of “RocoKingdom,” an open-world RPG scheduled for release soon by Morefun Studios—a subsidiary of Tencent Games—was held on September 21, 2026, at Bellesalle Shibuya First. This report covers the event, where the development team and guests took the stage to introduce the game.

entries.title: "The Book of Prosperity," an action RPG from Hong Kong where you beat up enemies using a math textbook. We spoke with the developer, who has been working on the game alone for seven years alongside his day job [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 数学の教科書で敵を殴る，香港発のアクションRPG「The Book of Prosperity」。本業のかたわら7年間，1人で作り続ける開発者に話を聞いた［OIGS2026］
entries.description: The 2D action RPG “The Book of Prosperity,” created by Hong Kong-based indie developer SingKeys, was showcased at the OSAKA INDIE GAME SUMMIT 2026. We introduced this game, which features timing-based battles using math textbooks as weapons in a world inspired by neon-lit Hong Kong, and spoke with the developer, who has been working on it for seven years alongside his day job.

entries.title: "The Tale of Mina and the Power of Words": A game where you summon rocks with your voice and shift the terrain. We played a demo of this 3D action game that turns words into actions and spoke with the developers [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 声で岩を呼び，足場を動かす「ミナと言霊の物語」。言葉を操作に変える3Dアクションを試遊し，開発者に話を聞いた［OIGS2026］
entries.description: When you say “Rock,” a rock appears; when you say “Elev,” the platform moves. "The Tale of Mina and the Power of Words," which we played at OIGS2026, is a 3D action game that combines controller-based movement with voice commands to summon objects. We’ll introduce the fun of playing with your voice and present an interview with yoshi, the developer who built his own voice recognition engine.

entries.title: How Was “Schrödinger’s Call” Created? A Stage Report from “Yoshi-P Radio” Featuring Achabox Discussing His Early Days and Plans for His Next Project [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 「シュレディンガーズ・コール」はいかにして生まれたか。Achabox氏の下積み時代と次回作の構想が語られた「吉Pラジオ」ステージレポート［OIGS2026］
entries.description: On October 3, Shuhei Yoshida’s live-recording talk show, “Yoshi-P Radio,” was held on the stage at “OSAKAINDIEGAMESSUMMIT2026.” Recorded as a special on-location edition, this episode featured Achabox—who had been scheduled to appear at the third summit, which was canceled due to a typhoon—as a guest, delving deeply into his journey leading up to the creation of “Schrödinger’s Call.”

entries.title: Use the centrifugal force generated by rotational motion to reach the goal. “SP!NG” is a delightful action-puzzle game featuring one-handed tap controls and high-quality sound (Start Today with Apple Arcade #85).
entries.title_ja: 回転運動が生み出す遠心力でゴールを目指せ。片手で遊べるタップ操作と，クオリティの高いサウンドが心地よいアクションパズル「SP!NG」（今日から始めろApple Arcade #85）
entries.description: In our monthly series “Start Today with Apple Arcade,” published on every day ending in 4 (the 4th, 14th, and 24th), we select one game each time from the more than 200 titles available on Apple Arcade and highlight why we recommend it. In this 85th installment, we’re featuring the action-puzzle game “SP!NG.”

entries.title: [Game Report] Get to work, Chief. The Commissioner has dumped work on you and disappeared, and a rowdy trio is waiting in every district. My experience with the first CBT for “Astrae Oratio”
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］働け，主任。長官は仕事を押し付けて消え，どの区にも騒がしい3人組が待っている。「アストラエ・オラティオ」第1回CBTを体験
entries.description: I participated in the first closed beta test (CBT) for *Astrae Oratio*. In this report, I’ll cover the story of a chief—who is just an ordinary civil servant—as he travels through the wizards’ territories in Tokyo while juggling tasks forced upon him by the commissioner, as well as the duel trials where players fight by switching between party members, and what life is like during free time.

entries.title: A New Adventure in the World of Side-Scrolling Action: A Play Report on “Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury,” Where a Cat-Eared Wizard Runs Amok in a Modern City [OIGS2026]

entries.description: Minimum Studio’s new title, “Catgirl Rage: Claws of Fury,” was on display at the “OSAKA INDIE GAME SUMMIT 2026,” held in Osaka on October 3 and 4. Here, we’ll explore the appeal of this title—which marks a bold shift in genre from the developer’s previous roguelike—and share our impressions of the gameplay experience available at the event.

entries.title: "Seeing a project through to completion" is the hardest part. Creating an environment to foster new game IPs in the Kansai region, as discussed at the OSAKA INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2026 [OIGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 「作り切る」のが一番難しい。OSAKA INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2026で語られた，近畿から新しいゲームIPを生むための環境づくり［OIGS2026］
entries.description: The Kinki Bureau of Economy, Trade and Industry views the gaming industry as a growth sector for the region and has begun efforts to foster an environment conducive to the creation of new game IPs in the Kinki region. The first initiative in this series brought together six individuals: Masafumi Kimura of room6, Masakazu Matsushita of HexaDrive, Shunji Mizutani of PLAYISM, Masahiko Murakami of SkeletonCrewStudio, Zenryu Mori of Osaka Electro-Communication University, and Koya Yokota of Directors’ Univ. to host a public session on the theme of “Game Development” at OIGS2026.

entries.description: Tokyo Marui’s main highlights at the “64th All Japan Model Hobby Show” are the “P-90R”—an electric-powered gun with internal modifications intended for ages 14 and up—and the “MP5K+,” an electric-powered gun designed to be compatible with LiPo batteries.

entries.title: Tommy Tech Announces the 5th Installment of “Tetsukore Pocket”! Micro Ace Displays the Final Sample of the “Eidan 3000 Series” [#AllJapanModelHobbyShow]

entries.description: The highlight at the Tomytec booth at the “64th All Japan Model Hobby Show” is the unveiling of the latest addition to the compact model train series “Tetsukore Pocket.” The company is also showcasing a diverse range of other products, including the “World Railway Collection,” featuring trains inspired by overseas models, and new releases from the “Narrow Gauge 80” series, which features small-scale trains designed to run on narrow tracks.

entries.title: His sulky expression is just too cute! From *Inuyasha*, Inuyasha makes his debut as a Noodle Stopper figure!

entries.description: Grey Parker Service exhibited the "Chii-Pura: Chikawa and Her Bicycle" plastic model kit from the "Chiikawa" series at the ongoing "64th All Japan Model & Hobby Show."

entries.description: The S14 booth at the “64th All Japan Model & Hobby Show” features a variety of notable products, such as “Cosmo Tiger” and “Cobra,” but this time we’d like to focus on the “FiGEAR Doronjo 1/8 Scale,” which is making its debut.

Also available now are clear files, acrylic stands, and pin badges featuring original illustrations, as well as a wireless charger! #Bocchi_the_Rock

entries.title: The KATO booth is showcasing a wide range of new products, including the JR-spec “113 Series Yokosuka/Sōbu Rapid Line,” as well as a special track-cleaning vehicle! [#AllJapanModelHobbyShow]
entries.title_ja: KATOブースはJR仕様の「113系横須賀・総武快速線」など多数の新商品を展示、線路をクリーニングする特殊車両も！【#全日本模型ホビーショー】
entries.description: In this article, we’d like to share information about new products exhibited by model train manufacturer KATO at the “64th All Japan Model Hobby Show.” In addition to the JR-spec “113 Series Yokosuka and Sobu Rapid Lines” and the “KiHa 120 Series” manufactured by JR West, a wide variety of new products—including those scheduled for release in December 2026 and January 2027—were on display.

Every manga has a “chapter you’ll want to read today, of all days.” In “Reasons to Read Today,” we select and feature just one chapter each day. *Breakfast at Tiffany’s* Volume 1, Chapter 1: The Morning It All Began. Everyone has their own reason to read this chapter today.  […]
