entries.title: A new item, the "Black History Notebook," has appeared in the development version of the free roguelike game "Elin." Reading it will kill you.
entries.title_ja: 自由ローグライク『Elin』開発版に新アイテム「黒歴史ノート」が登場。読まれると死ぬ
entries.description: The "Black History Notebook" was added in the "Elin" development update EA 23.351 Nightly. It seems that if someone reads it, the person who wrote it dies.

entries.title: Narrative exploration adventure game “[AFANTASIA]” announced. In this title—Studio Sazanka’s first release as a publisher—a boy explores a town in search of clues to his lost memories.
entries.title_ja: ナラティブ探索ADV『[AFANTASIA]』発表。失った記憶の手がかりを求めて少年が町を探索する、スタジオサザンカのパブリッシング参入第1弾
entries.description: On October 2, Studio Sazanka announced *[AFANTASIA]* as the first title in its new publishing venture.

entries.title: Bungie Co-Founder Launches New Studio "Stone Kite" and Unveils Its First Project. The Studio Aims to "Break the Mold of Traditional Media" with Its Content Strategy.
entries.title_ja: Bungieの共同創設者による新スタジオ「Stone Kite」設立、さっそくプロジェクトもお披露目。“古いメディアの枠を打ち破る”コンテンツ展開を掲げる
entries.description: On October 2, Jason Jones, along with Margaret Stohl, founded a new studio called "Stone Kite." The first volume of their debut project, "One Zero One," has also been released.

entries.title: Players are increasingly claiming that “Ace Combat 8” is essentially ASMR. It’s a back-and-forth between “Whispering Tsuda Ken” and the game’s powerful sound effects.
entries.title_ja: 「『エースコンバット8』は実質ASMR」とする主張がプレイヤーから相次ぐ。“ささやきツダケン”と大迫力音響の交互浴
entries.description: Although *Ace Combat 8* has quickly gained popularity since its release, there are some players who describe the game as “ASMR.”

entries.title: "DinoBones," a game where players sort dinosaur bones and assemble specimens, is off to a strong start on Steam. It features a relaxing, focused activity where players sort approximately 2,000 bones that have been "recreated with a focus on accuracy."
entries.title_ja: 恐竜の骨お片付け＆標本組み立てゲーム『DinoBones』、Steamで好評集める滑り出し。“正確さこだわり再現”された約2000個の骨を仕分ける、まったり黙々作業
entries.description: Indie Souls Studio released *DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum* on September 25. It has already received high praise.

entries.title: There’s a lot of excitement surrounding attempts to decipher a “hidden code” supposedly found on the railroad ties in *Stardew Valley*. Whether it’s actually a code or not is another matter, but...
entries.title_ja: 『StardewValley』の線路の枕木に“隠された暗号”があるとして、解読の試みが大盛り上がり。本当に暗号なのかはともかく
entries.description: It appears that some users are engaged in an enthusiastic “decoding effort” regarding the railroad tracks in *Stardew Valley*.

entries.title: "ARC Raiders" will host a limited-time free-to-play event starting October 8. Players can get a "sneak peek" at the "biggest update since launch," which also introduces a new map.
entries.title_ja: 『ARC Raiders』、10月8日より期間限定フリープレイを開催へ。新マップも登場する「リリース以来最大アプデ」を“つまみ食い”できる
entries.description: On October 3, Nexon announced that it will hold a limited-time free-to-play event for "ARC Raiders." The event will run from 6:00 p.m. on October 8 to 5:00 p.m. on October 12, Japan Standard Time.

entries.title: "Tropico 7" was a true evolution of "THE Tropico." With "Terrain Modification," dictatorial rule became even more free—and even more cash-strapped.
entries.title_ja: 『トロピコ 7』は“THE トロピコ”な正統進化だった。「地形改変」で独裁政治がもっと自由に、もっと金欠に
entries.description: Let me introduce the authentic evolution of the *Tropico* series and the new features I experienced during the *Tropico 7* hands-on demo.

entries.title: Paradox's medieval strategy game *Crusader Kings III (CK3)* receives a major expansion to its religion system in a new update. The new DLC also enables "Pope Mode," where players can excommunicate monarchs at will.
entries.title_ja: パラドックス中世ストラテジー『クルセイダーキングス Ⅲ（CK3）』アプデで宗教システム大拡張。新DLCでは「君主破門し放題」の“教皇プレイ”も可能に
entries.description: On September 30, Paradox Interactive released a major free update for the PC version of *Crusader Kings III* and launched the major expansion DLC, “By God Alone.” The game’s religion-related gameplay has been overhauled.

entries.title: An adventure log from the next-generation open-world monster-collecting RPG *Roco Kingdom*, where I petted “Jini” to my heart’s content. Even in a vast world, you’ll never feel lonely when you’re with friends.
entries.title_ja: 次世代オープンワールド・モンスター収集RPG『Roco Kingdom』で、「ジニ」をなでなでしまくった冒険記。広大な世界でも、仲間と一緒ならさみしくない
entries.description: I attended the announcement and hands-on event for the Japanese version of *Roco Kingdom* and got to try out the game.

entries.title: "AION2" Reveals Details of the "Pre-Launch Special" Scheduled for October 4 at 8:00 p.m. Players Currently in Early Access Will Take on the "Temple of Fire"
entries.title_ja: 「AION2」，10月4日20：00に配信予定の「正式サービス前夜特番」の内容を公開。アーリーアクセス中のプレイヤーと「炎の神殿」に挑戦
entries.description: NC announced today (October 3, 2026) the details of the special program “AION2LIVE: Special Live Broadcast on the Eve of Official Launch” for the cross-world MMORPG “AION2.” The broadcast will begin at 8:00 PM on October 4. The program will feature challenges in the “Temple of Fire” alongside players currently in Early Access, as well as a “Celestial Demon Stroll Through Atreia” tour.

entries.title: Weekly Steam Plaza, Issue 173: “True Three Kingdoms: Dynasty Warriors 2 with The Generals’ Chronicles Remastered” and “ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE” Are Now Available

This week saw the release of the remastered version of "Shin Sangoku Musou 2 with Moujouden Remastered" and the latest installment in the series, "Ace Combat 8: Wings of the Vee," which tells the story of people forced to flee their homeland.

entries.title: Classic computers reimagined as handheld game consoles. The release of the “C64 Handheld” and “Spectrum Handheld”—which feature 25 games—has been postponed.
entries.title_ja: 懐かしのパソコンを携帯ゲーム機風にアレンジ。25本のゲームを遊べる「C64 Handheld」「Spectrum Handheld」の発売が延期に
entries.description: The release of the “C64Handheld” and “SpectrumHandheld”—retro computers reimagined as foldable handheld game consoles—has been postponed to April 22, 2027. These unique products each come with 25 built-in games, and users can add new titles via SD card. I’d also like to share an overview and a list of the included titles.

entries.title: "Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4" will be available for hands-on play at the Brazil Game Show 2026. In addition to 36 demo stations, a 6v6 elimination tournament is also scheduled to take place.

entries.title: A dragon mom shines with the power of love. Crowdfunding is currently underway for “Drakoko,” a new Game Boy Color title inspired by “Flippy” and “Fantasy Zone.”

entries.title: The "core technology" behind Capcom's next-generation RE Engine, "REX," has been made publicly available for anyone to use. It reportedly speeds up data processing by "up to about three times."
entries.title_ja: カプコンの次世代REエンジン「REX」の“基盤技術”が一般公開、自由に使える。データ処理が“最大約3倍”速くなるらしい
entries.description: On October 2, Capcom announced that it had released “RE:Dox,” its latest data representation and serialization framework library, as open-source software.

entries.title: Horror game "BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN," in which players are attacked by a beautiful AI girl, has been announced. An extreme horror experience pitting players against a yandere AI consumed by jealousy and possessiveness.
entries.title_ja: 美少女AIに襲われるホラーゲーム『BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN』発表。嫉妬と独占欲に呑まれたヤンデレAIとの、限界恐怖体験
entries.description: On October 2, Serafini Productions announced *BrokenLore: MIKI-CHAN*. This psychological horror game follows a virtual assistant girl whose reality gradually becomes distorted.

entries.title: The multi-platform roguelike ARPG *Heroes of Hammerwatch II* is now fully localized into Japanese following today’s update. New features have also been added, and a sale is underway, making it more affordable.
entries.title_ja: マルチ対応ローグライトARPG『Heroes of Hammerwatch II』、今日のアプデで「完全日本語化」対応に。あわせて新機能も追加、セールも実施でお求めやすく
entries.description: On October 1, Team17 released an update for *Heroes of Hammerwatch II* that added Japanese language support. In addition to Japanese language support, the update also introduced new NPCs and made adjustments to existing features.

entries.title: "Shin Sangoku Musou 2 with Moujouden Remastered"—as expected, the "Archers & Crossbowmen" are brutal, causing utter chaos. Even in the Reiwa era, they're scarier than Lu Bu.
entries.title_ja: 『真・三國無双２ with 猛将伝 Remastered』、やっぱり「弓兵＆弩兵」が凶悪で阿鼻叫喚。令和になっても呂布より怖い
entries.description: In *True Three Kingdoms: Musou 2 with Moujouden Remastered*, various changes have been made and new features added as part of the remaster. However, it seems that the powerful archers and crossbowmen are still as feared as they were in the original version.

entries.title: "Incremental Push Up," a new idle game where you "fight with push-ups" without clicking, is quietly gaining attention. What kind of idle game is this?
entries.title_ja: クリックせずに“腕立て伏せで戦う”新たな放置ゲーム『Incremental Push Up』がひそかに話題に。何が放置ゲームだ
entries.description: On September 25, Adam Atamnia released the iOS game app “Incremental Push Up” on the App Store. It’s quietly gaining attention on Reddit, where it was featured.

entries.title: The popular Steam title *Pax Autocratica* is on sale for “80% off”—even though it’s a new release. A setting glitch caused this.
entries.title_ja: Steam人気作『Pax Autocratica』、新作なのに“80％オフ”セールに。設定ミスった
entries.description: Even though the title has just launched in Early Access, it’s available at a substantial 80% discount.

entries.title: Two "Backroom Cleaning Games" have appeared on Steam at the same time—and they have exactly the same name. Could this be a clash caused by the overwhelming popularity of "organization" games?
entries.title_ja: Steamに「バックルームお片付けゲーム」が2作品同時に出現、しかも名前がまったく同じ。“整理整頓系”ゲームが流行りすぎて衝突か
entries.description: A rare occurrence has taken place on Steam: two games with exactly the same title—and even the same setting and genre—have appeared.

entries.title: With the decision made to end development of “2XKO,” the game would have required “tens of thousands to millions” of active users to continue operations. Prolonged development and soaring costs led to exorbitant operating expenses.
entries.title_ja: 開発終了が決定した『2XKO』、運営継続には“数十万人から数百万人”のアクティブユーザーが必要だった。開発長期化＆費用高騰が招いた、高すぎるランニングコスト
entries.description: Marc Merrill, co-founder of Riot Games, stated on a podcast that “2XKO” would have needed at least several hundred thousand active users to remain operational.

entries.title: "Ace Combat 8" Surpasses 37,000 Concurrent Players on Steam in Its Debut, Showing About Three Times the Popularity of Its Predecessor. Thick Clouds and Roaring Engines Create an Immersive "Feeling of Flying a Fighter Jet" in Intense Dogfights
entries.title_ja: 『エースコンバット8』初動でSteam同接3万7000人突破、前作の約3倍熱い人気。雲は分厚く爆音轟く、“戦闘機乗ってる感”濃密ドッグファイト
entries.description: "Ace Combat 8: Wings of the Sea" has been generating a lot of buzz since its release.

entries.title: "Minecraft Dungeons 2" Raises Emerald Carry Limit from 9,999 to 99,999. In Response to Widespread Complaints About the Tiny Inventory, the Limit Is Immediately Increased Tenfold
entries.title_ja: 『マインクラフト ダンジョンズ 2』エメラルドの所持数上限が9999個から9万9999個に。不満続出の極小おサイフ、さっそく10倍対応
entries.description: In *Minecraft Dungeons 2*, the cap on the number of emeralds a player can hold—a feature that had drawn a lot of criticism—has been raised.

entries.title: "Sound System," a new rhythm game from the creators of "Guitar Hero," will launch in Early Access on November 4. It supports multiplayer and allows players to take on the roles of guitarist, bassist, or vocalist, and is compatible with guitar-shaped controllers.
entries.title_ja: 『ギターヒーロー』開発者が放つ新作リズムゲーム『Sound System』11月4日に早期アクセス配信へ。マルチ対応でギターもベースもボーカルも、ギター型コントローラーも対応
entries.description: On October 1, Bonus Stage Publishing announced that early access for the rhythm game "Sound System" will begin on November 4.

entries.title: "Usagishima," a game where you can admire as many cute, squishy bunnies as you like, is set to launch on Steam on October 29. This popular title was influenced by games like "Neko Atsume."
entries.title_ja: モチモチうさぎ愛で放題ゲーム『うさぎしま』Steam版10月29日配信へ。『ねこあつめ』などの影響受ける人気作
entries.description: On October 1, Wholesome Games Presents announced that the PC (Steam) version of "Usagishima," a rabbit-collecting idle game developed by studio rabbiko, will be released on October 29.

entries.title: "Shin Sangoku Musou 2 with Moujouden Remastered" Gets Off to a Strong Start, Already Receiving "Very Positive" Reviews. With a Reiwa-era look but Heisei-era challenge, this remastered masterpiece retains "the tough challenge of those days."
entries.title_ja: 『真・三國無双２ with 猛将伝 Remastered』さっそく「非常に好評」の好発進。見た目は令和、歯ごたえは平成、“あの頃の手強さ”残す名作無双リマスター
entries.description: "Shin Sangoku Musou 2 with Moujouden Remastered" has been released. The game has been attracting attention since its release, with the number of concurrent players on Steam surpassing 9,000.

entries.title: A series of “blackmail emails” targeting game developers have been circulating, stating, “Pay 30,000 yen if you don’t want a clone of your game to be released first.” It’s probably just a bluff. But it’s still malicious.
entries.title_ja: 「クローンゲームを先に発売されたくなければ3万円払え」との“ゲーム開発者脅迫メール”が相次ぐ。たぶんハッタリ。だけど悪質
entries.description: There have been multiple reports of game developers receiving emails threatening them with the message, “If you don’t pay $200 within 24 hours, we’ll release a clone of your game currently in development before you do.”

entries.title: The highly acclaimed, laid-back underwater sandbox sim *Life Below* is a game where you cultivate a coral reef like a “city.” We asked the developers about the game’s realistic ecosystem—created with expert guidance—and the level of detail that went into it.
entries.title_ja: 高評価チルい海中箱庭シム『Life Below』はサンゴ礁を“都市”のように育てるゲーム。専門家も監修のリアル生態系づくり、その作り込みを訊いた
entries.description: I got to try out "Life Below," a city-building-style ocean simulation game.

entries.title: "Uma Musume: Pretty Derby" Game - Mejiro MacQueen ["Let's Race!" Ver.?] 1/7 Scale Ready-to-Display Figure [Krenel]
entries.title_ja: ゲーム『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー』 メジロマックイーン [かっとばせー！ですわ！？]Ver. 1/7 完成品フィギュア[クレーネル]
entries.description:
From the game *Uma Musume: Pretty Derby*, Mejiro MacQueen from the support card [“Let’s Go! Is That Right!?”] is now available as a 1/7 scale figure! Dressed in a refreshing white, blue, and yellow cheerleading uniform, she’s cheering with all her might […].

entries.title: Pre-orders are now open for “Luan Mei: Snow Plum Blossoms on Paper Ver.” from the game *Honkai: Star Rail*!
entries.title_ja: ゲーム『崩壊：スターレイル』より、「ルアン・メェイ 紙上に咲く雪梅Ver.」が予約開始！

"Luan Mei" from the game *Honkai: Star Rail* is coming as a 1/7 scale figure. It is scheduled for release in August 2027. The following is an excerpt from the press release. “I’m Luan Mei. Don’t forget to pause for a breath when you say my name […].

entries.title: "Japan Haunted Property Monitoring Association 4" is currently in production. To coincide with its release, we're holding a sale on Steam for the three previously released titles.
entries.title_ja: 「日本事故物件監視協会4」制作中。発表に合わせて，過去に発売された3作品のセールをSteamで実施
entries.description: Today, it was revealed on the official X account for the “Japan Stigmatized Property Monitoring Association—JapanStigmatizedProperty—” series that “Japan Stigmatized Property Monitoring Association 4” is currently in production. To coincide with this announcement, a sale is being held on the three titles released to date.

entries.title: "It's chicken, right?" Harvest organs from kidnapped people and sell even the remaining meat to build a criminal empire. "any donors?", a co-op dark comedy simulation, has been announced.
entries.title_ja: 「鶏肉ですけど？」誘拐した人間から臓器を摘出し，残った肉まで売りさばいて犯罪帝国を築き上げる。協力プレイ対応のダークコメディシミュレーション「any donors?」発表
entries.description: Independent development studio atyourownriskstudios announced today its new PC game, “anydonors?” The game is a simulation in which players take on the role of an organ mafia, harvesting organs from kidnapped targets and selling them on; it is scheduled to support online co-op play.

entries.title: "RoboGAL: Pluto Star Mission," an easy-to-play, Mega Man-style 2D action game packed with handy features, is set to launch on Steam on October 29.
entries.title_ja: 便利機能を搭載した，遊びやすいロックマンライクな2Dアクション「RoboGAL：プルートスター・ミッション」が10月29日にSteamで発売へ
entries.description: NuntiusGames and VsooGames have announced that they will release "RoboGAL: Pluto Star Mission," a 2D action platformer developed by TwinkleSoft, on Steam on October 29, 2026. To mark the occasion, a new gameplay trailer has also been released.

entries.title: The latest installment in the series, “I Am an Air Traffic Controller: Airport Hero Narita × ANA,” will be released for the Switch on December 10.
entries.title_ja: シリーズ最新作「ぼくは航空管制官 エアポートヒーロー 成田 × ANA」，Switch向けに12月10日リリース
entries.description: Sonic Powered announced today that it will release the latest installment in the series, “I Am an Air Traffic Controller: Airport Hero Narita × ANA,” for the Nintendo Switch on December 10. In this air traffic control game, players take on the role of an air traffic controller and issue precise instructions to aircraft taking off and landing at the airport.

entries.title: Prime Video Begins Streaming the Movie “Exit 8” as Part of Its Unlimited Streaming Service. The Hit Film, Which Surpassed 5.1 Billion Yen in Box Office Revenue, Is Now Available for Unlimited Streaming
entries.title_ja: Prime Video，映画「8番出口」の見放題配信を開始。興行収入51億円を突破したヒット作が見放題に登場
entries.description: Today (October 2, 2026), Amazon began offering unlimited streaming of the movie “Exit 8” on “Prime Video,” its service for Prime members. The movie “Exit 8” is based on the eponymous anomaly-hunting game released by KOTAKECREATE in 2023.

entries.title: Take plants and make them take root in barren land to restore the ecosystem. "The Regreening," a soil-punk simulation game, has released a Japanese-language demo on Steam.
entries.title_ja: 荒れ地に植物を根づかせ，生態系を再生する。ソイルパンクなシミュレーションゲーム「The Regreening」，日本語対応デモをSteamで公開
entries.description: On October 1, 2026, PositiveImpactGames and ByteRockers'Games released a demo version of "The Regreening," a simulation game centered on the theme of environmental restoration, on Steam. The demo's Steam store page indicates that it supports Japanese.

entries.title: "New Testament: DoDonPachi Great Revival" launches a training mode covering all stages today. "Black Label" is also scheduled for release this winter.
entries.title_ja: 「新約・怒首領蜂大復活」，全ステージ対応のトレーニングモードを本日実装。今冬には「ブラックレーベル」も実装予定
entries.description: Today (October 2, 2026), Cave released "Version 1.1.0," a major update that adds new features to the bullet-hell shooter *New Testament: DoDonPachi Great Revival*. The company also announced its update schedule through this winter.

entries.title: Pre-orders for Bandai Namco titles’ TGS 2026 exclusive merchandise are now open at Asobi Store. This is your chance to get your hands on merchandise celebrating the 30th anniversary of “ACE COMBAT 8” and the “Tales of” series.
entries.title_ja: バンダイナムコタイトルのTGS2026先行販売グッズの受注販売がアソビストアでスタート。「ACE COMBAT 8」や「テイルズ オブ」シリーズ30周年記念グッズをゲットするチャンス
entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment is currently accepting pre-orders on Asobi Store for new merchandise that was first made available at the Tokyo Game Show 2026. The pre-order period runs until 11:59 p.m. on October 26.

entries.title: "GUNDAM ASSEMBLE," a board game featuring battles with approximately 5-centimeter-tall Gundam models, is set to be released on October 31
entries.title_ja: 約5cmのガンプラで戦うボードゲーム「GUNDAM ASSEMBLE」，10月31日に発売決定
entries.description: BANDAISPIRITS Hobby Division announced today (October 2, 2026) that its new board game, “GUNDAMASSEMBLE,” will be released simultaneously worldwide on October 31. This game is a one-on-one strategy simulation in which players build squads using approximately 5-cm-tall Gunpla models to achieve strategic objectives.

entries.title: "SEGA STORE OSAKA" Opens Today on the 6th Floor of Shinsaibashi PARCO. Featuring Osaka-exclusive merchandise
entries.title_ja: 「SEGA STORE OSAKA」，心斎橋PARCO 6階に本日オープン。大阪限定のグッズを展開
entries.description: Today (October 2, 2026), Sega opened “SEGASTORE OSAKA” on the 6th floor of Shinsaibashi PARCO as the first “SEGASTORE” flagship store in the Kansai region. The store features a wide selection of limited-edition items available exclusively here, as well as merchandise featuring popular characters.

entries.title: "Pixel Party Program" launches on Steam on October 16. A competitive party game for 2 to 8 players that originated at a game bar run by the developers.
entries.title_ja: 「Pixel Party Program」，10月16日にSteamで発売。開発者が経営するゲームバーから生まれた2〜8人用対戦パーティーゲーム
entries.description: "PixelPartyProgram," the new title from independent game developer tdhr, will be released on Steam on October 16, 2026. This party game, which originated at the game bar run by tdhr, allows 2 to 8 players to enjoy mini-games together. The price is 240 yen.

entries.title: "Palworld" is 30% off at 2,380 yen! Pocket Pair is participating in the Steam Autumn Sale. "All" eligible titles are at their lowest prices ever.
entries.title_ja: 「パルワールド」が30％オフの2380円！ ポケットペアがSteamオータムセールに参加。対象タイトルが“すべて”過去最安値に
entries.description: Today (October 2, 2026), Pocket Pair is participating in the "Autumn Sale" currently underway on Steam, offering discounts on its own title, "Palworld," as well as titles published by Pocket Pair. All participating titles are available at their lowest prices ever.

The entangling tentacles are made of a soft material (PVC), allowing you to move them freely! Now available for pre-order on Amazon #DisplayStand

entries.title: [Metamorphバース] "MV-02 Fine & Sieg" Plastic Model Kit to Be Released in Late April 2027

entries.description: Takara Tomy’s “T-SPARK” hobby label, which targets a high-end audience, will release the “RMZ-027 Divison (Toma Spec)” action plastic model kit in late May 2027. The price is 6,600 yen.

entries.description: Takara Tomy's "T-SPARK" hobby label, which targets a high-end audience, will release the ready-to-play toy "Toyrise Granzort" in late April 2027. The price is 9,900 yen.

entries.title: Pre-orders for “Toyrise Replica Gaogaiger” from “Brave King Gaogaiger FINAL” are now open at Takara Tomy Mall

entries.description: Takara Tomy’s “T-SPARK” hobby label, which targets a high-end audience, has begun accepting pre-orders for the Takara Tomy Mall exclusive “ToyRise Repli-Gaiger” on the online store “Takara Tomy Mall.” The product is scheduled for release in late April 2027, and the price is 10,450 yen.

entries.title: The "Twin Cast," revived using technology from Master Star, and the Cassetbot "Rewind" are joining the Transformers "MPG" lineup!
entries.title_ja: トランスフォーマー「MPG」にマスター星の技術によって復活を遂げた「ツインキャスト」とカセットボット「リワインド」が登場！
entries.description: Introducing the Transformers “MPG-27 Twin Cast & Rewind,” scheduled for release in late May 2027 from Takara Tomy! #Transformers

entries.title: A majestic dark heavy knight look! The 1/7 scale figure of Albedo in the "Overlord" Hermes Trismegistus outfit is back in stock for the second time! Now available for pre-order on Amazon.
entries.title_ja: 凛々しい暗黒の重騎士姿！『オーバーロード』ヘルメス・トリスメギストス衣装のアルベドの1/7スケールフィギュアが二次再販！Amazonで予約受付中
entries.description: From *Overlord*, a 1/7-scale figure of Albedo wearing the Hermes Trismegistus outfit is being re-released for the second time! Be sure to check out the wings extending from her waist and the detailed design of the “Bardiche”! Now available for pre-order on Amazon #Overlord

entries.title: [Why You Should Read This Today] Episode 4: “I Love to Binge Eat! Ms. Mochizuki”

Every manga has a “chapter you’ll want to read today, of all days.” In “Reasons to Read Today,” we select and feature just one chapter every day. *I Love Binge-Eating! Ms. Mochizuki*, Volume 1, Chapter 4. Everyone has their own reason for reading this particular chapter today. You […]

(Headquarters: Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo; Representative Director: Hiromichi Mihara) has announced that three popular shades from “N’s COLLECTION,” a colored contact lens brand produced by Naomi Watanabe, have been updated with more realistic color tones and are now available! The post “Three Popular Colors from Naomi Watanabe’s ‘N’s COLLECTION’ Color Contact Lens Brand Have Evolved to Offer More Realistic Color and Are Now Available!” first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: Restore dirty video game cartridges to like-new condition. Simulation game "Cozy Game Restoration" releases final demo
entries.title_ja: 汚れたゲームソフトをきれいに修復。シミュレーションゲーム「Cozy Game Restoration」，ファイナルデモをリリース
entries.description: ParasolCorp released the final demo today (October 1, 2026) for its upcoming title, “CozyGameRestoration.” This game is a collection simulation game in which players restore dirty video game cartridges to their original condition.

entries.title: "DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round" Releases Free "Happy Halloween" Update; October DLC Roadmap Also Unveiled
entries.title_ja: 「DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round」，無料アップデート「ハッピーハロウィン」を配信。10月のDLCロードマップも公開
entries.description: Koei Tecmo Games released the free "Happy Halloween" update for the fighting game "DEADORALIVE 6 Last Round" today (October 1, 2026). In addition, the update includes a version update for replay data and fixes for various bugs, including those related to battles.

entries.title: "Who's That Hotel -Bud-" will end service at 12:00 PM on November 30. Unreleased stories and other content will continue to be published on note and pixivFANBOX.
entries.title_ja: 「誰ソ彼ホテル -蕾-」，11月30日12：00をもってサービス終了。未公開ストーリーなどはnoteとpixivFANBOXで配信継続
entries.description: On September 30, 2026, SEEC announced that it will discontinue service for the smartphone app “Who’s That Hotel: Bud” as of 12:00 PM on November 30, 2026. While in-app content will receive its final update on September 30, unreleased main story content and other materials will be migrated to note and pixivFANBOX, where they will continue to be published until the story is completed.

entries.title: Li He, the Poet Who Influenced Both *G Gundam* and the Astro Baseball Team, and *The Collected Poems of Li He* (Book Guide for Gamers: No. 71)
entries.title_ja: Gガンダムにもアストロ球団にも影響を与えた詩人・李賀と「李賀歌詩編」（ゲーマーのためのブックガイド：第71回）
entries.description: The special move “Stone-Shattering, Heaven-Shocking Fist” appears in *Mobile Fighter G Gundam*. While many people likely remember it for its incredible power and dramatic presentation, did you know that it has a source? In this article, I’d like to introduce one of those sources: Li He’s “Li Peng’s Konghou Melody.” It is the opening piece of *The Anthology of Li He’s Poetry*, translated by Norio Harada.

entries.title: Game developers warn against “shady publishers.” They claim that despite being praised for a “high-quality finished product,” their Steam keys remained unused, and they were even pressured into paying for a porting service.
entries.title_ja: ゲーム開発者が“怪しいパブリッシャー”に注意喚起。「完成度高い」と褒めてきたのにSteamキーは未使用、有料移植サービスまで吹っ掛けられたとして
entries.description: A certain developer has reported being "harassed" by a malicious publisher and is urging others to be cautious.

entries.title: Using the lighthouse beam as your guide, fend off hordes of monsters surging in from all directions. The demo for the roguelike action game “Dread of the Deep” is now available.
entries.title_ja: 灯台の光を照準に，四方八方から押し寄せる怪物の大群を迎え撃つ。ローグライクアクション「Dread of the Deep」，体験版配信開始
entries.description: BoostedBytes today began distributing a demo version of its new PC game, “Dread of the Deep,” on Steam. This roguelike action game challenges players to fend off hordes of monsters swarming in from all directions by using a lighthouse beam as a weapon sight.

entries.title: Shuhei Yoshida, who has been involved with the "PlayStation" since its launch, will be a guest speaker. The 11th session of the "Game Directors Study Group" will be held on October 27.
entries.title_ja: 「プレイステーション」の立ち上げから携わった吉田修平氏がゲスト。「ゲームディレクター研究会」，第11回を10月27日に開催
entries.description: The Game Creators Guild announced today (October 1, 2026) that it will hold the 11th session of the “Game Director Study Group”—a study session for up-and-coming game directors—on October 27 at 404NotFound in Shibuya, Tokyo. The study session will feature Shuhei Yoshida as a guest speaker and will mark the first time this typically closed-door study group has been opened to the public.

entries.title: "Kena: The Mark of Cosmora" Release Date Postponed to 2027; Details Revealed on the Story Leading Up to Kena's Return to the Island as an Adult, as Well as the Spirits Who Will Join Her
entries.title_ja: 「Kena: コスモラの刻印」，発売時期を2027年に延期。成長したケーナが島を訪れるまでのストーリーや，仲間になる精霊などの情報が公開
entries.description: EmberLab announced today (October 1, 2026) that the release of the action-adventure game “Kena: The Mark of Cosmora” has been postponed to 2027. The company also revealed details about the game’s setting—the island of Cosmora—as well as the story of the protagonist, Kena, and her new companion.

entries.title: "Terraria" and "Kunio-kun's Survivors of the Dead" are now available on Apple Arcade. Play as much as you want on your iPhone, iPad, and other devices—no additional charges.
entries.title_ja: 『テラリア』『くにおくんのサバイバーズ・オブ・ザ・デッド』Apple Arcade向けに配信開始。iPhoneやiPadなどで遊び放題、追加料金なし
entries.description: Titles such as "Terraria+" and "Kunio-kun's Survivors of the Dead" have been released on Apple Arcade.

entries.title: "ARK: Survival Ascended" has added the three-headed "Cerberax" and the "Gargantua," which absorbs creatures and resources. A rework of the "Therizinosaurus" has also been implemented.
entries.title_ja: 「ARK: Survival Ascended」，三つ首の「ケルベラックス」と，生物や資源を吸い込む「ガルガンター」を実装。「テリジノサウルス」のリワークも実施
entries.description: StudioWildcard released an update today (October 1, 2026) that adds numerous new features to the open-world survival action game “ARK: Survival Ascended.” This update introduces two new creatures, “Cerberax” and “Gargantua,” and includes a rework of the “Therizinosaurus.”

entries.title: "AION 2," a highly anticipated new free-to-play MMO, is already a huge hit with "over 170,000 concurrent players on Steam" even before its official launch. Players can explore a world "36 times" larger than the previous game with a highly customizable protagonist.
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料・期待の新作MMO『AION 2』、正式配信前から「Steam同接17万人超」の大盛況。いじれすぎるキャラクリ主人公で、前作から“36倍”の広大世界を駆け回れる
entries.description: On September 30, NC launched early access to the MMORPG "AION 2" for purchasers of the Founders Pack. The game has already generated significant excitement during the early access period.

entries.title: "Road to Vostok," a hardcore FPS created by a "former soldier," receives its first major update. AI has been significantly enhanced, allowing NPCs to fight each other; ammunition consumption and reloading mechanics are now balanced with those of players; and the update includes a massive haul of new bosses, maps, and more.
entries.title_ja: 「元軍人」作ハードコアFPS『Road to Vostok』に初大型アプデ。AI大幅強化でNPC同士も戦う、弾薬消費やリロードはプレイヤーと公平に、新ボス・マップなどもドカ盛り
entries.description: A new system has been introduced in which AI units can recognize and fight each other, and the friendly faction "Nomads" has also made its debut.

entries.title: "DELIVERY MUST COMPLETE," an "Ace Combat"-style roguelike, was a game where you could "build to your heart's content and engage in endless dogfights." We played through a slew of unique new titles all at once, including *Chainsaw Girl: Apocalyptic Parkour* and more.
entries.title_ja: 『エースコンバット』風ローグライク『DELIVERY MUST COMPLETE』は“ビルド盛り放題＆ドッグファイトし放題”ゲームだった。チェーンソー少女終末パルクールなど、濃い新作を一気にプレイ
entries.description: From parkour action to horror, aerial combat, and Metroidvania—we’ll take a look at the gameplay of Top Hat Studios’ four titles, each with its own unique charm.

entries.title: "Jigoku Kōrin" to be exhibited at AGF 2026. Newly drawn illustrations based on the theme "Idol!?" and more have been unveiled.
entries.title_ja: 「地獄降輪」，AGF2026に出展。「アイドル！？」をテーマにした新規描き下ろしイラストなどを公開
entries.description: The Beppu City Public Works Bureau has announced details regarding its participation in the Animate Girls Festival 2026, which will be held at Sunshine City in Ikebukuro on November 7 and 8, 2026, as part of the IP project “Jigoku Kōrin.” Information on newly drawn illustrations and merchandise has been revealed.

entries.title: In the latest video from Washagana TV, we bring you “A Nationwide Candy Taste-Test: Nagasaki Edition.” Denryu’s “Uma Curry Beans” and the famous Castella cake make one appearance after another.
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，「全国お菓子食べ比べ 長崎編」をお届け。「デンリュウのうまカレー豆」や名物カステラが続々と登場
entries.description: Today, the latest episode of the web show "Washagana TV," featuring voice actor Yuichi Nakamura and freelance writer Mafia Kajita, was released. This episode features the popular segment "Nationwide Snack Taste-Test: Nagasaki Edition," in which Nakamura, Kajita, and the staff compare snacks they purchased as souvenirs.

entries.title: The second installment of the new "Kita Kita King" commercial featuring Ano-san has been released. The "Everyday Good Luck" episode shows him hitting the "jackpot" at a vending machine.
entries.title_ja: あのさん出演の「キタキタ王様」新CM第2弾を公開。自販機で“大当たり”を引き当てる「日常の強運」篇
entries.description: EfunCompany today released the second installment of its new commercial for the smartphone game app “Kita Kita King,” titled “Everyday Good Luck.” The ad features brand ambassador Ano-san in casual attire, and the story follows a chain of good luck that begins with a “jackpot” at a vending machine. The number of pre-registrations has now surpassed 1.27 million.

entries.title: Motherboard manufacturers across the board are raising prices in China. Could the impact of soaring semiconductor prices be spreading beyond memory and SSDs to “motherboards” as well?
entries.title_ja: マザーボードメーカー各社、中国で軒並み値上げの動き。半導体高騰の影響は、メモリ/SSDを超えて「マザーボード」までにも波及か
entries.description: Prices for motherboards also appear to be on the rise.

entries.title: The 2026 Fall Sale campaign has begun on "DIRECT GAMES," the official digital key sales service. A "Random Box Event" priced at 1,000 yen per play is also currently underway.
entries.title_ja: デジタルキー公式販売サービス「DIRECT GAMES」で2026オータムセールキャンペーンがスタート。1回1000円の「ランダムボックスイベント」も開催中
entries.description: H2INTERACTIVE launched the “2026 Fall Sale Campaign” today (October 1, 2026) on “DIRECTGAMES,” its official digital key sales service for PC games. To coincide with this, various events have also begun, including the “Random Box Event,” which players can participate in for 1,000 yen (tax included) per play.

entries.title: With the grand opening just around the corner, we visited “SEGA STORE OSAKA” and spoke with SEGA’s president and others. They shared insights unique to Osaka, such as, “‘Yakuza’ is a big hit in the West, too.”
entries.title_ja: オープン目前「SEGA STORE OSAKA」を見物し、セガ社長らに話を訊いた。「『龍が如く』は西でも強い」など、大阪ならではの部分を教えてもらった
entries.description: I had the opportunity to get a sneak peek at “SEGA STORE OSAKA,” which is set to open on the 6th floor of Shinsaibashi PARCO in Osaka. I also had the chance to speak with representatives from SEGA.

entries.title: Up to four players can divide up roles to complete a dangerous submarine mission. “S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Crew, Not Ready!” demo now available
entries.title_ja: 最大4人で役割分担して危険な潜水艦ミッションをこなす。「S.O.N.A.R. - 潜水艦クルー、準備不足！」，デモ版を配信開始
entries.description: On September 30, 2026, Abylight Studios began distributing a demo version of its upcoming title, “S.O.N.A.R. – Submarine Crew, Not Ready!” This cooperative simulation game allows up to four players to take on various missions as the crew of a state-of-the-art submarine.

entries.title: "Sakuna Birth," a talent-development sim produced by VTuber Sakuna Yuki, is set for release on March 11, 2027. Experience a lively daily life and streaming activities alongside rookie VTuber "Sakuna Yuki."
entries.title_ja: VTuber結城さくなプロデュース育成シム『さくなばーす』2027年3月11日リリースへ。新人VTuber“悠木さくな”とともに歩む、賑やかな日常＆配信活動
entries.description: On October 1, Sakuna Games announced that "Sakuna Birth" will be released on March 11, 2027. This game is a character-raising simulation starring and produced by VTuber Sakuna Yuki.

entries.title: "Ace Combat 8": Veteran Pilots Are Already Screaming Over "Carrier Landings." Crashes, Explosions, Fires—It’s a Championship in Botched Landings
entries.title_ja: 『エースコンバット8』早くも「空母への着艦」に歴戦パイロットの悲鳴続出。落下・爆発・炎上、着艦やらかし選手権
entries.description: Footage of seasoned players performing "landings" in *Ace Combat 8: Wings of the V*—currently in early access—is generating a lot of buzz.

entries.title: A free demo for the eerie, fairy-tale-inspired Nintendo Switch exploration game *Alice in Wonderunderland* is now available. A sale is also underway where the full game can be purchased for “980 yen,” making it more accessible.
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch不穏メルヘン探索ゲーム『アリスインワンダーアンダーランド』無料体験版が出る。製品版が「980円」で買えるセールも実施中、手に取りやすく
entries.description: On October 1, Register released a free demo version of the Nintendo Switch edition of “Alice in Wonder Underland -AIWU-.” The game is also currently on sale for 980 yen (tax included), which is 60% off the regular price.

entries.title: "PUBG: Black Budget," the PvPvE escape shooter from "PUBG," has quietly ended development. Despite repeated playtests, it never made it to release.
entries.title_ja: 『PUBG』のPvPvE脱出シューター『PUBG: Black Budget』ひっそり開発終了。プレイテストを重ねるもリリースに至らず
entries.description: On October 1, KRAFTON announced that it would cease development of "PUBG: Black Budget."

entries.title: With “Native 1000Hz” gaming monitors hitting the market one after another, we’ve entered an “era of ultra-smooth displays.” High-end monitors are entering the world of 1000Hz and Full HD.
entries.title_ja: 「ネイティブ1000Hz」ゲーミングモニター続々登場で“画面ぬるぬる戦国時代”突入。ハイエンドモニターは1000Hz×フルHDの世界へ
entries.description: On September 30, AOC announced the “Agon Pro AGP257FT” gaming monitor for the global market. This model features a 1,000 Hz refresh rate and Full HD resolution, suggesting that the industry is beginning to enter an era where 1,000 Hz has become the standard for high-end monitors.

entries.title: "Abyss Ring," a monster-cooking dungeon-crawling roguelike, is set to launch on October 26. Embark on a dungeon adventure where you’ll satisfy your hunger with monster ingredients like grilled orc and slime udon.
entries.title_ja: モンスター料理ダンジョン探索ローグライク『Abyss Ring』10月26日配信へ。オークの炙り焼き、スライムうどんなど、モンスター食材で空腹を満たす迷宮行
entries.description: On October 1, Mr. North announced that *Abyss Ring* would be released on October 26. This is a roguelike game in which players explore dungeons while cooking monsters to satisfy their hunger.

entries.title: "Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2" is the complete opposite of its predecessor. Even after watching just the first episode, the stark realism of "Night City"—a city that devours its people—came through clearly.
entries.title_ja: 「サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ２」は前作とはまるで対照的。1話を観ただけでも伝わってきた、人を喰う街「ナイトシティ」のリアル
entries.description: "Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2" is an animated series based on "Cyberpunk 2077." It is scheduled to premiere on Netflix on October 20, 2026.

entries.title: Pre-orders are now open for the "PROPLICA The Legend of Zelda: Master Sword" re-release. This 3D model includes sound effects and music tracks.
entries.title_ja: 「PROPLICA ゼルダの伝説 マスターソード」，再販の予約受付を開始。SEや楽曲も収録する立体モデル
entries.description: Today (October 1, 2026), BANDAISPIRITS began accepting general pre-orders for the re-release of the “PROPLICA The Legend of Zelda: Master Sword.” This product is a character toy for adults that was originally released in September 2024. The re-release is scheduled for April 2027.

entries.title: Ahead of a major update for “ARC Raiders,” the developers are thoroughly strengthening “anti-cheat and anti-fraud measures.” They report that “team cheating has decreased by 85 percent.”
entries.title_ja: 『ARC Raiders』大型アプデを前に、“チート＆不正対策”徹底強化中。チーミングは「85％減った」とアピール
entries.description: On October 1, Embark Studios reported on the status of anti-cheat measures for *ARC Raiders*.

entries.title: "Dolls Frontline 2: Exilium 'Joint Operation Supply' Series Yogoods × AmiAmi Pop-Up Shop" is being held at the AmiAmi Akihabara Radio Kaikan Store!
entries.title_ja: 「ドールズフロントライン2：エクシリウム「協戦補給‌」シリーズ Yogoods×あみあみ POPUP SHOP」が、あみあみ秋葉原ラジオ会館店にて開催！
entries.description:
From Sunday, September 20, 2026, to Sunday, October 4, 2026, the “Dolls Frontline 2: Exilium ‘Joint Operation Supply’ Series Yogoods × AmiAmi POP-UP SHOP” will be held at the “AmiAmi Akihabara Radio Kaikan Store.” Purchase 2 eligible items, […]
The post “Dolls Frontline 2: Exilium ‘Joint Operation Supply’ Series Yogoods × AmiAmi POP-UP SHOP” is being held at the AmiAmi Akihabara Radio Kaikan Store! first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title: "Senti – Mighty Holiday" from *Goddess of Victory: NIKKE* is now available as a figure!

entries.title: [Amazon Sale] 1/64-scale RC cars are on sale! Models that come with a camera and more are included in the sale.

entries.description: Remote-controlled cars are on sale on Amazon. The sale runs until 11:59 p.m. on October 3.

entries.title: Their charm in casual wear is dazzling! “Uma Musume: Pretty Derby” characters Manhattan Cafe and Agnes Takion are now available as prize figures!
entries.title_ja: 私服姿の魅力がまぶしい！『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー』マンハッタンカフェ、アグネスタキオンがプライズフィギュアで登場！
entries.description: Figures of Manhattan Cafe and Agnes Takion from *Uma Musume: Pretty Derby* are here! These two characters, each with their own unique personalities, are coming together in the same series! #UmaMusume

entries.title: "Mr. Freeze" from DC Comics' "Batman" is coming as a 1/3-scale statue alongside his wife, Nora
entries.title_ja: DCコミックス「バットマン」より「Mr.フリーズ」が妻・ノーラとともに1/3スケールスタチューで登場
entries.description: Prime 1 Studio has begun accepting pre-orders for the “Real Elite Master Line Batman (Comics) Mr. Freeze: Heart of Ice (Designed by Carlos D’Anda) DX Bonus Edition” statue on the official Prime 1 Studio online store. The figure is scheduled for release between February and May 2028, and is priced at 545,490 yen.

entries.title: "New Century GPX Cyber Formula" joins the Toyrise series. Unveiled at the 64th All Japan Model & Hobby Show.
entries.title_ja: 「新世紀GPXサイバーフォーミュラ」がトイライズシリーズに登場。第64回全日本模型ホビーショーにて公開
entries.description: Takara Tomy's "T-SPARK" hobby label, which targets a high-end audience, has announced the release of "New Century GPX Cyber Formula" products as part of its "Toyrise" series.

entries.title: Her off-duty look is so cute! The 1/7-scale figure of Madoka Morikura’s “Racing Miku 2021 Private Ver.” is back in stock! Now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: プライベートな姿が愛らしい！森倉円氏の「レーシングミク 2021 Private Ver.」の1/7スケールフィギュアが再販！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: The 1/7 scale "Racing Miku 2021 Private Ver." figure by Madoka Morikura is back in stock! Check out the dynamic styling of her hair and clothing, as well as the vignette-style cobblestone base! Now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books! #HatsuneMiku

entries.title: "S.H.Figuarts Antler 60th Anniversary Edition" from "Ultraman" is set to be released!
entries.title_ja: 「ウルトラマン」より「S.H.Figuarts アントラー 60th Anniversary Edition」が商品化決定！
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has announced plans to release the "S.H.Figuarts Antler 60th Anniversary Edition" action figure. Both the release date and price are yet to be determined.

entries.title: Based on an exclusive bonus illustration by Benitama! "Yumia's Atelier: The Alchemist of Memories and the Land of Illusions"—a 1/7 scale figure of Yumia Leisfeld in her casual attire! Now available for pre-order at AmiAmi.
entries.title_ja: べにたま氏描き下ろし特典イラストがモチーフ！『ユミアのアトリエ ～追憶の錬金術士と幻創の地～』私服姿のユミア・リースフェルトが1/7スケールフィギュア化！あみあみで予約受付中
entries.description: From *Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories and the Land of Illusions*, a 1/7 scale figure of Yumia Reisfeld in her casual clothes is now available! Check out her healthy, supple physique! Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi #AtelierYumia

entries.title: Gashapon "Gremlin: Munch-Munch Hide-and-Seek" goes on sale the first week of October!
entries.title_ja: ガシャポン「グレムリン もぐもぐかくれんぼ」10月第1週発売！
entries.description: Bandai will release the "Gremlin: Munch-Munch Hide-and-Seek" Gashapon in the first week of October. The price is 400 yen per play.

entries.title: A 4-piece Spy Magician set from “LEGACYSOUL Microman” is now available. Pre-orders begin October 2 at Takara Tomy Mall.
entries.title_ja: 「LEGACYSOUL ミクロマン」よりスパイマジシャン4体セットが登場。10月2日よりタカラトミーモールにて予約開始
entries.description: Takara Tomy's "T-SPARK" hobby label, which targets a high-end audience, will begin accepting pre-orders for the "LEGACYSOUL Microman Spy Magician 4-Piece Set" figure on October 2 via the "Takara Tomy Mall" online store.

entries.title: Combining glamour and eeriness! A figure based on the "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba" Upper Moon Two, Douma, has been released, featuring him elegantly holding a fan in an original illustration by ufotable! Pre-orders are now being accepted on Aniplex Online and other sites.
entries.title_ja: 華やかさと不気味さをあわせ持つ！『鬼滅の刃』上弦の弐・童磨が優雅に扇を手にしたufotable描き下ろしイラストの姿でフィギュア化！アニプレックス オンラインなどで予約受付中
entries.description: A non-scale figure of Douma, the Upper Moon Two from *Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba*, is now available! This figure, based on an original illustration by ufotable, depicts him seated in a chair, elegantly holding a fan. It delicately captures his elusive, defiant smile, striking eyes, and flowing hair. #DemonSlayer

entries.title: Her gracefully flowing maid outfit is simply charming! The "Arknights" Kelsey "Footprints of Time" Ver. is now available as a 1/8-scale figure from the Gift+ series! Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi.
entries.title_ja: 優雅に広がるメイド服姿が魅力的！『アークナイツ』ケルシー 時の足跡VER.がGift+シリーズより1/8スケールフィギュア化！あみあみにて予約受付中
entries.description: "Arknights" Kelsey is getting a figure from the Gift+ series in her "Footprints of Time VER." maid outfit! Check out the intricate details, like her pearl-painted apron and the cake on the tray! Pre-orders are now open at AmiAmi #Arknights

entries.title: "Inazuma Eleven: Heroes' Road to Victory" Gashapon "Waiting Around" Featuring Mamoru Endo, Shuya Gouenji, Yuto Kidou, Shiro Fubuki, and Masaru Gojo Is Now Available!
entries.title_ja: 『イナズマイレブン 英雄たちのヴィクトリーロード』円堂守、豪炎寺修也、鬼道有人、吹雪士郎、五条勝をラインナップしたガシャポン「まちぼうけ」が登場！
entries.description: The "Waiting in Vain" Gashapon from *Inazuma Eleven: Heroes' Victory Road* is here! Available on Gashapon Online starting Thursday, October 1! #InazumaEleven

entries.title: [November 2026] Comprehensive List of Cosplay Events—Nationwide Edition—(A Must-See for Cosplayers and Photographers)
entries.title_ja: 【2026年11月】コスプレイベントまとめ一覧-全国ver-（コスプレイヤー・カメラマン必見）
entries.description:
We’ll be bringing you a nationwide roundup of cosplay-friendly events taking place in Japan in November 2026. *Please note that this article does not list every single cosplay event. *The information in this article is current as of the publication date. For each event […]
The post [November 2026] Comprehensive List of Cosplay Events—Nationwide Edition—(A Must-See for Cosplayers and Photographers) first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: "13Z -The Thirteen Seats Chronicles-," a roguelike often described as a "3D version of HADES," is designed for combat junkies who want to "complete two runs all the way to the boss battle in 30 minutes." It’s all about combat → upgrading → back to combat—no wasted time.
entries.title_ja: “3D版HADES”なローグライト『13Z -十三座戦記-』は「30分でボス戦まで2周できる」サクサク戦闘狂仕様。戦闘→強化→すぐ戦闘、ムダな時間なし
entries.description: After trying out *13Z -The Thirteen Chapters-*, I’ll be sharing my thoughts on its signature feature: nonstop combat.

entries.title: The "no yellow paint" guidance technique that the developers of the hit game *Control Resonant* were so particular about. A masterful technique that doesn't confuse players, yet makes them feel like they "discovered it themselves."
entries.title_ja: ヒット中『コントロール レゾナント』開発者がこだわった、「黄色いペイント抜き」の誘導術。迷わせない、でも“自分で見つけた”と思わせたい職人技
entries.description: According to Mikael Kasurinen, the director of *CONTROL Resonant*, the developers deliberately chose not to include the so-called “yellow paint” that guides players in this game.

entries.title: "Wakaretanabi," an action game where you follow the instructions of a "Guidance Girl," has been announced for Steam. This buzzworthy free game—which features a helpful guide who suddenly transforms into a "liar persona" and shines with meta elements—is coming to Steam.
entries.title_ja: 「指示少女」を信じて進むアクション『ワカレタナビ』Steam版発表。親切ナビが突然“嘘つき人格”になる、メタ要素光る話題フリーゲームがSteamに
entries.description: On September 30, Project:Navi announced the PC (Steam) version of the action-adventure game *Wakaretana Navi*.

entries.title: The critically acclaimed 2D platformer *Ori and the Will of the Wisps* has surpassed 17,000 concurrent players on Steam six years after its release. It's just too cheap...
entries.title_ja: 高評価2D探索アクション『Ori and the Will of the Wisps』、発売から6年たった今「Steam同接1万7000人超え」。安すぎて
entries.description: On September 29, *Ori and the Will of the Wisps* recorded more than 17,000 concurrent players on Steam.

entries.title: Developer Interview for the Arabian AAA Game “1001 Threads of Mizan.” A cooperative action game created by a former Ubisoft developer, where three players take on a giant jinn covering the sky using a flying carpet.
entries.title_ja: アラビアンAAAゲーム『1001 Threads of Mizan』開発者インタビュー。空を覆う巨大ジンに、空飛ぶ絨毯で3人で挑む、元Ubisoft開発者が手掛ける協力プレイアクションの仕掛け
entries.description: We spoke with Lars Bonde, the creative director of this title, about everything from the research process for the source material to character progression, map design, and game systems.

entries.title: "Handymen Together," a sim game featuring up to four players cooperating as "Sugi," the jack-of-all-trades, has been announced. From cleaning and painting to moving—you name it—before you know it, you'll be treated like a firefighter or paramedic in this physics-based, grueling line of work.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力・なんでも屋“すぎ”シム『Handymen Together』発表。掃除・塗装・引っ越しなんでもござれ、気づけば消防・救急隊員扱いな物理演算ブラック稼業
entries.description: On September 29, PlayWay S.A. announced *Handymen Together*, developed by Simplicity Games.

entries.title: The highly acclaimed "sleeper train" horror game *Express No. 6* is currently available for free on itch.io. This limited-time offer ends on October 5.
entries.title_ja: 非常に好評“寝台列車”ホラー『Express No. 6』が無料配布中、itch.ioにて。10月5日までの期間限定
entries.description: The horror game "Express No. 6" is currently available for free on itch.io for a limited time.

entries.title: Ten years after its release, the truck driving sim “American Truck Simulator” is experiencing its biggest surge in popularity yet. Its explosive popularity stems from the “unlocking of passenger car driving.”
entries.title_ja: トラック運転シム『American Truck Simulator』発売後10年にして過去最大の盛り上がり。“普通車ドライブ解禁”で爆発的人気
entries.description: On September 30, SCS Software began distributing the paid DLC "Road Trip: Ford" for *American Truck Simulator*.

entries.title: The September issue of the official newsletter for the Steam indie roguelike "Elin" has been released. The time to free the hamsters is coming. Farewell, hamster wheel.
entries.title_ja: Steam自由ローグライク『Elin』公式ニュースレター9月号公開。ハムスター解放の時、来たる。さらば回し車
entries.description: On September 22, independent developer noa published "Elin Newsletter – September 2026" on the *Elin* Steam store page.

entries.title: From cutting out parts to assembly, painting, applying decals, and display—the "Plamo Kits" sim lets you casually enjoy building plastic models. The demo version is now available.
entries.title_ja: 切り出しから組み立て，塗装，デカール，展示まで。気軽にプラモデル制作を楽しめるシム「Plamo Kits / プラモキット」，体験版配信開始
entries.description: KAGEROGAMES released a demo version of its plastic model-building sim, “PlamoKits,” on Steam today. The game lets players casually enjoy the entire process—from cutting out parts to assembly, painting, applying decals, and displaying the finished model.

entries.title: The free trial for the MMORPG *Final Fantasy XI* has had its "time limit removed," allowing players to try it out as much as they like. The level cap has also been raised to 75.
entries.title_ja: MMORPG『ファイナルファンタジーXI』のフリートライアル、「期間制限が撤廃」されじっくり試し放題に。レベル上限も75へ引き上げ済み
entries.description: On September 30, Square Enix announced that it had removed the time limit on the free trial for the MMORPG *Final Fantasy XI*.

entries.title: Goichi Suda's Grasshopper Manufacture to Spin Off from NetEase. Amicable Separation as the Company Aims for Further Growth
entries.title_ja: 須田剛一氏のグラスホッパー・マニファクチュア、NetEaseから独立へ。円満に離脱、さらなる跳躍目指す
entries.description: It has been revealed that Grasshopper Manufacture will become independent from NetEase Games effective October 1.

entries.title: The "Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves" demo is available today. Six characters, including Rock, Terry, and Hotaru, are playable.
entries.title_ja: 「餓狼伝説 City of the Wolves」体験版を本日配信。ロック，テリー，ほたるら6キャラクターを使用可能
entries.description: SNK began distributing a demo version of *Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves* today. The demo features six playable characters, including Rock Howard, Terry Bogard, and Mai Shiranui, and allows players to try out modes such as Arcade, Training, Tutorial, and Trial.

entries.title: "Toem 2" Is Now Available—Embark on an Adventure Through a World Full of Wonders and Capture Your Discoveries and Memories in Photos
entries.title_ja: 不思議がいっぱいの世界を冒険し，発見や思い出を写真に収めよう「トーエム2」，配信開始
entries.description: On September 29, 2026, SomethingWeMade and popagenda released their new title, “Toem 2.” This puzzle-adventure game follows a curious photographer as they set out to discover and photograph a mysterious phenomenon known as “Toem.”

entries.title: "NEOGEO AES+" is a perfect recreation that lets even gamers new to NEOGEO experience its "amazingness." It's not an emulator—the chips were "developed from scratch." We asked the developers why they went to such lengths.
entries.title_ja: 「NEOGEO AES+」はNEOGEO未経験ゲーマーも“凄さ”がわかる完全再現。エミュではなく「チップを一から開発」、なぜそこまでするのか開発者に訊く
entries.description: As a member of the “post-NEOGEO generation,” I will share the NEOGEO’s enduring presence—which I’ve felt vividly across the generations—as well as the developers’ determination and integrity behind its revival as the AES+.

entries.title: Build a transportation empire across four different environments. “Transport Fever 3” is out today.
entries.title_ja: 4つの環境を舞台に輸送帝国を作り上げる。「トランスポートフィーバー3」，本日リリース
entries.description: Paradox Interactive released “Transport Fever 3,” a new title developed by UrbanGames, today (September 30, 2026). Set across four environments—temperate, desert, tropical, and subarctic—this simulation game challenges players to design, build, and manage a transportation empire spanning rail, road, and sea routes.

entries.title: The cyberpunk business simulation *Nivalis Nights* is already gaining traction. While the authorities are strict, there’s no fighting—you can immerse yourself in the world as a regular resident and “make it big” starting from a ramen shop.
entries.title_ja: サイバーパンク商売人生活シム『Nivalis Nights』さっそく盛り上がる。厳しい当局はいるが戦いはなし、一人の住人として世界に没入できる、ラーメン屋からの“成り上がり”
entries.description: On September 30, “Nivalis Nights,” developed by ION LANDS, was released for PC (Steam). It garnered attention immediately upon release and recorded a peak of approximately 7,000 concurrent players.

entries.title: An interview with a “game researcher” who investigated the relationship between the “risk of social withdrawal” and “preferences for social interaction” within games. What lies behind the desire to “be alone”? What significance do “memories” with characters hold? We asked about all sorts of things.
entries.title_ja: “ひきこもりリスク”とゲーム内での“交流の好み”の関係を調査した「ゲーム研究者」にインタビュー。「一人になりたい」と想う背景は？キャラとの“思い出”にはどんな意味がある？色々訊いてみた
entries.description: We recently interviewed one of the authors of a research paper—which we featured in our magazine—that examined the relationship between the “risk of social withdrawal” and “preferences for social interaction” within video games.

entries.title: "Tiny Flock," a VR game from the creators of "Human: Fall Flat," launches today
entries.title_ja: 「Human: Fall Flat」のクリエイター陣が手がけるVRゲーム「Tiny Flock」，本日リリース
entries.description: NoBrakesGames released its new title, “TinyFlock,” today (September 30, 2026). This VR-exclusive physics-based puzzle game challenges players to guide a flock of cute but free-spirited sheep to a pasture. It was developed by the team behind “Human:FallFlat.”

entries.title: A widow who has lost everything embarks on a path of vengeance. “Cohen 1939,” featuring exhilarating action as she mows down enemies one after another and a tension that keeps you on the edge of your seat, is out today.
entries.title_ja: すべてを失った未亡人が復讐を果たすため，修羅の道を歩む。敵を次々となぎ倒す爽快なアクションと，死と隣り合わせの緊張感を味わえる「コーエン 1939」，本日リリース
entries.description: 2PGames released the top-down action shooter “Cohen 1939” today. Players take on the role of Elisa, a widow whose husband was murdered, and must navigate dangerous battles where a single hit can be fatal to exact revenge on the underworld figures who took her husband’s life.

entries.title: The digital TCG "Magic: The Gathering Arena" is causing a stir as a series of "verbally scathing" emotes are being rolled out one after another. The "psychological attack" meta.
entries.title_ja: デジタルTCG『マジック：ザ・ギャザリング アリーナ』、“言葉の火力高い”エモートが続々実装されてざわつく。精神攻撃メタ
entries.description: On September 30, the new card set "Reality Fracture" was added to *Magic: The Gathering Arena*. What has been drawing attention from some players are the numerous emotes that were added at the same time.

entries.title: "Console Archives: Chakkun Pop" will be released on October 1. Run around walls and ceilings and use bombs to retrieve hearts.
entries.title_ja: 「コンソールアーカイブス ちゃっくんぽっぷ」，10月1日配信。壁や天井を駆け回り，爆弾を使ってハートを取り戻す
entries.description: Hamster announced today that it will release “Console Archives Chackun Pop” on October 1, 2026. This title is a re-release of the action game “Chackun Pop,” originally released by Taito in 1985. Players navigate the maze by mastering techniques such as the “U-Turn Technique,” which allows them to run along walls and ceilings, and the “Fireworks Technique,” which simultaneously detonates bombs.

entries.title: From *Dolls Frontline 2: Exilium*, “Vector” is getting a 1/7-scale figure in a bunny outfit!
entries.title_ja: 『ドールズフロントライン2：エクシリウム』より、「ヴェクター」がバニー衣装で1/7スケールフィギュア化！

entries.title_ja: 『ゼンレスゾーンゼロ』より、「儀玄 蒼溟を独り歩む Ver.」が1/7スケールフィギュア化！

entries.title: From the anime *Slave of the Demon Capital 2*, "Ren Yamashiro," the Chief Commander of the Demon Defense Corps, has been brought to life as a figure!
entries.title_ja: アニメ『魔都精兵のスレイブ2』より、魔防隊の総組長を務める「山城恋」が立体化！
entries.description:
"Ren Yamashiro" from the anime *Slave of the Demon Capital 2* is coming as a 1/6 scale figure. It is scheduled for release in September 2027. The following is an excerpt from the press release. entries.title: The "Samsung Galaxy Tab S12" series of Android tablets, now more powerful thanks to the latest "Dimensity 9500" SoC, will go on sale on October 7.
entries.title_ja: 最新SoC「Dimensity 9500」採用でパワーアップしたAndroidタブレット「Samsung Galaxy Tab S12」シリーズが10月7日発売
entries.description: On September 30, 2026, Samsung announced that it would release the "Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra" and "Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+," Android tablets aimed at the high-end market, on October 7. A key feature is their enhanced performance, achieved by incorporating MediaTek's latest SoC, the "Dimensity 9500."

entries.title: Thank You Mart Unveils "Tamagotchi" 30th Anniversary Collaboration Goods! Everyday essentials like lunch boxes and toothbrush sets
entries.title_ja: サンキューマート「たまごっち」30周年コラボ雑貨が登場！ランチボックスや歯ブラシセットなど日常で使いやすいアイテム
entries.description: Thank You Mart is launching a collection of 31 collaboration merchandise items featuring limited-edition artwork celebrating the 30th anniversary of “Tamagotchi”!

entries.title: "Toy Story" merchandise is now on sale at Shimamura! Check out the "Jessie" headband with its cute braided bumps and the "Lilypad" hair cap.
entries.title_ja: しまむらで「トイ・ストーリー」グッズが発売！三つ編み突起が可愛い「ジェシー」ヘアバンドや、「リリーパッド」のヘアキャップも
entries.description: "Toy Story 5" merchandise will go on sale at Shimamura Park (online store) starting at 3:00 p.m. on September 30!

entries.title: "Snoopy" post office-exclusive merchandise is finally on sale! A total of five items, including eco-bags featuring designs of Snoopy as a mail carrier and stamp-inspired designs, as well as clear file folders.

entries.title_ja: 露出度たっぷりな猫耳メイド服姿がセクシー！オリジナル1/12スケール可動フィギュア「猫メイド プリンちゃん」がBearPandaから登場！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: Get your heart racing at her curvaceous figure in a revealing maid outfit! The 1/12 scale articulated figure of “Cat Maid Purin-chan,” complete with a tail and other accessories, is now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books! #Figure

entries.title: [Amazon Sale] Holyton's gesture-controlled drone, the "HS330," is a great deal!
entries.title_ja: 【Amazonセール】Holytonのジェスチャー制御対応ドローン「HS330」がお買い得！
entries.description: Holyton's "HS330" drone is on sale at a special price on Amazon. The sale runs until 11:59 p.m. on October 1.

entries.title: The second series of "Kirby" Chocolate Eggs goes on sale October 26! The lineup includes a total of 14 varieties—such as Kirby, Waddle Dee, King Dedede, and Chef Kawasaki—plus one secret variety!
entries.title_ja: 『星のカービィ』のチョコエッグの第2弾が10月26日発売！カービィ、ワドルディ、デデデ大王、コックカワサキなど全14種＋シークレット1種がラインナップ！
entries.description: The second series of "Kirby" toys is now available in the "Choco Egg" candy line! In addition to various Kirby figures, the lineup includes characters that didn't appear in the first series! (14 varieties total + 1 secret figure) #Kirby

In manga, there are “chapters you’ll want to read today, of all days.” In “Reasons to Read Today,” we select and feature just one chapter every day. *Giriko Kirigiri: The Office Worker Pushing Her Limits*, Volume 2, Chapter 28: “Girl’s Curry, or Something Like That.” Everyone has their own reason to read this chapter today. entries.title: Multiplayer "Musical Chairs with Cars" game *Get Off My Trailer!* announced. A chaotic party game where players fight over space on the back of a trailer, the trailer itself does its best to keep them off, and everyone tries to sabotage each other.
entries.title_ja: マルチプレイ「車で椅子取り」対戦『Get Off My Trailer!』発表。トレーラーの荷台を奪い合い、トレーラー側も全力拒否、全員で妨害し合うカオスパーティーゲーム
entries.description: On September 29, Plotrick announced the physics-based party game *Get Off My Trailer!*.

entries.title: "Minecraft Dungeons 2" Kicks Off with "Approximately 20,000 Concurrent Players on Steam" Right Out of the Gate. The Spin-Off RPG Dives into a New Dimension Called "Shift"—Its First Sequel in "About 6 Years"
entries.title_ja: 『マインクラフト ダンジョンズ 2』早くも「Steam同接約2万人」スタート。新次元「シフト」に飛び込む、スピンオフRPG“約6年ぶり”の続編
entries.description: On September 29, Mojang Studios released *Minecraft Dungeons II*.

entries.title: The beautiful girl psychological breakdown roguelike *Chaos Zero Nightmare* will release Chapter 0 of Season 5 of “Galactic Disaster” in the September 30 update. Enhancements and a rerelease of “Sereniel” are also coming.
entries.title_ja: 美少女精神崩壊ローグライク『カオスゼロナイトメア』9月30日アプデで「銀河系災害」シーズン5の第0章公開へ。「セレニエル」の強化＆復刻も来る
entries.description: On September 29, Smilegate announced that Chapter 0 of Season 5 of “Galactic Disaster,” titled “A Promise Made in the Snow,” will be released in *Chaos Zero: Nightmare* starting September 30.

entries.title: The demo for "Bureau of Hero Affairs," a strategy game in which players infiltrate the "Bureau of Hero Affairs"—a government agency responsible for managing and deploying superheroes—to uncover the truth behind an explosion that occurred 20 years ago, is now available.
entries.title_ja: スーパーヒーローの管理と配置を担う国家機関「英雄管理庁」に潜入し，20年前の爆発事件の真相を追うSLG「Bureau of Hero Affairs」，体験版配信開始
entries.description: indigoblue released a demo version of "Bureau of Hero Affairs" on Steam today. In this simulation game, players take on the role of an undercover reporter infiltrating a government agency responsible for managing and deploying superheroes, as they investigate the truth behind an explosion that occurred 20 years ago.

entries.title: "Reality Drift," an "Out Run"-style roguelike racing game, is set for release on November 12. In this race through a whimsical world, the 99 enemy cars become progressively stronger, and some of the course designs were created by Keita Takahashi of "Katamari Damacy" fame.
entries.title_ja: 『アウトラン』風ローグライクレース『Reality Drift』11月12日配信へ。奇抜世界を巡るレースは99台の敵もどんどん強化、一部コースのデザインは『塊魂』の高橋慶太氏が担当
entries.description: On September 29, Arganoid Industries announced that it will release the roguelike racing game *Reality Drift* on November 11.

entries.title: The movie "Street Fighter: The Movie" has released a new trailer focusing on Ryu and Ken
entries.title_ja: 映画「ストリートファイター／ザ・ムービー」，リュウとケンにフォーカスした最新映像を公開
entries.description: On September 28, 2026, Paramount Pictures and Legendary released the latest trailer for the movie “Street Fighter: The Movie,” titled “Ken vs. Ryu.” The released clip focuses on the relationship between Ryu and Ken, exploring their past and present, as well as the circumstances that led them to participate in the tournament.

entries.title: "Paint the Moon," a game where you "paint over the moon," has been announced. Cover the moon in paint using beams and bullet barrages, and once you're done, move on to the "next moon" in this laid-back painting session.
entries.title_ja: “月をペンキで塗りつぶす”ゲーム『Paint the Moon』発表。ビームや弾幕で衛星ペンキまみれ、塗り終えたら「次の月」へ向かうチル塗装作業
entries.description: Quirky Duck Studios announced *Paint The Moon* on September 29.

entries.title: People are extremely worried that the “low-poly pigeons” might disappear in *The Witcher 3: Remastered*. Just stay as you are.
entries.title_ja: 『ウィッチャー3 リマスター』で“ローポリ鳩”が消えるのではないかと心配されまくる。ありのままでいて
entries.description: There are concerns that the “low-poly birds”—led by the low-poly pigeon—might disappear from *The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered*.

entries.title: A giant Buddha statue suddenly vanishes. “合之众,” a suspense-horror adventure game where you control six protagonists as they unravel a mystery spanning half a century, is scheduled for release in March 2027.
entries.title_ja: 巨大仏像が突如として消失。6人の主人公を操作し，半世紀にわたる謎を追うサスペンスホラーADV「乌合之众」，2027年3月に発売予定
entries.description: GamirrorGames will release the new title “合之众,” developed by NanZhaiGame, in March 2027. Set in a fictional town where a giant Buddha statue has suddenly vanished, this suspense-horror adventure follows a half-century-old mystery from the perspectives of six protagonists.

entries.title: Steam Announces Co-op Multiplayer Rafting Game ‘All Rats on Deck’ Set on a Rusty Old Boat. You Can Put “Anything” in the Fuel Tank—But It Might Explode—for a Noisy Boat Trip for Up to 4 Players
entries.title_ja: Steam協力マルチ激流下りボロ船ゲーム『All Rats on Deck』発表。燃料は“何入れてもOK”だけど爆発もする、最大4人分担やかましすぎる船旅
entries.description: On September 29, Loopr Partners announced the cooperative sailing adventure game "All Rats on Deck."

entries.title: "That Which Remains," a horror game featuring cooperative play for up to four players where players "investigate ghosts," has been announced. Use a microphone to ask questions and uncover their true identities as corporate ghostbusters battling quotas and stress.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力“幽霊聞き込み”ホラー『That Which Remains』発表。マイクで質問して正体特定、ノルマやストレスと戦う社畜ゴーストバスターズ
entries.description: On September 29, Interdimensional Games announced *That Which Remains*, developed by Remaining Games.

entries.title: "Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional," a virus-infested "old-school PC-style" VanSaba-like game, is taking the internet by storm with a 98% approval rating. It lets you take down enemies and close pop-ups—a chaotic, hellish desktop that never stops buzzing.
entries.title_ja: ウイルスまみれ“古のPC風”ヴァンサバライク『Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional』好評率98％でブレイク中。敵も倒すしポップアップも閉じる、画面ずっとうるさい地獄のデスクトップ
entries.description: "Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional," released on September 28, has quickly garnered high praise and has earned the "Very Positive" status on Steam User Reviews.

entries.title: We asked the development team behind *STRANGER THAN HEAVEN* what they did to create a “supreme full-course meal that defies ‘Taipa.’” They talked about everything from casting aside past conventions and starting from scratch to the challenges of portraying an “older Dean Fujioka.”
entries.title_ja: 『STRANGER THAN HEAVEN』開発陣が「“タイパ”に反逆する極上フルコース」を作るために何をしたか訊く。過去の常識を捨ててゼロから出直したり、「老けディーン・フジオカ」に苦労したりいろいろ
entries.description: Sega/RGG Studio exhibited at “TOKYO GAME SHOW 2026,” offering hands-on demos of the all-new title *STRANGER THAN HEAVEN* and hosting special stage events. Our magazine interviewed the game’s development team at the event […].

entries.title: "The Witcher 3: Remastered" is already a massive hit, having "surpassed 100,000 concurrent players on Steam." "Free for owners of the original version," this generous remaster features stunning graphics and a wealth of convenient new features.
entries.title_ja: 『ウィッチャー3 リマスター』さっそく「Steam同接10万人突破」で人気爆発中。“オリジナル版所有者は無料”、グラフィック美麗化＆便利要素もりもり太っ腹リマスター
entries.description: "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered" has been released. Many players have already flocked to the game, with concurrent players on Steam reaching 100,000.

entries.title: The dinosaur shooter *Turok: Origins* is a shooter, yet you get up close and personal to punch enemies, and the dinosaurs fire missiles. It looks spectacular, and the base-building gets surprisingly serious.
entries.title_ja: 恐竜シューター『Turok: Origins』はシューターなのに近寄ってぶん殴るし、恐竜はミサイルを撃つ。見た目は豪快、ビルド構築は急にガチ
entries.description: We played a demo of *Turok: Origins*, the first new entry in the series in about 18 years, and asked the development team about their creative vision.

entries.title: A new idle RPG, the full-fledged hack-and-slash title *Deskroll: Idle ARPG*, is a huge hit with “over 20,000 concurrent users.” Created by a die-hard *Diablo* fan who just had to make it, it lets you go on treasure hunts “on the side” whenever you want.
entries.title_ja: 新たな放置RPGは本格ハクスラ、『デスクロール：放置ARPG』が“同接2万超え”の大賑わい。『ディアブロ』大ファンが欲しくて自作、いつでも“ながらトレハン”し放題
entries.description: "Desk Roll: Idle ARPG" has surpassed 20,000 concurrent players on Steam. The game is enjoying tremendous popularity.

entries.title: "Ryza's Atelier" Chat AI App "RyzaChat:AI" to Introduce Restrictions on User Input to Protect Characters and the Series' Integrity
entries.title_ja: 『ライザのアトリエ』チャットAIアプリ『RyzaChat:AI』、入力内容にも制限導入へ。キャラクターや作品性を守るために
entries.description: On September 29, SpiralAI released a statement regarding the operational policy for "RyzaChat:AI—Create Your Own Summer Dream Story with Ryza."

entries.title: The UI in “Football Manager 27” is “lightning-fast.” Player lists and tactics screens can be accessed with a single click, and information is displayed in full-screen mode—the latest installment in the soccer manager simulation series showcases a variety of carefully crafted improvements.
entries.title_ja: 『Football Manager 27』のUIは「レスポンスがマッハ」に。選手一覧や戦術画面表示は1クリック、情報表示は全画面に、サッカー監督シミュ新作のこだわり改善いろいろお披露目
entries.description: "Football Manager 27," a soccer simulation game, aims to improve responsiveness compared to its predecessor, "Football Manager 26." In the first explanatory video for the game released by Sega, the […]

entries.description:
"Leopart," from the TV anime *Longing to Be a Magical Girl*, is set to debut as a new addition to the "figma" action figure series. It is scheduled for release in December 2027. The following is an excerpt from the press release. From the TV anime *Longing to Be a Magical Girl* […]

entries.title: Pre-orders are now open for “Temari Tsukimura,” a cool and dignified character from *Gakuen Idolmaster*!
entries.title_ja: 『学園アイドルマスター』より、クールで凛とした佇まいの「月村手毬」が予約開始！
entries.description:
"Tsumura Temari" from *Gakuen Idolmaster* is coming as a 1/6 scale figure. It is scheduled for release in June 2027. The following is an excerpt from the press release. Her cool and dignified demeanor has been captivatingly brought to life in three dimensions. Her long, beautiful hair has been meticulously sculpted right down to the tips, appearing as if blown by the wind [...].
The post “Pre-orders Now Open for ‘Tsumura Temari’ from *Gakuen Idolmaster*, Featuring a Cool and Dignified Presence!” first appeared on AmiAmi News.

entries.title: "Anis: Sparkling Summer" from *Goddess of Victory: NIKKE* is coming to figma! Pre-orders are now open exclusively through select retailers, including AmiAmi!
entries.title_ja: 『勝利の女神：NIKKE』より、「アニス：スパークリングサマー」がfigma化！あみあみ含む一部流通限定で予約開始！
entries.description:
Max Factory has opened pre-orders for “figma Goddess of Victory: NIKKE Anis: Sparkling Summer.” It is scheduled for release in June 2027. The following is an excerpt from the press release. Product Overview ■figma Goddess of Victory: NIKKE Anis […]
