entries.title: "ReBEAST: Umehara—A Life Bet on 1/60 of a Second," a documentary film featuring an in-depth, long-term look at Umehara, is set to be released on January 29, 2027. A teaser trailer has also been released.
entries.title_ja: ウメハラ選手に長期密着したドキュメンタリー映画「ReBEAST 〜ウメハラ、1/60秒に賭けた人生〜」，2027年1月29日に公開。ティザー予告も解禁
entries.description: The documentary film “ReBEAST: Umehara—A Life Bet on 1/60 of a Second,” which closely follows Umehara over an extended period, will be released nationwide on January 29, 2027, at Theater Shinjuku and other venues. The film chronicles Umehara’s tumultuous year as he takes on new challenges in a fresh environment following his joining the professional esports team “REJECT.”

entries.title: "Dicevaders," a spin-off of "StarVaders," launches today. A deck-building roguelike where you assemble an alien army to invade Earth.
entries.title_ja: 「StarVaders」のスピンオフ作品「Dicevaders」本日発売。エイリアンの軍団を編成して地球を侵略するデッキ構築型ローグライク
entries.description: Playstack today released “Dicevaders,” developed by Pengonauts, for PC, Switch 2, and Switch. In this deck-building roguelike, players take on the role of an alien commander, using dice to assemble an army and invade Earth. Players place units on a grid, roll dice, and execute combos to increase their attack score.

entries.title: "Drawing Song Showdown," a party game where players create drawings based on song lyrics alone, will release its early access version on October 1.
entries.title_ja: 歌だけを頼りにお題の絵を描きあげるパーティゲーム「えかきうた大合戦」，10月1日に早期アクセス版をリリース
entries.description: 2PSTART announced today (September 29, 2026) that it will release the Early Access version of its upcoming title, “Drawing Song Showdown,” on Steam at 5:00 PM on October 1. This game is a party game for 2 to 4 players in which everyone listens to the same sing-along song and draws pictures simultaneously.

entries.title: Set in a school trapped in a loop, the VR-exclusive horror game "Seven Ghost Stories of the School," in which players must uncover supernatural phenomena and escape, is now available on Steam.
entries.title_ja: 舞台はループする学校。怪異を見つけて脱出を目指すVR専用ホラーゲーム「学校の七つの怪談」，Steamで配信開始
entries.description: Hikachof began distributing the PC game “Seven Ghost Stories of the School” on Steam today. This title is a VR-exclusive horror game in the style of “Exit 8,” where players must uncover supernatural phenomena in a looping school while making their way to the rooftop. Classrooms, restrooms, hallways, and art rooms—a variety of room types are featured, with 57 different types of supernatural phenomena awaiting players.

entries.title: "18TRIP" Main Story Season 2, "Reach for the Next Star," will begin streaming on October 9. Seven new characters from KOBE Ward and their cast members have also been revealed.
entries.title_ja: 「18TRIP」メインストーリーSeason2「Reach for the Next Star」が10月9日に配信開始。KOBE区長の新キャラクター7名とキャストも公開に
entries.description: Season 2 of “18TRIP”’s main story, “Reach for the Next Star,” will begin streaming on October 9, 2026. In addition to the announcement of seven new KOBE ward chiefs and the cast, a special advertising campaign featuring all 30 ward chiefs—HAMA and the KOBE ward chiefs—will be launched at Minatomirai Station.

entries.title: Collaboration items from “Yakuza” & “STRANGER THAN HEAVEN” and FREAK’S STORE are now on sale. The collection includes graphic sweatshirts and more.
entries.title_ja: 「龍が如く」＆「STRANGER THAN HEAVEN」とFREAK’S STOREのコラボアイテムが販売開始。グラフィックスウェットなどを展開
entries.description: Today (September 29, 2026), Daytona International released collaborative items with FREAK’SSTORE, the “Yakuza” series, and “STRANGER THAN HEAVEN.” These items are available at select FREAK’SSTORE locations and online.

entries.title: Take on anomalies as a member of a mega-corporation’s special forces unit. “Phantom Line”: The Prologue Edition will be available for free on October 26.
entries.title_ja: 巨大企業の特殊部隊員として，アノマリーに立ち向かえ。「Phantom Line」，プロローグ版を10月26日に無料配信決定
entries.description: AntistaticStudios announced today (September 29, 2026) that it will release “PhantomLine: Prologue,” which allows players to experience the early stages of its upcoming title “PhantomLine,” for free on October 26. The Prologue version will allow players to experience training and the first mission, as well as various elements of the open world.

entries.title: "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered" is out today. In addition to enhanced visuals and a revamped skill tree, the console version now supports mods.
entries.title_ja: 「ウィッチャー3 ワイルドハント リマスター」本日リリース。ビジュアルの強化やスキルツリーの刷新に加え，コンシューマ版もMODに対応
entries.description: CD PROJEKT RED released "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered" today for PC, Switch 2, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. This is a remastered version of the open-world RPG *The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt*. In addition to visual enhancements and a revamped skill tree, the console versions now support cross-platform mods.

entries.title: "Genshin Impact" has revealed details about "Valerie" (Voiced by Shin Furukawa), the captain of a special operations squad composed of elite members. Her Divine Eye is "Thunder," and her Constellation of Life is "Ursus Magnus."
entries.title_ja: 「原神」，精鋭たちで編成された特殊任務隊の隊長「バレリー」（CV：古川 慎）の情報を公開。神の目は「雷」，命ノ星座は「ウルスス・マグヌス座」
entries.description: HoYoverse today revealed details about “Valerie” (voiced by Shin Furukawa), a character from the open-world RPG *Genshin Impact*. Valerie is the captain of the “Special Operations Squad,” a unit composed of elite members of the First Grenadier Corps. Her Divine Eye is “Thunder,” and her Constellation of Life is “Ursus Magnus.”

entries.title: Dig as much as you want in your favorite spots, then use the fossils you collect to assemble skeletons at the museum. The excavation sim "Digging Dinosaur Museum" has been announced and is scheduled for release on October 16, 2026.
entries.title_ja: 好きな場所を好きなだけ掘り進み，集めた化石を使って博物館で骨格を組み上げていく。発掘シム「穴掘り恐竜博物館」発表，2026年10月16日に発売予定
entries.description: Independent development studio YagniLab announced today its new game, *Digging Dinosaur Museum*, scheduled for release on October 16, 2026. This simulation game lets players freely dig wherever they like, bring the fossils they uncover back to the museum, and reconstruct complete skeletons.

entries.title: "HR: Human Remains," a puzzle adventure game set in a world ruled by demons where the protagonist works as an office worker, is now available.
entries.title_ja: 悪魔に支配された世界で会社員として働くパズルアドベンチャー「HR: Human Remains」，配信開始
entries.description: BlackLanternCollective released its new title, “HR: Human Remains,” today (September 29, 2026). This first-person puzzle-adventure game follows the story of an “ordinary office worker” in a world that has collapsed under the rule of demons.

entries.title: uyet Releases Health Survey of 311 VTubers; About 80% Continue Streaming Even When Feeling Unwell

On January 13, 2027, a collaborative event with VTuber Ruden of the Juufutei clan will begin at the Tokyo National Museum. The event will run until March 22. entries.title: ROBOT Spirits “Queen Mansha” 40th Anniversary Edition—Second Round of Pre-orders Starts September 29! An oversized, out-of-the-ordinary Mobile Suit featuring numerous original design elements and markings
entries.title_ja: 「クィン・マンサ」40周年記念のROBOT魂、2次予約は9月29日から！規格外の大型MS、オリジナルのアレンジやマーキングも多数
entries.description: The second round of pre-orders for "ROBOT Spirits <SIDE MS> Queen Mansa ~Marking Plus~" will begin on September 29 at 4:00 p.m. on Premium Bandai!

entries.title: GEO is currently holding a lottery sale for the “30th CELEBRATION” expansion pack, celebrating the 30th anniversary of “Pokémon Card”! Sales are limited to one box per customer; individual packs cannot be purchased.

entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has released preview images for its "METAL ROBOT SPIRITS" action figure series.

entries.title: To commemorate the 30th anniversary of *Sakura Wars*, a limited-edition pocket watch featuring a three-dimensional sculpture inspired by Mitsutake’s Great Divine Machine is now available in a limited run of 2,026 pieces! Check out the dial, designed to resemble the cockpit, and the hands shaped like the twin swords of the Niten Ichi-ryu style!
entries.title_ja: 『サクラ大戦』30周年を記念し、光武の大神機をモチーフとした立体彫刻の懐中時計が2,026点限定で登場！操縦席をイメージした文字盤や二天一流の双剣をかたどった針に注目！
entries.description: Pre-orders for the “Kōbu Daijinki Model” pocket watch—commemorating the 30th anniversary of *Sakura Wars*—will begin on Tuesday, September 29, at 10:00 a.m., with a limited run of 2,026 pieces! The lid features a three-dimensional engraving of Kōbu, the dial is modeled after a cockpit, and the hands are inspired by the twin swords of the Niten Ichi-ryū style! The included card featuring the six members of the Flower Troupe is another highlight. #SakuraTaisen #SakuraTaisen30thAnniversary

entries.title: Collaboration apparel with “earth music & ecology Japan Label,” designed to capture the world of the TV anime *Attack on Titan*, is now available! Full-body panels of Eren, Levi, and Erwin are also on display at participating stores.
entries.title_ja: TVアニメ『進撃の巨人』の世界観を表現した「earth music＆ecology Japan Label」とのコラボアパレルなどが登場！対象店舗ではエレン、リヴァイ、エルヴィンの全身パネルも展示
entries.description: A variety of apparel and merchandise from the “earth music & ecology” collaboration—including a Survey Corps-themed hoodie inspired by the world of the TV anime *Attack on Titan*—is now available! Participating stores are also featuring full-body panel displays of Eren, Levi, and Erwin! #AttackOnTitan #shingeki

entries.title: The popular strategy game *Total War: WARHAMMER III* has surpassed 100,000 concurrent players on Steam for the first time in four years. Its popularity is surging again thanks to a major DLC that adds four new leaders.
entries.title_ja: 人気ストラテジー『Total War: WARHAMMER III』4年ぶりにSteam同接「10万人超え」。新指導者ドドンと4人追加の大型DLCで一気に人気再燃中
entries.description: "Total War: WARHAMMER III," developed by Creative Assembly, has surpassed 100,000 concurrent players on Steam. This marks the first time the game has reached the 100,000 mark in about four years, since August 2022.

entries.title: "WARLOCK," an action RPG based on "Dungeons & Dragons," aims to recreate the extreme freedom of tabletop role-playing games through "magic." Where did this gameplay—which doesn't dictate to players but instead challenges their creativity—come from?
entries.title_ja: 『ダンジョンズ&ドラゴンズ』のアクションRPG『WARLOCK』は、TRPGの超自由度を「魔法」で再現したい。プレイヤーに指示しない、創造力試すゲームプレイはどこから来たか
entries.description: We spoke with developers at Invoke Studios about the background and specific gameplay of *WARLOCK*.

entries.title: "Normal Golf Game," a golf sim that calls itself "ordinary," has quickly become a huge hit with a "98% approval rating." It's a physics-based, hardcore golf game, but the courses are all kinds of weird.
entries.title_ja: “自称普通”のゴルフシム『Normal Golf Game』、さっそく「好評率98％」の大人気。物理演算ガチゴルフ、だけどコースはいろいろ変
entries.description: On September 21, Luke Muscat released "Normal Golf Game."

entries.title: The "overly helpful hints" in the PS5 game *Marvel's Wolverine*, which divided opinions, can now be partially hidden via an update. Players can reduce the "scent navigation" feature—which even guides you along the path—to enjoy the game their way.
entries.title_ja: PS5『マーベル ウルヴァリン』で賛否分かれた「親切すぎるヒント」、アプデで一部非表示にできるように。道まで教える“匂いナビ”、減らして遊べる
entries.description: Regarding the on-screen prompts in *Marvel’s Wolverine*—which had sparked mixed reactions for being “too helpful”—it is now possible to hide them in the settings.

entries.title: In *Gakuen Idolmaster (Gakumasu)*, the "Another P Idol Liberalization" update is here. You can now produce your favorite P idols with Another songs—even those other than the initial SSR idols.
entries.title_ja: 『学園アイドルマスター（学マス）』にて「アナザーPアイドル自由化」へ。初期SSR以外でもOK、好きなPアイドルをアナザー楽曲でプロデュースできる
entries.description: On September 28, Bandai Namco Entertainment announced that it will implement the “Another P Idol Liberalization” feature in *Gakuen Idolmaster* (Gakumasu) in mid-October.

entries.title: Excitement is building for the free-to-play FPS “AVA RE:BIRTH,” which has expanded the number of spots for its closed beta test to 5,000. With less than 24 hours remaining until the application deadline, the number of spots was suddenly increased by 2.5 times due to the high volume of applications.
entries.title_ja: 期待高まる基本無料FPS『AVA RE:BIRTH』、クローズドβテスト参加枠を5000人に拡大。募集締め切りまで24時間を切る中で急遽2.5倍に、応募多数につき
entries.description: The company announced that it will expand the number of participants in the closed beta test for the online FPS "AVA RE:BIRTH" from the originally planned 2,000 to 5,000.

entries.title: The "Kingdom Rush" tower defense series, now in its 15th year, has seen a new installment released—yet for some reason, the original game is generating far more excitement. With "just under 20,000 concurrent users," it has significantly surpassed its previous record.
entries.title_ja: 15年続くタワーディフェンス『Kingdom Rush』シリーズ、新作が出たのになぜか初代のほうが大盛り上がり。“同接2万弱”で過去最高値を大幅更新
entries.description: Although "Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD" has been released, the first game in the series, "Kingdom Rush - Tower Defense," is actually generating more buzz than the new title.

entries.title: In *Fire Emblem: A Thousand Blossoms*, the mysterious concept of “Brigand University” is introduced. If your stats don’t improve, you’ll have to “repeat a year”—it’s a university focused on power.
entries.title_ja: 『ファイアーエムブレム 万紫千紅』にて謎の「ブリガンド大学」なる概念生まれる。力が伸びなきゃ“留年”、パワー系大学
entries.description: An internet meme called “Brigand University” has emerged in connection with strategies for leveling up physical-type classes in *Fire Emblem: A Thousand Blossoms*.

entries.title: In the Nordic mythology survival game *Valheim*, a player has recreated that village from *Skyrim*. The level of detail is so impressive that it’s even causing “collective auditory hallucinations.”
entries.title_ja: 北欧神話サバイバル『Valheim』にて、『スカイリム』のあの村を再現したプレイヤー現る。あまりの完成度に“集団幻聴”も
entries.description: In *Valheim*, a player has recreated an entire village from another open-world game.

entries.title: "Witch the Showdown," a game combining deck-building with fast-paced parry action, was a paradise for parry enthusiasts. The shrewd reason behind deliberately releasing it on the same day as "GTA 6."
entries.title_ja: デッキ構築×高速パリィアクション『Witch the Showdown』は、パリィ好きにとって遊園地だった。『GTA 6』配信開始日にあえて被せた、そのしたたかな理由
entries.description: In conjunction with the Tokyo Game Show 2026, we played a demo of *Witch the Showdown* and interviewed the development team. We assessed the game’s quality and asked about their reasoning for scheduling its release to coincide with *GTA 6*.

entries.title: "AQUA FALL," a high-speed water slide racing game supporting up to 8 players, debuts on Steam. Race toward the finish line at 100 km/h—and take risky "off-course shortcuts" if you dare.
entries.title_ja: 最大8人マルチ対応・ウォータースライダー爆走レース『AQUA FALL』Steamにてお披露目。時速100キロでゴールまっしぐら、一か八かの“場外ショートカット”も可
entries.description: On September 28, Tatsumaki Games launched the Steam store page for its party racing game, “AQUA FALL.”

entries.title: The supernatural photography horror game *Shinjuku Anomaly* is set to launch on September 30. It’s a part-time job where you “just” photograph supernatural phenomena—you want to get a close-up, but you can’t get too close.
entries.title_ja: 怪異撮影ホラーゲーム『新宿異変』9月30日配信へ。怪異を撮影する“だけ”のアルバイト、アップで撮りたいけど、近寄り過ぎてはダメ
entries.description: On September 28, AMATA Games announced that it will release the horror visual novel game *Shinjuku Incident* at 10:00 a.m. on September 30.

entries.title: "Minecraft" attracts "an average of more than 300,000 new players" every day. Seventeen years after its launch, its momentum shows no signs of slowing down.
entries.title_ja: 『マインクラフト』には毎日「平均30万人以上の新規プレイヤー」がいる。誕生から17年、今でも勢い衰えず
entries.description: On September 27, Asha Sharma, CEO of Xbox, revealed that, on average, more than 300,000 users play *Minecraft* for the first time every day.

entries.title: “Operator Files for Bankruptcy”: The offline version of “Link! Like! Love Live! (Linkra)” will end distribution on “October 30.” If you want to keep a copy, now’s the time.
entries.title_ja: “運営元が破産”『Link！Like！ラブライブ！（リンクラ）』オフライン版は「10月30日」で配信終了へ。手元に残すなら今のうち
entries.description: On September 28, Odd Number announced details regarding support for "Link! Like! Love Live! (Link! Like! Love Live! Hasu no Sora School Idol Club)."

entries.title: The developers of the highly anticipated space RPG *EXODUS* say they’re “more than ready to challenge players.” When *Mass Effect* fans tried it out, they immediately found themselves scratching their heads over the “ultimate choice.”
entries.title_ja: 注目の宇宙RPG『EXODUS』開発者は“プレイヤーを悩ませる気満々”。『Mass Effect』ファンが試遊したら、さっそく「究極の選択」で頭を抱えた
entries.description: We’ll explore what kind of game *EXODUS*—developed by a master of space opera ARPGs—will ultimately be, based on our hands-on experience and a Q&A with the developers.

entries.title: From *Azur Lane*, “Anchorage: Exchange Dormitory Ver.” is now available as a 1/8-scale figure!

entries.title: Repeating the same day over and over to save a girl who is destined to die. The psychological horror adventure game "Akeno Yosuga - Twilight Loop -" is now available as a demo on Steam.
entries.title_ja: 必ず死んでしまう少女を救うために1日を繰り返す。心理ホラーADV「アケノヨスガ - Twilight Loop -」，デモ版をSteamで配信開始
entries.description: STUDIOCHARON began distributing a demo version of its PC game “Akeno Yosuga -Twilight Loop-” on Steam today. This psychological horror adventure game follows a man haunted by a girl’s death as he relives the same day over and over in an attempt to save her.

entries.title: Interact with the stream through comments and tips to track down your missing favorite streamer. The psychological horror adventure game “Tsumimi Jikan: I Love You So Much It’s Crazy” has released its latest, expanded demo version, “Final Demo.”
entries.title_ja: コメントや投げ銭で配信に介入し，失踪した推しの行方を追う。サイコホラーADV「つみみじかん 狂オシイホド愛シテル」，内容を拡充した最新体験版“Final Demo”を配信開始
entries.description: Today, Tomoshira Co. began distributing the latest demo version, “FinalDemo,” for its new PC title, *I Love You So Much It’s Crazy: Tsumimiji Time*, on Steam. In the FinalDemo, character voices have been added, and the playable content has been expanded to include part of DAY 7.

entries.title: Discover anomalies in an infinitely looping Japanese-style aquarium and aim to escape from Area 8. "Suzuchina Aquarium," an anomaly-hunting game in the style of Exit 8, has been announced.
entries.title_ja: 無限にループする日本風の水族館で異変を見つけ，エリア8からの脱出を目指す。8番出口ライクの異変探しゲーム「すずちな水族館 / Suzuchina Aquarium」発表
entries.description: SuzuchinaGames has announced its new PC title, “Suzuchina Aquarium.” Set in an infinitely looping, Japanese-style aquarium, this mystery-solving game challenges players to spot anomalies in their surroundings while attempting to escape from Area 8.

entries.title: Report on the “‘TINGS’ Plush Keychain Launch Celebration! ‘Shine Post’ Special Talk Show.” Actually, the company behind 4Gamer is the one that came up with the idea for the plush toys [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 「『TINGS』ぬいぐるみキーホルダー発売記念！　『シャインポスト』スペシャルトークショー」レポート。実はぬいぐるみを企画したの，4Gamerの会社なんです［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the 4Gamer booth during the Tokyo Game Show 2026, a special talk show titled “Celebrating the Release of the ‘TINGS’ Plush Keychains! ‘Shine Post’ Special Talk Show” was held. Here is a report on the talk show, which featured Rika Nakagawa, the voice of Momiji Ito, and Rimo Hasegawa, the voice of Yukine Gionji.

entries.title: Did the entry of major PC manufacturers and the surge in memory prices affect ONEXPLAYER’s portable gaming PC? An exclusive interview with the CEO during his visit to Japan [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 大手PCメーカーの参入やメモリ価格の高騰は，ONEXPLAYERの携帯型ゲームPCに影響を与えたのか？ 来日したCEOに直撃取材［TGS2026］
entries.description: ONE-NETBOOK, in collaboration with Tenku, set up the “ONEXPLAYER” booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 to showcase its 2026 product lineup. Since the company’s CEO, Jack Wang, was also present at the event, we’ll take a look back at the 2026 models and share an interview with him.

entries.title: "WARDOGS" has surpassed 3 million copies sold. Season 2 is scheduled to begin on October 15.
entries.title_ja: 「WARDOGS」の販売本数が300万本を突破。10月15日にはシーズン2の開始を予定
entries.description: On September 27, 2026, BULKHEAD announced that “WARDOGS,” currently in Early Access on Steam, has surpassed 3 million copies sold. Additionally, Season 2 is scheduled to begin on October 15, and a game reset is expected to take place.

entries.title: What you see is only a part of the truth. "Estella: Sin of Time," a suspense adventure game where you switch between multiple protagonists to follow the events that unfold over three days, has been announced.
entries.title_ja: あなたが見ているものは，真実の一部にすぎない。複数の主人公を切り替え，3日間に起きる出来事を追うサスペンスADV「エステラ - 時ノ罪 -」発表
entries.description: On September 26, 2026, ESTELLA Productions announced the PC game “Estella: Sin of Time” and launched its Steam store page. This suspense adventure game allows players to switch between multiple protagonists as they unravel the events that unfold over the course of three days.

entries.title: "Hela: The Little Mouse and the Enchanted Forest," a heartwarming adventure game where you explore the great outdoors as a mouse, is set to be released by Shochiku Games on December 1.
entries.title_ja: ねずみになって大自然を冒険するほのぼのアドベンチャー「Hela：ちいさなねずみと魔法の森」，松竹ゲームズから12月1日に発売決定
entries.description: Shochiku Games announced today (September 28, 2026) that it will handle the publishing of the new title “Hela: of Mice & Magic,” currently in development by WindupGames, for the Japanese market, and revealed that the Japanese title has been set as “Hela: The Little Mouse and the Enchanted Forest.”

entries.title: In the latest video from Washagana TV, I show off some merchandise I bought at Jump Shop. For some reason, an action figure of Tamakichi Sakura that I bought at "NOW AND THEN" also makes an appearance.
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，ジャンプショップで買ってきたグッズを紹介。なぜか「NOW AND THEN」で購入した桜玉吉さんのアクスタも登場
entries.description: Today, the latest episode of the web show “Washagana TV,” hosted by voice actor Yuichi Nakamura and freelance writer Mafia Kajita, was released. In this episode, they showcase merchandise they purchased at “THE Jump Shop Jimbocho” and at Tamakichi Sakura’s exhibition event, “NOWANDTHEN.”

entries.title: [Interview] “Fragaria Memories”: The “Lost Kitty Arc” Finally Comes to a Close! Taketo Kajiwara Discusses Harurit’s Turbulent Emotions and the Existence of Harurit Shadow
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］「フラガリアメモリーズ」，ついに「ロストキティ編」が完結！　梶原岳人さんが語る，ハルリットの揺れ動く心とハルリット・シャドウの存在
entries.description: The “Lost Kitty Arc,” the main story of Sanrio’s chivalric fantasy project “Fragaria Memories,” has come to a close. We spoke with Taketo Kajiwara, who voices both Harulit and Harulit Shadow, about how he prepared to play two roles, behind-the-scenes stories from the recording sessions, and the thoughts he poured into the story and its music.

entries.title: 2D Exploration Survival Game "Delverium": The Joy of Expanding the World Lies Beyond the "Walls"! High Level of Polishing Despite Being in Early Access [Craft Survival Guide]
entries.title_ja: 2D探索サバイバル『Delverium』世界を拡げる楽しさは「壁」の先にある！早期アクセスながら高い完成度【クラフトサバイバル名鑑】
entries.description: In the “Craft Survival Guide,” the author—a fan of games in this genre—highlights the appeal of some classic titles.

entries.title: Starring Etsushi Toyokawa, Shinji Takeda, and More! How Did the PS1 Live-Action Game *NIGHT HEAD -THE LABYRINTH-*, Based on a Popular Sci-Fi Drama, Capture the “90s Vibe”? [Special Feature]
entries.title_ja: 豊川悦司、武田真治ら出演！人気SFドラマ原作のPS1実写ゲーム『NIGHT HEAD -THE LABYRINTH-』は「90年代の空気」をどう映し出したのか【特集】
entries.description: What was the atmosphere like in the 1990s, when there was a boom in the occult—including psychic abilities and the spiritual realm?

entries.title: Will it become the next big hit fishing game since *Fishing Master*? The mobile version of a burger shop management game is also gaining momentum on par with AAA titles—3 Must-Watch Games Not Yet Available in Japan [September 27, 2026]

entries.title: Keyboards as far as the eye can see, left and right. I went to the “TOKYO KEYBOARD EXPO 2026,” where trends, individuality, and craftsmanship come together in a spectacular display.

entries.description: On September 23, 2026, the “TOKYOKEYBOARDEXPO2026” was held at the TRC Tokyo Distribution Center in Tokyo. Eighty-seven keyboard-related brands from Japan and abroad gathered, and the venue was literally filled with keyboards as far as the eye could see. From the latest models to unique keycaps, here’s a report on the lively atmosphere of the event, featuring a diverse array of exhibits.

entries.title: Why Was There “Tofu with a Kansai Accent” in *Resident Evil 2*? As we look back on the history of horror, we’ll make tofu that can survive. My Collaboration Cafe: Menu 092
entries.title_ja: 「バイオハザード2」になぜ“関西弁の豆腐”がいたのか。恐怖の歴史を振り返りながら，生き残れる豆腐を作る。俺のコラボカフェ：Menu 092
entries.description: The monthly series “My Collaboration Café,” published on the fourth Saturday of every month, is a column in which Tetsuya Onishi—a working chef—creates his own collaborations with various video games and other sources, then shares the recipes inspired by them. This installment’s theme is the giant block of tofu that speaks in a Kansai dialect, as seen in *Resident Evil 2*. He even went so far as to use the food enzyme transglutaminase to create a block of tofu capable of surviving in Raccoon City.

entries.title: Periscopes, chicken puppets, dog-paddle controllers, and robots. Introducing unique student projects [TGS2026]

entries.description: From among the student projects exhibited at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” I’d like to highlight some particularly unique initiatives and works that utilize specialized, homemade input devices—which have recently become all the rage. The range is vast, from periscopes and chicken puppets to dog-paddle controllers, and their originality and energy are truly remarkable.

entries.title: Try Out the Nintendo Switch 2 Version of “007: First Light” at TGS 2026! The Origins of a Young James Bond and a “Classic 007” Spy Experience

entries.description:
This is an innovative story that lets you experience the process of Bond’s origin.
Its creative approach offers a high degree of freedom in how you play, which is one of its biggest draws.
You can switch between stealth and action depending on the situation.
It’s clear that the developers are committed to delivering the exact same experience on the Switch 2 without compromise.
The storytelling that depicts the young Bond’s growth and quick thinking is particularly memorable.

entries.title: In the pirated software community, the movement to “buy and support” *CONTROL Resonant* is gaining momentum. That’s impressive—but it’s only natural.
entries.title_ja: 海賊版コミュニティにて、『CONTROL Resonant』を“買って応援”の輪が広がる。えらい、でもそれが普通
entries.description: Regarding the popular game *CONTROL Resonant*, it appears that a movement to “purchase it through official channels” is gaining momentum within the pirated software community.

entries.title: "Apex Legends" to Discontinue "Easy Anti-Cheat" at the End of This Month; Will Instead Introduce "EA's Own Powerful Anti-Cheat System," Which Has Proven Effective in Titles Like "Battlefield 6"
entries.title_ja: 『Apex Legends』、今月末で「Easy Anti Cheat」廃止へ。代わりに『バトルフィールド6』などで実績上げた“EA独自の強力アンチチート”を導入
entries.description: On September 25, Electronic Arts announced that it would be introducing "EA Javelin Anticheat" to the PC version of the battle royale FPS *Apex Legends*.

entries.title: Gabe, the founder of Steam, was hooked on "Mongolian throat singing" and sang it every day at the office, leading a former Valve employee to reveal, "It was a nuisance to everyone." It was so loud that people would close their office doors.
entries.title_ja: Steamの生みの親ゲイブ、“モンゴルの喉歌”にハマり会社で毎日歌うので「みんな迷惑してた」と元Valve社員がぶっちゃける。うるさくて、オフィスのドアを閉められる
entries.description: It is said that Gabe used to practice throat singing—known in Mongolia as “khöömei”—repeatedly at Valve’s office, to the point where employees would close their office doors to block out the noise.

entries.title: “Thank You 4 Playing,” a game where players deduce strategies for beating challenging games, has been announced for Steam and is set to launch on January 8 of next year. Players must sift through social media to find useful tips in this “Obladin”-style information-gathering game.
entries.title_ja: “高難度ゲームの攻略法を推理する”ゲーム『Thank You 4 Playing』Steam版発表、来年1月8日配信へ。SNSから役立つ攻略情報を見極める、『オブラディン』風情報集め
entries.description: On September 25, Libragames announced the Steam release of *Thank You 4 Playing*. It is a deduction-puzzle adventure game in which the protagonist clears the game by looking up strategies for bosses and stages on social media.

entries.title: "Fake: The Gate of Rules (Study)," an art-inspired puzzle game influenced by Kafka, has been announced. Developed by Iruka, it features exploration in an absurd world reminiscent of *The Warehouse Keeper*.
entries.title_ja: カフカの影響を受けたアート系パズル『贋作・掟の門（習作）』発表。イルカが開発する、『倉庫番』風不条理世界探索
entries.description: Dolphin has unveiled the Steam store page for *Fake: The Gate of the Law (Study)*. The game is a *The Warehouse Keeper*-style 3D puzzle adventure inspired by Franz Kafka’s “The Gate of the Law.”

entries.title: The supernatural action game *Control: Resonant* is a huge hit on Steam, with over 34,000 concurrent players. Featuring "no parry" close-quarters combat, players storm into a "gravity-reversed" Manhattan in search of their sister.
entries.title_ja: 超常アクション『コントロール レゾナント』、Steam同接「3万4000人超」の大盛況。“パリィなし”のド近接バトル、姉を探して「重力あべこべ」マンハッタンへ殴り込む
entries.description: Remedy Entertainment released *CONTROL Resonant* on September 24. The game has been a huge hit since its release, attracting more than 34,000 players on Steam.

entries.title: Tactical SRPG "Mercenaries Grace: Black Wings and the Golden Right Arm" Announced, Set for Release in November. The eighth installment in the series adopts a "one-move-per-turn" system, ramping up the tension of counterattacks.
entries.title_ja: タクティカルSRPG『マーセナリーズグレイス 黒い羽根と黄金の右腕』発表、11月発売へ。シリーズ8作目は「一手交代型ターン制」採用で反撃の緊張感マシマシ
entries.description: On September 25, Ride On Japan announced *Mercenaries Grace: Black Wings and the Golden Right Arm*. This title is a tactical simulation RPG and the latest installment in the *Mercenaries Saga* series.

entries.title: "Dance Dance Incremental" Announced: A Rhythm Game with Inflation. A "DDR"-Style Game Where "Higher Numbers Are Better," Fully Compatible with Mat-Style Controllers
entries.title_ja: リズムゲームなのにインフレ『Dance Dance Incremental』発表。“数値はデカいほどいい”『DDR』風ゲーム、ちゃんとマット型コントローラー対応
entries.description: On September 25, TWIN PIXELS announced the incremental rhythm game *Dance Dance Incremental*.

entries.title: “Ignore Your Turn Completely”—“Dopa Shogi!,” a shogi game where whoever makes the move wins, is now available for free. You can’t wait for your opponent—it’s a high-speed battle with dopamine pumping through your veins!
entries.title_ja: “手番全無視”指したもん勝ち将棋ゲーム『ドパ将棋！』無料公開。相手なんか待っていられない、ドーパミンどばどばハイスピードバトル
entries.description: On September 23, Keichi released "Dopa Shogi!" While based on shogi, this game is characterized by high-speed battles in which there is no concept of turns.

entries.title: Individuals associated with a pirated goods shop sued by Nintendo have been ordered to pay "approximately 700 million yen" in damages. Anonymous users were identified through Nintendo's "thorough investigation."

entries.description: A default judgment was handed down against an individual believed to have been involved in the operation of pirate shops and other such businesses, against whom Nintendo of America had filed a lawsuit.

entries.title: "No Such Place," a cooperative PvE escape shooter for up to four players set in an "abnormal world," is set to launch in Early Access on October 14. Scavenger all unknown items, and watch as your guns "mutate" due to contamination.

entries.title: "Slow Roads," a game where you simply lose yourself in driving with no destination in mind, is off to a strong start on Steam. Whether through the wilderness, along the coast, or even on the "lunar surface," it’s a Zen-like journey of aimless driving.

entries.title: It’s not just about shooting them in the head! A hands-on report on the Western-style Souls-like FPS *Guns of Escaton*, where you read documents to take down enemies the “right way.” Reloading is a hassle, but that “annoying” aspect is actually fun…!
entries.title_ja: 頭を撃てばいいわけじゃない！文書を読んで“正しい方法”で敵を撃ち抜く西部劇ソウルライクFPS『ガンズ・オブ・エスカトン』試遊レポ。リロードも手間がかかる、“面倒くさい”が面白い…！
entries.description: A 19th-century revolver that you load one bullet at a time, different strategies for each enemy, and boss fights with unique mechanics. It offered a unique kind of fun that’s characteristic of an “FPS where you can’t just shoot wildly.”

entries.title: Grab a match and burn the evil queen to ashes… This Metroidvania set in a dark fairy-tale-style world is “highly acclaimed”—Fresh off the press! Today’s 12 Featured Steam Games [September 24, 2026]

entries.description: You'll take on the role of "Glimmer," a small bird, and fight alongside your friends.

entries.description: Investigate supernatural phenomena in a setting where bizarre beings and agents from hostile organizations lie in wait.

entries.title: Shrink down and dive into the miniature world you’ve created yourself! A hands-on review and developer interview for the free-to-play slow-life game *Lili’s World*. The goal is to create “another world right next to everyday life.”
entries.title_ja: 自分で作ったミニチュア世界に、小さくなって飛び込める！基本プレイ無料のスローライフゲーム『リリのワールド』試遊レポ＆開発者インタビュー。目指すのは「日常のすぐ隣にある、もうひとつの世界」
entries.description: We got an early look at the life simulation game *Lili's World*, currently in development by LilliLandia Games. We spoke with the development team about the attention to detail in the miniature world, the story of the resident "Lili," future updates, and the game's monetization strategy.

entries.title: The remastered version of *The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt* will be released on September 29 at 7:00 p.m.! It will be released simultaneously for both PC and console versions.

entries.title: "SLAM TANK," a high-speed, head-on tank action game, has been announced. Featuring barrel-spinning attacks against AI machines, this "no-cannon" "melee tank" is on the move.
entries.title_ja: 体当たりハイスピードバトル戦車アクション『SLAM TANK』発表。AI機械たちに砲身大回転攻撃、「砲撃なし」の“肉弾戦車”がゆく
entries.description: On September 23, Next Stage announced *SLAM TANK* for Steam. This action game lets players pilot tanks and engage in close-quarters combat against robots and other enemies.

entries.title: "Cyberpunk 2077": "Strategies for Defeating" a Traumatizing Boss Are Suddenly Trending. A Build to Avoid Horror-Style Hide-and-Seek
entries.title_ja: 『サイバーパンク2077』トラウマ級ボスの「封殺テクニック」、今になって一躍話題に。ホラーかくれんぼ拒絶ビルド
entries.description: A technique that allows players to “neutralize” a certain boss in the *Cyberpunk 2077* expansion “Temporary Freedom” is now gaining attention—three years after the expansion’s release.

entries.title: Discord’s new age verification system has already encountered a glitch, leading to a situation where “even verified adults are being locked out of age-restricted servers.” The official team has issued a response to the issue, laced with a touch of self-deprecating humor.
entries.title_ja: Discordの新年齢確認システムにさっそく不具合発生、“確認済みの大人でも年齢制限付きサーバーから締め出される”事態に。公式は“自虐”混じりに対応報告
entries.description: A new system for determining user age categories was introduced on "Discord," but it was accompanied by some technical issues. Shortly thereafter, the official X account reported that some of the issues had been resolved.

entries.title: “ALICE=NULL,” a yuri adventure game featuring “the devil who grants wishes” and a young girl, debuts on Steam. A story about a girl’s wish—made in exchange for her soul—and the nature of existence.
entries.title_ja: “願いを叶える悪魔”と少女の百合ADV『ALICE=NULL』Steamにてお披露目。魂を引き換えにした少女の願い、そして実存をめぐる物語
entries.description: On September 23, Blink Hydrate launched the Steam store page for *ALICE=NULL*. This yuri visual novel explores the theme of existence through the story of a girl who summons a demon.

entries.title: The popular mythological hack-and-slash ARPG *Titan Quest II* is set for official release on January 19 of next year, with PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions launching simultaneously. Embark on an adventure through the world of ancient Greece and face off against mythical monsters.
entries.title_ja: 人気神話ハクスラARPG『Titan Quest II』来年1月19日に正式リリースへ、PS5/XBOX Series X|S版も同時発売。古代ギリシャ世界を冒険し、神話モンスターに立ち向かう
entries.description: On September 23, THQ Nordic announced that “Titan Quest II,” developed by Grimlore Games, will be officially released on January 19, 2027. The game has been available in Early Access since August 2025, and this official release comes approximately one and a half years later.

entries.title: "ODDCORE," a backroom-style roguelike FPS, has implemented a new "stacking debuff hell" mode in a major update. Face a constant stream of brutal choices in this adrenaline-pumping, endless otherworldly warp experience.
entries.title_ja: バックルーム系ローグライクFPS『ODDCORE』大型アプデで、“デバフ上乗せ地獄”新モード実装。鬼の2択を迫られ続ける、脳汁放出エンドレス異世界ワープ
entries.description: On September 18, Scarecrow Arts released a major update titled "Mall 33" for the roguelike FPS *ODDCORE*, developed by ODDCORP.

entries.title: "Mortal Shell 2" PS5 Boxed Edition Playthrough Impressions. From the Hunter with the Huge Butt to the Runaway Wheelchair, this classic, meaty Soulslike occasionally reveals its "quirky" side. But that's what makes it great.
entries.title_ja: 『Mortal Shell 2』PS5パッケージ版プレイ感想。巨尻ハンターに暴走車いす、正統派骨太ソウルライクはたまに“クセつよ”が見え隠れ。だがそれがいい
entries.description: For those considering purchasing this game, I’d like to share its charms and “some slightly odd aspects” based on my own gameplay experience.

entries.title: "REMATCH," the no-foul, physical soccer game, finally kicks off its "Blue Lock" collaboration. Egoism runs wild in the new "ultra-offensive" mode.
entries.title_ja: 反則なし肉弾サッカーゲーム『REMATCH』、「ブルーロック」コラボがついにキックオフ。“超攻撃的”新モードでエゴイズム爆発
entries.description: On September 24, Sloclap announced the start of Season 5 for its online soccer game, "REMATCH."

entries.title: “The Terrors of the Sea”: Push-Boat Voyage Game ‘RED SKIES AT DAWN’ Announced. Sail freely in a small sailing ship—but when a storm hits, despair sets in.

entries.description: On September 20, Junklab announced the nautical adventure game *RED SKIES AT DAWN*. This is a first-person sailing adventure game in which players navigate the seas aboard a small sailboat.

entries.title: “It feels like a ‘little indie game’” — The physics-based stick figure action game *Stick It to the Stickman* is taking the internet by storm following its official release. With multiplayer support, the rampaging stick figure “teaches his boss a lesson.”
entries.title_ja: “「小小作品」っぽい” 物理演算棒人間アクション『Stick It to the Stickman』正式リリースで人気白熱。マルチ対応・大暴れ棒人間が職場の上司を“わからせる”
entries.description: On September 24, Devolver Digital began rolling out Version 1.0 for *Stick It To The Stickman: Rise to the Top of a Crazy Company*. The game has officially launched and is once again enjoying great popularity.

entries.title: "Break the rules and you die": Escape game "Absolute Compliance" set for release on October 16. "No matter what happens," the rules are absolute. Don't look, don't touch, don't stop.
entries.title_ja: 「禁止事項を破ると死ぬ」脱出ゲーム『絶対遵守』10月16日リリースへ。“何があっても”規則は絶対。見るな、触れるな、止まるな

entries.title: "Clifa: The Divine Visage" is out today. In a post-apocalyptic Tokyo overrun by supernatural threats, anticipate your enemies' attacks and land your counterstrikes.
entries.title_ja: 「神貌のクリファ」本日発売。怪異が跋扈する世界崩落後の東京で，敵の攻撃を見極めカウンターを叩き込め
entries.description: Arc System Works today released the tactical counter-timeline RPG *Clifa: The Divine Countenance*. Set in Tokyo after the “World Collapse,” where supernatural phenomena run rampant, this RPG challenges players to identify enemy attacks foretold on the timeline and strike back with skill-based counters. To coincide with the release, the opening cinematic has also been unveiled.

entries.title: "Kalanoro" launches today on PC, PS5, and Switch. An action-adventure set in a world inspired by the folklore and art of Madagascar.

entries.title: "Well Dweller," a dark fairy-tale Metroidvania game featuring a timid little bird wielding a match, is now available.

entries.title: "PokéPoké" will add the "High Class Pack MEGA," which guarantees a Pokémon EX card, for a limited time starting September 30. It includes all past "◆◆◆◆" cards.

This special expansion pack features a large selection of cards that originally appeared in sets ranging from “Mega Rising” to “Ruler of the Skies.”

entries.title: "Touken Ranbu Pazugiri," a puzzle RPG featuring the Touken Danshi in miniature form, launches today. Gifts are also being offered to celebrate reaching 500,000 pre-registrations.

entries.description: A limited-run version of Fujimi Models' 1/24 scale "Civic (EK9) Type R Late Model" kit from the "Toge Series" is now available, featuring decals to reproduce the carbon-fiber hood! Scheduled for release on December 24. #FujimiModels #PlasticModelKit

entries.title: Recreate pit-dwelling houses and raised-floor warehouses! Fujimi Models is releasing a special edition plastic model kit of the “Toro Ruins” that includes an instruction booklet!
entries.title_ja: 竪穴式住居や高床式倉庫を再現！「登呂遺跡」のプラキットが解説冊子を封入した特別仕様でフジミ模型より発売！
entries.description: A plastic model kit that recreates the pit-dwelling and elevated-floor warehouse from the “Toro Ruins” in palm-sized scale has been released as part of Fujimi Models’ “Building Series” in a special edition that includes an explanatory booklet supervised by the Toro Museum! It also comes with an acrylic keychain featuring the mascot character “Toro-Bé”! #ToroRuins #FujimiModels

entries.title: Recreating Kremer's unique aerodynamic design! The "Porsche 935 K2," which competed in the 1977 German Racing Car Championship, is now available as a 1/24 scale kit from Platz/BEEMAX!
entries.title_ja: クレマー独自の空力フォルムを再現！1977年のドイツレーシングカー選手権で活躍した「ポルシェ935 K2」がプラッツ/BEEMAXから1/24スケールキットで登場！
entries.description: A 1/24-scale kit of the "Porsche 935 K2," which competed in the 1977 German Racing Car Championship, is now available from Platz/BEEMAX! It precisely reproduces the body—featuring Kremer's unique aerodynamic modifications—and the roll cage, among other details. Special detail-up parts are also being released simultaneously! #Platz #BEEMAX

entries.title: Border Model has released a 1/35 scale kit of the German Army's latest main battle tank, the "Leopard 2 A7V"! Not only are the kit parts pre-painted, but the metal gun barrel and photo-etched parts are also pre-painted, allowing you to assemble the model in NATO camouflage!
entries.title_ja: ドイツ軍の最新主力戦車「レオパルド2 A7V」の1/35スケールキットをボーダーモデルが発売！キットパーツはもちろん金属製砲身やエッチングも塗装済みでNATO迷彩に組み上がる！
entries.description: A 1/35 scale kit of the German Army’s latest main battle tank, the “Leopard 2 A7V,” is now available from Border Model! This pre-painted kit features pre-painted parts and photo-etched components, so you can assemble it to reveal the intricate NATO camouflage! In Japan, Hasegawa imports and sells this kit. #Hasegawa #PlasticModelKit

entries.title: [Zoids] Additional details revealed for the "AZ-18 Godos" Moving Kit. Interchangeable parts allow you to recreate both the standard and heavily armored versions.
entries.title_ja: 【ゾイド】ムービングキット「AZ-18 ゴドス」の追加情報が公開。差し替えで通常型、重装甲型を再現可能
entries.description: Takara Tomy’s high-end hobby label, “T-SPARK,” has released additional details about the “AZ-18 Godos” moving kit, for which pre-orders will begin in October.

entries.title: The second installment of the “Pick and Connect” series for *Freiren: The Funeral* is back! It features Freiren, Himmel, Heiter, and Eisen in a “pick-and-connect” design!
entries.title_ja: 『葬送のフリーレン』のつまんでつなげてますこっとの第2弾が再登場！フリーレン、ヒンメル、ハイター、アイゼンをつままれデザインで収録！
entries.description: The second series of “Funeral Freiren” from the “Pinch and Connect Mascots” Gashapon—where you can have fun connecting the mascots—is back! Featuring Freiren, Himmel, Hyter, and Eisen in a “pinchable” design! #Freiren #CapsuleToy

entries.title: You’ll be mesmerized by her cool beauty! “Dolls Frontline 2: Exilium Nikita” [Exclusive Photos from AmiAmi Display]—Brought to life with a large rifle and various pieces of gear
entries.title_ja: クールな美しさに見惚れる！「ドールズフロントライン2：エクシリウム ニキータ」【あみあみ展示撮り下ろし】大型ライフルや各種装備を携えた姿で立体化
entries.description: Fat Company is set to release the 1/6-scale "Nikita" figure in July 2027. This figure brings to life "Nikita," a police officer who stands firm for justice, from the strategy RPG "Dolls Frontline 2: Exilium," developed by SUNBORN.

entries.title: The adorable "Ouran High School Host Club" Gashapon mascots, wrapped in baby blankets, are back! The set includes all 7 varieties, each with a colorful ball chain!
entries.title_ja: おくるみに包まれた姿が可愛い『桜蘭高校ホスト部』のガシャポンマスコットが再登場！カラフルなボールチェーン付きで全7種を収録！
entries.description: The "Ouran High School Host Club" plush mascots are back in Gashapon! The lineup includes a total of 7 characters, such as Haruhi Fujioka and Tamaki Suou! Each comes with a colorful ball chain! #CapsuleToy

entries.title: "Mega Hobby EXPO 2026," a free-admission figure exhibition event, will be held on Saturday, September 26! Don't miss the new releases from participating manufacturers—including Kotobukiya, KADOKAWA, and Alter—as well as the "Cyber Formula" event and more!
entries.title_ja: 入場無料のフィギュア展示イベント「メガホビEXPO2026」が9月26日（土）開催！コトブキヤ、ＫＡＤＯＫＡＷＡ、アルターをはじめとする出展メーカーの新作展示や、『サイバーフォーミュラ』のイベントなどに注目！
entries.description: "Mega Hobby EXPO 2026 F-DASH!!!," an exhibition event featuring figures and more, will be held on Saturday, September 26, at Akihabara UDX! In addition to displays of new figures from Alter, Kotobukiya, and others, there will also be stage events for "Cyber Formula," "One Piece," and more! #MegaHobbyEXPO

entries.title: [Latest for 2026] Which Ichiban Kuji Releases Are Coming Next? A Roundup of Notable Titles Starting in September
entries.title_ja: 【2026年最新】次に発売予定の一番くじは？9月以降の注目タイトルをまとめて紹介
entries.description:
"Ichiban Kuji" is a lottery where you can win limited-edition merchandise from anime, games, and character-based works. With many items—such as figures, acrylic stands, and practical goods—available exclusively through Ichiban Kuji, many people keep checking to see which series will be released next [...].
The post [2026 Update] What’s Next for Ichiban Kuji? A Roundup of Notable Titles Scheduled for Release Starting in September first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: [Why You Should Read This Today] Chapter 18: Summer Festival · A Sincere Confession—"The Beautiful Evening Moon"
entries.title_ja: 【今日、読む理由。】第18話 夏祭り・本気の告白『うるわしの宵の月』
entries.description:
In manga, there are “chapters you’ll want to read today, of all days.” In “Reasons to Read Today,” we select and feature just one chapter every day. *The Beautiful Moon of the Evening*, Volume 5, Chapter 18: Summer Festival · A Sincere Confession. Everyone has their own reason to read this chapter today.  […]
The post [“Reason to Read Today.”] Chapter 18: Summer Festival · A Sincere Confession, “The Beautiful Moon of the Evening” first appeared on Cospot Media.

entries.title: "Graveyard Keeper 2," a slow-life game set in a black graveyard, is a huge hit, carrying on the overwhelming popularity of its predecessor. Experience life as a necromancer who commands a "zombie army" to defend the town.
entries.title_ja: ブラック墓場管理スローライフ『Graveyard Keeper 2』、リリース前の圧倒的人気受け継ぐ盛況。“ゾンビ軍”を率いて街防衛もする死体使役生活
entries.description: On August 27, tinyBuild announced that *Graveyard Keeper 2* would be released on September 22. Set in the Middle Ages, this graveyard keeper simulator has been a huge hit since its release.

entries.title: The developer of *Doodle Kingdom 2* has announced that they are working on “something in the vein of Doodle Kingdom.” Expectations are running high for “a new title 22 years in the making.”
entries.title_ja: 『ラクガキ王国2』の開発者、「ラクガキ王国的な何か」を制作中と発表。“22年越しの新作の可能性”に期待高まる
entries.description: On September 22, Yuichi Tanzawa announced that he is currently working on “something in the style of *Ragaki Kingdom*” to mark the 22nd anniversary of *Ragaki Kingdom 2: The Battle of the Demon King’s Castle*. Although details have not yet been revealed, it has become a major topic of discussion on social media.

entries.title: "Wo Long 2" Developers Feel Encouraged by the Response to the Demo. We Asked Them About Everything from the Current Status to Their Design Intentions, Including the Reasons for Introducing an Open World and Lessons Learned from the Previous Game
entries.title_ja: 『Wo Long 2』開発者、体験版の反響に手応えあり。オープンフィールド導入の理由や前作の反省など、現状から設計の意図までいろいろ訊いた
entries.description: We interviewed Masakazu Hirayama, the producer, and Masaaki Yamagiwa, the development producer.

entries.title: "Charaya," an app that lets you place characters you've created on your desktop, is a huge hit. Even though it's still in beta, it has "about 30,000" concurrent users on Steam, and you can even create "relationships" between the chubby characters.
entries.title_ja: 作ったキャラがデスクトップ画面に居てくれるアプリ『キャラ屋』が大盛況。まだデモ版なのにSteam同接「約3万人」、もちもちキャラ同士の“関係性”も作れる
entries.description: On September 16, Yinengjie released a demo version of its desktop pet app, “Charaya.” Although the app is currently available only as a demo, it has already proven to be a huge hit, attracting approximately 30,000 users.

entries.title: At the “Astraea Oratio” media session, bits and pieces of development information were revealed. Topics included the combat system’s influences from “Street Fighter” and “Persona,” plans for a PC version, and the reasons behind the game’s Japanese setting, among others.
entries.title_ja: 『アストラエ・オラティオ』メディアセッションで、開発情報ぽろぽろ判明。戦闘は『ストリートファイター』『ペルソナ』から影響、PC版は検討、舞台が日本の理由などなど
entries.description: According to the director, the combat in this game incorporates "elements of fighting games" such as *Street Fighter*.

entries.title: Major shake-up erupts following Xbox organizational restructuring. The next "Halo" will be developed by none other than Activision, the makers of "CoD," while Obsidian is set to become part of Bethesda—a massive reorganization and consolidation is underway.
entries.title_ja: XBOX組織改編で、大規模改革勃発。次の『Halo』開発担当はなんと『CoD』Activisionに、ObsidianはBethesda傘下化など、どでかい再編＋統合あり
entries.description: On September 22, Microsoft announced the layoff of 268 employees and a restructuring of its development studios.

entries.title: "Shiren the Wanderer 6" Sets New Record for Concurrent Players on Steam. With the release of the "Torneko's Great Adventure" remaster, is the "Mystery Dungeon" boom reigniting?
entries.title_ja: 『風来のシレン６』Steamにて過去最高同接プレイヤー数更新。『トルネコの大冒険』リマスター登場もあり、「不思議のダンジョン」ブーム再燃か
entries.description: It seems that interest in *Mystery Dungeon: Shiren the Wanderer 6: Chronicles of Toguro Island* is surging again on Steam.

entries.title: Two types of “replaceable front panels with displays” for the Steam Machine have been announced, set for release in October. They can display a clock, weather forecast, device status, and more, allowing for customization.
entries.title_ja: Steam Machineの“ディスプレイ付き交換用フロントパネル”2種発表、10月発売へ。時計や天気予報、機器ステータスなどを映してカスタマイズ
entries.description: On September 22, JSAUX GAMING announced the “E-Ink Faceplate” and “Pixel Matrix Faceplate,” front panels designed for Steam Machines. These products are interchangeable front panels compatible with Steam Machines.

entries.title: About 290 titles have been added to the Nintendo Switch 2/Switch sale. The remasters of *Dragon Quest VII Reimagined* and *Minsaga* have hit new all-time lows, while *Little Nightmares 3* and other titles are also available at near-record-low prices.
entries.title_ja: Nintendo Switch 2/Switch向けセールに約290本追加。『ドラゴンクエストVII Reimagined』『ミンサガ』リマスターが最安値更新、『リトルナイトメア3』なども最安値級でお求めやすく
entries.description: A new sale on titles for the Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch began on September 23 on the Nintendo eShop. Here are some highlights from the approximately 290 eligible titles.

entries.title: Recruitment is now open for participants in a new playtest for the buzzworthy open-world detective game *The Silver Castle*. Here’s your chance to experience this deduction-action game—where you race through the city—once again.
entries.title_ja: 話題の探偵オープンワールド『白銀の城』、新プレイテストの参加者募集開始。街を駆け回る推理アクションを、再び体験できるチャンス
entries.description: On September 23, Elementa began accepting applications for the new closed beta test for *The Silver Castle*, titled “Dichotomy: Retrace.” Players can apply by completing a survey by 6:00 p.m. on October 10.

entries.title: The hugely popular 100-player FPS “WARDOGS” is set to release its Season 2 update on October 15. This major update—featuring everything from new content to game balance adjustments—is expected to change the dynamics of battle with the addition of “rain.”
entries.title_ja: 大盛況100人対戦FPS『WARDOGS』、シーズン2アプデは10月15日配信へ。新コンテンツから調整まで来る大型アプデ、“雨”で戦いの様子も変わりそう
entries.description: BULKHEAD announced that the new season of "WARDOGS" will premiere on October 15.

entries.title: "Nex Playground," a controller-free game console, is coming to Japan. When you play "Sonic" and "Pac-Man" using your "whole body," familiar games feel like something entirely different.
entries.title_ja: コントローラー不要ゲーム機「Nex Playground」日本上陸へ。『ソニック』『パックマン』を“全身”で遊んだら、知っているゲームが別物に
entries.description: Nex Playground is a home console that has been available in North America since late 2023. Specifically designed for families, it features motion-based gameplay, allowing people of all ages to enjoy active play together.

entries.title: 2D mechanical Metroidvania "AVELUNE" announced. Explore a crumbling kingdom alongside a "customizable" helper robot.
entries.title_ja: 2D機械世界メトロイドヴァニア『AVELUNE』発表。“カスタム可”なお助けロボットとともに行く、滅びゆく王国探索
entries.description: On September 23, Skyho announced *AVELUNE*. This title is a 2D Metroidvania in which players explore a fallen kingdom.

entries.title: The “Life” of Aniimo, as Experienced in the Open-World Monster-Collecting Game “Aniimo.” Living with Aniimo, Fighting with Aniimo, and Becoming Aniimo Itself
entries.title_ja: モンスター集めオープンワールド『アニモ（Aniimo）』で感じた、アニモの“いのち”。アニモと暮らし、アニモと戦い、アニモそのものになる
entries.description: Here is a preview report on the officially released open-world monster-collecting game *Aniimo*.

entries.title: Discord will introduce user age verification starting tomorrow to protect minors. However, by making full use of its “automatic age determination” feature, more than 90% of users will not need to go through the verification process.
entries.title_ja: Discord、未成年者保護のためのユーザー年齢確認を明日から導入へ。ただし“成人かどうか自動判定”機能も駆使で、90%以上のユーザーは手続き不要
entries.description: On September 23, Discord announced that it will introduce a new system tomorrow to determine user age categories on its communication service, “Discord.” According to Discord, the age estimation model means that more than 90% of users will not need to verify their age.

entries.title: We’d like to add about two more characters. Footage of the fifth character is already available—Roguelite Action Game “Cinderia”: Interview with the Executive Director [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: キャラはあと2人くらい追加したい。すでに5人目の映像も――ローグライトアクション「Cinderia」，総括ディレクターインタビュー［TGS2026］
entries.description: "Cinderia," currently in Early Access, is a roguelike action game characterized by high-speed combat and build-customization elements that involve strategizing around the ebb and flow of debuffs. We spoke with Executive Director Xiaoyu about the future of this highly acclaimed title.

entries.title: Yuichi Nakamura, who plays Cain, takes on a combo challenge. The “Washagana TV Special Edition” stage, where he plays “Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves” with the development team [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: カイン役の中村悠一さんが連続技に挑戦。「餓狼伝説 City of the Wolves」を開発陣と遊ぶ「わしゃがなTV出張版」ステージ［TGS2026］
entries.description: A stage event for *Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves* was held as part of the “Washagana TV Special Edition” at TGS 2026. Yuichi Nakamura played as Cain and experienced the "Smart Style" system, which makes it easy to pull off combo attacks. Together with Mafia Kajita, he heard stories from the development team about the surprising origins of Salvatore Ganacci’s moves and the design of Chun-Li.

entries.title: You Can Even Chat with the Boss!? The Two Hosts of "Washagana TV" Embarked on a Free-Roaming Adventure in "Kataris," Where AI Weaves the Story [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: ボスにもチャットで話しかけられる!?　AIが物語を紡ぐ「Kataris」で，わしゃがなTVの2人が自由な冒険を繰り広げた［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the “Washagana TV Special Edition” event during TGS 2026, Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita tried out the AI-driven interactive visual novel game “Kataris.” By freely inputting the protagonist’s lines and actions, the AI weaves the rest of the story. From the adventures of a feisty monk to strategic negotiations with enemies through chat, here’s a look at the demo.

entries.title: "Tales of Eternia," which has been revived after about 25 years, was, as expected, absolutely fantastic. Here’s a look at the changes in the remaster, as confirmed during a media hands-on session.
entries.title_ja: 約25年の歳月を経て蘇った「テイルズ オブ エターニア」はやはり最高だった。メディア向けの試遊で確認できたリマスターでの変更点をチェック
entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment will release *Tales of Eternia Remastered* on October 15, 2026. I had the opportunity to play a pre-release demo of this masterpiece RPG, which has been revived more than 25 years after the original version’s release, so I’d like to focus this report on the changes from the original.

entries.title: How did the multi-award-winning South Korean indie game “MONOWAVE” connect with a Japanese publisher and make its way to the market? We ask Phoenixx and developer Studio BBB [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 数々の賞に輝いた韓国インディー「MONOWAVE」は，いかにして日本のパブリッシャと出会い，世に出たのか。Phoenixxと開発元Studio BBBに聞く［TGS2026］
entries.description: "MONOWAVE," a South Korean indie game, was released on September 17. This 2D puzzle-action game involves switching between four different emotions as you progress. We spoke with Im Gwon-yeong of developer StudioBBB and Phoenixx, which handles sales in Japan, at TGS 2026.

entries.title: "Inazuma Eleven Cross" Unveils First Footage of Special Moves from the New Chapter. Washagana TV Takes on Layton's Puzzles at the Level-5 Stage [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 「イナズマイレブン クロス」，新章の必殺技映像を初公開。レイトンのナゾ解きにも挑んだ，わしゃがなTVのレベルファイブステージ［TGS2026］
entries.description: On the “Washagana TV Special Edition” segment at TGS 2026, Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita introduced two Level-5 titles. For *Inazuma Eleven Cross*, they revealed the synopsis of the new chapter set to be added on September 29, along with footage of the combined special moves. In the subsequent live demonstration of *Professor Layton and the New World of Steam*, they tackled puzzles by pooling their wisdom with the audience.

entries.title: Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita Take on the Roguelike Action Game “SlashZero”! “Washagana TV Special Edition” Report [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 中村悠一さんとマフィア梶田さん，ローグライクアクション「SlashZero」に挑戦！「わしゃがなTV出張版」レポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: On September 20, 2026, the final day of the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” the “SlashZero” stage of “Washagana TV Special Edition at TGS 2026” took place at the 4Gamer booth. Here’s a look at the event where voice actors Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita took on a roguelike side-scrolling action game.

entries.title: [Interview] “Shape of Dreams,” Now Announced for Home Consoles: The Challenges of External Collaboration and the Behind-the-Scenes Story of Game Design Faced by a Small Team
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］家庭用ゲーム機版も発表された「Shape of Dreams」。少人数チームが直面した外部協業の苦労やゲームデザインの裏側とは
entries.description: "Shape of Dreams," an action roguelite released for PC that has sold over 1.5 million copies. We conducted an email interview with Shim Eun-sup, CEO of LizardSmoothie, about the game, asking him about the development process, what led to the console version, and the challenges unique to a small development team.

entries.title: The "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba" Aniplex lottery is amazing! The Grand Prize is a figure that vividly recreates the intense battle between Tanjiro, Giyu, and Gyokko, complete with plenty of special effects.
entries.title_ja: 「鬼滅の刃」アニプレックスくじが素敵！A賞は炭治郎と義勇、猗窩座の激闘をエフェクトたっぷりに再現したフィギュア
entries.description: Sales for the "Aniplex Online Lottery ~Battle for the Infinite Castle Begins~" will continue until 11:59 p.m. on September 23.

entries.title: A 1/7-scale "Nia" figure from *Xenoblade Chronicles 2* is making a welcome return! She’s depicted in her awakened form as a Blade—be sure to check out the detailed texture work, which makes extensive use of clear materials and pearlescent paint.
entries.title_ja: 『ゼノブレイド2』より「ニア」1/7スケールフィギュアが嬉しい再販！ブレイドとして覚醒した姿で立体化、クリア素材やパール塗装などを多用した質感表現に注目
entries.description: The "Nia" 1/7 Scale Figure Is Back in Stock!

entries.title: Including the fluffy, flocking Sunsun! “Puppet Sunsun Gummies with Mascots” features a total of 8 varieties, including Nonon and Zonzon.
entries.title_ja: ふわふわフロッキーのスンスンも！「パペットスンスン マスコットつきグミ」に、ノンノンとゾンゾンを含む全8種
entries.description: "Puppet Sunsun Gummy Candies with Mascots" will go on sale in November! There are a total of 8 different mascot designs.

entries.title: "Chiikawa" merchandise will go on sale again at Shimamura starting at 3:00 p.m. on September 23! The collection includes cute socks with small embroidered designs, as well as slippers featuring "Hachiware" and "Rabbit."
entries.title_ja: しまむらで「ちいかわ」グッズが9月23日15時より再販！ワンポイント刺繍が可愛いソックス、「ハチワレ」「うさぎ」たちのルームシューズも
entries.description: "Chiikawa" merchandise will go on sale again at Shimamura Park (online store) starting at 3:00 PM on September 23!

entries.title: That voluptuous lower body…! Pre-orders are now open for the 1/7 scale figure of Toridamono’s original character, “Vell.” A Character Fine mat is included as a bonus.
entries.title_ja: 下半身のボリューム感…！トリダモノ氏オリジナルキャラ「Vell -ベル-」1/7スケールフィギュアが予約受付中ー特典にはキャラファインマットを用意
entries.description: Pre-orders are now open for the “G.S.Collection Vell” 1/7-scale figure!

entries.title: Pre-orders are now open for the first-ever “Puppet SunSun” guidebook! To celebrate the release, original merchandise will be on sale, and the interactive event “Where’s SUNSUN?” will be held.
entries.title_ja: 「パペットスンスン」初のガイドブックが予約受付中！発売記念としてオリジナルグッズの販売、体験型イベント「Where’s SUNSUN?」開催
entries.description: The “Puppet Sunsun Guidebook” goes on sale on November 11! Various promotional activities will also be held in conjunction with the release.

entries.title: The new "Dragon Ball" Ichiban Kuji features the "Goku Family"! Six characters—including Gohan, Goten, Bardock, and Raditz—are being released as figures.
entries.title_ja: 「ドラゴンボール」新作一番くじは、“悟空一族”に注目！悟飯や悟天、バーダックにラディッツまで6体がフィギュア化
entries.description: The full lineup for “Ichiban Kuji Dragon Ball: SPIRIT OF THE SAIYAN” has been revealed! It will go on sale at 7-Eleven, Ito-Yokado, and other locations starting October 17, 2026.

entries.title: [Cosplay] Her stunning legs, emerging from a lustrous red kimono, are simply dazzling! You won’t be able to take your eyes off this elegant and alluring “Narushio” beauty with animal ears [8 Photos]

entries.description: In the 1990s, a wave of action games featuring a host of unique characters emerged, primarily on the Super Famicom and Mega Drive. It was during this era that the British game studio System 3 created “Putty,” a mysterious character with a body resembling blue putty. To mark the 35th anniversary of Putty’s debut, we interviewed the development team behind the new Nintendo Switch 2 title *Putty World* at TGS 2026.

entries.title: Steam’s new co-op game, the “run-for-your-life” action title *PICK A BOO*, has been officially announced. Up to six players can bundle up furniture and haul it away in a haphazard yet exhilarating fashion—choose whether to make a quick escape from the lurking monsters or go for the big score.
entries.title_ja: Steamの新たな協力プレイゲーム、“夜逃げ”アクション『PICK A BOO』正式発表。最大6人で家具をまとめて雑すぎ豪快運搬、うろつく怪物からさっさと逃げるか欲張るか
entries.description: Game & Co. has officially announced "PICK A BOO," a roguelike cooperative escape action game supporting up to six players.

entries.title: "Star Wars: Galactic Racer" is an immersive "Star Wars" experience—without the Force or the Jedi. Why a racing game? How is multiplayer balanced? We played it ourselves and asked the developers.
entries.title_ja: 『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』はフォースなし、ジェダイなしの濃厚「スター・ウォーズ」体験。なぜレース？マルチプレイの調整は？実際に遊んで開発者に訊いた
entries.description: We had the opportunity to play a demo of *Star Wars: Galactic Racer*, scheduled for release on October 7, and to interview the developers directly, so here’s what we learned.

entries.title: "Stream Deck," a favorite among streamers, seemed handy for regular gamers, too. From training mode in fighting games to "work," I took the time to learn how to use it at the TGS 2026 exhibit.
entries.title_ja: 配信者御用達「Stream Deck」は一般ゲーマーでも便利そうだった。格ゲーのトレモから“仕事”まで、TGS2026展示で使い方をじっくり学んだ
entries.description: Elgato exhibited under the theme “Stream Deck for Gamers.” It was packed with features that seemed useful not only for streamers but for others as well.

entries.title: A "plagiarism" controversy has erupted over a potato-peeling game. The developer of "Potato Please," who has been accused of plagiarism, has denied the allegations, saying, "I've never even seen it."
entries.title_ja: ジャガイモの皮をむくゲームをめぐり“アイデア盗用”論争。疑惑を向けられた『Potato Please』開発者は「見たこともない」と反論
entries.description: An indie developer is claiming that the concept for the incremental potato-peeling game “Potato Please” was stolen from him.

entries.title: The PS5 version of *Earth Defense Force 6.2* has way too many enemies, but our firepower is brutal. I experienced the despair of a “screen full of enemies” and mowed them down with “custom weapons” in this hands-on demo of an over-the-top battle.
entries.title_ja: PS5『地球防衛軍 6.2』は敵が多すぎるが、こっちの火力も暴力的。“画面全部が敵”の絶望を味わい、「カスタム武器」でなぎ倒したインフレバトル試遊体験
entries.description: Here are my impressions from playing a demo at the *Earth Defense Force 6.2* event at TGS 2026.

entries.title: The demo for the “physics-based” Metroidvania game *Iron Bramble* is a massive hit, with a “99%” rating and “overwhelmingly positive” reviews. This new title from the developers of *Rusted Moss* lets you swing through massive mechanical structures using a grappling hook.
entries.title_ja: “物理演算”メトロイドヴァニア『アイアンブランブル』体験版が「99％・圧倒的に好評」の大人気。グラップリングフックで巨大機構を舞う、『ラスティッド・モス』開発元による新作
entries.description: The demo version of *Iron Bramble*, which PLAYISM released on September 17, has been well received.

entries.title: "Magical Girl: The Village of Tradition" is even more ruthless than its predecessor, "Manosaba," and might really dig deep into the player's psyche. We spoke with Yuka Hiiragi, who voices Rizu Mikage, about how "twisted" the new characters are.
entries.title_ja: 『魔法少女ノ因習村』は前作『まのさば』以上に容赦なし、プレイヤーの内面をえぐるかも。御影リズ役の柊優花さんに、新キャラの“ドロドロ”具合なども訊いた
entries.description: At TGS 2026, a joint press interview was held featuring Yuka Hiiragi, the voice actress for Rizu Mikage. Our magazine was able to attend, so we’d like to share our coverage of the event in this article.

entries.title: At the “Wizardry Variants Daphne” TGS booth, visitors explored a dungeon displayed on three giant LED screens. Players were challenged to make decisions such as whether to hand over the final herb or not, and whether to open treasure chests that were likely to contain traps.
entries.title_ja: 『Wizardry Variants Daphne』のTGSブースで、3面の巨大LEDで表現されたダンジョンを探索。最後の薬草を渡す、渡さないやトラップ濃厚の宝箱を自分で開けるかなどの判断が問われる
entries.description: In this article, I’d like to share my experience with the content available at the “Wizardry Variants Daphne” booth.

entries.title: "THE FIRST ZOMBIE," created by Kentaro Fujii of "Mizu Douw," features "various surprises" that can't be revealed just yet. We spoke with the production team about the behind-the-scenes development [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 「水ダウ」の藤井健太郎氏が手がける「THE FIRST ZOMBIE」には，まだ明かせない“さまざまな仕掛け”が。制作チームに開発の裏側を聞いた［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the Phoenixx booth at TGS 2026, we interviewed Yudai Nozaki of Phoenixx about “THEFIRSTZOMBIE.” Produced by Kentaro Fujii, this game lets players control a protagonist who has become a zombie and turn humans into zombies to expand their group. We asked him about how the concept came about, the development process, and even the behind-the-scenes story of creating the game’s pop-style characters.

entries.title: "Day of the Devs," an indie game festival, is now accepting submissions for "The Game Awards Digital Showcase 2026," to be held on December 9.
entries.title_ja: インディーゲームの祭典「Day of the Devs」，12月9日開催「The Game Awards Digital Showcase 2026」への出展作品を募集中
entries.description: "Day of the Devs," an event showcasing indie games, has begun accepting submissions for "Day of the Devs: The Game Awards Digital Showcase 2026," which will stream on December 9, 2026. The deadline for submissions is September 28. The event is seeking a wide range of entries from game developers around the world.

entries.title: I played the unique mystery adventure game “Inkblood.” You take on the role of an inquisitor who cannot step off a horse-drawn carriage and use an investigative device that reflects the past to investigate cases in various locations [TGS 2026].
entries.title_ja: 異色の推理ADV「Inkblood」をプレイ。馬車から降りられない異端審問官となり，過去を映し出す捜査機器を使って各地の事件を調べていく［TGS2026］
entries.description: CRITICALREFLEX showcased a playable version of “Inkblood,” developed by HeyBird!, at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026.” Players take on the role of an Inquisitor who is trapped inside a carriage and must investigate incidents occurring across various locations, as well as a cult suspected of being behind them. We tried the game at the event, so here’s our report.

entries.title: Experience the New Beta Version of “Lili’s World,” a Life Sim Set in a Miniature World on a Desk, and Hear the Director Discuss How It Came to Be
entries.title_ja: 机の上のミニチュア世界で暮らすライフシム「リリのワールド」の新ベータ版を体験＆ディレクターが語る誕生のきっかけ
entries.description: At gamescom 2026, LilliLandia Games showcased “Lili’s World,” a life simulation game currently in development. A section was set up within the Tencent Games booth, featuring a lineup of demo stations for the new beta version. During the event, I had the opportunity to interview CodeChen, the game’s technical director, and I’d like to share the details of that conversation.

entries.title: "False Hero," an action-adventure game where you "steal" your enemies' moves and use them against them, has been released on Steam
entries.title_ja: 敵の技を「盗んで」叩き返すアクションアドベンチャー「False Hero」がSteamでリリース
entries.description: Today (September 22, 2026), Ytopia began distributing “FalseHero,” developed by Torchlight Games, on Steam. The game features a combat system that allows players to steal enemy moves and use them as their own attacks; the demo version had received “very positive” reviews. The price is 2,480 yen.

entries.title: A presentation on the “NEOGEO AES+,” which faithfully recreates the legendary NEOGEO down to its frame rate drops, supports vintage peripherals, and features modern capabilities like low-latency HDMI [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 名機NEOGEOを処理落ちまで再現。過去の周辺機器も使えて，低遅延HDMIなど現代向けの機能も備える「NEOGEO AES+」のプレゼンをレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: The “NEOGEOAES+,” which brings the legendary “NEOGEO” back to life for the modern era, was showcased as a playable exhibit at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026.” The development team also gave a presentation at the venue, highlighting the system’s features and their dedication to reviving the NEOGEO.

entries.title: "DARK MACHINE," a franchise spanning games and anime, is set to be adapted into a manga. Here’s a report on the latest updates from the production team, including Goro Taniguchi [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: ゲームとアニメを展開する「DARK MACHINE」はコミカライズも決定。谷口悟朗氏ら制作陣が語った最新情報をレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: On September 18, 2026, a press conference for “DARKMACHINE”—a project spanning games and anime—was held at the Tokyo Game Show 2026. In addition to the announcement of the anime’s ending theme and a manga adaptation, the production team also discussed the game’s major overhaul and shared insights into the anime’s battle scenes. Here is a summary of the announcement and the highlights of both works.

entries.title: "Genshin Impact" Version 7.1: A Pre-Release Feature on "Vesna," the Charming and Playful Empress's Blade. A Deep Dive into the Charm of This Fun and Cute Commander Who Combines Combat Power with Practicality [PR]
entries.title_ja: 「原神」Ver.7.1，可憐でお茶目な女皇の刃「ヴェスナ」実装直前特集。戦闘力と利便性を兼ね備えたおもしろカワイイ司令官の魅力を深掘り【PR】
entries.description: HoYoverse will release Version 7.1 of the open-world RPG *Genshin Impact*, titled “Requiem for the Underworld,” on September 23, 2026. This update introduces a new character, “Vesna.” She’s strong, cute, and fun—and she’s packed with so many elements! Let’s take a closer look at what makes her so appealing.

entries.title: [Manga Jangema] 539. "The Original Holster"
entries.title_ja: 【漫画じゃんげま】539.「元のホルスター」の巻
entries.description: "Jangema" is a Game*Spark original four-panel manga series that depicts the slightly comical, chaotic, and laid-back—yet full of friendly fire—daily lives of female shooters. It seems that Eimu and Romeko have "made up" without anyone noticing. What sparked it?

entries.title: "Dressmaker," an authentic dress-making sim that lets you do everything from fabric selection to cutting and sewing, is now available on Steam! This highly anticipated title has over 400,000 wishlist entries.
entries.title_ja: 生地選びから裁断・裁縫までできちゃう本格派ドレスクラフトシム『Dressmaker』Steamにてリリース！ウィッシュリスト40万件超の注目作
entries.description: They create beautiful dresses tailored to each client's order. In addition to custom orders, they also sell dresses designed by the studio itself in their store.
