entries.description: Forget all that—it's time to eat!!

entries.title: "Core Keeper" Major Free Update "The Underground Rider" Now Available! Ride livestock, use the hookshot for easy travel, and explore the new "Moss" biome.
entries.title_ja: 『Core Keeper』大型無料アプデ「地下のライダー」配信！畜産動物への騎乗や移動に便利なフックショット、新たなバイオーム「コケ」登場
entries.description: Three new pets, new gear, and more!

entries.title: Taiwan, South Korea, Thailand, Vietnam… 10 “Asian-Made” Horror Games Where You Can Experience “Fear Found Only Here” [Special Feature]
entries.title_ja: 台湾、韓国、タイ、ベトナム……「ここでしか生まれない恐怖」を味わえる“アジア産”ホラゲー10選【特集】
entries.description: A carefully curated selection of recommended horror games that let you experience the unique thrills of Asia!

entries.title: "Tom and Jerry" is coming to Medicom Toy's MLE brand! The lineup features a variety of fashion items—including T-shirts, sweatshirts, and tote bags—featuring the adorable Taffy!
entries.title_ja: メディコム・トイのMLEブランドに『トムとジェリー』が登場！愛らしいタフィーも仲間入りしたTシャツ、スウェット、トートバッグなどの各種ファッションアイテムをラインナップ！
entries.description: T-shirts, sweatshirts, and tote bags featuring the animated series “Tom and Jerry” are scheduled to go on sale in November 2026 from “MLE,” the fashion and lifestyle brand by Medicom Toy! The lineup includes many cute designs featuring Taffy! #TomAndJerry #MLE

entries.title: The Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force’s Yokosuka Base ships “Ikazuchi,” “Yugiri,” “Amagiri,” “Tokiwa,” and “Zuiryu / Kokuryu” are now available as 1/1250-scale semi-assembled model kits! A total of 10 varieties, including Full Hull and At Sea versions!
entries.title_ja: 海上自衛隊横須賀基地の「いかづち」「ゆうぎり」「あまぎり」「ときわ」「ずいりゅう / こくりゅう」が1/1250スケール半完成組み立てキット化！フルハルver.と洋上ver.の全10種！
entries.description: A total of 10 different food toy kits! The destroyer “Ikazuchi,” based at the Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force’s Yokosuka Base The “Yugiri” and “Amagiri,” the supply ship “Tokiwa,” and the submarines “Zuiryu” and “Kokuryu” are now available as 1/1250-scale semi-assembled model kits from Eftoys! #JapanMarineSelfDefenseForce #FoodToys

entries.title: Sanrio characters are being released as figurines in chic, grown-up outfits! “PERIHAPI! Hide & Seek: Hide-and-Seek Jewelry Dress Hello Kitty and Friends” goes on sale in October.
entries.title_ja: サンリオキャラクターズがオトナっぽいシックな衣装でフィギュア化！「PERIHAPI! Hide ＆ Seek かくれんぼ ジュエリードレス Hello Kitty and Friends」10月発売
entries.description: Takara Tomy Arts will release the "PERIHAPI! Hide & Seek: Jewelry Dress Hello Kitty and Friends" figurine series in October. The series consists of eight variations, including two secret versions, and each figurine is priced at 1,870 yen.

entries.title: Sample images of the "MGSD Kshatriya" Gunpla from *Mobile Suit Gundam UC* have been released! Scheduled for release on September 26.
entries.title_ja: 『機動戦士ガンダムUC』のガンプラ「MGSD クシャトリヤ」のサンプル画像公開！9月26日発売予定
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has released sample images of the "MGSD Kshatriya" Gunpla kit. It is scheduled to go on sale on September 26, priced at 7,700 yen.

entries.title: The "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON Assemble Collection Vol. 01" food toy is on sale today!
entries.title_ja: 食玩「ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON アセンブルコレクション Vol.01」本日発売！
entries.description: Bandai will release the food toy "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON Assemble Collection Vol. 01" on September 21. The price is 1,650 yen.

entries.title: Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi for Aoshima's 1/43-scale "Mobile Police Patlabor" plastic model kit, "AV-98 Ingram Unit 1 + Type 98 Special Command Vehicle Set," scheduled for release in October 2026!
entries.title_ja: アオシマの『機動警察パトレイバー』1/43スケールプラモデル「AV-98 イングラム 1号機＋98式特型指揮車セット」の2026年10月販売分があみあみで予約受付中！
entries.description: "Mobile Police Patlabor" Ingram Unit 1 + Type 98 Special Command Vehicle Set! Aoshima's 1/43-scale plastic model kit—which also includes a Guard Robot and other accessories—is scheduled for release in October 2026, and pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi! #MobilePolicePatlabor

entries.title: A seductive smile and an outstanding presence! “High School D×D HERO Rias Gremory Bunny Ver.” [Exclusive Photos from AmiAmi Display] Now Available as a 1/3 Scale Figure
entries.title_ja: 妖艶な微笑みと抜群の存在感！「ハイスクールD×D HERO リアス・グレモリー バニーVer.」【あみあみ展示撮り下ろし】1/3スケールフィギュアで登場
entries.description: From Freeing, the 1/3-scale figure “Rias Gremory Bunny Ver. [1/3 Scale]” was released in August 2026. This figure depicts “Rias Gremory,” a character from the TV anime “High School D×D HERO,” in a bunny outfit.

entries.title: Sample Images Released for the “DAEMON X MACHINA TS” × “30MM” Collaboration Plastic Models: “Bahamut” and “The Indescribable Thing”!
entries.title_ja: 「DAEMON X MACHINA TS」×「30MM」コラボプラモ「バハムート」と「名状しがたきもの」のサンプル画像公開！
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has released sample images of the plastic model kits “30MM DAEMON X MACHINA TS Bahamut” and “30MM DAEMON X MACHINA TS The Indescribable.”

entries.title: Mebius Models has released 1/25-scale kits of the 1963 “Chevrolet Nova SS” convertible and coupe, as well as the 1978 “Chevrolet Monte Carlo”! The kits also feature recreations of the inline-6 and V-8 engines.
entries.title_ja: 1963年型「シボレー ノバSS」コンバーチブル／クーペと、1978年型「シボレー モンテカルロ」がメビウスモデルから1/25スケールキットで登場！直列6気筒／V型8気筒エンジンも再現
entries.description: Mebius Models Releases Three 1/25-Scale Chevrolet American Car Kits! Platz will import and sell the 1963 “Chevrolet Nova SS” convertible and coupe, as well as the 1978 “Chevrolet Monte Carlo Landau Coupe,” in November! #MebiusModel #Chevrolet

entries.title: Kotobukiya Announces Re-release of the “Grande Scale Lumitia” Plastic Model from “Arcadia”! Pre-orders Begin September 24
entries.title_ja: コトブキヤ、「アルカナディア」よりプラモデル「グランデスケール ルミティア」の再生産決定！9月24日より予約開始
entries.description: Kotobukiya has announced that it will re-release the "Grande Scale Lumitia" plastic model kit.

entries.title: The "Divison" in Thomas's configuration from the anime "ZOIDS" is coming to the Realize Model series. Pre-orders will begin soon.
entries.title_ja: アニメ「ゾイド-ZOIDS-」よりトーマ仕様の「ディバイソン」がリアライズモデルに登場。近日予約開始
entries.description: Takara Tomy's "T-SPARK" hobby label, which targets a high-end audience, will soon begin accepting pre-orders for the action model kit "RMZ-027 Divison (Toma Spec)."

entries.title: A special edition kit of Fujimi Models' "1/700 Wave Series" "Yamato" is now available, complete with photo-etched parts and wooden deck decals! The wooden deck decals are pre-cut and can be applied perfectly without any additional preparation!
entries.title_ja: フジミ模型「1/700 波シリーズ」の「大和」にエッチングパーツ＆木甲板シールが付属する特別仕様キットが登場！木甲板シールは切り抜き済みで無加工でピッタリ貼り付け可能！
entries.description: A special edition of the battleship "Yamato" from Operation Ten-1, featuring etched parts and wooden deck decals, has been released as part of Fujimi Models' "1/700 Wave Series" of ship kits with wave-base displays! The specially developed wooden deck decals are pre-cut for a perfect fit! #FujimiModels #PlasticModelKit

entries.title: Hasegawa has released a kit of the "YF-21" in its Battloid form from *Macross Plus*, using all-new molds! Take a final look at its majestic appearance in these photos of the completed model!
entries.title_ja: 『マクロスプラス』より「YF-21」のバトロイド形態をハセガワが完全新金型でキット化！完成見本写真でその勇姿を最終チェック！
entries.description: From the OVA *Macross Plus*, Hasegawa has released a 1/72-scale kit of the “YF-21” variable fighter—piloted by Gald Goa Bowman—in its Battroid form, using all-new molds! Check out its majestic appearance in these photos of the finished model! #MacrossPlus #Hasegawa

entries.title: Darth Vader, the Dark Lord, has joined the vintage soft vinyl figure series from “Star Wars”! You can even recreate his appearance with his helmet off!
entries.title_ja: 『スター・ウォーズ』のビンテージソフビシリーズに暗黒卿「ダース・ベイダー」が出現！ヘルメットを脱いだ素顔状態も再現可能！
entries.description: A new Darth Vader soft vinyl figure from “Star Wars” has joined Medicom Toy’s retro-style vintage soft vinyl figure series! It faithfully recreates his eerie face beneath the helmet, and you can even have him hold a lightsaber. #StarWars #SoftVinyl

entries.title: You’ll be mesmerized by her bold race queen look! “Azur Lane: St. Louis Race Queen Ver.” [Exclusive Photos from AmiAmi Display]—Her elegant pose, leaning against the case, brought to life in 3D
entries.title_ja: 大胆なレースクイーン姿に見惚れる！「アズールレーン セントルイス レースクイーンVer.」【あみあみ展示撮り下ろし】ケースに身を預けた優雅なポーズを立体化
entries.description: From APEX-TOYS, the 1/7 scale figure “Azur Lane: St. Louis Race Queen Ver.” is scheduled for release in May 2027. This figure depicts “St. Louis,” a Union-affiliated light cruiser from the smartphone game “Azur Lane” operated by Yostar, in a race queen outfit.

entries.title: "Godzilla -1.0": A dynamic recreation of its attack on Ginza! Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi for the December 2026 release of Aoshima Bunka Kyozaisha's plastic model kit, "PLAfig. Godzilla (2023)"!
entries.title_ja: 『ゴジラ-1.0』銀座に襲来した姿をダイナミックに再現！青島文化教材社のプラモデル「PLAfig. ゴジラ（2023）」の2026年12月販売分があみあみで予約受付中！
entries.description: Pre-orders are now being accepted on AmiAmi for the Aoshima plastic model “PLAfig. Godzilla (2023)” featuring the Godzilla from *Godzilla -1.0*, scheduled for release in December 2026! Based on the original prototype created by Shuzo Kanimushi, this model recreates Godzilla’s attack as it marches from Tokyo Bay to Ginza! #Godzilla

entries.title: Carry around cute photo-style cards featuring Rilakkuma, Sumikko Gurashi, Tarepanda, Kogepan, and more! The "San-X Universe Photo Card Keychain" food toy is now available!
entries.title_ja: リラックマ、すみっコぐらし、たれぱんだ、こげぱんたちのフォト風カードをかわいく持ち歩ける！食玩「サンエックスユニバース フォトカードキーホルダー」が登場！
entries.description: The "San-X Universe Photo Card Keychain" food toy is now available from E-Toys! A total of 10 designs featuring Rilakkuma, Sumikko Gurashi, Tarepanda, Kogepan, and Afro Dog! Decorate these cute photo-style cards and carry them with you! #San-X

entries.title: The MFS-3 Type 3 Kiryū plastic model kit, based on the movie *Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla*, is back! It features numerous movable parts, including the mouth, the Absolute Zero, and opening/closing leg thrusters! Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi!
entries.title_ja: 映画『ゴジラ×メカゴジラ』仕様のMFS-3 3式機龍のプラモデルが再登場！口やアブソリュート・ゼロ、脚部バーニアの開閉など多数の可動ギミックが搭載！あみあみで予約受付中！
entries.description: Aoshima is re-releasing the “MFS-3 Type 3 Ki-Ryū” plastic model kit from *Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla*! Don’t miss the smooth articulation of the neck, tail, and legs, achieved using soft plastic parts! The kit also includes the “Red Eye” parts for when it goes berserk! Pre-orders are now being accepted at AmiAmi. #Godzilla

entries.title: [Zoids] Pre-orders for the "AZ-18 Godos" Moving Kit Will Begin Soon
entries.title_ja: 【ゾイド】ムーイングキット「AZ-18 ゴドス」が近日予約開始
entries.description: Takara Tomy's "T-SPARK," aimed at a high-end market, will soon begin accepting pre-orders for the "AZ-18 Godos" moving kit.

entries.title: Sample images of the "30MS Option Body Parts: Sigma Sisters Paradox 2 [Color C]" Bishoujo Plastic Model Kit have been released! Images of the "Arm Parts & Leg Parts S [Color C]" have also been released.
entries.title_ja: 美少女プラモ「30MS オプションボディパーツ シグマシスターズパラドクス2[カラーC]」のサンプル画像公開！「アームパーツ&レッグパーツS[カラーC]」も公開
entries.description: BANDAI SPIRITS has released sample images of the plastic model kits “30MS Option Body Parts: Sigma Sisters Paradox 2 [Color C]” and “30MS Option Body Parts: Arm Parts & Leg Parts S [Color C].”

entries.title: [FGO Cosplay] Hidechon / hideto's Da Vinci is just too gorgeous... Is this what an all-around genius looks like?!
entries.title_ja: 【FGOコスプレ】ひでちょん / hidetoさんのダ・ヴィンチちゃんが麗しすぎる…これが万能の天才か！
entries.description:
Although she’s known as a “universal genius,” her charm isn’t limited to her intellect alone! Her glamorous and confident demeanor—and above all, her appearance, which seems to embody the very “beauty” she pursues—is the very essence of Da Vinci-chan. In this post, we take a look at Da Vinci [… ]
The post [FGO Cosplay] Hidechon / hideto’s Da Vinci-chan is simply stunning… Is this what a “universal genius” looks like?! first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: "HODKA," an open-world wilderness road trip game, has been announced. Players will scavenge for junk alone in a beat-up van, only to be attacked by "something huge" when night falls.
entries.title_ja: オープンワールド荒野運転旅ゲーム『HODKA』発表。おんぼろバンで孤独なガラクタ漁り、夜になると“巨大な何か”に襲われる
entries.description: On September 21, Skystone Games announced "HODKA," an open-world exploration adventure game in which players travel in a beat-up van.

entries.title: "Poppy Playtime" Becomes a Co-op Horror Survival Game; "Escape from Playtime" Launches in Early Access on October 22. Escape from, Hide from, and Build a Home to Escape the Huge, Scary "Failed Toys."
entries.title_ja: 『ポピープレイタイム』が協力対応ホラーサバイバルに、『Escape from Playtime』10月22日早期アクセス配信へ。デカくて怖い“失敗作おもちゃ”から逃げて隠れて家づくり
entries.description: "Escape from Playtime," a multiplayer survival horror spin-off of "Poppy Playtime," is scheduled to launch in Early Access on October 22.

entries.title: In the MMORPG “Management” sim *Let’s Build a Dungeon*, you can subject the development team to “overtime hell” or listen to player requests—it’s incredibly realistic. The game you create is actually playable; Early Access launches on February 11 next year.
entries.title_ja: MMORPG「運営」シム『Let’s Build a Dungeon』では“開発チームを残業地獄”にしたりプレイヤーの要望を聞いたり生々しい。作ったゲームはほんとに遊べる、来年2月11日早期アクセス配信へ
entries.description: On September 21, Springloaded announced that “Let’s Build a Dungeon” will be released in Early Access on February 11, 2027.

entries.title: "Loftia," an MMO life simulation set on a floating island, is set to launch in Early Access on November 4. This highly anticipated title, which raised 200 million yen through crowdfunding, lets players live a laid-back life while helping one another.
entries.title_ja: 空島暮らしMMOライフシム『Loftia』11月4日に早期アクセス配信へ。クラファンで2億円集めた注目作、仲間と助け合いながらのんびり暮らす
entries.description: On September 21, Qloud Games announced that early access for the life simulation MMO "Loftia" will begin on November 4 (Japan Standard Time).

entries.title: The intense Steam adventure game *The Crying Geese* is set to feature full Japanese voice acting. Players will now be able to enjoy this harrowing story—which has “divided opinions due to its darkness”—with Japanese voiceovers.
entries.title_ja: Steam壮絶ADV『泣き叫ぶ雁』に日本語フルボイス実装へ。“暗すぎて賛否真っ二つ”過酷物語を、日本語吹き替えで楽しめるように
entries.description: On September 20, 2P Games and ZerocreationGame announced that they would implement full Japanese voice acting for *The Crying Goose* sometime in September.

entries.title: The "BenQ MOBIUZ" gaming monitor, designed with a focus on color, features "color modes tailored to game art." For example, the sci-fi mode enhances the metallic sheen—you'll clearly see the difference when you see the actual product at TGS 2026.
entries.title_ja: 色にこだわるゲーミングモニター「BenQ MOBIUZ」には“ゲームアートにあわせたカラーモード”あり。SFは金属のツヤ感アップなど、TGS2026で実物を見ると違いがくっきり
entries.description: Just by changing how colors and light appear, the impression you get from a game world changes more than you might expect. I strongly encourage you to see it in person and experience for yourself the strengths of game art that MOBIUZ brings to life.

entries.title: “A Logbook from an RPG-Style Inn”: The mystery game *The Guest Register of the Inn in Front of the Demon King’s Castle* is now available for free. A *Obladin*-style game where you unravel mysteries using fragments of information.
entries.title_ja: “RPGっぽい宿屋の記録”推理ゲーム『魔王城前店の宿泊名簿』無料公開。断片情報から謎に迫る『オブラディン』風ゲーム
entries.description: On September 20, independent game developer "Mr. Sakuchau" released a free browser-based mystery game titled *The Guest Register of the Inn in Front of the Demon King's Castle*.

entries.title: The first major DLC for the smash-hit roguelike "BALL x PIT" has been announced, set for release on November 13. The long-awaited new stage takes players to the skies, along with a host of new characters, balls, and buildings.
entries.title_ja: 大ヒットローグライト『BALL x PIT』初の大型DLC発表、11月13日配信へ。待望の新ステージは天空へ、新キャラ・ボール・建物もどっさり追加
entries.description: On September 21, Devolver Digital announced that the major DLC for *BALL x PIT*, titled "The Ascension of Volbilon," will be released on November 13 (Japan Time).

entries.title: "Potato Please," a physics-based game where you do nothing but peel potatoes, has been announced. Get covered in potatoes for the sake of your country—a dystopian labor sim.
entries.title_ja: ひたすらジャガイモの皮をむく物理演算ゲーム『Potato Please』発表。お国のために芋まみれ、不穏労働シム
entries.description: On September 20, Golden Horn Studios announced "Potato Please," a game in which players continuously peel potatoes.

entries.title: "MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA" Hands-On & Media Session Roundup: Simple Control Mode Features Powerful Rapid-Fire Combos, "Gauntlet"—a System Move That’s a Mid-Range Charge Attack with Armor—and Various Other New Details
entries.title_ja: 『MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA』試遊&メディアセッションまとめ。簡易操作モードは連打コンボが強い、アーマー付き突進中段のシステム技「ガントレット」など新情報いろいろ
entries.description: In this article, we’ll share a play report on the new systems we experienced during the hands-on demo, as well as details about the new “Grand Scenario Mode” revealed during the media session.

entries.title: "Control Resonant": Even in a pinch, the close-quarters combat—where "you fight rather than run"—is intense. I played the new "Control" at TGS 2026—it’s accessible yet edgy.
entries.title_ja: 『コントロール レゾナント』、ピンチでも“逃げるより殴る”近接戦が熱い。とっつきやすくて尖ってる、新生『コントロール』をTGS2026で遊んだ
entries.description: After trying out a demo of *CONTROL Resonant*, I was impressed by its aggressive combat and a story that’s more accessible than the previous game’s.

entries.title: "The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 2nd" Has Become an Instant Hit, With Concurrent Players on Steam Reaching a Record High for Falcom. It Has Surpassed "the 1st," and the Sequel Remake Is Also Performing Exceptionally Well.
entries.title_ja: 『空の軌跡 the 2nd』いきなり大人気、Steam同接はファルコム史上トップに。『the 1st』を超え、続編リメイクも絶好調
entries.description: "The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 2nd" has quickly garnered high praise. On Steam, it has become a massive hit, setting the record for the highest number of concurrent players ever for a Nihon Falcom title.

entries.title: "Call of Duty" is adopting a two-pronged strategy to combat cheating: "crushing both users and sellers." The game aims to strike at the root of the "massive cheat market, estimated at 550 billion yen annually."
entries.title_ja: 『Call of Duty』のチート対策は「使う側も潰し、売る側も潰す」二正面作戦に。“年間推計5500億円規模の巨大チート市場”を、根元から叩く
entries.description: On September 18, Activision released information regarding its anti-cheat team, "TeamRICOCHET," and announced a strategy to target the massive "cheat economy" itself.

entries.title: "Sputnika Game," a gravity puzzle game where you "throw and merge" planets, is still free on Steam for now but will become a paid title on September 23. The game has been "very well-received."
entries.title_ja: 惑星を「投げて合体」重力パズル『Sputnika Game』Steamにて今ならまだ無料、9月23日に有料化へ。「非常に好評」なゲーム
entries.description: On September 15, independent game developer egunan announced that the merge puzzle game "Sputnika Game" will become a paid title on September 23 (local time).

entries.title: The developers implemented the "new features to make adventuring easier" in the major overhaul update for *Dragon's Dogma 2* despite anticipating criticism. With a solid sense of confidence, they are now preparing for the release of *Dark Arisen*—we asked them about their commitment to the game.
entries.title_ja: 『ドラゴンズドグマ 2』大改修アプデの“冒険を楽にする新機能”は、批判覚悟で実装していた。たしかな手応えで迎える『ダークアリズン』、そのこだわりを訊いた
entries.description: We interviewed the development team behind *Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen*. We asked them about their impressions of the updates implemented in the main game and for details on the DLC.

entries.title: "Potato Please," a first-person simulation game where you endlessly peel potatoes, has been announced. The reveal trailer has been released.
entries.title_ja: ジャガイモの皮むきをひたすら続ける一人称視点のシミュレーション「ポテト・プリーズ」発表。Reveal Trailerを公開
entries.description: On September 20, 2026, GoldenHornStudios announced the PC simulation game "PotatoPlease" and released a reveal trailer. The game is a first-person physics-based simulation in which players continuously peel potatoes to prepare meals for the military.

entries.title: The gameplay itself becomes a melody! “MeloMisterio -play your melody-” is a 3D platformer where you play soothing melodies as you work your way toward the goal [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 操作そのものがメロディになる！ 「MeloMisterio -play your melody-」は，ゴールを目指すうちに心地よい旋律を奏でられる3Dプラットフォーマーだった［TGS2026］
entries.description: GentleGiants LLC showcased a playable version of “MeloMisterio—playyourmelody—” at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026.” This 3D platform action game transforms the player’s actions into melodies. I had the chance to try out the demo, so let me share my impressions of the gameplay.

entries.title: Details of the “Street Fighter League ASIA 2027” tournament have been revealed for the first time. It has also been confirmed that the official women’s tournament, the “Queen’s Cup (tentative title),” will be held in 2027.
entries.title_ja: 「ストリートファイターリーグ ASIA 2027」の大会概要を初公開。女性向け公式大会「女王杯（仮）」の2027年開催も決定
entries.description: Capcom announced the tournament details for the “Street Fighter League ASIA 2027” today. The tournament will be held in the fall of 2027 with a total of six teams, and the single team representing the JAPAN region will be selected through an open tryout tournament. In addition, new information was announced, including the key visual for “CAPCOM CUP 13” and details on the official women’s tournament, the “Queen’s Cup” (tentative title).

entries.title: VAR Decisions Based on Videotapes and Stickers!? Hands-On with “Eye of the Match: The VAR Game,” a Soccer Referee Game from Brazil [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: VARの判定はビデオテープとシールで!?　ブラジル発のサッカー審判ゲーム「Eye of the Match: The VAR Game」を試遊［TGS2026］
entries.description: "Eye of the Match: The VAR Game," which I found at the Brazil booth at TGS 2026, is a strategy game where you take on the role of a soccer VAR official and make calls on plays during a match. While the game is based on the latest officiating technology, the tools you use to make your decisions are... retro videotapes and stickers!

entries.title: Welcome to “Sabakistan,” a dog-ruled dictatorship! A hands-on preview of “Sabakistan: The Land of Dogs,” in which a journalist uncovers the truth behind this closed-off nation [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 犬たちの独裁国家「サバキスタン」へようこそ！　ジャーナリストが閉鎖された国の真実に迫る「サバキスタン：犬の国」を試遊［TGS2026］
entries.description: The “Republic of Sabakistan” is a dictatorship inhabited by dogs. Its supreme leader is holding a rehearsal for his own funeral. I got to try out the visual novel “Sabakistan: The Land of Dogs”—which depicts this strange country through the eyes of people (?) in various roles—at the Tokyo Game Show 2026.

entries.title: What Is the Reality of the Government’s Support for the Content Industry? A Report on a Stage Event Where METI Officials and Game Developers Discussed the Current Situation and Future Outlook [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 政府のコンテンツ産業支援の実態はどうなってるの？ 経産省の担当者とゲーム開発・展開の現場が現状と展望を語ったステージイベントをレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the 4Gamer booth during the Tokyo Game Show 2026, a stage event titled “Behind the Scenes of Japan’s ‘Entertainment Strategy’—Why Is the Government Betting on the Game and Content Industries Now?” was held. Representatives from the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) and game industry executives discussed the current state of Japan’s entertainment and IP strategies and support measures, how they are actually being utilized in the field, and future challenges.

entries.title: The latest model of the "V-Sweet" VR sleep pillow is a body pillow style. It might be perfect for those who like to sleep with someone [TGS2026]

entries.description: "VRChat" made its debut at the Tokyo Game Show 2026. In a VR corner located a short distance from their booth, ROOX was showcasing a new product in its "V-Sweet" series of VR sleep pillows, so I gave it a try right away. The new model is designed as a body pillow, so it might be perfect for those who like to sleep with a pillow.

entries.title: The Xbox version of "The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt" will support Xbox Play Anywhere. If you own the Xbox version, you'll be able to get the PC version at no additional cost.
entries.title_ja: XBOX版「ウィッチャー3 ワイルドハント」，XBOX Play Anywhereに対応決定。XBOX版を所持していれば，PC版が追加費用なしで受け取れるように
entries.description: CD PROJEKT announced today that, in conjunction with the release of the remastered update for the open-world RPG *The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt* on September 29, the Xbox version will be compatible with "Xbox Play Anywhere." Players who own the Xbox version will be able to claim the PC version from the Microsoft Store at no additional cost.

entries.title: Mechagodzilla—which appears exclusively on posters and is capable of transforming and combining—is making a comeback. Pre-orders for the “Chogokin Mechagodzilla (Noriyoshi Ikuyori Poster Ver.)” are open until September 23! [#TamashiiNations]

entries.description: "Mechagodzilla," which appeared exclusively on the poster for the theatrical film *Godzilla vs. Mechagodzilla*—illustrated by Noriyoshi Namiyori—is making a comeback in a new color scheme. A sample is currently on display at the TAMASHII NATIONS STORE TOKYO.

entries.description: From *The Witch's Journey*, Irena is now available as a prize figure! Her long hair and gentle smile are her charms! #TheWitchsJourney

entries.title: The major update "Ver. 3.7" for *Narushio* is set to be released on September 30. The "Story Recap" feature is finally being implemented, photo-taking capabilities have been enhanced, and the story in this new world is heading toward its final chapter.
entries.title_ja: 『鳴潮』大型アプデ「Ver3.7」は9月30日配信へ。ついに“物語振り返り機能”実装、写真撮影も強化され、新天地での物語は最終章を迎える
entries.description: On September 19, KURO GAMES announced that it will release a major update for *Narushio*, Version 3.7, titled “A Delusional World Chained to a Mirror, the Red Dust Illuminated by the Heart,” on September 30.

entries.title: The wildly popular MOBA-style roguelike *Shape of Dreams* even turns “broken builds caused by bugs” into intended features. The developers’ commitment to creating games where “breaking things is fun.”
entries.title_ja: 大人気MOBA風ローグライト『Shape of Dreams』は「バグ由来のぶっ壊れビルド」すら、仕様にしちゃう。開発者が貫く、“壊して楽しい”ゲーム作り
entries.description: We interviewed the developers of *Shape of Dreams* to learn about the game’s origins and the story behind the surprise release of the console port.

entries.title: Is the Country House in the Free-to-Play Game “NTE” Really Worth “6.9 Million”? I Took a Serious Look at It. A Bed in the Field, a Mahjong Table in the Yard, and a Standoff with the Police
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料『NTE』の田舎一軒家は本当に“690万の価値”ある？本気で考えてみた。畑にベッド、庭に麻雀卓、警察相手に立てこもり
entries.description: Is the “Masashi Shizuno Mansion,” added in Ver. 1.3 of *NTE: Neverness to Everness*, really worth 6.9 million fans? We took a closer look to determine its true value.

entries.title: An exhibition titled “PERSONA 30th EX.” has been announced to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the “Persona” series. The exhibition will feature never-before-seen materials and areas recreating the series’ world settings.
entries.title_ja: 「ペルソナ」シリーズ30周年を記念した展覧会「PERSONA 30th EX.」開催決定。初公開資料やシリーズの世界設定を再現したエリアなどを展示
entries.description: KADOKAWA announced today that it will hold “PERSONA30thEX.,” a large-scale exhibition commemorating the 30th anniversary of the “Persona” series. The exhibition will take place at the Ueno Royal Museum in Tokyo from January 21 to February 7, 2027. Additionally, further details are scheduled to be announced on the official X account at 7:00 p.m. on October 23.

entries.title: "Twisted," Unveils Silhouettes of New Characters; Releases Special Video Ahead of New In-Game Event
entries.title_ja: 「ツイステ」，新キャラクターのシルエットをお披露目。ゲーム内新イベントに先駆けて特別映像を公開
entries.description: Today (September 20, 2026), Aniplex released a special video ahead of a new in-game event for “Disney Twisted Wonderland,” revealing the silhouette of a new character. In addition, a special ABEMA program titled “Disney Twisted Wonderland Channel” will stream starting at 7:00 p.m. on October 4.

entries.title: "Atelier Karia": Details Revealed on New Playable Characters Rutger and Reyna. They’ll Support Karia and the Others as Seniors in the Aladis Pioneering Group.
entries.title_ja: 「カリアのアトリエ」新たな参戦キャラクター，ルトガー＆レイニャの詳細情報が明らかに。アラディス開拓団の先輩としてカリアたちをサポート
entries.description: Koei Tecmo Games announced today (September 20, 2026) the latest information regarding the alchemy RPG *Atelier Karia: The Kingdom of Night and the Signposts of Memories*, scheduled for release on February 25, 2027. This update provides detailed information on Rutger and Rayna, whose inclusion in the game was recently announced.

entries.title: The terror of letting your little sister—who’s all talk—take the wheel. The indie game “Teaching My Little Sister to Drive,” guaranteed to have viewers in stitches, has been thrilling audiences at [TGS2026].
entries.title_ja: 調子だけいい妹にハンドルを握らせる恐怖。爆笑必至の配信向けインディーゲーム「妹に運転を教える」でギャラリーを沸かせてきた［TGS2026］
entries.description: "Teaching My Little Sister to Drive," which was showcased in the "SELECTEDINDIE80" section at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, is a voice-controlled indie game developed by the South Korean studio EasyFox. What kind of experience awaits players? Let’s take a look at our hands-on demo, which was filled with laughter and screams.

entries.title: "Ace Attorney" Series Celebrates 25th Anniversary with New Commemorative Visual; "Ace Attorney 123: Naruhodo Selection" Surpasses 5 Million Copies Sold Worldwide
entries.title_ja: 「逆転裁判」シリーズ25周年，記念ビジュアルを公開。「逆転裁判123 成歩堂セレクション」は世界500万本突破
entries.description: Capcom has unveiled the main visual for the "Ace Attorney" series, which will celebrate its 25th anniversary on October 12, 2026. The artwork, created exclusively for this occasion by Takuro Fuse and Kazuya Nuri, features nine characters—including Ryuichi Naruhodo, Mayoi Ayasato, and Reiji Mitsurugi—depicted in special outfits.

entries.title: The "Warron 2" demo has evolved to be more fast-paced... but the bosses still have that classic "die-and-retry" feel. I was impressed by the unpredictable mechanics in "Train Attack." Flying through the sky in "One-Stroke Evolution." This Week in Gaming
entries.title_ja: 『ウォーロン2』体験版は軽快に進化した……けどボスの「死にゲーらしさ」も健在。『電車アタック』の予測不能ギミックに感心。『一筆進化』で空を飛ぶ。今週のゲーミング
entries.description: "Now Gaming" is a weekly column that runs every Sunday, where our writers casually share their thoughts on the games they’ve played that week. This is the 562nd installment.

entries.title: Kanta Hongo’s Passion as a “Die-Hard Fan” of *Ore Dake Level Up: KARMA* Shines Through: Report on the TGS 2026 Presentation. A Hands-On Demo Faithfully Reproducing the Original Work, Filled with Overflowing Love for the Source Material
entries.title_ja: 本郷奏多さんの“『俺レべ』強火ファン”ぶり炸裂、『俺だけレベルアップな件：KARMA』TGS2026発表会レポート。原作再現たっぷりの試遊プレイに、ほとばしる原作愛
entries.description: Here’s a report on the media briefing for *I’m the Only One Leveling Up: KARMA*, which took place at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 venue.

entries.title: "Street Fighter 6" is teaming up with the anime "Detective Precure!" for a collaboration set to stream starting December 17. Unravel the mystery behind the incident that occurred in the Battle Hub.
entries.title_ja: 『ストリートファイター6』がアニメ「名探偵プリキュア！」とコラボ、12月17日より配信へ。バトルハブで起きた事件の謎を解き明かす
entries.description: On September 20, Capcom announced a collaboration between *Street Fighter 6* and the anime *Detective Precure!*. It appears that a four-episode series will begin streaming on December 17.

entries.title: Now is the perfect time to play *My Real Life Is Way Too Fulfilling*, a school romance comedy featuring a “heroine with a ‘otome game’ mindset.” While the premise is catchy, the storytelling is meticulous and thought-provoking.
entries.title_ja: 「乙女ゲーム脳の主人公」の学園ラブコメ、『私のリアルは充実しすぎている』を今こそ遊んでみよう。題材はキャッチーだが描写は丁寧で深みもある
entries.description: "My Real Life Is Way Too Fulfilling" isn't just a story that uses the protagonist's dual nature as a hook; it's a work that carefully develops its characters through the theme of "What is the true self?"

entries.title: "Persona 4 Revival" also features Aika Nakamura, an original character from the anime series—a laid-back Chinese girl. Through Aika, the game introduces new elements that delve deeper into "Inaba City of the past."
entries.title_ja: 『ペルソナ４ リバイバル』には、アニメ版オリキャラのマイペース中華娘「中村あいか」も登場。あいかを通じ、“過去の稲羽市”を深掘りする新要素も
entries.description: It has recently been revealed that Aika Nakamura, an original character from the anime adaptation, will be making an appearance.

entries.title: The release date for "Touken Ranbu Puzzle" has been set for September 24. 42 Touken Danshi will be available at launch [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 「刀剣乱舞ぱずぎり」の配信日が9月24日に決定。リリース時には42振の刀剣男士を実装［TGS2026］
entries.description: On September 20, 2026, EXNOA announced during a stage event at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 that the release date for the puzzle RPG “Touken Ranbu Pazugiri” has been set for September 24, 2026. In addition, the company revealed the latest information, including the Touken Danshi characters and the main story that will be available at launch.

entries.title: "Dream Club ZERO R+" Announced, Set for Release in 2027. The dream members-only club—where only the "pure" are allowed—is set to be reborn in the Reiwa era.
entries.title_ja: 『ドリームクラブ ZERO R+』発表、2027年発売へ。ピュアじゃないと入れない、夢の会員制クラブが令和によみがえる
entries.description: On September 20, D3 Publisher announced "Dream Club ZERO R+."

entries.title: "AWS BuilderCards," a card game that lets you learn about AWS through play, goes on sale on Amazon on September 25. "Faraday Blues," a new adventure game created by the artist behind "Doki Doki Bungaku-bu!," has been announced. Here are 7 must-read game articles from this week.
entries.title_ja: AWSを遊んで学べるカードゲーム『AWS BuilderCards』、Amazonにて9月25日発売。『ドキドキ文芸部!』のアーティスト手がける新作ADV『Faraday Blues』発表。今週の見逃せないゲーム記事7選
entries.description: We’ve selected seven articles from this week’s AUTOMATON, focusing primarily on game reviews that generated a lot of buzz. This week, titles such as “AWS BuilderCards,” “SophieChat:AI,” and “Higurashi no Naku Koro ni: Sparrow REMASTER” were among the hot topics.

entries.title: "Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade" hits a new all-time low at 75% off, for about 1,400 yen. "Far Cry 6" is under 1,000 yen at 90% off. This week's PC games with the highest discounts
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーVII リメイク インターグレード』は75％オフで最安値更新、約1400円。『Far Cry 6』は90％オフで1000円切り。今週の高割引率PCゲーム
entries.description: In this article, we’ll highlight the games on Steam that went on sale this past week and offer the deepest discounts.

entries.title: I-O Data’s “GigaCrysta” gaming monitor is packed with thoughtful features that “you can’t tell just from the spec sheet.” It helps reduce screen-induced dizziness and even explains technical terms related to settings.
entries.title_ja: アイオーデータのゲーミングモニター「GigaCrysta」は“スペック表ではわからない”気遣い満載。画面酔いも低減してくれるし、設定の専門用語も教えてくれる
entries.description: They emphasized that it is “GigaCrysta from a Japanese manufacturer,” and I could truly sense the kind of meticulous attention to detail typical of Japanese manufacturers.

entries.title: "Honkai: Star Rail" Version 4.6, "Dance with the Beast Before the Moon Rises," will be released on September 28. The ★5 character "Pearl" will be playable.
entries.title_ja: 「崩壊：スターレイル」Ver.4.6「月立つ前に獣と踊れ」，9月28日にリリース。★5キャラクター「パール」がプレイアブルに
entries.description: HoYoverse announced today (September 20, 2026) that it will release Version 4.6 of “Honkai: Star Rail,” titled “Dance with the Beast Before the Moon Rises,” on September 28. In this update, “Pearl,” a ★5 Ice-element character who walks the path of Delight, will become a playable character.

entries.title: We tried out the new model of “G'AIM'E,” which lets you play first-person shooters even on a thin-profile display. A report from the Jitsuryo Denki & Pioneer booth [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 薄型ディスプレイでもガンシューティングをプレイできる「G'AIM'E」の新モデルを体験。達成電器＆パイオニアブースをレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the joint booth of Jissatsu Denki and Pioneer at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, visitors could try out the latest products from both companies. A new model of the plug-and-play game console “G'AIM'E” was on display as a prototype. Let’s take a look at what’s different from the previous model.

entries.title: Tokyo Game Show 2026: Events on the final day, September 21, will be held online. Some official programs will be streamed as scheduled.
entries.title_ja: 東京ゲームショウ2026，最終日9月21日のイベント開催をオンラインに変更。一部の公式番組を予定どおり配信
entries.description: On September 20, 2026, CESA announced that it would cancel the in-person events scheduled for the final day of the Tokyo Game Show 2026—which had previously been postponed—and switch to an online format instead. The organization stated that it would stream certain official programs as scheduled, while ensuring the safety of the participants.

entries.title: The live talk show "Yoshi-P Radio/Yoshi-P Night" has been canceled due to inclement weather and disruptions to public transportation caused by an approaching typhoon.
entries.title_ja: 公開トーク番組「吉Pラジオ/吉Pナイト」，台風接近に伴う悪天候や交通機関への影響を考慮し開催中止に
entries.description: The talk shows “YoshiP Radio” and “YoshiP Night,” which were scheduled to take place on September 21, 2026, at “404NotFound” on the Shibuya Sakura Stage in Tokyo, have been canceled. This decision was made in light of the inclement weather and potential disruptions to public transportation caused by an approaching typhoon, as announced by Shuhei Yoshida and on the 404NotFound X account.

entries.title: The latest news—including the digital release of the “Persona: The Legend of the Goddess” soundtrack and collaborations with apparel brands—will be revealed all at once during the “Persona 30th Anniversary” special live stream.
entries.title_ja: 「女神異聞録ペルソナ」のサントラ配信やアパレルブランドとのコラボなど，最新情報が「ペルソナ30周年」スペシャル生放送で一挙公開に
entries.description: Today (September 20, 2026), Atlus streamed a "Persona 30th Anniversary" special live broadcast on its official YouTube channel. During the event, information about the game and related topics was announced, and a live performance was also held.

entries.title: I walked right past it thinking it was a neck speaker, but it turned out to be a shoulder pain relief device. Panasonic is promoting “Korikoran” to gamers [TGS2026]

entries.description: At the Panasonic booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, I spotted a product that looked like a neck speaker. entries.title: The Tokyo Game Show 2026 attracted a total of 257,642 visitors over its four days. The 2027 event is scheduled to be held at Makuhari Messe from September 16 to 20 [TGS2026].

entries.description: It has been revealed that the total number of attendees at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” which concluded its in-person event today, was 257,642. Based on figures from the four-day period from September 17 to 20, this represents a decrease of 5,459 people compared to the previous year’s total of 263,101. Although the event was originally scheduled to run for five days, the September 21 session was canceled due to Typhoon No. 25. The 2027 event is scheduled to take place at Makuhari Messe from September 16 to 20.

In this installment, we present a mini-interview with the developers of *Warlord: Awaji*, an open-world strategy game set in medieval Awaji Island, developed by Darkmatter Games and released for PC on September 10.

entries.title: Life-size figures of Gabriel from *Expelled from Paradise* and Mash [Paladin] from *FGO*, as well as a Nabeshima-style Tachikoma from *Ghost in the Shell*, are on display! Figures from *Love Live!*, *Love Live!*, and *Kisekoi*—now available for pre-order—are also featured! [Kyoto International Manga & Anime Fair (Kyomaf) 2026 Breaking News Report]
entries.title_ja: 『楽園追放』ガブリエル、『FGO』マシュ〔パラディーン〕の等身大フィギュアや『攻殻機動隊』鍋島焼のタチコマが展示！予約受付中の『ラブライブ！』『ラブライブ！』『着せ恋』などのフィギュアも！【京都国際マンガ・アニメフェア（京まふ）2026速報レポート】
entries.description: Kyomaf 2026 will feature life-size figures of Gabriel from *Expelled from Paradise* and Mash [Paladin] from *FGO*, as well as a Nabeshima-yaki Tachikoma from *Ghost in the Shell*! Kyomaf 2026 Breaking News Report #Kyomaf #kyomaf

entries.title: A Fearless Female Warrior! Casca from the "Golden Age Arc" of *Berserk* is now available as a 1/6-scale articulated figure in threezero's "SIXTH" series! Pre-orders are now being accepted at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 気丈な女戦士！『ベルセルク』黄金時代篇のキャスカがthreezeroの「SIXTH」シリーズにて1/6スケール可動フィギュア化！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: Casca from the "Golden Age Arc" of *Berserk* is joining threezero’s 1/6-scale articulated "SIXTH" figure series! With approximately 44 points of articulation and wires built into her cloth cape, you can pose her in dynamic action poses! Pre-orders are now open on Rakuten Books! #Berserk

entries.title: The "Doraemon" light mascots, whose soft glow is sure to soothe your soul, are now available as capsule toys! The lineup includes Doraemon, Dorami, and even the Small Light!
entries.title_ja: 柔らかく光る姿に癒される『ドラえもん』のライトマスコットがカプセルトイ化！ドラえもんやドラミちゃんに加えてスモールライトもラインナップ！
entries.description: "Doraemon" is coming to the Gashapon Light Mascot Series! Featuring cute, relaxed versions of Doraemon and Dorami, as well as the Small Light! #Doraemon #CapsuleToys

entries.title: "The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 1st"—Painted samples of the "OSHI WORKS Mini" series of affordable, chibi-style figures featuring Estelle, Joshua, Scheherazade, and Olivier have been revealed! Pre-orders are set to begin soon!
entries.title_ja: 『空の軌跡 the 1st』エステル、ヨシュア、シェラザード、オリビエのお手頃価格のデフォルメフィギュア「OSHI WORKS Mini」シリーズの彩色見本公開！近日予約開始予定！
entries.description: You'll want to collect them all! Kotobukiya has revealed painted samples of the affordable "OSHI WORKS Mini" chibi figures of Estelle, Joshua, Scheherazade, and Olivier from *The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky the 1st*! Pre-orders are scheduled to begin soon. #TrailsSeries #TrailsInTheSky

entries.title: GSI Creos’ “VANCE PROJECT Material Series Mr. Molding Clay” Takes the No. 1 Spot! : Amazon Hobbies “Tools & Parts” New Arrivals Ranking (September 18, 2026 Edition)
entries.title_ja: GSIクレオス「VANCE PROJECT マテリアルシリーズ Mr.型取りクレイ 型取用粘土」が1位！：Amazonホビー「ツール＆パーツ系アイテム」新着ランキング（2026年9月18日版）
entries.description: Check out the best-selling new and upcoming tools and parts items as of September 18, 2026, including GSI Creos’ “Mr. Molding Clay” and more! #PlasticModels #Tools

entries.title: Be captivated by her fleeting yet adorable appearance! Shiroha Naruse in her swimsuit from "Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE" is now available as a 1/6 scale figure! Pre-orders are now being accepted at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 儚くも愛らしい姿に魅了される！『Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE』水着姿の鳴瀬しろはが1/6スケールフィギュア化！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: From *Summer Pockets REFLECTION BLUE*, Shiroha Naruse—known for her striking white hair and blue eyes—is now available as a 1/6-scale figure! Check out her adorable swimsuit look as she holds a beach ball! Pre-orders are now open at Rakuten Books! #SummerPockets

entries.title: The fourth installment of “Nijisanji” biscuits with collectible pins is here! The set includes a total of 15 designs featuring popular streamers like Kokoro Amamiya and Wen Akagi in their original “food toy” outfits!
entries.title_ja: 「にじさんじ」の缶バッジ付きビスケットの第4弾が登場！食玩オリジナル衣装の天宮こころや赤城ウェンなど、人気ライバーたちが描かれた全15種を収録！
entries.description: The fourth installment of "Nijisanji" pin badge cookies, featuring designs of streamers in their "Nijisanji" concierge outfits, is here! The lineup includes a total of 15 different pin badges! Scheduled for release on September 21! #Nijisanji #Shokugan

entries.title: Doraemon pops out from inside the door! From "Doraemon," the "Anywhere Door" interior light is now available as a prize!
entries.title_ja: ドアの中からドラえもんがひょっこり！『ドラえもん』より、インテリアライト どこでもドアがプライズ化！
entries.description: The "Anywhere Door" from *Doraemon* is now available as an interior light prize! This playful item features the familiar secret gadget glowing softly! #Doraemon

entries.title: Let her gentle smile soothe your soul! The “Zenless Zone Zero” Masaki Hoshimi Ver. is now available as a 1/8-scale figure in the LIMEPIE series! Pre-orders are now being accepted at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 穏やかな笑みに癒される！『ゼンレスゾーンゼロ』星見雅 曉 Ver.がLIMEPIEシリーズにて1/8スケールフィギュア化！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: From *Zenless Zone Zero*, the Akira Hoshimi Ver. is now available as a 1/8-scale figure in the LIMEPIE series! This figure captures her sitting on a bench holding a bouquet of flowers. Pre-orders are now open on Rakuten Books! #ZenZero

entries.title: "Super Princess Kaguya!" Full-graphic T-shirts featuring Kaguya, Ayaha Sakayose, Yachiyo Tsukimi, Akira Tei, Rai Komazawa, and Noi Komazawa are now available! Pre-orders are being accepted on the online store "FaNeMa" through Saturday, October 19, 2026!
entries.title_ja: 『超かぐや姫！』かぐや、酒寄彩葉、月見ヤチヨ、帝アキラ、駒沢雷、駒沢乃依のフルグラフィックTシャツが登場！ECサイト「FaNeMa」にて2026年10月19日（土）まで予約受付中！
entries.description: Full-graphic T-shirts for “Super Princess Kaguya!” are now available for pre-order on “FaNeMa,” the e-commerce site operated by System Service! The collection features all 6 designs—Kaguya, Ayaha Sakayose, Yachiyo Tsukimi, Akira Tei, Rai Komazawa, and Noi Komazawa—each available in 3 sizes! #SuperKaguyaPrincess

entries.title: Cosplayer [TOMOSUKE] | Cosplay of "Furiodor," a designer VTuber who approaches his work with passionate dedication
entries.title_ja: コスプレイヤー【TOMOSUKE】｜あついこだわりを胸に活動するデザイナーVTuber「フリオドール」コスプレ
entries.description: Let me introduce the cosplayer “TOMOSUKE,” who shared a cosplay of “Frio Dore” from “Nijisanji EN” on X (formerly Twitter). All of TOMOSUKE’s cosplays faithfully capture the characters’ unique atmospheres and the worlds of the original works.

entries.title: The chaotic battle royale multiplayer RTS "OpenFront" is already receiving positive reviews on Steam. The wildly popular browser game with "1 million monthly active users" has finally made its debut on Steam.
entries.title_ja: バトロワ乱戦マルチRTS『OpenFront』、Steamでさっそく好評。「月間アクティブ100万人」の大人気ブラウザゲーム、ついにSteam殴り込み
entries.description: On September 17, OpenFront Inc. launched the multiplayer RTS game “OpenFront” in Early Access for PC (Steam). It has already garnered positive reviews.

entries.title: The highly rated “cardboard” FPS free-to-play game *PAPERHEAD EP.0* will end distribution on September 24. Get it now for your last chance to play it forever.
entries.title_ja: 高評価”段ボール”FPSの無料ゲーム『PAPERHEAD EP.0』、9月24日配信終了へ。今入手すればずっと遊べるラストチャンス
entries.description: On September 18, HypeTrain Digital announced that "PAPERHEAD EP.0" will be removed from streaming on September 24. If you add it to your library before the deadline, you'll still be able to play it after it's removed from streaming.

entries.title: "Mysterious Giant Egg Destruction": Incremental Game 'CRACK' Announced, Set for Release on October 27. A Co-op Multiplayer Title Where You Carefully Chip Away at the Shell with a Pickaxe—and Catch a Glimpse of an "Eye" Lurking Inside.
entries.title_ja: 「謎の巨大卵破壊」インクリメンタル『CRACK』発表、10月27日配信へ。協力マルチ対応・ツルハシでコツコツ殻むき、殻の奥からは“目”がチラリする不穏ゲーム
entries.description: On September 18, game developer Rafoli announced *CRACK*. The game is a cooperative incremental adventure game for 1 to 4 players.

entries.title: Traffic to "hidden indie games" on Steam suddenly surged more than 500-fold. Industry insiders analyze that "recommendations for niche titles have been quietly boosted."
entries.title_ja: Steamの“埋もれインディーゲーム”、ストア流入がいきなり500倍以上に。“ニッチ作品のおすすめ表示がひっそり強化”との業界人分析
entries.description: There have also been reports that “niche” works tailored to users’ preferences are now more likely to appear on the homepage.

entries.title: "BELTFED," a roguelike factory automation defense game, has been announced. Players must mass-produce weapons to fend off "hundreds of thousands" of enemies with barrage fire and a "black hole cannon."
entries.title_ja: ローグライク・工場自動化防衛ゲーム『BELTFED』発表。押し寄せる「数十万体」の敵、兵器を大量生産して弾幕や“ブラックホール大砲”などで迎え撃つ
entries.description: On September 16, Hello World Studios officially announced the roguelike defense game "BELTFED."

entries.title: Tokyo Game Show to Be Canceled on September 21 Due to the Approach of Typhoon No. 25
entries.title_ja: 東京ゲームショウ、9月21日の開催中止へ。台風25号接近のため
entries.description: It was announced that the "Tokyo Game Show 2026," scheduled for September 21, has been canceled.

entries.title: The free Steam puzzle game “20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes”—a “mini-maze medley”—has exploded in popularity with a “99% positive rating.” Featuring 20 levels packed with twists and turns, it’s created by the creator of the “overwhelmingly well-received” puzzle series.
entries.title_ja: Steam無料“ミニ迷路ごった煮”パズル『20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes』、「好評率99％」で人気爆発。20の盤面にひねり満載、「圧倒的に好評」パズル作者が手がける
entries.description: On September 18, FLEB began offering *20 More, Somehow Even Smaller, Mazes* for free. This puzzle game challenges players to solve 20 small mazes and has been well-received since its release.

entries.title: “Nex Playground,” a motion-controlled gaming console that lets users “jump and bounce,” announced that it has raised “over 20 billion yen” to expand into Japan and other markets. Riding a wave of momentum after surpassing 1 million units sold, the company is now aiming for global expansion.
entries.title_ja: “飛んで跳ねて”体で動かすゲーム機「Nex Playground」、日本など展開に向けて“200億円超”の資金を調達したと発表。販売台数100万台突破で勢いに乗り、世界進出へ
entries.description: On September 17, Nex announced that it had raised more than $150 million (approximately 23.53 billion yen) to expand its business. The company also plans to launch its “Nex Playground” game console in Japan in 2027.

entries.title: "Fate/EXTRA Record" has evolved into a "modern JRPG" while staying true to the original work, featuring a major overhaul of its deck-building battle system. We asked about the developers' goals and the impact of the "transfer to Aniplex," among other topics of interest.
entries.title_ja: 『Fate/EXTRA Record』は原作を守りつつ「現代のJRPG」に進化、デッキ構築型バトルに大刷新。その狙いや“アニプレックス移管”の影響など、気になることを訊いた
entries.description: We introduced the revamped battle and exploration systems, as well as interactions with Servants, in *Fate/EXTRA Record*, while also asking about the transfer of the development team and the goals behind the revamp.

entries.title: "Shangri-La Frontier: The Seven Strongest Species" is seriously aiming to be an "immersive 'Shangfro' game." A recap of the TGS 2026 presentation, where popular cosplayer Enako was thrilled by the dynamic performances of her "favorite characters."
entries.title_ja: 『シャングリラ・フロンティア ～七つの最強種～』は本気で「『シャンフロ』没入ゲーム」を目指す。人気コスプレイヤーえなこさんも“推しキャラ”躍動に感激したTGS2026発表会まとめ
entries.description: On September 17, Netmarble held a media briefing for “Shangri-La Frontier: The Seven Strongest Species” at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 venue. In this article, we’ll take a look at the energetic atmosphere of the briefing and the booth.

entries.title: "Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance" caused a huge stir with a surprise reveal of Fulful. A surprise appearance featuring "just the neck stretching out"
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ：アセンダンス』にてフルフルしれっとお披露目で大盛り上がり。“超伸び伸び首だけ乱入”のサプライズ登場
entries.description: The moment that got the crowd most excited wasn't a new feature, but the appearance of the beloved monster "Furufuru."

entries.title: "Get Us Out," a comical prison-break game supporting up to four players, has been announced. Players must outwit the guards using "banana peels" in a cooperative prison-break adventure where improvisation is key.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人マルチ対応・コミカル脱獄ゲーム『Get Us Out』発表。看守は“バナナの皮”で突破、アドリブ力が物を言う協力脱獄劇
entries.description: On September 18, layWay S.A. announced *Get Us Out*, developed by AM Playhouse. The game is a prison-break action title that supports cooperative play for up to four players.

entries.title: In *Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance*, the developers have thoroughly reviewed the “lessons learned from *Wilds*” and focused on enhancing the aspects that “make the game even more fun.” We spoke with the development team about the challenges they faced in implementing Boost Bracers for all weapon types.
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ：アセンダンス』では“『ワイルズ』の反省点”を徹底的に見直し、「もっと面白くなるところ」を伸ばす。全武器種ぶんブーストブレイサー実装の苦労など、開発陣に訊いた
entries.description: We asked how the development of *Ascendance* proceeded, based on *Monster Hunter: Wilds*.

entries.title: "Animal Town Diner Story," a life simulation game featuring a "seaside restaurant" and co-op play for up to four players, is set to launch in Early Access on October 26. From boat races to arcades, island life is "packed with plans" and full of things to do along the way.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力“海辺レストラン“生活シム『どうぶつの町の食堂物語』10月26日早期アクセス配信へ。ボートレースにゲームセンター、寄り道だらけの”予定ぎっしり“島ライフ
entries.description: On September 19, Dreland Enterprises announced that it will release ArtDock's *The Story of the Animal Town Diner* in early access on October 26.

entries.title: "Mongil: STAR DIVE" Scheduled for Release on DMM GAMES in November. Report on the Stage Presentation Featuring Development Producer Lee Dong-jo [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 「モンギル：STAR DIVE」，DMM GAMES版を11月中にリリース予定。開発PDのイ・ドンジョ氏が登壇したステージをレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the DMMGAMES booth at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” which has been running since September 17, 2026, a stage event was held to present the latest information on Netmarble’s “Mongil: STARDIVE.” Here is a report on the event, featuring a presentation by Development Producer Lee Dong-jo.

entries.title: The latest installment in the “King of Vocabulary” series, “Memory King of Vocabulary,” will be released in early October. It’s a board game that tests your memory and vocabulary skills.
entries.title_ja: 「語彙の王様」シリーズ最新作「語彙の記憶王」，10月上旬に発売。記憶力と語彙力が試されるアナログゲーム
entries.description: Ensky announced today that it will release “Vocabulary Memory King,” the latest installment in the “King of Vocabulary” board game series, in early October. In this game, players rely on their memory to flip over face-down cards and answer words related to the theme written on each card to win the cards.

entries.title: SELECTED INDIE 80 “MASK IT” Play Report. An adventure game packed with dark humor where you apply mosaics to photos, turn them into fake news, and make them go viral [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: SELECTED INDIE 80「MASK IT」プレイレポート。写真にモザイクをかけ，フェイクニュースに仕立ててバズらせる，ブラックユーモアたっぷりのADV［TGS2026］
entries.description: By blurring and altering news photos to create fake news stories and making them go viral, players attract readers’ attention. “MASKIT,” an adventure game brimming with dark humor that lets players experience this unethical media behavior as a fictional game, is currently on display at the SELECTEDINDIE80 booth.

entries.title: Your travel companion as you walk through the scorching wilderness is a giant robot. “Hello Sunshine” Play Report [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 灼熱の荒野を歩く旅の相棒は，巨大ロボット。「Hello Sunshine」プレイレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: "Hello Sunshine" is available to play at the NorwegianGames booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026. Here’s a report on the gameplay experience of this title, in which you journey through the wilderness alongside a giant robot. Since it supports co-op play, we highly recommend it to parents and children or friends visiting the event together.

entries.title: Ditto, Eevee, and Umbreon are now available in the "Sweet Dreams Friends" Pokémon plush toy series. They look so cute sleeping peacefully.
entries.title_ja: ポケモンのぬいぐるみシリーズ「すやすやフレンド」に，メタモン，エーフィ，ブラッキーが登場。幸せそうに眠る姿がかわいい
entries.description: Today (September 19, 2026), Pokémon released Ditto, Eevee, and Umbreon as part of the new lineup for Takara Tomy Arts’ “Suyasuya Friend” plush toy series.

entries.title: Impressions of the streetcar driving game "TRAMCITY HAKODATE." It delivers a realistic driving experience with switches identical to those on the actual vehicles and a mechanism that reproduces the different notches on the accelerator lever depending on the streetcar model [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 路面電車運転ゲーム「TRAMCITY HAKODATE」インプレッション。実機と同じスイッチ，そして電車の型番によって異なるアクセルレバーのノッチを再現する機構で，リアルな運転体験を演出する[TGS2026]
entries.description: While a wide variety of games were on display at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” one of the most unique experiences was the chance to play “TRAMCITYHAKODATE,” which lets players operate a streetcar using a realistic control panel made with the same parts as the actual vehicle. Here’s our report on that experience. We also asked about some of the details we were curious about, such as the specifications of the control panel, which is scheduled to be funded through crowdfunding.

entries.title: Is an era coming where gaming skills can be put to use in the workplace? We experienced Nittoku Construction’s demo of remotely operating heavy machinery with a controller [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: ゲームの腕を仕事に生かせる時代がやってくる？　コントローラで重機を遠隔操作する日特建設のデモを体験［TGS2026］
entries.description: Nittoku Construction, a construction company, is showcasing a demonstration at the Tokyo Game Show 2026 in which a game controller is used to operate heavy construction machinery located at a remote site. Perhaps the era when gaming skills can be put to use in the workplace is finally here. Here’s a report on the hands-on experience.

entries.title: "Disney Sparklink Stars" Launches "Decorate! Sparkrider Photo," a Special Website Where You Can Take Photos of Sparkriders and Have Fun Decorating Them
entries.title_ja: 「ディズニー スパークリンク・スターズ」，スパークライダーを撮影しデコレーションを楽しめる特設サイト「デコって！Sparkrider Photo」を開設
entries.description: Today (September 19, 2026), coly announced the launch of a special website called “Decorate! SparkriderPhoto” for the smartphone app “Disney Sparkrider Stars.” On this site, users can take photos of “Sparkriders” and decorate them with stickers.

entries.title: I checked out the newly released "Xeno Pro" gamepad at the LeadJoy booth. I also got to see a familiar attachment again.
entries.title_ja: 発売されたばかりの最新ゲームパッド「Xeno Pro」をLeadJoyブースでチェック。見覚えのあるアタッチメントとの再会も
entries.description: When I stopped by the LeadJoy booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, they were showcasing their latest gamepad, the “XenoPro,” which had just gone on sale. Priced at 9,980 yen (including tax), it offers a wide range of features at an affordable price.

entries.title: Colopl's event has been moved up from September 21 to September 20. The latest schedule for the 4Gamer booth has been announced [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: コロプラのイベントは9月21日から9月20日に前倒しで実施。4Gamerブースの最新スケジュールを発表［TGS2026］
entries.description: As announced by CESA today (September 19, 2026), due to the approach of Typhoon No. 25, it has been decided to cancel the Tokyo Game Show 2026 on September 21, which was scheduled to be the final day of the event. This decision will also affect the stage events scheduled for that day at the 4Gamer booth. Here is the updated schedule.

entries.title: As a prisoner who doesn't exist on the records, uncover the secrets the facility is hiding. The stealth horror game "PROCEDURE ZERO" is now available as a demo.
entries.title_ja: 記録上存在しない囚人として，施設が隠す秘密を探れ。ステルスホラー「PROCEDURE ZERO」，デモ版を配信開始
entries.description: On September 15, 2026, DELANIVOGAMES began distributing a demo version of its upcoming title, “PROCEDUREZERO.” The game is an adventure title that blends first-person stealth action with psychological horror.

entries.title: Kou Shibusawa stated unequivocally, “We will definitely make *Romance of the Three Kingdoms 15*.” Here’s a report on the special stage event where past development teams from the series discussed the 40-year history of the *Romance of the Three Kingdoms* series and the behind-the-scenes story of its production [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: “三國志15は必ず作る”とシブサワ・コウ氏が明言。シリーズ歴代開発陣が「三國志」シリーズ40年の歩みと制作の裏側を語ったスペシャルステージをレポート［TGS2026］
entries.description: Today (September 19), Koei Tecmo Games held a special stage event at its booth during the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” currently taking place at Makuhari Messe, to commemorate the 40th anniversary of its historical simulation game series “Romance of the Three Kingdoms” and look back on its history. Ko Shibusawa, who took the stage, also expressed his determination regarding the latest installment in the series.

entries.title: What happens when you remove the axis from a gamepad’s analog stick? We try out Axisray Lab’s “BASH,” which has a pleasantly “squishy” feel [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: ゲームパッドのアナログスティックから軸を取ったらどうなる？ “ぐにぃ”という感触が心地いいAxisray Labの「BASH」を試す［TGS2026］
entries.description: AxisrayLab had a booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, where it showcased its unique gamepad, “BASH.” This product is an unconventional device that features a proprietary mechanism called “GumiTap,” which serves as a replacement for the standard analog stick.

entries.title: On a houseboat sushi restaurant drifting through a Shibuya on the verge of being submerged, the player serves dishes tailored to a variety of guests. The narrative adventure game “SHIBUYA SUSHI MASTER” was a Japanese-style “coffee talk” [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 水没寸前の渋谷を漂う屋形船の寿司屋で，さまざまな来客にふさわしい一皿を振る舞う。ナラティブADV「SHIBUYA SUSHI MASTER」は日本風の「コーヒートーク」だった［TGS2026］
entries.description: TOONLEAGUE is showcasing its new title, “SHIBUYASUSHIMASTER,” at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026.” Set in Shibuya in the year 2688, just before it is submerged, this narrative adventure game follows the protagonist as they run a sushi restaurant and serve each customer the perfect dish. In this article, I’ll share my impressions of the game’s playability based on my hands-on experience.
