entries.title: A bunny suit that shows off her voluptuous bust! “Goddess of Victory: NIKKE” Viper – Toxic Rabbit joins the “Hyper Body” action figure series! Now available for pre-order at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 豊満バストが映えるバニースーツ！『勝利の女神：NIKKE』バイパー - トキシックラビットが可動フィギュア「Hyper Body」に登場！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: From *Goddess of Victory: NIKKE*, Viper - Toxic Rabbit is now available as a “Hyper Body” action figure! The set includes interchangeable facial expressions, the Last Chaser (weapon), a cell phone, and more! Pre-orders are now open at Rakuten Books! #NIKKE

entries.title: Aoshima's "The Model Car" series presents a 1/24-scale plastic model of the Honda PP1 Beat, a lightweight mid-engine convertible! Now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: アオシマ「ザ・モデルカー」より軽ミッドシップオープンカー「ホンダ PP1型ビート」が1/24スケールプラモデル化！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: A lightweight mid-engine convertible! Honda’s “PP1-type Beat” is now available as part of Aoshima’s 1/24-scale plastic model series, “The Model Car”! Now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books! #PlasticModel

entries.title: "Star Wars" characters like Luke and Darth Vader are joining the "PalVerse" series of palm-sized stylized figures! The lineup includes a total of 7 varieties, including a secret figure!
entries.title_ja: 『スター・ウォーズ』ルークやダースベイダーたちが手のひらサイズのデフォルメフィギュアシリーズ「PalVerse（パルバース）」に登場！ラインナップはシークレットを含む全7種！
entries.description: Bushiroad’s “PalVerse” chibi figure line is introducing a total of seven figures, including six popular “Star Wars” characters—such as Luke—and a secret figure! On sale Friday, September 18. #StarWars #PalVerse

entries.title: "Uma Musume: Pretty Derby" Rice Shower is getting a figure from Alter in her apron-style racing outfit [Yummy Dreamy Fairy]! Agnes Takion is also being re-released!
entries.title_ja: 『ウマ娘 プリティーダービー』ライスシャワーがエプロンドレス調の勝負服[Yummy Dreamy Fairy]姿でアルターからフィギュア化！アグネスタキオンも再販！
entries.description: From the game *Uma Musume: Pretty Derby*, “Rice Shower” is being released as a figure by Alter, dressed in her racing silks [Yummy Dreamy Fairy]! Agnes Takion is also being re-released! #UmaMusume

entries.title: Hedora from the movie *Godzilla vs. Hedora* makes his debut in the “Movie Monster Series Giga” soft vinyl figure line! Features highly detailed paintwork and packaging featuring an exclusive, newly drawn illustration!
entries.title_ja: 映画『ゴジラ対ヘドラ』よりヘドラがソフビフィギュア「ムービーモンスターシリーズ戯華（ギガ）」に初登場！より細部まで塗り分け＆パッケージは描き下ろしの特別イラスト！
entries.description: From the movie *Godzilla vs. Hedora*, Hedora makes his first appearance in the "Movie Monster Series Giga" soft vinyl figure line! Now available for pre-order at Premium Bandai! #Godzilla #Hedora

entries.title: SSK, a baseball equipment manufacturer, has released softball gloves featuring designs inspired by the “Ultraman Tiga” Color Timer and GUTS team uniforms! The lineup also includes short-sleeve and long-sleeve T-shirts that recreate the Color Timer and V-shaped lines!
entries.title_ja: 『ウルトラマンティガ』カラー＆GUTS隊員服デザインの軟式野球用グラブが野球メーカーのSSKから登場！カラータイマーやV字ラインを再現した半袖・長袖Tシャツもラインナップ！
entries.description: Pre-orders are now being accepted starting Friday, September 18, for softball gloves featuring designs inspired by Tiga and the “GUTS” team uniforms, created through a collaboration between *Ultraman Tiga* and baseball equipment manufacturer SSK! Short-sleeve and long-sleeve T-shirts featuring Tiga’s body design are also available for purchase! #UltramanTiga

entries.title: Her dignified expression is stunning! A 1/4-scale figure of Irelia, the Miss Maker from *League of Legends*, is here! Don’t miss the deluxe base with built-in lighting effects! Now available for pre-order at Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 凛とした表情が麗しい！『League of Legends』ミスメーカー イレリアが1/4スケールフィギュア化！発光ギミック内蔵の豪華台座も必見！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: "League of Legends" Miss Maker Irelia is now available as a 1/4-scale figure! Don't miss the beautiful sculpting, featuring a dynamic pose and flowing hair! Pre-orders are now open at Rakuten Books! #LoL

entries.title: Katsushika Hokusai × Hatsune Miku! "Hatsune Miku" is coming as a Nendoroid featuring a collaborative design by Rella inspired by ukiyo-e! Scheduled for release in April 2027!
entries.title_ja: 葛飾北斎×初音ミク！Rella氏による浮世絵とのコラボレーションデザインで「初音ミク」がねんどろいど化！2027年4月発売予定！
entries.description: From the "Katsushika Hokusai × Hatsune Miku" project, a collaboration design by illustrator Rella is being released as a Nendoroid! Scheduled for release in April 2027! #KatsushikaHokusai #HatsuneMiku

entries.title: The 1/24-scale plastic model “The ☆ Tuned Car” of the FD3S RX-7 based on *The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya* is back in a new format! In addition to decals, it comes with stickers for beginners! Now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books!
entries.title_ja: 『涼宮ハルヒの憂鬱』仕様のFD3S RX-7の1/24スケールプラモデル「ザ☆チューンドカー」が新フォーマットで再登場！デカールに加え初心者向けにシールも付属！楽天ブックスで予約受付中！
entries.description: The "The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya"-themed FD3S RX-7 is making a comeback in a new format to commemorate the anime’s 20th anniversary! Aoshima’s 1/24-scale plastic model kit, “The ☆ Tuned Car,” is now available for pre-order on Rakuten Books! #HaruhiSuzumiya #PlasticModelKit

entries.title: [TGS 2026] Introducing the Official "Bishoujo" Cosplayers of the Tokyo Game Show
entries.title_ja: 【TGS2026】東京ゲームショウ美少女公式コスプレイヤー紹介
entries.description:
Article Updated: September 18, 2026 On September 17, 2026, Cospot’s official photographer had the chance to interview some wonderful cosplayers spotted at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026” held at Makuhari Messe♪ Read this article […]
The post [TGS2026] Introducing the Official Beautiful Cosplayers of the Tokyo Game Show first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: [Heisei-Era Anime Cosplay] Why Is It Gaining Attention Again in the Reiwa Era? Why These Nostalgic Works Resonate Once More Today
entries.title_ja: 【平成アニメコスプレ】なぜ令和に再注目？懐かしい作品が今また刺さる理由
entries.description:
While cosplays based on the latest anime and video games keep popping up one after another, haven’t you noticed that when you browse social media or attend events lately, you’re increasingly coming across cosplays that make you think, “Oh, this series brings back memories!”? *The Melancholy of Haruhi Suzumiya*, *Higurashi: When They Cry*, *The Private Tutor Hitman […]]
The post [Heisei-Era Anime Cosplay] Why Are They Gaining Attention Again in the Reiwa Era? Reasons Why Nostalgic Works Resonate Once More first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: "SophieChat:AI," the chat AI app for *Atelier Sophie*, was announced out of the blue. Following the *Liza* version, a *Sophie* version is also coming.
entries.title_ja: 『ソフィーのアトリエ』のチャットAIアプリ『SophieChat:AI』電撃発表。ライザに続いてソフィー版も出る
entries.description: On September 18, Koei Tecmo Games and SpiralAI announced "SophieChat:AI."

entries.title: DMM's full-scale 3D "beautiful girl" RPG "ANGELICA ASTER" will end service on October 19. The spiritual successor to "The Giant God and the Vow-Bound Maiden" will come to a close after approximately two years.
entries.title_ja: DMMによる本格3D美少女RPG『ANGELICA ASTER』10月19日にサービス終了へ。『巨神と誓女』のコンセプト後継作、約2年で幕を下ろす
entries.description: On September 18, DMM GAMES announced that it would discontinue service for "ANGELICA ASTER" on October 19.

entries.title: "Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back" takes the series' signature "extra, extra, extra" style to the next level. It takes exhilarating action—which showcases Juliet's charm to the fullest—to the extreme.
entries.title_ja: 『ロリポップチェーンソー 2 Back2Back』はシリーズ作の表現“マシマシ盛り盛り”に進化。ジュリエットの魅力を最大限に生かした爽快アクションを突き詰める
entries.description: Details regarding the production status of *Lollipop Chainsaw 2: Back2Back* and the background leading to the development of the sequel were revealed during a stage event at the Tokyo Game Show 2026.

entries.title: The “Ryza’s Atelier” chat AI app, “RyzaChat:AI,” is also considering “multiplayer for up to four players.” Plans for updates—including Ryza’s skins and a Japan Travel mode—are coming one after another.
entries.title_ja: 『ライザのアトリエ』チャットAIアプリ『RyzaChat:AI』では“最大4人マルチプレイ”も検討中。ライザのスキンや日本旅モードなど、アプデ構想続々
entries.description: It is reported that the developers are considering adding a multiplayer mode for up to four players to the game.

entries.title: The file size of *Final Fantasy VII: Revelations* is expected to be “about 200 GB”—equivalent to two copies of *FFVII Remake*.
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』の容量、「約200GB」になりそう。『FFVII リメイク』2本分
entries.description: Naoki Hamaguchi revealed details about the file size of *Final Fantasy VII: Revelations* in an interview with the international media outlet VGC.

entries.title: "Future Knight," a "rich and quirky game" with a slick, LCD-style look, continues to gain popularity while maintaining a 98% approval rating. This "Game & Watch"-style action game from the developers of "Narita Boy"—masters of smooth pixel art—is steadily gaining momentum.
entries.title_ja: ぬるぬる液晶風“濃厚奇ゲー”『Future Knight』好評率98%のまま人気高まる。滑らかドット絵名手『Narita Boy』開発元が放つ「ゲーム&ウオッチ」風アクションがじわじわ勢い増す
entries.description: On August 14, Aeternum Game Studios released "Future Knight," a 2D action game that pays homage to "Game & Watch."

entries.title: "Shangri-La Frontier"’s game "Shannana" isn’t a "crap game," but it’s not your typical game either. It’s a condensed game that lets you play with one hand while giving you the full "MMO raid experience."
entries.title_ja: 『シャングリラ・フロンティア』のゲーム『シャンナナ』は“クソゲーじゃない”、しかしよくあるゲームでもない。片手で遊べる「MMOレイドやってる感」濃縮ゲーム
entries.description: After trying out *Shangri-La Frontier: The Seven Strongest Species*, I found that it had turned out to be a “game that isn’t a piece of crap”—which, in a sense, could be seen as a faithful recreation of the original.

entries.title: "Kaguraden," a Japanese-style roguelike dungeon-crawling RPG featuring "vertical elevation changes," has been unveiled on Steam. Players can take advantage of the vertical dimensions to navigate the hexagonal grid dungeons.
entries.title_ja: 「高低差あり」和風ローグライクダンジョン探索RPG『カグラデン』Steamにてお披露目。高さも活かし、六角グリッドのダンジョンを攻略
entries.description: On September 18, Jet Studio unveiled the Steam store page for *Kaguraden*. The game is a roguelike RPG in which players navigate maps composed of hexagons.

entries.title: "Fluffy Spy Dog" action game *Barkool* features special forces dog moves captured via motion capture from a former military dog—and the dog occasionally gets a little rowdy. This stealth game utilizes high-tech mechs; a demo version is now available.
entries.title_ja: 「もふもふスパイ犬」アクション『バークール』は“元軍用犬をモーキャプ”した特殊部隊わんこムーブ、時々はしゃぐ。ハイテクメカ活用ステルスゲーム、デモ版配信中
entries.description: VARSAV Game Studios plans to release "BARKOUR" in the fourth quarter of this year.

entries.title: The developer of the new Souls-like game *Valor Mortis* has announced it will “stop selling at full price.” With an eye on the fall rush of new releases, the game will be priced so players can “pick it up on a whim.”
entries.title_ja: 新作ソウルライク『Valor Mortis』開発元が「フルプライス販売やめる」宣言。秋の新作ラッシュを見据え、“ついで買い”できる価格に
entries.description: Lyrical Games and One More Level announced that the price of the Souls-like RPG *Valor Mortis* will be set at approximately $40 (about 6,200 yen). This price cut comes ahead of the wave of new releases expected this fall.

entries.title: "BrainWash: Zombie Cleanup," a co-op zombie cleanup sim, has been announced. You start by “cleaning up” the scene, and as you eliminate zombies, more work piles up.
entries.title_ja: 協力プレイ対応「ゾンビ災害の後始末」シム『BrainWash: Zombie Cleanup』発表。まずは現場を“一掃”するところから、駆除するたび仕事も増える
entries.description: On September 17, Haz Games announced *BrainWash: Zombie Cleanup*.

entries.title: Mouse Computer’s “Unique New Gaming PC” is the perfect first machine. A desktop PC that deliberately uses a laptop CPU, featuring a bold design that balances performance and quiet operation.
entries.title_ja: マウスコンピューター“異色の新ゲーミングPC”は初めての1台にちょうどいい。ノートPC向けCPUをあえて使ったデスクトップPC、性能と静音性両立の欲張り仕様
entries.description: This model strikes the perfect balance, offering both quiet operation and ease of use in everyday life while also delivering the processing power needed for gaming and the customization options of a BTO system.

entries.title: The highly acclaimed terrain-shifting strategy game *Endless Legend 2* is taking the gaming world by storm following its official release. As the seas recede and land expands, the struggle for supremacy continues to ebb and flow.
entries.title_ja: 高評価・地形変動ストラテジー『エンドレス・レジェンド 2』正式リリースで人気沸騰。海が干上がり土地拡大、情勢のうねり止まぬ覇権争い
entries.description: On September 18, Japan time, Hooded Horse officially released *ENDLESS Legend 2*. This turn-based strategy game features factions vying for dominance in a world with ever-changing terrain.

entries.title: Disney's 3D action game, *Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed*, is coming to smartphones. The game, featuring Mickey wielding a magic brush, will now be available across all platforms.
entries.title_ja: ディズニーの3Dアクション『ディズニー エピックミッキー：Rebrushed』スマホ向けにも登場。魔法の筆を操るミッキーのゲームが、プラットフォームを選ばず遊べるように
entries.description: On September 16, THQ Nordic released *Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed* for iOS. It was also released for Android on September 17.

entries.title: “Sea Tower” Desktop Idle Fishing Game *CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife* Set for Release on October 9. Fish, Build, and Eventually Soar to the Skies—A Slow-Life Experience in a Submerged World Where You Can “Gaze at the Constellations” at Night
entries.title_ja: “海上タワー”デスクトップ放置釣りゲーム『CELESTAY Craft&Slowlife』10月9日配信へ。釣って建ててやがて空へ、夜は”星座を眺める“水没世界スローライフ
entries.description: On September 18, BUBBLE GUM announced that "CELESTAY Craft & Slowlife" will be released digitally on October 8. This game is a "slow life" game that incorporates idle gameplay elements.

entries.title: The cheerleader with a chainsaw and her head-only boyfriend are back. A world-first hands-on experience with “LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW 2 Back2Back” [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: チェーンソー持ちのチアリーダーと，首だけボーイフレンドが帰ってきた。「LOLLIPOP CHAINSAW 2 Back2Back」を世界初体験［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the Tokyo Game Show 2026, a playable demo of the new game “LOLLIPOPCHAINSAW2Back2Back” was showcased at the Sega/Atlus booth. Juliet, a blonde high school girl with a passion for cheerleading, is once again slicing and dicing zombies.

entries.title: Kajima Construction’s “OPSODIS 1” desktop speaker offers a soundstage that feels just like wearing headphones. It’s also the perfect device for ASMR [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: 鹿島建設の卓上スピーカー「OPSODIS 1」，ヘッドフォンを装着したような音場を体験。ASMRにも最適な機材だ［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the Tokyo Game Show 2026 venue, I had the opportunity to experience the performance of Kajima Corporation’s desktop speaker, the “OPSODIS1,” so I’d like to share my impressions of it. There are also several products at the venue that originated from crowdfunding campaigns. It might be worth exploring the venue from that perspective as well.

entries.title: A new title starring Hololive’s “Koyori Hakui,” *Koyorinium*, was announced; I checked out the Entergram booth [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: ホロライブ“博衣こより”さん主演の新作「コヨリニウム」が発表された，エンターグラムのブースを見た［TGS2026］
entries.description: I checked out the Entergram booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026. Among the lineup of recently announced titles, the highlight of the TGS announcement was the latest collaboration between Hololive and Entergram: “Koyorinium,” starring Koyori Hakui.

entries.title: [Play Report] "CONTROL Resonant" takes place in Manhattan. Immerse yourself in this supernatural world, where both the scale of the story and the combat action have undergone a major transformation since the previous game.
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］「CONTROL Resonant」の舞台はマンハッタンへ。物語のスケールもバトルアクションも前作から大きく変貌を遂げた超常世界を堪能しよう
entries.description: Remedy Entertainment’s latest title, “CONTROL Resonant,” will be released on September 24. Seven years after the events of the previous game, Dylan, who has just awakened, rises to action armed with “Avelant,” the melee weapon entrusted to him by his sister. We’ll provide a detailed look at our impressions from an early hands-on session, covering features such as three-dimensional movement, puzzles, and combat that has shifted its focus to melee.

entries.title: It’s basically a complete remake, isn’t it? I played *Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX* and was surprised by how much it’s changed. There’s also an interview with the developers. [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: なんか，ほぼフルリメイクじゃない？「遊戯王 TAG FORCE GX」をプレイして，その変わりっぷりに驚いた。開発者インタビューもあるよ［TGS 2026］
entries.description: At the KONAMI booth during the ongoing “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” “Yu-Gi-Oh! TAGFORCE GX”—which caused a stir when it was suddenly announced on September 9, 2026—was on display. Why has a digital title from a previous era been remade now? We’ll bring you a hands-on play report and highlights from our interview.

entries.title: A fast-paced, high-energy adventure game where you quickly fulfill customer requests! — But behind it all lies a bleak apocalypse. Play "Roman Sands RE:Build," which depicts a complex world [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 素早く客の要求に応えるハイテンションADV！ ――の裏に隠された陰鬱な終末。複雑な世界を描く「Roman Sands RE:Build」をプレイ［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the Tokyo Game Show 2026, which has been running since September 17, 2026, the new title “RomanSandsRE:Build” was on display. Set in a luxury resort as the end of the world approaches, this first-person adventure game involves fulfilling the requests of strange guests—but unsettling elements are hidden throughout.

entries.title: "Kirby" and Tirol Choco Team Up! Tirol Choco BOX and Strawberry Shortcake-Flavored Chocolates to Be Released Gradually
entries.title_ja: 「星のカービィ」とチロルチョコがコラボ！ チロルチョコBOXやいちごショートケーキ味のチョコを順次発売
entries.description: Today (September 18, 2026), Tirol Chocolate announced a collaboration with "Kirby." Two products—the "Kirby Tirol Chocolate Box" and the "Kirby Tirol Chocolate <Strawberry Shortcake>"—will go on sale in October.

entries.title: Can "Scent" Help Create a Space Where You Can Focus on Gaming? What Is "Gaming Air," as Proposed by Scent Specialist Carmore? [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: ゲームに集中できる空間作りは「匂い」から？ 匂いの専門企業であるカルモアが提唱する「ゲーミングエアー」とは［TGS2026］
entries.description: Calmore, a company that develops deodorizing and odor-eliminating products, is exhibiting at the Tokyo Game Show. The company’s focus has shifted slightly since its last appearance; this time, it is promoting a concept called “Gaming Air” and proposing solutions for odors in gaming spaces.

entries.title: Left the company to devote his final year to development. Interview with Surume Manjuu, creator of the mecha shoot 'em up “OMEGA PHENEX” [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 最後の1年を開発に専念するため退社。メカSTG「OMEGA PHENEX」するめまんじゅう氏インタビュー［TGS2026］
entries.description: The mecha shoot 'em up “OMEGAPHENEXCOMMENCEDPROJECTSIX” is being showcased at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026.” We spoke with Surume Manjuu, who has been developing the game almost single-handedly for eight years and resigned from his company in August 2026.

entries.title: Come try out the brand-new, feature-packed game “SlashZero” at the 4Gamer booth—featuring anime-style 3D graphics, exhilarating side-scrolling action, and roguelike elements that make building your character a blast [TGS2026]
entries.title_ja: アニメ調の3Dグラフィックス，爽快な横スクロールアクション，ビルド構築が楽しいローグライク要素など，魅力たっぷりの新作「SlashZero」を4Gamerブースで遊ぼう［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the 4Gamer booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, which is being held from September 17 to 21, 2026, “SlashZero” is available for hands-on play. With anime-style 3D graphics, smooth and satisfying side-scrolling action, and roguelike elements that make building your character fun, this title is packed with appeal.

entries.title: "Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement" Releases "TGS 2026 Gameplay Trailer" Showcasing Combat and Exploration with Two Protagonists
entries.title_ja: 「Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement」，2人の主人公による戦闘や探索を収めた「TGS2026 ゲームプレイトレーラー」を公開
entries.description: On September 17, 2026, 505Games and ArtPlay released the “TGS 2026 Gameplay Trailer” for *Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement*. The video showcases combat and exploration featuring Leonardo and Alexander, as well as the gothic world of 16th-century England rendered in 2.5D.

entries.title: PARCO GAMES is celebrating its first anniversary. Look for their booth at this year’s TGS—it’s easy to spot with its white walls and tall structure! They’ll be showcasing the Switch version of “Finding Polka” and more [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: 1周年を迎えるPARCO GAMES。今年のTGSも白い壁と高さのあるブースが目印！ 「Finding Polka」のSwitch版などを出展［TGS2026］
entries.description: PARCOGAMES, celebrating its first anniversary since the label’s founding, is exhibiting at TGS 2026. The booth, featuring white walls and a tall structure, showcases “FindingPolka,” “DEPERSON,” and “Constance,” and the “PARCOGAMES JOURNAL” pamphlet is also being distributed.

entries.title: "UNDERGROUNDED," a mystery-solving adventure game that explores American history and culture, will be released for Nintendo Switch on January 28, 2027
entries.title_ja: アメリカの歴史と文化をたどる謎解きADV「UNDERGROUNDED」，Nintendo Switch版を2027年1月28日にリリース
entries.description: On September 17, 2026, room6 announced that the Nintendo Switch version of “UNDERGROUNDED”—developed by Game Studio and currently available on Steam—will be released on January 28, 2027. The game is a dungeon-crawling puzzle-adventure that explores American history and culture.

entries.title: The game features more characters, making it even cuter—but the enemies are anything but cute. A sneak peek at the two-player co-op mode in the roguelike action game “Cinderia” [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: キャラが増えて可愛さアップだが，敵の強さは可愛くない。ローグライトアクション「Cinderia」の2人協力モードを先行体験［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the 4Gamer booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, the roguelike action game “Cinderia” is available for hands-on play. Released on March 30, 2026, the title has garnered over 4,000 Steam reviews and earned a “Very Positive” rating; at the TGS venue, visitors can get an early look at the “2-player co-op mode” scheduled for future implementation.

entries.title: "Walking House" Craft Adventure Game 'Bloomwalker' Officially Announced. A Journey to Purify a Polluted World—Could This Be a New Title Related to Level-5's 'Ni no Kuni'?

entries.description: On August 21, Netmarble officially announced “Bloomwalker.”

entries.title: The creators of *Doki Doki Bungei-bu!* have announced their new title, *Faraday Blues*. This dark card-based adventure game centers on a character who “arbitrarily resets” her parents’ lives because they’re “too miserable,” featuring 64 endings—almost all of which are bad endings.

entries.description: On September 17, Serenity Forge announced *Faraday Blues* and stated that it will be released in 2027.

entries.title: A whopping 560 titles have been added to the Nintendo Switch 2/Switch sale. Titles like *Word Play* and *Battlefield Fugue 3* are at near-record lows, and a “chore game” featuring a little witch has also hit a new all-time low, making it a great deal.

entries.description: On September 17, a new sale on titles for the Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch began on the Nintendo eShop. Approximately 560 titles are included in the sale.

entries.title: The zombie-slaying hack-and-slash survival game *Reincarnation Insurance Co., Ltd. R.I.P.* has officially launched. A new character—a “sexy ninja specializing in melee combat”—has joined the fray, and with the addition of a final boss and Endless Mode, the possibilities for building your character are endless.

entries.description: On September 16, 2P Games officially released *Reincarnation Insurance Co., Ltd. R.I.P.*, developed by WarmCore Studio.

entries.title: The alien invasion action game *Destroy All Humans! 2 – Re-Probed* is now available for the Switch 2. Wreak havoc on Earth with weapons and supernatural powers—and in the Japanese version, you’ll even battle “Kojira.”

entries.description: On September 17, THQ Nordic began distributing the Nintendo Switch version of *Destroy All Humans! 2 - Reprobed*.

entries.title: The free-to-play MMORPG "Mabinogi Mobile" is set to launch on PC and smartphones on October 7. "The New Mabinogi," where you can battle and build your own home, brings a cozy lifestyle that’s coming soon.

entries.description: "Mabinogi Mobile" will be released on October 7.

entries.title: "Hope in the City," a mystery game in which you track down your missing parents, is set to be released on November 10. Record all evidence through "sketches" and chart a path to the truth.

entries.description: On September 17, Lofty Sky Entertainment announced that "Hope in the City" will be released digitally on November 10. It is a story-driven mystery game in which a young protagonist sets out to find his parents, who have suddenly disappeared.

entries.description: It has been hinted that a body type change system for the protagonist of *Atelier Karia: The Kingdom of Night and the Signposts of Memories* is on its way to being implemented.

entries.title: The wildly popular, multi-platform MOBA-style roguelike *Shape of Dreams* has suddenly launched on PS5, Xbox, and Switch, along with a major update. New gameplay depth is added with a new frost-wielding character and a system that randomizes boss behavior.

entries.description: "Shape of Dreams" for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2 has been released unexpectedly. A major update was also released at the same time.

entries.description: On September 16, Vals AI reported on the progress of an experiment in which it had GPT-6 Astra play *Minecraft*. Although Astra’s gameplay was going smoothly, the company said it suddenly became reluctant after a certain incident.

entries.title: Mouse Computer has made a big splash with the announcement of three new gaming products. The lineup includes a new model that combines high performance with quiet operation, as well as a machine that lets you enjoy gaming anywhere using “GeForce NOW,” among other offerings.
entries.title_ja: マウスコンピューターからゲーミング向け新製品3種ドドンと発表。高性能＆静音両立新モデルから「GeForce NOW」活用どこでもゲーム環境満喫マシンなどいろいろ
entries.description: On September 17, Mouse Computer announced three new products. The lineup includes two new desktop PCs and a docking station for tablet PCs.

entries.title: "The Apothecary's Tale: The False Imperial Brother," developed by Gust (the studio behind the "Atelier" series), actually began as "Nekomeko's Atelier." It came to fruition immediately following a proposal from the anime adaptation of "The Apothecary's Tale."

entries.description: It appears that one of the catalysts for the project was when Toho came up with an idea for a project called “Neko Neko’s Atelier” and proposed it to the Gusto brand.

entries.title: The online post-apocalyptic survival game *Once Human* is set to release its major update, “The Forbidden Island,” on October 22. Build a ship and set sail into the vast ocean where monstrous creatures roam.

entries.description: The company announced that it will release "Isles of Abyss," a major update for the Ocean chapter, on October 22.

entries.title: “Fight with Custom Moves”: The physics-based sword-fighting action game *Gladio Mori* has finally been officially released. Aim for arteries and organs to knock out opponents—a hit title with “sales of approximately 200 million yen.”

"Nemesis" from *Kinnikuman* is joining SpiceSeed’s *Kinnikuman* series. Pre-orders are now being accepted on the SpiceSeed website. The following is an excerpt from the press release. Shattered by the betrayal and darkness of the Kinnikuman clan, he harbors a deep hatred […]

entries.title: From "Oni-Pien" to the "Hammer of Justice" (Political Correctness Hammer), "Dead Account: Two Blue Flames"—a game where you manipulate electricity with your smartphone [TGS 2026]

entries.title: "Granblue Fantasy Versus -Rising-" Releases Version 2.60, Adding the New Character "Ido" and New Gameplay Systems
entries.title_ja: 「グランブルーファンタジーヴァーサス -ライジング-」，新キャラ“イド”や新たなシステムを追加するVer 2.60を配信
entries.description: Cygames began rolling out the latest update, Version 2.60, for “Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising” today (September 17, 2026). With this update, “Ido” from “GRANBLUE FANTASY: Relink” joins the roster as a new DLC character.

entries.title: "Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes" is scheduled for release in 2027. Newly drawn visuals for the game have been unveiled.

entries.description: Today (September 17, 2026), Sanrio unveiled new artwork for “Fragaria Memories: Color of Wishes,” a smartphone game based on the chivalric fantasy project “Fragaria Memories,” which blends storytelling and music.

entries.title: Get an early look at “Mabinogi Mobile” at a booth featuring a campfire—a signature touch of the game. Take a peek into the world of Erin, both nostalgic and fresh, on your iPad [TGS 2026]

The booth features an area where visitors can play on iPads while gathered around a campfire, allowing them to experience the true spirit of Mabinogi through both the gameplay environment and the content itself.

entries.title: Tottori Prefecture Itself Becomes a Game! Report from the “TOTTORI GAME SHOW” Reveals the Mechanics and Game Content of “Ryugu-koku Tottori,” an “RPG Connected to Reality” [TGS2026]

entries.description: "Ryugu-koku Tottori" is an RPG that incorporates Tottori's mythology, cuisine, and cityscape, linking real-world actions to the game. The game's content and the full scope of this ambitious project were revealed at the "TOTTORIGAMESHOW," where Mr. Tabata and others took the stage.

entries.title: "Mobile Police Patlabor: The Case Files," a 3D action game that lets you relive iconic scenes from "Mobile Police Patlabor," is released today.
entries.title_ja: 「機動警察パトレイバー」の名シーンを追体験できる3Dアクション「機動警察パトレイバー the Case Files」が本日リリース

entries.title: A full remake of a classic with a gameplay feel reminiscent of “LibesaGa.” Experience the reimagined exploration and combat in a hands-on demo of “Romancing SaGa 3: Destiny United” [TGS 2026]

entries.description: Square Enix is showcasing a playable demo of *Romancing SaGa 3: Destiny United* at the *Tokyo Game Show 2026*. At the venue, visitors could try out two scenarios: “Rescue the Lost Gon!” and “The Evil Dragon Gweyn.” How have the exploration, combat, and character-development systems been reimagined from the original game? We went to check it out for ourselves.

entries.title: Throw those custom dice! The dice-action roguelike “GIMMIKO” was a game with incredible “passion” born from its overwhelming attention to detail [TGS 2026]
entries.title_ja: カスタムダイスをぶん投げろ！ ダイスアクションローグライト「GIMMIKO」は，圧倒的な作り込みが生む“熱量”がすさまじい作品だった［TGS2026］
entries.description: At the CRITICALREFLEX booth at the "Tokyo Game Show 2026," which kicked off today (September 17), the new title "GIMMIKO" by SorryPoniko! was on display. The prototype version of this game, which was well-received at the "GMTK Game Jam," has since evolved—but how exactly? I played it myself to find out.

entries.title: Genro-shiko had been struggling with issues such as a “name barrier” and “difficulty in communicating its message.” The concept and product lineup for the new brand “Crowxis” have been revealed [TGS 2026]

entries.description: Why is the long-established PC component brand “Gurento Shiko” transitioning to the new brand “Crowxis”? Here’s what the president of CFD Sales explained at the company’s booth at the Tokyo Game Show 2026, along with information on the graphics cards and power supplies scheduled for release under the new brand.

entries.description: At the joint booth (09-W01) of Xing and Gifu Plastic Industries in Hall 9 of the Tokyo Game Show 2026, an exhibition was held featuring a combination of “Karaoke JOYSOUND for STREAMER,” a karaoke service for live streamers and video creators, and “VOICEBOX,” a soundproof booth designed for streaming and singing.

entries.title: Let’s protect the story alongside the tiny Sword Men! A hands-on preview of the casual and exhilarating “Touken Ranbu Puzzle Cut” [TGS 2026]

entries.description: The new smartphone puzzle game “Touken Ranbu Pazugiri” is on display at the DMMGAMES booth at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026.” Visitors can try out the game at the booth. I was able to play a demo session lasting about two minutes per stage, so I’ll share my first impressions.

entries.title: "Lumi Master," a monster-collecting and raising RPG, launches today. Collect and raise over 100 types of "Lumi." Supports one-handed play.
entries.title_ja: モンスター収集×育成RPG「Lumi Master」，本日リリース。100種類以上の「るぅみ」を集めて育成。片手操作にも対応
entries.description: bilibiliGame today launched the official service for “LumiMaster,” a monster-collecting and -raising RPG. Set in the mysterious and fantastical world of the “Lumia Continent,” this game lets players collect over 100 types of “Rumi” and embark on adventures while raising and evolving them. It also features vertical-screen, one-handed controls and is designed for quick, casual play sessions of about 5 minutes each.

entries.title: "Mabinogi Mobile" Set for Release on October 7. An online RPG depicting adventures in Erin
entries.title_ja: 「マビノギモバイル」，10月7日に配信決定。エリンでの冒険を描いたオンラインRPG
entries.description: Nexon announced today that it will release the online RPG “Mabinogi Mobile” on October 7, 2026. The game will operate on a free-to-play model with in-game purchases. Set in the same world of “Erin” as “Mabinogi”—which has been in service since 2005—this game depicts adventures in that world.

entries.title: Cook to the monsters' tastes! We experienced the terror of serving monsters in "SATED," which features a slot machine-style ingredient delivery system [TGS 2026]

entries.description: At the “Tokyo Game Show 2026,” currently being held in Makuhari, there are many indie-related booths, offering more opportunities to discover interesting games. “SATED,” the game we’re covering here, is one such title I came across. Here’s a play report on this unique game where you cook to avoid being eaten by monsters.

entries.title: "Creation of the World" is set for release on January 14, 2027. New features include "Arrange Mode," rewind functionality, and a museum. A playable demo will be available at TGS 2026 [TGS2026].

entries.description: ClearRiverGames announced today that it will release the action RPG "Creation of the World" on January 14, 2027. This is a revival of the original 1995 version for current-generation consoles, featuring new additions such as "Arrange Mode," a rewind function, and a music player. A playable demo is also being showcased at the Tokyo Game Show 2026.

entries.title: Mercari Bans Listings of “Pokémon Card Game” 30th Anniversary Packs for “a Certain Period.” Announces Measures to Prevent “Immediate Resale” on the Day Before Release

entries.description: On September 15, Mercari, Inc. announced that it would prohibit the listing of products related to the "30th CELEBRATION" MEGA expansion pack for the "Pokémon Card Game" starting September 16.

entries.title: "AWS BuilderCards," an "Amazon Web Services" educational card game that was previously unavailable for sale in Japan, will go on sale on September 25 on Amazon. Players can learn about "best-practice, well-architected architectures" through gameplay.
entries.title_ja: 日本で非売品だった「Amazon Web Services」学習カードゲーム『AWS BuilderCards』9月25日に発売、Amazonにて。“ベストプラクティスなウェルアーキテクテッドのアーキテクチャ”を遊んで学べる
entries.description: The Japanese version of "AWS BuilderCards," a card game that teaches players about AWS—which was previously available only at events in Japan—is now available for purchase on Amazon.

entries.title: ARG "Poker Dolls" to Be Adapted into a Game on Steam. The life-or-death poker game played by girls who "must not let it be released" is coming as a mystery adventure game.
entries.title_ja: ARG「Poker Dolls」Steamでゲーム化決定。“リリースさせてはいけない”少女たちの命がけのポーカーが、ミステリーADVとして
entries.description: On September 15, NTT Solmare announced that it would develop a video game based on the ARG “Poker Dolls.”

entries.title: The hugely popular card shop management sim "TCG Card Shop Simulator" has officially launched, introducing a massive number of new cards—an impressive total of "1,452 types." Once you build a deck, you can even "play against yourself."
entries.title_ja: 大好評カードショップ経営シム『TCG Card Shop Simulator』正式リリースで新カード大量投入、その数圧巻の「1452種」。デッキを組めば“自分で対戦”もできる
entries.description: OPNeon Games officially released "TCG Card Shop Simulator" on September 15.

entries.title: "Total War: Warhammer 40,000" Early Access Impressions: From getting started with this popular strategy game—complete with Japanese subtitles—to wiping out enemy legions with special weapons
entries.title_ja: 『トータルウォー：ウォーハンマー40,000』先行プレイ感想。日本語字幕付きで人気ストラテジーゲーム入門から、特殊兵器で敵軍団を一網打尽まで体験
entries.description: In this article, I’d like to share my impressions based on about 75 minutes of gameplay. I’ll focus primarily on the tutorial and campaign modes.

entries.title: NHN PlayArt’s new title from the creators of “#Compass” is “OVER RUSH,” a lightning-fast card battle RPG for Steam and mobile. We spoke with the developers about their commitment to the philosophy of “fun right from the start.”
entries.title_ja: 『#コンパス』のNHN PlayArtの新作は、Steam/モバイル向け爆速カードバトルRPG『OVER RUSH』。「プレイしてすぐ楽しい」理念を貫く、開発者に聞いた
entries.description: We interviewed Mr. Kota Terada, the game’s development producer. He shared some fascinating insights into the game’s development history and key features.

entries.title: In the wildly popular 100-player multiplayer FPS *WARDOGS*, a theory that the “Blue Team is the weakest” has somehow taken hold. There have even been instances where matches couldn’t start because the Blue Team was so heavily avoided that there weren’t enough players.
entries.title_ja: 大人気100人対戦FPS『WARDOGS』なぜか“青チーム最弱説”が広まる。避けられすぎて人数不足でマッチが始まらない事態も発生
entries.description: In *WARDOGS*, rumors seem to be spreading that Lonestar (the blue team)—one of the three teams in the league—is the “weakest.”

entries.title: The wildly popular multi-platform survival crafting game *RuneScape: Dragon Wilds* has finally been officially released. Embark on an adventure filled with freedom and romance as you set out to defeat a giant dragon—and a major update has introduced the “final boss.”
entries.title_ja: 大人気マルチ対応サバイバルクラフト『ルーンスケープ：ドラゴンワイルズ』ついに正式リリース。巨大ドラゴン討伐を目指す自由とロマンの冒険、大型アプデで“ラスボス”も実装
entries.description: On September 15, Jagex officially released the survival crafting game *RuneScape: Dragonwilds*.

entries.title: "Fantasy Idle Expedition," an adventurer-training idle RPG, is set to launch on October 9. Three squads set out simultaneously in a chaotic frenzy, while you spend your time meticulously selecting gear right from your desktop.
entries.title_ja: 冒険者育成・放置型RPG『ファンタジー放置遠征隊』10月9日配信へ。3部隊がわちゃわちゃ同時出撃、デスクトップ下で装備厳選三昧
entries.description: On September 14, Infini Fun announced that it will release *Fantasy Idle Expedition*, developed by One Interactive Studio, on October 9.

entries.title: "Mega Man X: Command Mission" is making its first-ever re-release on PS5 and PS4 after 22 years, and it’s available for individual purchase. It’s the only turn-based command RPG in the "Mega Man X" series.
entries.title_ja: PS5/PS4にて『ロックマンX コマンドミッション』が22年越しの初復刻、単品購入もできる。『ロックマンX』シリーズ唯一のターン制コマンドRPG
entries.description: On September 15, Capcom began offering the RPG *Mega Man X: Command Mission*, originally released for the PS2, through the "Classics Catalog" for PS Plus Premium subscribers. The game is also now available for individual purchase.

entries.title: First Impressions of NHN PlayArt’s New Blazing-Fast Card Battle RPG, “OVER RUSH.” A “short, intense” game where matches wrap up in just a few minutes, but still keep your mind working at full speed.
entries.title_ja: NHN PlayArt新作爆速カードバトルRPG『OVER RUSH』先行プレイ感想。数分間でサクッと決着がつく、だけど頭はフル回転な「短期集中」型ゲーム
entries.description: "OVER RUSH" is a fast-paced card battle RPG that incorporates roguelike elements. We got an early look at its "short, intense" battles.

entries.title: A new game starring Azusa Honami, titled “Aju~ru Memoria,” has been announced. Following titles such as “Oka-yu Nyu~~mu!,” “Aju-nee” is making her gaming debut.
entries.title_ja: 本阿弥あずささん主演の新作ゲーム『あじゅ～るメモリア』発表。『おかゆにゅ～～む！』などに続き、「あじゅ姉」がゲームに
entries.description: On September 15, Entergram announced a new game titled "Aju~ru Memoria," starring and supervised by Azusa Honami.

entries.title: The Great Sword from *Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance* is finally revealed. With moves like the Mach-Speed Blade Slash and Counter & Follow-Up, it’s incredibly fast.
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ：アセンダンス』の太刀、満を持してお披露目。マッハ気刃斬りや相殺＆追撃などとにかく素早い
entries.description: A video introducing the Great Sword in *Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance* has been released.

entries.title: "Escape from Tarkov" is finally introducing a "ranking system," with the new "League" system set to kick off tonight. A weekly experience point race where 50 players compete for promotion.
entries.title_ja: 『Escape from Tarkov』にいよいよ“ランク制”導入、新システム「リーグ」が今夜開幕へ。昇格を賭けて50人で競い合う、“毎週決着”経験値レース
entries.description: On September 15, Battlestate Games announced that it had begun server maintenance for Update 1.1.5.1 of "Escape from Tarkov."

entries.title: "Ninjala 2: The Unknown Planet" Developer Interview: The open-world version of "Ninjala" focuses on "movement and comfort" as its core ninja elements, creating a PvE open world where you can play with friends.
entries.title_ja: 『ニンジャラ２ 未知なる惑星』開発者インタビュー。オープンワールド化した『ニンジャラ』は「移動と快適さ」のニンジャ要素で勝負、友達とも遊べるPvEオープンワールドへ
entries.description: We spoke with Motoki Kaneda, the director of this title, about everything from the start of development to the game’s overall features and the highlights that set it apart from existing open-world titles.

entries.title: The indie game festival “TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2027” is set to take place on March 27 and 28, 2027. Applications are now open for participating creators.

entries.title: "Cleaner Company," a four-player co-op cleaning game where players fly through space and tackle dangerous locations, is now available as a demo on Steam

entries.description: On September 14, 2026, WildflameStudio began distributing a demo version of its upcoming title, “CleanerCompany.” The game is an online cooperative first-person cleaning action game that supports multiplayer for up to four players.

entries.title: "Stupid Never Dies": The second installment of the developer commentary video series has been released. It focuses on the game cycle that allows characters to level up rapidly.
entries.title_ja: 「ステューピッド・ネバー・ダイズ」，開発陣による解説動画シリーズ第2弾が公開に。キャラクターを急激に成長させるゲームサイクルにフォーカス
entries.description: Today (September 15, 2026), Sega released the second installment of “DEEPBITE,” a series of explanatory videos by the development team, featuring new information about the action RPG “Stupid Never Dies.” This installment focuses on the game cycle.

entries.title: The horror game "The Road to the Forest of Trees" is set to be released on Steam in 2027. Take on the role of a night-shift taxi driver and transport passengers—who may not be what they seem—to their destinations.

entries.description: tinyBuild announced today that it will release the PC game *The Road to the Forest* on Steam in 2027. Set in the mountains of Japan, the game is a first-person horror title. Players take on the role of a taxi driver working the night shift, ferrying passengers to their destinations while traveling back and forth through a small town surrounded by a cursed forest.

entries.title: [Game Report] “Total War: Warhammer 40,000” is a cut above the previous entries in the series. Witness the clash of unique styles in battle!
entries.title_ja: ［プレイレポ］これまでのシリーズとはひと味違う「トータルウォー：ウォーハンマー40,000」。個性がぶつかり合う戦いを見よ！
entries.description: "Total War: Warhammer 40,000," set to be released in 2027, is a real treat for strategy game fans. entries.title: "Active Matter," a PvPvE escape shooter set in a twisted world where players battle for control of a mysterious substance, launches today

entries.title: "Shangfro" Game Adaptation, *Shangri-La Frontier: The Seven Strongest Species*, Finally Kicks Off in Earnest. The "Crap Game Hunter" Takes on the Challenge, with Live Gameplay by SHAKA and Others Set to Be Unveiled

entries.description: On September 11, Netmarble began accepting pre-registrations for *Shangri-La Frontier: The Seven Strongest Races*. On the 14th, details about a stage event at the “Tokyo Game Show 2026” were also announced, signaling that the project is now in full swing.

entries.title: Steam Announces New Multiplayer "Extreme Camping Life" Horror Game *Feed the Fire*. A survival game with a massive contrast: during the day, players work together to gather supplies, but at night, it becomes terrifying as the map is overrun by monstrous creatures.
entries.title_ja: Steamの新たなマルチ“極限キャンプ生活”ホラー『フィード・ザ・ファイア』発表。昼は仲良く物資集め、夜はだいぶ怖い異形まみれの落差デカすぎサバイバル
entries.description: On September 14, Magellan Tide Games announced the multiplayer survival horror game *Feed the Fire*.

entries.title: "Satori Chuunibyou Counseling Room: Translator of the Second Reality," a mystery that delves into the psychology of "chuunibyou," will launch in early access on October 9. A story of empathetic deduction that explores memories of past lives and the "aching in the right arm."
entries.title_ja: 「中二病」心理解明ミステリー『さとり中二病相談室 -第二現実の翻訳者- 』、10月9日に早期アクセス配信へ。前世の記憶や“右腕の疼き”に寄り添う共感推理
entries.description: On September 14, Fine Co., Ltd. announced that early access to *Satori: The Middle Schooler Syndrome Counseling Room - Translator of the Second Reality* will begin on October 9.

entries.title: The developers of *The Witch's Spring* have announced a new ARPG titled *The Shadow of the Doll: The Tale of Piyorita*. It tells a story of “jealousy and malice” among dolls vying for the title of “the perfect doll.”
entries.title_ja: 『魔女の泉』開発元による新作ARPG『人形の影：ピヨリタの物語』発表。「完成品」の座を奪い合う人形たちの、“嫉妬と悪意”の物語
entries.description: On September 14, KIWIWALKS released *The Shadow of the Doll: The Story of Piyorita*.

entries.title: In *Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance*, the Slash Axe has undergone a major evolution, featuring a follow-up move reminiscent of the "Flying Dragon Sword" after the "Zero-Distance Unleashed Thrust." It looks incredibly agile.
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ：アセンダンス』でスラッシュアックス大進化、「零距離解放突き」から「飛翔竜剣」っぽい追い打ち技。機動力すごそう
entries.description: On September 11, Capcom released a video introducing the Slash Axe weapon in *Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance*.

entries.title: "Star Wars: Galactic Racer" is a racing adventure developed in collaboration with the creators of "Burnout," where "if you push too hard, you're out." Featuring intense races where vehicles collide head-on, it will be released on October 6.
entries.title_ja: 『スター・ウォーズ：ギャラクティック・レーサー』は『バーンアウト』開発者携わる、“攻めすぎれば脱落”レーシングアドベンチャー。マシンがぶつかり合う熾烈なレース、10月6日発売へ
entries.description: This game is a racing title set in the world of the "Star Wars" space opera series. In addition to single-player mode, it supports online multiplayer for up to 12 players.

entries.title: "Crystal Crisis," an all-star battle puzzle game featuring "Astro Boy," is currently available for free on Steam. The game normally retails for about 2,000 yen.

entries.description: On September 14, Nicalis began offering the competitive puzzle game *Crystal Crisis* for free.

entries.title: HORI Announces "HORI Arcade Classic Pro" Arcade Controller for Switch 2, Switch, and PC. Compatible with "Arcade Archives," it features four interchangeable components—including a trackball in addition to the joystick—to recreate the classic feel of yesteryear.

entries.description: On September 14, HORI announced the "HORI Arcade Classic Pro for Nintendo Switch 2" arcade controller. The price is 39,980 yen (tax included).

entries.title: "Ninjala 2" was a highly mobile ninja open-world game. Serious ninjas dart around in every direction—up, down, left, and right—and both movement and combat are all about "brute force."
entries.title_ja: 『ニンジャラ２』は高機動ニンジャオープンワールドゲームだった。本気のニンジャは上下左右四方八方飛び回る、移動も戦闘も「ゴリ押し」放題
entries.description: Here are the highlights of *Ninjala 2: The Unknown Planet*, a game that truly drives home the truth that “to a ninja, up, down, left, and right are all the ground.”

entries.title: "Mystery Dungeon-style" high-paced roguelike *Hero Rogue* set for release on October 31. With improvements to dashing, arrow farming, and item identification, you can die smoothly and effortlessly.

entries.title: A wealth of advice for overseas developers worried about their work “not feeling Japanese enough.” With no utility poles and roads that are too wide, Japan might actually be a bit more cluttered.
entries.title_ja: 「日本っぽくならない」と悩む海外開発者に大量のアドバイス。電柱がない、道路が広すぎなど、日本はもっとごちゃっとしているかも
entries.description: While creating a game set in Japan, a developer faced the problem of not being able to make the map look authentically Japanese. So, when he asked for advice on how to make it look more Japanese, he received many suggestions.

entries.description: Volks is accepting pre-orders for its injection-molded plastic model kit, “VSMS 1/100 Gateion Mark 3 Liter Jet: The Bursting Doll (Hawkhead),” until today, September 13. The price is 12,430 yen.

entries.title: Otomate has announced its new "Deception and Love" otome game, *Doppel in the Deep Window: The Slanderous Words of Kurozaki, Whose Blood Smells of Radiance*. Set in the postwar era, it tells a retro Showa-era love story of "love and deception."

entries.description: On September 13, Otomate announced *Doppel in the Deep Window: The Slanderous Words of Kurozaki, Who Exudes the Fragrance of Shining Blood* at Otomate Party 2026. Set in Japan shortly after World War II, this game is a retro-style romantic adventure that depicts a poignant love story.

entries.title: "Romancing SaGa 3: Destiny United" Will "Eliminate" Commander Mode. Official Live Stream Provides Answers One After Another, Including "You Can Now Play as Sara as the Protagonist Without Worry"

entries.description: During the “Official Live Stream Celebrating the Announcement of ‘Romancing SaGa 3: Destiny United’!” broadcast on September 12, the development team revealed details regarding changes from the original version.

entries.title: The latest installment in the series, “Diablo V,” has been announced, with a release scheduled for spring 2029. A Netflix animated series based on “Diablo” is also in production.
entries.title_ja: シリーズ最新作「ディアブロ V」発表，2029年春発売へ。「ディアブロ」のNetflixアニメシリーズも制作中
entries.description: Blizzard Entertainment announced "Diablo V," the latest installment in the Diablo series, today (September 13, 2026) at the ongoing "BlizzCon 2026."

entries.title: *Onimusha: Way of the Sword* is great at “punishing” players. The remastered version of *Touhou: Koumakyou* is especially recommended for those who haven’t played the original. *The Death Game Report* was short, intense, and really good. This Week in Gaming
entries.title_ja: 『鬼武者 Way of the Sword』は“プレイヤーを懲らしめる”のが上手。リメイク版『東方紅魔郷』は原作未経験者にこそおすすめ。『デスゲームの報告書』は、短く濃厚で非常によかった。今週のゲーミング
entries.description: "Now Gaming" is a weekly column published every Sunday where our writers casually share their thoughts on the games they've played that week. This is the 561st installment.

entries.title: A new *The Idolmaster SideM* game for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 has been announced. This marks the first *Idolmaster* console title since *Starlit Season*.
entries.title_ja: 『アイドルマスター SideM』、Nintendo Switch/Switch 2向け新作ゲームが制作決定。『スターリットシーズン』以来のコンソール向けアイマス
entries.description: On September 13, Bandai Namco Entertainment announced the launch of a home console game project for *The Idolmaster SideM*. This will be the first console title since *The Idolmaster: Starlit Season*.

entries.title: "Diablo V" Surprise Announcement: Set for Release in Spring 2029. New Class That "Spreads Disease" and More Unveiled
entries.title_ja: 『ディアブロ V』サプライズ発表、2029年春リリースへ。“病を広げる”新クラスなどもお披露目
entries.description: On September 13, Blizzard Entertainment announced *Diablo V*. The game is scheduled for release in the spring of 2029.

entries.title: "Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves" will release the latest DLC character, "Kim Kaphwan," on September 24. Following his two sons, South Korea's strongest Taekwondo master joins the fray.
entries.title_ja: 「餓狼伝説 City of the Wolves」，最新DLCキャラ「キム・カッファン」を9月24日に配信。2人の息子に続き，韓国最強のテコンドー使いが参戦
entries.description: SNK announced today (September 13, 2026) that it will release “Kim Kaphwan,” the third DLC character in Season Pass 3 “DESTINED FOR REVENGE” for the fighting game *Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves*, on September 24. A playable version of Kim Kaphwan will be showcased at TGS 2026.

entries.title: A brand-new *Kirby* game, *Kirby: World Beyond*, has been announced. The latest entry in the 2D *Metroid* series, *Metroid: Ravenus*, has also been announced. The fall update for *Minecraft* will be released on September 16 (Japan Time). Here are 7 must-read gaming articles from this week.
entries.title_ja: 星のカービィ完全新作『星のカービィ ワールドビヨンド』発表。2Dメトロイドシリーズ最新作『メトロイド ラヴェナス』も発表。『マインクラフト』秋アプデは日本時間9月16日に配信。今週の見逃せないゲーム記事7選
entries.description: We’ve selected seven articles from this week’s AUTOMATON, focusing on game review pieces that generated a lot of buzz. In addition to *Kirby: World Beyond*, *Super Painter* and *Mayhem à la Carte* were among the topics making waves this week.

entries.title: "Monster Hunter Rise" is 80% off, priced at about 800 yen. "Mythos Star Note," a survival-action game from the creator of "El Shaddai," is 90% off, priced at just 298 yen. This week's PC games with high discount rates
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターライズ』は80％オフで約800円。『エルシャダイ』クリエイターのサバイバー系アクション『神話構想スターノート』は90％オフでわずか298円。今週の高割引率PCゲーム
entries.description: In this article, we’ll highlight the games on Steam that went on sale this past week and offer the deepest discounts.

entries.title: In the open-world city game “NTE,” “cafés that beat up and kick out customers” are profitable. It’s crazy but practical—so I decided to try out all kinds of “worst money-making schemes” right now.
entries.title_ja: 街オープンワールド『NTE』は「客を殴って追い出すカフェ」が儲かる。狂ってるけど実用的、今こそ“最悪な金策”をいろいろ試してみた
entries.description: In the free-to-play game *NTE: Neverness to Everness*, not only are the standard ways to make money practical, but even the most outlandish methods are useful.

entries.title: "Overwatch" Announces New Support Hero "Doctrine"; "Sombra" Will Shift to the Support Role in the Season 5 Rework
entries.title_ja: 「オーバーウォッチ」，新サポート「ドクトリン」を発表。シーズン5のリワークで「ソンブラ」はサポート・ロールに移行へ
entries.description: Blizzard Entertainment announced today (September 13, 2026) a host of new details at "BlizzCon 2026," including a new "Overwatch" hero and reworks of existing heroes.

entries.title: The latest installment in the classic RTS series “StarCraft” will be a story-driven open-world shooter. “STARCRAFT” is set for release in 2030.
entries.title_ja: 名作RTS「StarCraft」の新作は物語主導型のオープンワールドシューターに。「STARCRAFT」，2030年発売
entries.description: A new installment in the classic RTS series “StarCraft,” titled “STARCRAFT,” was announced today (September 13, 2026) at BlizzCon 2026. It is scheduled for release in 2030 as a story-driven open-world shooter.

entries.title: In “Diablo V,” players travel in a caravan without a fixed base. The “Plague Knight” makes its debut as a new class.
entries.title_ja: 「ディアブロ V」では特定の拠点を持たずにキャラバンで移動。新クラスとして「プレイグ・ナイト」が登場
entries.description: Blizzard Entertainment has released details about the latest installment in the series, "Diablo V," which was announced at the ongoing "BlizzCon 2026" event. The game is set in Sanctuary after it has been conquered by Diablo, and will feature three playable classes: the "Demon Hunter," the "Monk," and the "Plague Knight."

entries.title: Otomate Announces New Otome Game, “VELVET CANDY TINT KISS.” A modern fantasy romance featuring a little devil who captivates men with “dangerous kisses.”
entries.title_ja: オトメイト新作乙女ゲーム『VELVET CANDY TINT KISS』発表。「危険なキス」で男を虜にする、現代ファンタジー小悪魔ラブロマンス
entries.description: On September 12, Otomate announced *VELVET CANDY TINT KISS*. This modern fantasy romance game features a protagonist who, through a kiss, “might captivate a human man.”

entries.title: "An ensemble battle drama featuring young boys and girls with superpowers who have too much time on their hands." But what it really explores is the human psyche. Now is the perfect time to play *The Children of the Belgrade Metro*.
entries.title_ja: 「暇を持て余した少年少女の超能力者たちのバトル群像劇」。でも描かれるのは人間の内面。『ベオグラードメトロの子供たち』を今こそ遊んでみよう
entries.description: While the game is based on a pixel-art visual style reminiscent of the PC-98, it creates a unique, decadent atmosphere by combining backgrounds—which are modified versions of photographs the creator, Reizōko, actually took in Serbia—with electronic music.

entries.title: A summary of the announcements made during the opening ceremony of “BlizzCon 2026”
entries.title_ja: 「BlizzCon 2026」のオープニングセレモニーで発表された内容をまとめて紹介
entries.description: Activision Blizzard released the latest information announced during the "Opening Ceremony" of the ongoing "BlizzCon 2026" on September 13, 2026 (Japan Time). New titles such as "Diablo V," a new entry in the "StarCraft" series, and "World of Warcraft: Forever" were revealed.

entries.description: Idea Factory held the "Otomate Party 2026" event today

entries.title: Aetas will release plush keychains featuring TINGS, a unit from "Shine Post," on September 19. A talk show celebrating the release will also be held at the 4Gamer booth during TGS 2026.
entries.title_ja: Aetasが「シャインポスト」のユニットTINGSのぬいぐるみキーホルダーを9月19日に発売。TGS 2026の4Gamerブースでは発売記念トークショーも
entries.description: Aetas, the operator of 4Gamer, announced today that it will release plush keychains featuring the five members of the idol unit “TINGS” from “Shine Post” on September 19, 2026. To commemorate this, a special talk show will be held at the 4Gamer.net booth during TGS 2026 on the day of the release.

entries.title: In the new season of "Diablo IV," titled "Legacy of the Abyss," celebrating the series' 30th anniversary, the nightmares of Deckard Cain and the Three Prime Evils return. We got the full scoop on the addition of the "Amazon" class and the new game systems.
entries.title_ja: シリーズ30周年記念の「ディアブロ IV」新シーズン「獄遺継承」でデッカード・ケインと三大魔王の悪夢が蘇る。「アマゾン」参戦や新システムの全貌を聞いた
entries.description: At the ongoing "BlizzCon 2026" event, details were revealed regarding the future of "Diablo IV." A new season titled "Legacy of the Abyss" will begin on September 16, 2026, introducing a variety of new features, and the "Amazon" class—a fan favorite from "Diablo II"—is set to make its debut in 2027.

entries.title: "Diablo IV: The Age of Hatred" Collection Announced for Nintendo Switch 2; Support for Japanese Included; Set for Release on September 15
entries.title_ja: 「ディアブロ IV: 憎悪の時代」コレクション，Nintendo Switch 2版を発表。日本語にも対応して9月15日にリリース
entries.description: At "BlizzCon 2026," currently being held in the U.S., the Nintendo Switch 2 version of the "Diablo IV: Age of Hatred" Collection was announced. It is scheduled for release in Japan on September 16, 2026, and will support Japanese. The game also supports cross-play and cross-progression, so it looks like it will be easy to play on the go.

entries.title: "Pottery Master," a pottery simulation game where you can create original ceramics by spinning the potter's wheel, is now officially released! Run your very own showroom.

entries.title: "Ancient God: Nezha" is a 3D action game that depicts the "Clash of the Gods" with intense, Dragon Ball-style action. What is the "ambition" driving Chinese game developers in the wake of "Black Myth: Wukong"? [Interview]

entries.title: "Dumbfire," a physics-based missile "self-guided" game, is drawing major attention and showing signs of becoming a hit. It explodes on impact and features addictive, extremely challenging acrobatic flight—playtests are currently underway.

entries.title: The popular medieval open-world game *Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Royal Edition* has been announced for the Switch 2. In a stark contrast to the rushed port of the previous title on the Switch, this one is set to be a smooth port to the Switch 2.

entries.title: The official ``Friday the 13th: The Game'' has been caught up in a copyright dispute and is now being sued by the copyright holder for ``insufficient payment.'' ``You are the one who ended the game, you are so brazen,'' he declared in anger.

entries.description: It appears that a new legal dispute has erupted over this title, even though its online services have already been discontinued and sales have ended.

entries.title: The Nintendo Switch 2/PS5 version of the puzzle adventure "Order of the Sinking Star" will be released in 2026. Over 1,000 “living puzzles” created by the developers of “The Witness” over 10 years of work

entries.description: The Japanese console version of the large-scale puzzle-adventure game *Order of the Sinking Star* is scheduled for release on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 5 sometime in 2026.

entries.title: "Final Fantasy VII Revelation" D. Hamaguchi aimed to evolve because "RPGs are difficult these days." An open world with airships, the final game in the series that makes sense to play by yourself
entries.title_ja: 『ファイナルファンタジーVII リベレーション』浜口Dが目指した、“RPGが苦しい現代”ゆえの進化。飛空艇ありきのオープンワールド、「自分でプレイする意味」があるシリーズ最終作
entries.description: We spoke with Naoki Hamaguchi of Square Enix, director of the “Final Fantasy VII Remake” series, about why he has been involved with the series and to learn more about “Final Fantasy VII Revelations.”

entries.title: Announcing ``Under Mytos'', an otherworldly hot spring inn management and dungeon exploration survival RPG. A new work brought together by creators who worked on “Pokémon,” “Tales,” and “GRANDIA.”

entries.description: On September 10, Kadus announced its new JRPG, *Under Mythos*. This dark fantasy JRPG combines the peaceful daily life of a hot spring inn with dungeon exploration.

entries.title: HORI announces a truly practical "driving training simulator". Jointly developed with Hino Motors, simulator “complete with dedicated devices”

entries.description: On September 10, HORI Co., Ltd. announced the commercial release of a full-scale driving simulator.

entries.title: Kogado Studio's new product, Honeybee Girl Roguelite STG ``Brabee'' has been announced, and will be on display at TGS. Push through the forest where the battle situation changes day and night with a “specialized build”

entries.description: On September 10, Kogado Studio announced the roguelike shooter "Brabee."

entries.title: Monster breeding MMORPG "Icarus Online", which ended its domestic service, will be "restarted" after four years. Returns this fall with improved playability and lots of additional features

entries.description: On September 10, G·O·P announced that it will relaunch the MMORPG "Icarus Online" in Japan in the fall of 2026.

entries.title: The life-threatening prison meal game “Full of Escape Plan” will be released in 2027. From white rice to eyeballs, from soup to shark, aim to eat everything deliciously and escape.
entries.title_ja: 獄中命がけ食事ゲーム『満腹脱獄計画』2027年配信へ。白米から目玉、スープからサメ、美味しく完食して脱走目指す
entries.description: In *The Full Belly Escape Plan*, players take on the role of the protagonist, who has been captured by an enemy organization, and experience the “dreaded mealtime” from a first-person perspective.

entries.title: It gets exciting when the idea that ``the main character of ``Metroid'' is not a Metroid'' finally becomes irrelevant. After “Dread”, a new work “properly featuring Metroid as the main character”
entries.title_ja: 「『メトロイド』の主人公はメトロイドじゃない」がいよいよ通用しなくなると盛り上がる。『ドレッド』を経て、“ちゃんとメトロイドが主人公”の新作
entries.description: On September 9, Nintendo announced *Metroid: Ravenus*. Seeing Samus wielding the power of the Metroid—which also serves as the game’s title—has sparked a buzz on social media, with many commenting, “Metroid really is the protagonist here.”

entries.title: A large update has arrived for Nintendo Switch 2, making it easier to use online licenses. When creating Mii, “that BGM” plays and various changes

entries.title: “Seal Punch” fishing action “Sea Sniffers” officially announced. A great ocean adventure where you can hit and catch fish.

entries.title: Idle hack and slash RPG “War of Genesis: Idle Loot” releases early access version on Steam
entries.title_ja: 放置系ハクスラRPG「War of Genesis: Idle Loot」，Steamで早期アクセス版をリリース

This work is an idle hack and slash RPG that can be enjoyed on your PC desktop. Even if the player is doing other tasks, the character will continue to fight and grow.

entries.title: "Assetto Corsa Rally", large early access update V0.6 released. Added 3 new machines including Audi Quattro Gr.4

In addition to three new cars that have left their mark on rally history—including the Audi Quattro Gr.4—the update also introduces private lobbies, custom liveries, and a photo mode.

entries.title: A crowdfunding campaign aiming to revive "Uta Macross" reached its target amount in about an hour and a half after it went live. Details on stretch goals will be announced at a later date.

entries.description: "FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION" has been announced for release on April 8, 2027. As the final installment of the trilogy, this game brings significant changes to the way players explore the world they first encountered in "Reverse." We spoke with Naoki Hamaguchi in detail about why the developers chose to reintroduce vast open fields and how they crafted this even more expansive world of adventure.

Inspired by 1980s arcade racing games, this title is unique in that players compete based on distance traveled rather than their finishing position. Players control Alice, also known as RedRider, as she races through 12 stages from noon until sunrise.

entries.description: We bring you the after-sales report from the modeler booth at the 25th International Model Railway Convention! With the theme of "Shinkansen and the eve of its opening," everything from realistic N gauge scenes such as the Hakone Tozan Train and Joetsu Line to the impressive HO, 13mm gauge, and rideable 5-inch gauge are gathered! #International Model Railway Convention 2026 #JAM2026

entries.title: Tamiya's "Trail Mini 4WD Halloween Version (EZ Chassis)" with a Jack O'Lantern on it is now available! Large diameter tire and wheel set and 2mm aluminum lock nut are also released at the same time.
