entries.description: Tamiya's "Trail Mini 4WD Halloween Version (EZ Chassis)" is scheduled for release on October 10! It features a purple body topped with a jack-o'-lantern and equipped with orange spike tires. A large-diameter tire and wheel set for the EZ Chassis will also be released at the same time! #Halloween #Mini4WD

entries.title: “Detective Precure Movie! ” x Gokurakuyu/RAKU SPA collaboration campaign will be held from October 1, 2026 (Thursday)! We will be selling limited collaboration goods and menus with newly drawn illustrations!
entries.title_ja: 『映画名探偵プリキュア！』×極楽湯・RAKU SPAコラボキャンペーンが2026年10月1日（木）より開催！描き下ろしイラストの限定コラボグッズやメニュー販売などを実施！
entries.description: “Detective Precure Movie! ” collaboration campaign will be held at 16 Gokurakuyu/RAKU SPA Group stores from October 1st (Thursday)! In addition to selling store-limited goods and menus using newly drawn illustrations, there is also a lot of content such as collaborative baths and tests! #Tanpuri #Gokurakuyu

entries.title: Pre-orders for “Grande Scale Lumitia ReACT-A” from “Arcadia” will begin on September 8 at 11:00 a.m.
entries.title_ja: 「アルカナディア」より「グランデスケール ルミティア ReACT-A」が9月8日11時より予約開始
entries.description: Kotobukiya will begin accepting pre-orders for the "Grande Scale Lumitia ReACT-A" plastic model kit starting at 11:00 a.m. on September 8. The product is scheduled for release in February 2027, and the price is 14,300 yen.

entries.title: "Gakuen Idolmaster ESPRESTO-High contrast- Seina Jūō" Photo Review: The "First Star," with her stunning costume design and expressions, makes her debut as a prize figure
entries.title_ja: 「学園アイドルマスター ESPRESTO-High contrast-十王星南」フォトレビュー衣装デザインや表情など見ごたえ抜群の“一番星”がプライズで登場
entries.description: From "ESPRESTO," a prize figure brand that focuses on the charm of BANDAI SPIRITS characters and highlights their unique features, a figure of "Seina Juou" wearing the "Hajime" costume from "Gakuen Idolmaster" has been rolling out sequentially since September 3, 2026.

entries.title: Pretty party style! "Sanrio Characters" Bikkura Egg is now available! There are 8 types in the lineup, including Hello Kitty wearing a glittering metallic hat, Cinnamoroll, and Pompompurin!
entries.title_ja: ぷりてぃーなぱーてぃスタイル！「サンリオキャラクターズ」のびっくらたまごが新登場！キラキラメタリックな帽子を被ったハローキティ、シナモロール、ポムポムプリンなど8種がラインナップ！
entries.description: "Bikkura Tamago Sanrio Characters Pretty Party," a bath salt featuring Sanrio mascots, is now available! The lineup includes Hello Kitty, Pompompurin, and others wearing sparkly metallic hats and holding accessories! #Sanrio

entries.title: Deformed figures of Ken Kaneki, Touka Kirishima, and others in sitting positions holding their knees! “Tokyo Ghoul” is now available in the Gashapon “Machiboke” series!
entries.title_ja: 金木研や霧嶋董香などを膝を抱えた座り姿でデフォルメフィギュア化！ガシャポン「まちぼうけ」シリーズに『東京喰種』が登場！
entries.description: “Tokyo Ghoul” is now available in the Gashapon figure “Machiboke” series! Deformed figures of Ken Kaneki, Toka Kirishima, Riyo Kamishiro, and Juzo Suzuya with sad looks! Scheduled to be released in the second week of September! #Tokyo Ghoul #Capsule Toy

entries.title: Adorable gestures and facial expressions are attractive! "Overlord" Albedo in black cat form is now a figure from Flew Prize "melffy"!
entries.title_ja: 愛らしい仕草＆表情が魅力的！『オーバーロード』黒猫姿のアルベドがフリュープライズ「melffy」からフィギュア化！
entries.description: "Overlord" Albedo will be made into a prize figure from "melffy", which features fluffy and cute flocked parts! Scheduled to be rolled out around February 2027! #Overlord #Frue Prize

entries.title: Evangelion Racing x Hasegawa! Check out the completed sample photo of the resin figure kit of circuit mate “Momo Watarikawa” who plays Shikinami Asuka Langley! Also pay attention to the cute expression
entries.title_ja: エヴァンゲリオンレーシング×ハセガワ！式波・アスカ・ラングレー役サーキットメイト「渡川 もも」さんのレジン製フィギュアキットを完成見本写真でチェック！キュートな表情にも注目
entries.description: Hasegawa has made a 1/12 scale resin kit of "Momo Watarikawa", the circuit mate who plays Shikinami Asuka Langley from "Evangelion Racing"! Check out its cute expression and plug suit motif costume in the completed sample photo! #Eva #Hasegawa

entries.title: [Amazon Sale] UWANT and Dreamy Cordless Vacuums on Sale
entries.title_ja: 【Amazonセール】UWANTとドリーミーのコードレス掃除機がセール価格に
entries.description: Cordless vacuums from UWANT and Dreamy are currently on sale at a special price on Amazon. The sale runs until 11:59 p.m. on September 21.

entries.title: "Keroro Gunso☆" Keroro, Giroro, and Dororo's childhood appearances are made into figures made of soft vinyl material! Gashapon “Punipushitai” is now available!
entries.title_ja: 『ケロロ軍曹☆』ケロロ、ギロロ、ドロロの幼い頃の姿をやわらかいソフビ素材でフィギュア化！ガシャポン「ぷにぷにし隊」が登場！
entries.description: From the anime *Sergeant Keroro☆*, the Chibi Keroro characters are making their debut in the "Puni Puni Squad" Gashapon series! Sales begin on Tuesday, September 8, on Gashapon Online! #SergeantKeroro #Gashapon

entries.title: Be charmed by Pom Pom Purin and friends in their yukata! The "Kata-Zun Fig. Sanrio Characters: Relaxing on the Veranda" gacha machine will go on sale in mid-September.
entries.title_ja: 浴衣姿のポムポムプリンたちに癒される！ガチャ「肩ズンFig.サンリオキャラクターズ 縁側のんびり」9月中旬発売
entries.description: Takara Tomy Arts will release the gacha product “Katan-Zun Fig. Sanrio Characters: Relaxing on the Veranda” in mid-September. The price is 400 yen per play.

entries.title: A summary of new product information announced at the 25th International Railway Model Convention and company booths! Check out KATO's "THE ROYAL EXPRESS" and TOMIX's EF58 type N gauge, Rokuhan's Z gauge, and Katsumi Endo and Tenshodo's HO gauge!
entries.title_ja: 第25回国際鉄道模型コンベンション・企業ブースで発表された新製品情報などを総括！KATO「THE ROYAL EXPRESS」やTOMIXのEF58形などNゲージ、ロクハンのZゲージ、カツミ・エンドウ・天賞堂のHOゲージもチェック！
entries.description: Summary of new product information released at company booths at the 25th International Model Railway Convention! Check out the hottest products, from popular N gauge products such as KATO's THE ROYAL EXPRESS and TOMIX's EF58 type, to the latest HO and Z gauge prototypes from each company! #International Model Railway Convention 2026 #JAM2026

entries.title: The final volume of ``Masahiro Sakurai's Thoughts on Games'' comes with an ebtenDX pack that comes with the cover illustration ``Sakurai-san and Fukura-san'' drawn by Keiichi Tanaka! Now accepting reservations with Eviten limited benefits!
entries.title_ja: 『桜井政博のゲームについて思うこと』最終巻に田中圭一氏描き下ろし表紙イラスト「桜井さんとふくらさん」のアクスタが同梱のebtenDXパックが登場！エビテン限定特典付きで予約受付中！
entries.description: The final volume of the popular serialized series *Masahiro Sakurai’s Thoughts on Games* comes with an acrylic stand featuring an original cover illustration by Keiichi Tanaka titled “Mr. Sakurai and Mr. Fukura”! The ebtenDX Pack is now available for pre-order on ebten! #MasahiroSakurai #KeiichiTanaka

entries.title: [Reason for reading today. ] One-shot “London Mysterious Life Insurance”
entries.title_ja: 【今日、読む理由。】読み切り『ロンドン怪奇生命保険』
entries.description:
In manga, there is a story that you want to read just for today. In ``Reason to read today.'', we will introduce one story each day. Jump + London Mysterious Life Insurance Everyone has different reasons for reading this story today. What reason would you […]
The post [Reason to read today. ] One-shot “London Mysterious Life Insurance” first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: [TGS2026] Let me cover your cosplay!
entries.title_ja: 【 TGS2026】あなたのコスプレ、取材させてください！
entries.description:
Article updated: September 7, 2026 This time, Cospot Media is heading to …TOKYO GAME SHOW 2026 &#821 […] which will be held at Makuhari Messe from Thursday, September 17, 2026 to Saturday, September 21, 2026.
The post [TGS2026] Let me cover your cosplay! first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: The main character, holed up in a six-tatami room, explores a strange underground world that has appeared at the back of the room. 1bit action ADV “Rokujo Hitoma”, Steam store page released
entries.title_ja: 六畳一間に引きこもる主人公が部屋の奥に出現した奇妙な地下世界を探索。1bitアクションADV「ロクジョーヒトマ」，Steamストアページを公開
entries.description: HANDSUM today unveiled the Steam store page for “Rokujo Hitoma,” a PC game developed by m7kenji. This 1-bit action-adventure game follows the protagonist, Hitoma, who is confined to a six-tatami-mat room, as he explores a strange underground world that appears at the far end of his room.

entries.title: Physics calculation earthworm office worker sim ``Warming from Home'' has suddenly achieved a favorable reception rate of 98%. Experience being an intelligent earthworm who twists his whole body, is forced to work at a desk, and even engages in evil deeds.
entries.title_ja: 物理演算ミミズ会社員シム『Worming from Home』いきなり好評率98％の快進撃。全身くねらせ無理やりデスクワーク、悪事にも手を染める知能派ミミズ体験
entries.description: Warming from Home, a sim in which an earthworm works as a financial man, is receiving positive reviews on Steam.

entries.title: Rat city construction + automation sim "Whisker Wood" is exploding in popularity with the biggest update ever. Implementation of "open ocean expansion" system, evolving into a greedy game with town building and ocean voyage
entries.title_ja: ネズミ都市建設＋自動化シム『ウィスカーウッド』過去最大アプデで人気爆発中。「外洋進出」システム実装、街づくりあり大航海ありの欲張りゲームに進化
entries.description: On September 4th, Hooded Horse released a major update for the city construction and automation sim "Whiskerwood."

entries.title: "Missmon" is now available on Steam. It's a "loot-based action RPG × strategy game" where you assemble a party of mythical monsters and set out to defeat the Demon King.
entries.title_ja: 「ミスモン」がSteamで配信開始。神話のモンスターでパーティを編成し，魔王討伐を目指す「ハクスラ×ストラテジーゲーム」
entries.description: On September 8, 2026, Kodansha Creators Lab released “MythicMonster” on Steam. The price is 980 yen (tax included). This title is a “hack-and-slash × strategy game” in which players assemble a party of mythical monsters called “MythicMonsters” to defeat the Demon King.

entries.title: New heroes such as Kai and Theodora from "Fire Emblem Heroes" and the new "FE Manshi Senku" will join the battle on September 8th. Campaign information also announced
entries.title_ja: 「ファイアーエムブレム ヒーローズ」，新作「FE万紫千紅」のカイ，セオドラら新英雄が9月8日に参戦。キャンペーン情報も発表
entries.description: On September 7, 2026, Nintendo released a video titled “Fae Channel 2026.9.7” and announced the latest information on *Fire Emblem Heroes*. This time, the company announced that a summoning event featuring four heroes—including Kai and Theodora—from *Fire Emblem: A Thousand Colors* will begin on September 8 at 4:00 PM, along with details on a new campaign.

entries.title: "Onimusha Way of the Sword" worldwide sales exceed 1 million copies on the first day of release. Cumulative sales of the series reach 10 million units
entries.title_ja: 「鬼武者 Way of the Sword」，全世界販売本数が発売初日に100万本を突破。シリーズ累計販売本数は1000万本を達成
entries.description: On September 7, 2026, Capcom announced that worldwide sales of “Onimusha: Way of the Sword” had surpassed 1 million units on its first day of release. The company also revealed that, thanks to this sales growth, cumulative sales of the “Onimusha” series have reached 10 million units.

entries.title: CyberAgent Group's Applibot is recruiting game development talent. We are recruiting a wide range of creators, engineers, planners, etc. who are immersed in game creation.
entries.title_ja: サイバーエージェントグループのアプリボットがゲーム開発人材を募集。ゲームづくりに没頭するクリエイター、エンジニア、プランナーなどを幅広く募集
entries.description: Applibot Co., Ltd. is currently recruiting mid-career personnel.

entries.title: "SAW: Genesis," an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game, will hold its second closed alpha test starting September 17
entries.title_ja: 非対称対戦型ホラーゲーム「SAW: Genesis」，第2回クローズドアルファテストを9月17日から開催
entries.description: On September 4, 2026, BlooberTeam announced that the second closed alpha test for the upcoming title "SAW: Genesis," currently in development by BrokenMirrorGames and AnsharStudios, will begin on September 17. Registration is currently open on the official website.

entries.title: The home I got with a 35-year loan is a condominium controlled by a dictatorial chairman. ``RULES OF RESIDENCE,'' a political sim in which you choose between control and reform to realize your ideal life, announced, released in 2027
entries.title_ja: 35年ローンで手に入れたマイホームは，独裁理事長に支配されたマンション。理想の暮らしを実現するため，支配か改革かを選ぶ政治シム「RULES OF RESIDENCE」発表，2027年に発売
entries.description: Toydium announced today its new PC title, “RULES OF RESIDENCE.” Set in an apartment complex ruled by a dictatorial chairman, this political simulation game challenges players to become a member of the homeowners’ association board, establish rules, and strive to create their ideal lifestyle.

entries.title: "Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance"'s Charge Ax is ``really evolving,'' he says. Introducing various offsets and “sword-enhanced rotating slash” etc.
entries.title_ja: 『モンスターハンターワイルズ：アセンダンス』のチャージアックス、「めっちゃ進化してる」と沸き立つ。相殺いろいろ＆“剣強化回転斬り”などお披露目
entries.description: On September 7th, Capcom released a video introducing the Charge Ax weapon in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance.

entries.title: Dokkan Nagoya 2026, one of the largest game conferences in the Chubu region, will be held on October 3rd. Must-see lectures by P. Mizokami, Gemdrop Kitao, and others from “Honogurashi no Niwa”
entries.title_ja: “中部圏最大級”のゲームカンファレンス「どっかんナゴヤ2026」10月3日に開催へ。『ほの暮しの庭』溝上Pや、ジェムドロップ北尾氏らによる講演など必見
entries.description: The Dokkan Nagoya Management Committee has announced that ``Dokkan Nagoya 2026'' will be held on October 3rd.

entries.title: The Steam version of "Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO NITRO ARCHIVE" is now available. The debut work of Gen Urobuchi, known for works such as Madoka Magica.
entries.title_ja: Steam版「Phantom PHANTOM OF INFERNO NITRO ARCHIVE」が配信開始。まどマギなどで知られる虚淵 玄氏のデビュー作
entries.description: On September 4, 2026, Nitroplus released the Steam version of “PhantomPHANTOMOFINFERNONITROARCHIVE.” This title is a PC port of the Xbox 360 version, which added elements from the TV anime adaptation to “PhantomPHANTOMOFINFERNO”—Nitroplus’s first title, released in 2000.

entries.title: "Bonespire," a simulation game where you become the master of a magical tower and influence the mortal world, has been announced.
entries.title_ja: 魔法の塔の主となって地上世界に干渉するシミュレーションゲーム「Bonespire」が発表に
entries.description: AkuparaGames announced its new title, “Bonespire,” today (September 7, 2026). In this simulation game, players take on the role of a wizard living in a magical tower, forging artifacts and brewing potions while observing the world full of adventure and mystery that spreads out below.

entries.title: Sushi Shogi, a shogi-style game where you pick up and eat sushi, is now available on Steam. The person who eats the food is the one who pays the bill, and you lose even if you run out of money.
entries.title_ja: 寿司を取って食べる将棋風ゲーム『寿司将棋』Steamにてお披露目。食べた側がお会計、所持金がなくなっても負け
entries.description: Today's recommendation! (Today's Special!) released the Steam store page for ``Sushi Shogi'' on September 7th.

entries.title: Highly rated SF mystery “Stellar Code” console version announced, scheduled for release this fall. An outrageous mystery related to space created by the “Ihanashi no Majo” development circle
entries.title_ja: 高評価SFミステリー『ステラーコード』コンソール版発表、今秋リリースへ。『イハナシの魔女』開発サークルによる、宇宙にまつわるとんでもない謎
entries.description: KEMCO announced the console version of ``Stellar Code'' on September 7th.

entries.title: The roguelike ACT “Crime Light” that approaches the “sins” of girls will be released as an “official trial version” from September 17th. You can play ``the entire first chapter'' of Furyu's new work first.
entries.title_ja: 少女たちの“罪”に迫るローグライクACT『クライムライト』、9月17日より“正式体験版”配信へ。フリューの新作を「第1章丸ごと」お先に遊べる
entries.description: Furyu Co., Ltd. announced on September 7th that the official trial version of ``CRYMELIGHT'' will be distributed on Steam from 10:00 am on September 17th.

entries.title: Washagana TV's latest video introduces the Chinese-made robot figure ``Progenitor Effect.'' Surprised by the cost performance of the 3 robot set
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，中国製のロボットフィギュア「プロジェニターエフェクト」を紹介。ロボ3体セットのコスパに驚愕
entries.description: Today, the latest episode of the web show “Washagana TV,” hosted by voice actor Yuichi Nakamura and freelance writer Mafia Kajita, was released. In this episode, Nakamura unboxes the “PROGENITOREFFECT” series of articulated robot figures, which he bought on impulse.

entries.title: Onimusha Way of the Sword's sales exceeded 1 million copies on the first day of release. A new era of Onimusha, with the first completely new work in 20 years
entries.title_ja: 『鬼武者 Way of the Sword』発売初日で売上100万本突破。20年ぶりの完全新作が斬り込む、『鬼武者』の新時代
entries.description: Capcom reported on September 7th that ``Onimusha Way of the Sword'' sold over 1 million copies worldwide on its first day of release on September 4th.

entries.title: “Silver Castle” now accepting global pre-registration. An open world RPG set in a Victorian-style metropolis where you fight monsters while investigating and deducing incidents.
entries.title_ja: 「白銀の城」，グローバル事前登録を受付中。ヴィクトリア朝様式の大都市を舞台に，事件を調査・推理しながら怪物と戦うオープンワールドRPG
entries.description: Elementa is currently accepting global pre-registrations for the open-world RPG “Silver Castle.” Set in “Sylvania,” a metropolis in the Victorian style, the game features action-packed battles centered on parrying as players investigate and solve mysteries involving werewolves and monsters lurking within human society.

entries.title: "Kinsaba" of the MMORPG "Redstone" that has been running for 21 years is coming to an end, and this is your last chance to quickly grow up to level 1500. TGS2026 exhibition information also announced
entries.title_ja: 21年続くMMORPG『レッドストーン』の「金鯖」終了迫る、レベル1500まで高速育成のラストチャンス。TGS2026出展情報もお披露目
entries.description: In the MMORPG ``RED STONE'', the end date of the limited-time high-speed training world ``21st. Gold Experience World'' is approaching. This work is also scheduled to be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2026.

entries.title: ``Gamescom'' is a gaming festival that attracts people from all over Japan, and the place was full of ``game lovers.'' It's not just new release announcements, it's trial play, cosplay, and the enthusiasm of gamers
entries.title_ja: 日本からも人が集まるゲームの祭典「gamescom」 、現地は“ゲームが好き”で溢れていた。新作発表だけじゃない、試遊にコスプレ、たぎるゲーマーの熱
entries.description: We will tell you about the atmosphere of the venue and the contents of the event, along with photos and impressions from the staff who went to the large-scale game event "gamescom" to cover the scene.

entries.title: Screenings of the Japanese-dubbed version of the movie “Resident Evil” have been confirmed. Hiro Shimono will voice the protagonist, Brian, and Saori Hayami will voice his girlfriend, Michelle.
entries.title_ja: 映画「バイオハザード」，日本語吹替え版の上映が決定。主人公ブライアン役に下野 紘さん，恋人ミシェル役に早見沙織さんを起用
entries.description: Sony Pictures announced today (September 7, 2026) that it will release a Japanese-dubbed version of the movie "Resident Evil." In the Japanese-dubbed version, Hiro Shimono will voice the protagonist Brian, and Saori Hayami will voice Brian's girlfriend Michelle.

entries.title: An "automatic difficulty change" system has been implemented in the popular Souls-like "Mortal Shell 2". Auto-adjusts to “just the right level of difficulty” that gets harder the more you win and easier the more you lose
entries.title_ja: 人気ソウルライク『Mortal Shell 2』に「難易度自動変化」システム実装。勝つほど難しく、負けるほど簡単になる“ちょうどいい高難度”オート調節
entries.description: The update adds an experimental feature called Adaptive Difficulty, which changes the strength of enemies depending on how the player fights.

entries.title: The rapidly increasing number of "mass item tidying up" games on Steam are being dubbed "sort slops." A new trend following friend slop
entries.title_ja: Steamで急増する“大量アイテムお片付け系”ゲーム、さっそく「ソートスロップ」と呼ぶ動き。フレンドスロップに続く新たなトレンド
entries.description: There is also a movement to call the game ``sortslop,'' a game in which you clean up a large number of items scattered on the floor back to their original locations.

entries.title: Announcing ``Rules of Residence,'' an apartment politics sim for ``35-year loan new moms.'' My long-awaited new home turns out to be a “dictatorship apartment”, and the board of directors survives to protect my life.
entries.title_ja: “35年ローン新米ママ”のマンション政治シム『ルール オブ レジデンス』発表。念願の新居はまさかの「独裁マンション」、暮らしを守る理事会サバイバル
entries.description: Toysium Co., Ltd. announced ``RULES OF RESIDENCE'' on September 7th.

entries.title: Cumulative sales of "Exit 8" exceeded 3 million copies. As a commemoration, a sale has started at "Exit 8" and "Platform 8"
entries.title_ja: 「8番出口」の累計販売本数が300万本を突破。記念として「8番出口」「8番のりば」のセールがスタート
entries.description: PLAYISM announced today (September 7, 2026) that the cumulative sales of the walking simulator "Exit 8" developed by KOTAKECREATE has exceeded 3 million units. Currently, as a commemorative sale, ``Exit 8'' and its sequel ``Terminal 8'' are being held on all platforms except PS Store.

entries.title: Pick up over 200,000 colored balls and return them to the ball pool. Playrooms, a disturbing work sim where you work in a playroom where no one is supposed to be, announced, released in October 2026

entries.title_ja: XBOX Cloud Gaming，11月からプレイ時間制限を導入。超過時間は購入制となり，XBOX Game Pass非加入者も時間購入でストリーミングが可能に
entries.description: Microsoft announced today (September 4, 2026) that it will change the way it offers “Xbox Cloud Gaming” starting in November. In addition, a new option will be introduced that allows users to access Xbox Cloud Gaming without subscribing to Game Pass.

entries.title: "Denari," an action-adventure game featuring South Pacific-inspired culture, will feature vocals by Emi Evans and is set to be released on Nintendo Switch [gamescom]

entries.description: At gamescom 2026, New Zealand's AstronautDiaries' hack-and-slash action ADV ``Denari'' was released. This is a notable work that incorporates the culture and mythology unique to the South Pacific region, and it has also been decided that Emi Evans, who is known for her role in the ``NieR'' series, will be participating in vocals, and that it will be released for Switch.

entries.title: "LOL, the Demon King's Castle Is Right Next Door to My House lol," begins its open beta test on Steam today. Monsters attack the village during the Demon King's Live Concert (Demon Frenzy Banquet).

entries.description: One or Eight today started an open beta test for the village-building action RPG ``Awesome, The Devil's Castle Next to My House'' on Steam. No application is required, the number of participants is unlimited, and the period ends at 13:59 on September 7, 2026. The game can be played for about 2 to 3 hours up to the first boss, and is available in Japanese, English, and Chinese (simplified/traditional).

entries.title: "Professional Ship Simulator" Launches on Steam Early Access on September 16. Navigate a wide variety of ships using an advanced fluid dynamics model.

It is a hydrodynamic model that reproduces wind, waves, tides, etc., and can be used to maneuver tugboats, LNG tankers, etc. Set on Rügen Island and the Strait of Dover, you will take on missions such as cargo transport and rescue.

entries.description: There were also reports that Rob Nelson of Rockstar Games acknowledged that the game runs at 30 fps.

Here’s the second installment of our breaking news photo report from the Arcadia Engage Fest 2026! #Arcadia #EngageFest2026

entries.title_ja: とびきりの笑顔にときめく！「カードキャプターさくら クリアカード編 木之本桜 [包囲(シージュ)]コスチュームVer.」【あみあみ展示撮り下ろし】ピンクのバトルコスチューム姿で、杖やケロちゃんも再現
entries.description: Kotobukiya is set to release the 1/7 scale figure “Sakura Kinomoto [Siege] Costume Ver.” in April 2027. This figure depicts the protagonist “Sakura Kinomoto” from the TV anime “Cardcaptor Sakura: Clear Card Arc,” based on the original work by CLAMP.

entries.description: The 1/7 scale figure "Saori (Dress)" is scheduled to be released in March 2027 by Cranel. This is a three-dimensional version of ``Saori Locke'', the leader of the Arius Squad at the Arius Branch School, who appears in the smartphone RPG ``Blue Archive'' operated by Yostar.

Standing approximately 28 centimeters tall, this impressive figure is a must-see! Scheduled to be released sequentially starting Friday, September 25! #GundamSEED #Prize

Collect all three varieties to complete a bust-up model standing approximately 20 centimeters tall!! The online version of the Gashapon comes with a light and cable unit, allowing for an even more realistic display!! #Gundam #Gashapon

entries.title: [Why You Should Read This Today.] Episode 3: “Life as a Bear”
entries.title_ja: 【今日、読む理由。】第3話『くまぐらし』
entries.description:
Every manga has a “chapter you’ll want to read today, of all days.” In “Reasons to Read Today,” we select and feature just one chapter each day. *Kumagurashi*, Volume 1, Chapter 3. The reason to read this particular chapter today is different for everyone. What reason would you come up with? […]
The post [“Reasons to Read Today.”] Chapter 3: “Kumagurashi” first appeared on Cospot media.

entries.title: The popular multiplayer stealth horror game *Secret Neighbor* has been targeted by a cyberattack demanding only that sales be halted. While player data has been deleted and the service temporarily suspended, the developer is vowing to fight back with everything it has.
entries.title_ja: 人気マルチ・ステルスホラー『Secret Neighbor』に“販売停止のみ”を要求する不正アクセス攻撃が仕掛けられる。プレイヤーデータ削除被害＆サービス一時休止の一方、開発元は徹底抗戦の構え
entries.description: On August 27, tinyBuild and Hologryph announced that *Secret Neighbor* had been the victim of an unauthorized access incident. In response to the incident, the game servers have been temporarily taken offline.

entries.title: "Far Far West," a Western-themed PvE shooter supporting co-op play for up to four players, has seen a surge in popularity with over 8,000 concurrent players following an update packed with new features. The addition of melee weapons and the implementation of an "ice element" have completely transformed the gameplay experience.
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力・西部劇PvEシューター『Far Far West』、新要素てんこ盛りアプデで同接8000人超えの盛況。近接武器追加や“氷属性”実装などでプレイ感も一変
entries.description: On August 27, Fireshine Games and Evil Raptor released “Frostburn,” a major update for *Far Far West*. The game is currently experiencing a surge in popularity, with player numbers rising sharply.

entries.title: EA's new "Iron Man" action game: Sudden announcement that "development is ongoing." Undeterred by leaks, the company remains unfazed, saying, "Stay tuned for more updates."
entries.title_ja: EAの「アイアンマン」新作アクションゲーム、突然の「開発継続中」報告。リークにも負けず、“続報待ってて”とどっしり構える
entries.description: On August 29, Motive Studio released an update regarding the new "Iron Man" action-adventure game it is developing.

entries.title: A practicing doctor has, for some reason, suddenly released a video in which he passionately talks about *THE KING OF FIGHTERS ’98* for a full “hour.” He delivers a passionate monologue that reveals his true “hardcore gamer” spirit, and even offers suggestions for an “ideal remake.”
entries.title_ja: 現役医師がなぜか突然『THE KING OF FIGHTERS ’98』について「1時間」も熱く語る動画を公開。「ガチ勢」の気迫隠せぬ語りを披露、“理想的リメイク”の提言も飛び出す
entries.description: On August 27, “Clinic Four: Medical & Health Information Channel” posted a video featuring Dr. Hirokazu Muraoka, a practicing physician, discussing *KOF98*. In the 50-minute video, he shares his passionate feelings about the game.

entries.title: “96% Approval Rating”: Voice-Recognition Battle Action Game “Smack Talk” Gains Popularity Following Official Release. A “Super Smash Bros.”-Style Party Game Supporting Battles for Up to 8 Players, Where Special Moves Are Triggered by Voice Commands
entries.title_ja: “好評率96%”音声認識対戦アクション『Smack Talk』正式リリースで人気博す。最大8人対戦対応・必殺技は“声”で出す『スマブラ』風パーティーゲーム
entries.description: Monchii Studio officially released "Smack Talk" on August 27. The game has gained popularity as a competitive action party game in the platformer genre where players battle using voice commands.

entries.title: "Mega Man: Dual Override," the first all-new title in nine years, is a game the team "absolutely wanted to release" for the series' 40th anniversary. We asked the development team about their attention to detail, including the "deliberately challenging" boss difficulty.
entries.title_ja: 9年ぶり完全新作『ロックマン: デュアル オーバーライド』は、40周年で「なんとしても出したかった」作品。“あえてキツめ”なボス難易度など、開発陣にこだわり訊いた
entries.description: On August 14, our magazine, AUTOMATON, participated in a group interview with the development team behind the action game *Mega Man: Dual Override*.

entries.title: What kind of game is “Roco Kingdom,” the next-generation open-world monster-collecting RPG? A monster RPG focused on “ecosystems” and “daily life.”
entries.title_ja: 次世代オープンワールド・モンスター収集RPG『Roco Kingdom』ってどんなゲーム？「生態系」や「暮らし」にフォーカスしたモンスターRPG
entries.description: Let me introduce you to *Roco Kingdom* and tell you what kind of game it is.

entries.title: Activision Reports It Has Cracked Down on "CoD" Cheat Vendors, Accompanied by a "Home Visit Video." The company emphasizes that it won't let cheat vendors get away with it by showing a visit to one of their homes.
entries.title_ja: Activision、『CoD』チート業者を摘発したと“家宅訪問動画”付きで報告。チート業者のお宅訪問、絶対逃がさないアピール
entries.description: On August 29, Activision released a video showing its lawyers visiting the home of a cheat developer to deliver a cease-and-desist letter. This appears to be an effort to showcase the results of its comprehensive anti-cheat measures.

entries.title: "Dirty Derby," a competitive racing game where players "wildly manipulate" animal races, has been officially announced. It supports up to four players and features "chaotic battle races" where players constantly interfere using syringes and bats.
entries.title_ja: どうぶつレースを“めちゃくちゃに操作する”対戦レースゲーム『Dirty Derby』正式発表。最大4人対戦対応、注射器やバットで介入しまくる“乱闘バトルレース”
entries.description: On August 28, developer Jebi Studio launched the store page for "Dirty Derby."

entries.title: In the multiplayer open-world exploration game *Big Walk*, reports are pouring in of encounters with a mysterious “helper player.” This “legendary helper” only comes to the rescue when players are truly in trouble.
entries.title_ja: みんなで探検オープンワールド『Big Walk』にて、謎の“助っ人プレイヤー”との遭遇報告相次ぐ。本当に困った時だけ助けてくれる、“伝説のお手伝いさん”
entries.description: In the cooperative adventure game *Big Walk*, there have been a series of reports of encounters with a mysterious figure known as “John Bigwalk.” It is said that “John Bigwalk” frequently appears in the lobby and lends a hand only when needed.

entries.title: Wired Productions has signed publishing contracts with three Asian horror films. Playable exhibit at gamescom 2026 [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: Wired Productionsがアジア発のホラー3作品と相次いでパブリッシング契約。gamescom 2026にプレイアブル出展［gamescom］
entries.description: At the Wired Productions booth at gamescom 2026, three horror titles from Asia were on display: “BrokenLore: DON’T LIE” from Japan, “AGNI: Village of Calamity” from Indonesia, and “Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit” from Thailand.

entries.title: "Cassette Beasts 2002" has evolved into a cinematic 3D pixel art. An ambitious sequel where the story changes depending on who you borrow the phone from [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: シネマティックな3Dドット絵に進化した「Cassette Beasts 2002」。電話を借りる相手で物語が変わる意欲的な続編［gamescom］
entries.description: At the RawFury booth at gamescom 2026, I checked out a live demo of “CassetteBeasts 2002,” a monster-collecting RPG developed by the UK-based Bytten Studio. With its visual style that blends third-person 3D graphics and pixel art, as well as a storyline that changes depending on who you borrow a phone from at the start of the game, this is a sequel that’s definitely worth keeping an eye on.

entries.title: "Once Human" October Major Update: "Isles of Abyss." Build a raft into a sea fortress and set sail [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: 「Once Human」10月の大型アップデート「Isles of Abyss」。いかだを海上要塞に育てて航海する［gamescom］
entries.description: NetEase Games will showcase "Once Human" at gamescom 2026. On August 28, Derek Qiu provided an overview of the major update “Isles of Abyss,” scheduled for release in October, and we got to try out a pre-release build. Set in a new environment where the ocean itself becomes a giant monster, the game involves sailing from a simple raft to a sea fortress as you upgrade your vessel along the way.

entries.title: [Interview] The number of exhibitors from Japan increased by 25%. The aim of gamescom 2026, where the exhibition area was completely filled for the first time [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］日本からの出展社は25％増。出展エリアが初めて完全に埋まったgamescom 2026の狙い［gamescom］
entries.description: gamescom 2026 is being held in Cologne, Germany, from August 26 to 30, 2026. This is the first year that the exhibition space has been completely booked, and exhibitor registrations have set new records for the third consecutive year. We sent questions to Tim Endres, Director of gamescom, and Felix Falk, Managing Director of the German Games Industry Association, ahead of the event.

entries.title: A new character “Marco” has finally appeared. Latest DLC for rock climbing sim “Cairn” released for free [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: いよいよ新キャラ“マルコ”が登場。ロッククライミングシム「Cairn」の最新DLCは無料でリリース［gamescom］
entries.description: We spoke with Community Manager Laurent Coduro at gamescom 2026 about “On the Trail,” the first DLC for “Cairn,” an authentic rock climbing sim developed by France’s TheGameBakers.

entries.title: You can interact with Rocky! I experienced the VR game version of the hit science fiction movie "Project Hail Mary: Journey Among The Stars" [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: ロッキーとインタラクトできる！大ヒットSF映画のVRゲーム版「Project Hail Mary: Journey Among The Stars」を体験してきた［gamescom］
entries.description: At the “gamescom 2026” venue, I had the opportunity to try out a demo of MazeTheory’s new VR/MR game, “Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars.” Based on the best-selling novel by Andy Weir and its film adaptation, this highly anticipated title offers the immersive experience unique to VR and the chance to interact with your companion, “Rocky.”

entries.title: I finally tried out ``Crazy Taxi: World Tour.'' Run around the new stage “Germany” like crazy [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: 「クレイジータクシー：ワールドツアー」をついに試遊。新ステージ「ドイツ」をクレイジーに走り回る［gamescom］
entries.description: It’s been a little over two months since the hands-off presentation at Summer Game Fest 2026. At gamescom 2026, I got to play *Crazy Taxi: World Tour* and spent about 30 minutes driving around the newly announced “Germany” stage.

entries.title: [Interview] Never miss out on the ``Rockman-ness''. “Rockman: Dual Override” aims for a completely new work for the 40th anniversary
entries.title_ja: ［インタビュー］「ロックマンらしさ」は絶対に外さない。「ロックマン：デュアル オーバーライド」が目指す，40周年の完全新作
entries.description: The latest entry in the “Mega Man” series, “Mega Man: Dual Override,” was showcased as a playable title at Gamescom. This title incorporates new elements such as “Override,” “Custom Chips,” and the female boss “Twinkle Girl.” We spoke with the developers about their goals and the vision behind the game’s development.

entries.title: Play “SAW: Genesis,” which explores the origins of Jigsaw, at gamescom 2026. An asymmetrical 3-vs.-1 horror game that forces you to make the ultimate choice [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: ジグソウの原点を描く「SAW: Genesis」をgamescom 2026でプレイ。究極の選択を迫る3対1の非対称対戦ホラー［gamescom］
entries.description: At the BlooberTeam business booth at gamescom 2026, a playable demo of the new horror game "SAW: Genesis" was on display. Set approximately 100 years before the events of the "SAW" series, it is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game in which three "Defendants" face off against one "Judge."

entries.title: [Interview] We asked about the details of new features such as "Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen", hack-and-slash style "relics", additional dungeons that can be challenged repeatedly, hard mode, etc.

entries.description: I participated in a joint interview for *Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen*. I spoke with the development team about the new features I was most interested in, including “Relics”—new equipment that offers hack-and-slash-style gameplay—the new dungeon “The Forgotten Trial,” new skills added to each job, and even Hard Mode.

entries.description: I played a demo of "Helcast," which was showcased as a playable title at the HYPERREAL booth in the Indie Corner at gamescom 2026. Shinobu is one of the Pillars of the Demon Slayer Corps—the Insect Pillar—and is known for her unique breathing technique that uses poison. Shinobu herself is a very cute, charming character who, while having a sharp tongue and a mysterious side, is also sensitive and competitive.

entries.title: The psychological mystery thriller "The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline" is set to be released on September 11. It's a puzzle-solving exploration game set in Hell that offers a "new interpretation" of Dante's "Divine Comedy."
entries.title_ja: サイコロジカルミステリースリラー『The Alighieri Circle：ダンテの血縁』9月11日配信へ。ダンテ「神曲」を“新解釈”した、地獄謎解き探索ゲーム
entries.description: On August 29, Creek & River announced that *The Alighieri Circle: Dante's Bloodline* will be released on September 11. This title is a first-person psychological mystery thriller game.

entries.title: The Gothic bullet-hell shooter *Caladrius 2: Dark Element*, featuring “strip elements,” is set for release on December 10. The “Shame Break” system—which makes you want to get hit on purpose—has evolved and is returning after 13 years.
entries.title_ja: “脱衣要素あり”ゴシック弾幕STG『カラドリウス2/ダークエレメント』12月10日発売へ。つい被弾したくなる「羞恥ブレイク」システムが進化して13年越しに帰ってくる
entries.description: On August 27, Mos Co., Ltd. announced that "Caladrius 2: Dark Element" will be released on December 10.

entries.title: "Elden Ring" New DLC Features Surprisingly Impressive Additional Weapons, Including "Some Pretty Amazing Unique Combat Skills." Eight New Weapons and Shields Are Being Added in a Big Way

entries.description: The new weapons added in *ELDEN RING: Tarnished Edition* and the “Tarnished Pack” are already generating a lot of buzz.

entries.title: The developer of the dog-sled Arctic survival game *Arctico*—which was initially deemed a “total flop riddled with bugs”—is delighted to report, “After 12 years of continuous updates, sales have grown to 420,000 copies.” By persistently nurturing a game that had lost its way, it ended up becoming a massive hit.
entries.title_ja: 当初“バグだらけで大失敗”だった犬ぞり北極サバイバル『Arctico』開発者、「12年アプデし続け売上42万本まで伸びた」と喜ぶ。迷走ゲームを育て続けて、大化け
entries.description: "Arctico," an Arctic dog-sled survival game that entered early access in 2014 and was officially released in 2022, has reportedly sold 420,000 copies to date.

entries.title: The official Unreal Engine 5 “hyper-realistic city” sample—which garnered attention with its “Matrix demo”—has undergone a major overhaul after four years. It now supports the latest version of UE, automatically generates entire cities, and even allows for “LLM control.”
entries.title_ja: 「マトリックスのデモ」で注目集めた、Unreal Engine 5の公式“超リアル街”サンプルが4年越しに大刷新。最新UE対応で街ごと自動生成、“LLM制御”もできる
entries.description: On August 28, Epic Games updated the "City Sample" sample project for Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) to Unreal Engine 5.8.

entries.title: "Cassette Beasts 2002," a monster-collecting RPG where you transform and battle, is set for release next March. The number of monsters has nearly doubled, and when combined, they can take on "over 50,000" different forms—too many to count.
entries.title_ja: 「自分が変身して戦う」モンスター収集RPG『Cassette Beasts 2002』来年3月発売へ。モンスター数ほぼ倍増、合体すれば“5万通り超”の姿に、見きれない
entries.description: On August 27, Raw Fury announced that *Cassette Beasts 2002*, developed by Bytten Studio, is scheduled for release in March 2027.

entries.title: The totalitarian tower defense game *Absolute Rocket Defense* is just way too intense. You can strengthen your allies by pointing “guns” at them, and there’s propaganda, secret police—you name it, it’s all there.
entries.title_ja: 独裁国家タワーディフェンス『絶対ロケット防衛主義』、何もかも物騒すぎる。味方に「銃口」を向けて強くしたり、プロパガンダ、秘密警察、なんでもあり
entries.description: On August 28, tiny cactus studio announced that it will release the base-building strategy game *Absolute Rocket Defense* on September 4.

entries.title: "Turok: Origins," the first all-new installment in 19 years of the popular dinosaur shooter series "Turok," can be played in "TPS" mode and lets you shoot aliens. The game—which features humans who steal DNA to become stronger—is set for release next spring.
entries.title_ja: 人気恐竜シューター『Turok』19年ぶりの完全新作『Turok: Origins』は「TPS」でも遊べるし、エイリアンも撃てる。DNAを奪って強くなる人間やめぎみ新作、来年春発売へ
entries.description: On August 26, Saber Interactive announced that "Turok: Origins" will be released in the spring of 2027.

entries.title: "Football Manager 27," a soccer club management sim, has been officially announced and is set for release in November. The new title addresses issues—such as the user interface—that were criticized in the previous installment, marking a comeback for the series.
entries.title_ja: サッカークラブ経営シム『Football Manager 27』正式発表、11月発売へ。前作で不評だった「UI」などにメス、シリーズ巻き返しの新作
entries.description: On August 27, Sega and Sports Interactive officially announced *Football Manager 27* as the latest installment in the *Football Manager* series.

entries.title: "Samurai vs. Steampunk": Japanese-Style SRPG *Shadow of the Road* Set for Release on November 12. A Slightly Whimsical Fantasy Japan Where Samurai Fight Back Against Machine Guns and Flamethrowers with Swords and the Power of Yokai
entries.title_ja: 「侍vsスチームパンク」和風SRPG『Shadow of the Road』11月12日配信へ。機関銃、火炎放射に刀と妖怪の力で抗う、ちょっとおかしな架空日本
entries.description: On August 27, Owlcat Games announced that it will release "Shadow of the Road," a turn-based strategy RPG developed by Another Angle Games, on November 12.

entries.title: The popular, massive-scissors-wielding witch roguelike *The Witch's Garden* has added Japanese voice acting and finally concluded its story. With a significantly revamped combat system and a host of new features, the game is now officially released.
entries.title_ja: 人気のでっかいハサミぶん回し魔女ローグライト『魔女の庭』、日本語ボイス実装&物語ついに完結。戦闘システムも大幅刷新、新要素どっさりで正式リリース
entries.description: Team Tapas officially released "The Witch's Garden" on August 28.

entries.title: The popular medieval city-building sim "Manor Lords" has added "cows" in a major update, allowing players to make cheese from milk. The update brings a wealth of new content, including a lush new map with a flowing river.
entries.title_ja: 人気中世都市づくりシム『Manor Lords』、大型アプデで「牛」追加、乳からチーズも作れる。川の流れる緑豊かな新マップなど、コンテンツどっさり到来アプデ
entries.description: On August 28, Hooded Horse released a major update for *Manor Lords*, developed by Slavic Magic. The update introduced cows, apple cider, and mead, and added a new map.

entries.title: The "RPG Maker" series is currently on a massive sale on Steam. The latest title, "RPG Maker MZ," is 61% off—the lowest price ever—and there are also limited-time bundles and plugins available for great savings.
entries.title_ja: Steamにて「RPGツクール」シリーズがどどんとセール中。最新作「RPGツクールMZ」は過去最安の61%オフ、期間限定バンドルやプラグインも合わせてお得
entries.description: On August 28, Gotcha Gotcha Games launched the "RPG Maker Special Sale 2026." It's a great sale with fantastic deals, including "RPG Maker MZ" at 61% off.

entries.title: Announcing "Koe," a 1970s-style rural otherworld exploration horror game. A multi-ending horror experience where you investigate the mystery of an influencer’s disappearance while exploring a mysterious realm.
entries.title_ja: 1970年代の村風異界探索ホラー『越え』発表。インフルエンサー失踪の謎を追い、不思議空間を探索するマルチエンド恐怖体験

entries.title_ja: 新生『AVA』こと『AVA RE:BIRTH』には“PvPvE脱出シューター”のような新モード実装へ。持ち返った装備は、「ほかのモード」でも使える
entries.description: On August 28, G·O·P released details about the "HUNTING FIELD" in *AVA RE:BIRTH*.

entries.title: Introducing a playable demo of “God Save Birmingham,” a unique zombie survival game that blends physics-based action with a life simulation [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: 物理演算を生かしたアクションと生活シミュレーションが融合した異色のゾンビサバイバル「God Save Birmingham」のプレイアブルデモを紹介［gamescom］
entries.description: At gamescom 2026, currently being held in Cologne, Germany, a playable demo of “GodSaveBirmingham,” developed by OceanDriveStudio, was on display. The game is set in 14th-century England, which has been devastated by zombies. It combines action that takes full advantage of Unreal Engine 5’s physics simulation with a rich life simulation.

entries.title: Information on the live-action adventure game "Shibuya Scramble Stories," featuring the mysterious high school student "Tsuna Yukishiro" and the Shibuya monster "Shibura," has been released.

entries.title_ja: 巨人警官の機嫌を取りつつ街からの脱出を図るステルスADV。「Militsioner」，XBOX Game Pass対応で2027年に発売決定

entries.title: "Divinum," a Metroidvania game developed by an independent developer over the course of 10 years, has been released on Steam. It combines stylish combat with the joy of exploration.

entries.description: SigilGames released the PC game "Divinum" on Steam today. The game is a hack-and-slash Metroidvania that combines stylish combat with the joy of exploration. It was developed by Vladislav, a self-taught independent developer, who spent 10 years bringing it to completion.

entries.title: "STAR WARS: Zero Company," a turn-based strategy game set during the Clone Wars era, launches today

This turn-based strategy game follows former Republic officer “Hawks” and Zero Squad—an unconventional elite unit of professionals—as they are summoned to fight together in an operation led by Republic Intelligence.

entries.title: The soccer management game "Football Manager 27" is set for release in November 2026. Details about the game are scheduled to be announced starting in September.

entries.description: On August 27, 2026, SportsInteractive announced that it will release the soccer management game “Football Manager 27” in November 2026. The specific release date and supported platforms will be announced at a later date. Starting in September, the company plans to showcase gameplay, as well as feature in-depth coverage of key features, commentary from the development team, and blog posts.

entries.title: Sony Music Entertainment to Acquire Approximately 22.9% of GungHo's Shares for About 28.6 Billion Yen; Will Become Largest Shareholder and Form a Capital and Business Alliance
entries.title_ja: ソニー・ミュージックエンタテインメント，ガンホー株式約22.9％を約286億円で取得へ。筆頭株主となり資本業務提携も
entries.description: SME announced today that it has entered into a share transfer agreement to acquire shares in GungHo, as well as a capital and business alliance agreement with the company. The two companies plan to pursue a wide range of collaborations by combining GungHo’s leading IPs—such as “Puzzle & Dragons”—along with its game development capabilities and expertise, with the Sony Music Group’s knowledge and experience in the entertainment sector.

entries.description: 2PGames today announced that the official version of the action roguelike ``Tensei Insurance Co., Ltd. R.I.P'', which is currently in early access on Steam, will be released on September 16, 2026. With the addition of the close-range specialized agent ``Rin'', the final stage, new modes, and more, you can enjoy building with hundreds of types of equipment.

entries.title: On the surface, it's a theme park that exhibits zombies and vampires, but behind the scenes it's a cult operation. Trial version of Monster Park Tycoon, a dark comedy management sim in which not-so-smart people work behind the scenes, is now available
entries.title_ja: 表向きはゾンビや吸血鬼を展示するテーマパーク，裏ではカルト教団の運営。あまり賢くない連中が暗躍するダークコメディ経営シム「Monster Park Tycoon」，体験版を配信中
entries.description: OverPoweredTeam is distributing the trial version of "MonsterParkTycoon" on Steam. This is a management simulation game in which you run a monster theme park and a cult organization at the same time. In the trial version, you can enjoy 5 types of monsters and levels with tutorials.

entries.title: The release date of the first-person action ADV “Alien Deathstorm” that explores a devastated alien colony is set for spring 2027
entries.title_ja: 荒廃した異星のコロニーを探索する一人称視点アクションADV「Alien Deathstorm」の発売時期が2027年春に決定
entries.description: Rebellion today (August 27, 2026) released the latest trailer for the new title "Alien Deathstorm" under development, and revealed that the release date has been decided for spring 2027. The game is a first-person action-adventure that explores an alien colony ravaged by a devastating superstorm and occupied by dangerous aliens.

entries.title: Major update “Frostburn” for the “very popular” cooperative FPS “Far Far West” released today. Many new elements such as shields and ice magic appear
entries.title_ja: “非常に好評”の協力FPS「Far Far West」，大型アップデート「Frostburn」を本日リリース。シールドや氷魔法などの新要素が多数登場
entries.description: EvilRaptor and FireshineGames today (August 27, 2026) released a major update, ``Frostburn,'' for the PC cooperative FPS ``FarFarWest.'' Many new elements have been implemented, including the new element ``shield'' that prevents a certain amount of damage independent of physical strength, and the new attribute ``ice magic'' that freezes the target.

entries.title: As something inhuman approaches his home, he must also respond to frequent messages from his lover. Survival horror with only stress “Sleepless Night with the Devil and Girlfriend”, playtest underway
entries.title_ja: 人ならざるものが自宅に迫るなか，恋人から頻繁に届くメッセージにも返信せねばならない。ストレスしかないサバイバルホラー「悪魔とカノジョと眠れない夜」，プレイテスト実施中
entries.description: TailtoneGames has started a playtest of ``The Devil, the Girlfriend, and the Sleepless Night'' by Ixavon on Steam. This work is a survival horror story in which the player survives the night as a monster approaches his home while maintaining his relationship with his lover and searching for his missing friend.

entries.title: ``Road Kings'', a truck simulator that allows you to navigate even rough roads buried in collapsed roads and floods, will be released on March 11, 2027

This is a truck simulation game set in the plains of the southern coast of the United States, where players drive a 40-ton semi-trailer and complete various tasks.

entries.title: “ELDEN RING”, update file “Ver.1.17” distributed. Compatibility with the DLC "Tarnished Pack" and major adjustments to game balance were made.

entries.title: The latest installment of the tower defense series, "PixelJunk Monsters 3," has been announced. A playtest of the 20th anniversary of the series will be held from September 4th.

A completely new game to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the series, it features hand-drawn art in 4K resolution and introduces roguelike elements. Playtesting will begin on September 4, 2026.

entries.description: Colopl announced today that it will release its new smartphone app, “Quiz Action RPG With Generation,” this winter. entries.title: How Should You Make a Sequel to a Hit Game? The Developer of “Subnautica 2” Reveals the Dangers of “Sequel Syndrome” and the “One-Third Rule” [gamescom]
entries.title_ja: ヒット作の続編はどう作るべきか？ 「サブノーティカ 2」開発者が明かす“続編病”の恐怖と「3分の1の法則」［gamescom］
entries.description: At gamescomdev2026, a keynote presentation was held on the popular survival-crafting game *Subnautica 2*, set on an unknown ocean planet. The talk addressed the fear of “sequel syndrome” facing the sequel to this smash hit, as well as the clear design principle known as the “one-third rule” that the development team had devised.

entries.title: "Grand Strategy SSB2" Launches Season 2 on November 26, Adding Campaign Mode, "Technology," and the New Weapon "F-3"
entries.title_ja: 「大戦略SSB2」，シーズン2を11月26日に開始。キャンペーンモードや「技術力」，新兵器「F-3」などを追加
entries.description: System Soft Beta announced today that Season 2 of “Grand Strategy SSB2” will begin on November 26, 2026. The company will release the "Power-Up Kit" DLC—which includes a "Campaign Mode" featuring 30 maps to conquer—as well as weapon, map, and BGM packs for "Australia" and "India," and will also roll out a major free update for the main game.

entries.title: The hardcore strategy sim “Grand Strategy SSB2” will implement a new free map titled “Challenge the U.S. as North Korea” in a free update on August 27. A new scenario map featuring “old-school tank battles” in Somalia is also coming.
entries.title_ja: 硬派戦略シム『大戦略SSB2』8月27日の無料アプデで「北朝鮮としてアメリカに挑む」新フリーマップ実装へ。ソマリアで“旧型戦車戦”新シナリオマップも来る
entries.description: On August 25, System Soft Beta announced that it will release a free update for the strategy sim "Grand Strategy SSB2" on August 27.

entries.title: "Grand Strategy SSB2" Adds Free Scenarios: "Three Arrows" (China, North Korea, and South Korea vs. the U.S.) and "Turkish Military vs. Islamic Extremist Group"
entries.title_ja: 「大戦略SSB2」，中朝韓vsアメリカのフリーマップ「三本の矢」と，トルコ軍vsイスラム過激派組織のシナリオを無料追加
entries.description: System Soft Beta announced today that it will release an update on August 27, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., adding the scenario map “Battle of Mogadishu” and the free map “Three Arrows” to *Grand Strategy SSB2* at no cost. Players will be able to enjoy a scenario featuring a clash between the Turkish military and “Al-Shabaab,” as well as a free map in which North Korea, South Korea, and China form an alliance to challenge the United States.

entries.title: "ROLLA," a game where you become a mass of flesh that devours the city, is set to launch on October 1. A "B-movie horror-style" action game filled with chaos and mayhem, where you devour everything in your path—people, cars, and more.
entries.title_ja: 肉塊となって街を呑み込むゲーム『ROLLA』10月1日配信へ。人も車も全てを喰らう、阿鼻叫喚“B級ホラー風”アクション
entries.description: On August 25, Pantaloon announced that it will release "ROLLA," developed by Tyrmä Games, on October 1.

entries.description: On August 25, Caspianborn Publishing announced that it will begin streaming *Trust Your Gut*, produced by Mishleto, on November 19 (local time).

entries.title: The rice-farming action RPG *Sakuna: Of Rice and Ruin* has launched its first update in about five years, with a beta test finally beginning on Steam. Players can get an early look at features like “New Game+” and additional events.

entries.title: "Handsome Villains: A Love Story of Evil Blooming in the Dark of Night" adds three new characters belonging to the new organization "Libra." An event featuring them is also coming up.

entries.description: Cyberd announced today that it has added three new characters belonging to the organization “Libra” to its romance game for women, “Handsome Villains: A Love Story of Evil Blooming in the Dark Night.” The three characters added in this update are Yuren (voiced by Kengo Kasai), Zain Regulus (voiced by Kento Ito), and Lucian Morsandor (voiced by Tomoaki Maeno).

entries.title: Ponos, the developer of *The Great Cat War*, is hiring mid-career professionals. The company is seeking game engineers, as well as planning and operations staff, to help nurture this long-loved IP.

entries.description: Ponos Co., Ltd. is currently recruiting experienced professionals.

entries.title: "Ylem’s Cat," a beautiful adventure game featuring a giant cat and a young girl, is brought to you by a "development team where almost everyone owns a cat"—a game that relies heavily on feline help. The goal is to capture "that feeling" from *The Outer Wilds*.

entries.description: "Ylem's Cat" is a "knowledge-unlock" action adventure game inspired by titles such as "Outer Wilds" and "TUNIC."

entries.title: "PLACE TO FIT" launches on Steam on August 27. In this physics-based organizing and storage puzzle game, try to fit items perfectly into limited spaces.
entries.title_ja: 「PLACE TO FIT」，8月27日にSteamでリリース。物理演算を生かした片付け・収納パズルで，限られたスペースにモノをぴったり収めよう
entries.description: BitRockGames announced today that it will release “PLACETOFIT,” a tidying and storage simulation featuring physics-based puzzles, on Steam at 12:00 PM on August 27, 2026. Players take on tasks such as tidying up cluttered rooms, loading cargo, and arranging merchandise, figuring out how to orient and stack items to fit them into limited spaces.

entries.title: "Tsuguno Hi - The Thread of Salvation Summoned by Heaven" is now available on Steam. Will the girl, who is viewed as the family of the perpetrator, ultimately take the hand at the end of the thread?

This title is the latest installment in the “Tsugunohi” series of everyday life-infiltrating horror games and represents a “return to its roots,” deliberately revisiting the art style and atmosphere of the early games.

entries.title: “Swaggerfall,” an open-world RPG that “runs on the command line,” has been unveiled. A 3D fantasy world crafted from “ASCII characters”—a romantic adventure woven by keystrokes.

entries.title: "Dinghai," a roguelike action RPG based on the *Classic of Mountains and Seas*, has released a demo on Steam. Players can switch between two weapons to unleash fluid combos.
entries.title_ja: 山海経を題材としたローグライクアクションRPG「定海」，体験版をSteamでリリース。2つの武器を切り替えて，流れるようなコンボを繰り出せる
entries.description: Justdan International today released a demo version of “Dinghai,” the company’s first PC game developed entirely in-house, on Steam. The game is a roguelike action RPG based on the ancient mythological text *Shanhaijing* and the legend of *Dayu’s Flood Control*. It features a “Dual Weapon System” that allows players to switch between two weapons and execute fluid combos.

entries.description: On August 22, 2026, the finals of “GGGP 2026,” a prize-money tournament featuring Gundam games, were held at the Ryogoku Kokugikan. The game featured for the 2026 tournament was *Mobile Suit Gundam Extreme Versus 2: Infinite Boost*. Japan’s top players gathered to battle fiercely for the 6 million yen grand prize and the title of GGGP 2026 champion.

entries.title: "NAMCO LEGENDARY Mountains" releases Version 1.2.0 today, adding multiplayer functionality. The update includes two new modes: Score Attack and Voxel Race.
entries.title_ja: 「NAMCO LEGENDARY Mountains」，対戦機能を追加するVer1.2.0を本日配信。スコアアタックとボクセルレースの2モードを実装
entries.description: Bside released a major update (Ver. 1.2.0) for the 3D puzzle game “NAMCOLEGENDARYMountains” today. New competitive features have been added, including “Score Attack,” where players compete to achieve the highest score within a time limit, and “Voxel Race,” where players race to create the largest voxel before their opponent. The game also supports solo practice mode.

entries.title: Set in a land ravaged by a plague, a web of intrigue surrounding purification and destruction unfolds. “Among Shadows,” a game that combines “Werwolf” mechanics with a retreat-based action style, is currently undergoing a limited-time beta test.
entries.title_ja: 疫病が蔓延する土地を舞台に，浄化と破壊をめぐる駆け引きが交錯する。人狼ゲームと撤退型アクションを組み合わせた「Among Shadows」，期間限定テストを実施中
entries.description: TMXNGames today launched a limited-time beta test on Steam for “AmongShadows,” a game that combines the Werewolf game with a retreat-style action RPG. In this game, players are divided into the “Order of the Secret Flame,” which aims to eliminate the source of the infection, and the “Priests of Darkness” lurking within the order, engaging in sword-and-sorcery combat and identity deduction. The test runs until 6:00 PM on August 31.

entries.title: The movie "Exit 8" will air for the first time on terrestrial TV on August 28 on "Friday Roadshow." You can watch this survival movie, which grossed 5.1 billion yen at the box office, uncut.

entries.description: Nippon Television announced that it will air the film “Exit 8” for the first time on terrestrial television as part of its “Friday Roadshow” program on August 28, 2026, at 9:00 p.m. This live-action film is based on the video game of the same name, which was released on November 29, 2023. The film grossed over 5.1 billion yen at the box office, and this broadcast will feature the full, uncut version of the movie.

entries.title: "gamescom dev," Europe's largest developer conference, has kicked off. Following a rebranding from the former "devcom," it has evolved into a new, expanded B2B platform [gamescom].

entries.description: Ahead of gamescom 2026, one of the world’s largest gaming events, “gamescomdev”—Europe’s largest game developers’ conference—has kicked off. entries.description: Nexon today released the latest information on the booth it will exhibit at "Tokyo Game Show 2026", which will be held at Makuhari Messe from September 17th to 21st, 2026. entries.title: “Persona 4 Revival” & Switch 2 version “Metaphor: Refantasio” to be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2026

entries.description: Atlus announced on August 24, 2026 that ``Persona 4 Revival'' and the Nintendo Switch 2 version ``Metaphor: Refantasio'' will be exhibited as playable games at the Tokyo Game Show 2026. In the former, you can experience either ``Story'' or ``Dungeon,'' and in the latter, you can experience ``Trial of the Sword,'' an experiential game content based on the battle system.

entries.title: AI pixel art battle, a drawing battle game where you draw and fight monsters that look like that, now available on Steam

This is a drawing competition game in which players draw and fight monsters that are likely to defeat their opponent's monsters. In addition to ``regular battles,'' where you freely draw and fight monsters, you can also enjoy ``retrofit battles,'' where you create monsters based on a theme.

This work is a sequel to the Soul-like dark action RPG ``Mortal Shell'' released in 2020. Summon abilities from the corpses of warriors scattered around the world and take on highly difficult battles.

At the venue, you can try out three titles: "Shinjuku Incident," "Kinki Spiritual Bureau," and "Manny's."

This work is set in an art museum after the museum has closed, and the story revolves around finding out what is wrong with the same hall that you keep coming across over and over again, and then choosing the correct one out of two doors to proceed through.

entries.title: “The Three Coffins” is a masterpiece by John Dickson Carr, who ushered in the golden age of mystery with his “closed-door lectures” (Book Guide for Gamers: No. 69)

entries.description: Have you ever come across a scene in a mystery game where the detective character speaks in a ``lecture''-like tone? John Dickson Carr's ``The Three Coffins'' was the origin of this style of storytelling, which can be said to be a staple of mystery stories. This time, based on the newly translated version released in 2014, we will take a closer look at this mystery's unique pedantic taste.

entries.title: In the newly implemented beach volleyball game of the town open world “NTE”, a “safe way to win” is born. Dump truck tactics to block enemy lines

entries.description: Beach volleyball in ``NTE: Neverness to Everness'' Ver. 1.3 has become a hot topic for having a unique ``winning method''.

entries.title: I saw how serious COREBLAZER is about "growing games" at the Shanghai game event "COREBLAZER Game Fest 2026." Spend money, create opportunities, and develop freely.
entries.title_ja: COREBLAZERの「ゲーム育て」への本気度を、上海ゲームイベント「COREBLAZER Game Fest 2026」で見た。お金は出す、機会も作る、そして自由に開発してね
entries.description: Hypergryph's game investment and incubation brand "COREBLAZER" held the "COREBLAZER Game Fest" in Shanghai. We would like to share with you a glimpse of the brand's attitude toward game developers through the event.

entries.title: "Super New Space-Time Game Neptunia ∞ (Unlimited)" play report. Even in the first proper sequel in 11 years, its sharpness has not diminished. The usual "Neptunia" taste that makes you feel glad you're an otaku
entries.title_ja: 『超新時空ゲイム ネプテューヌ∞（アンリミテッド）』プレイレポート。11年ぶりの正統続編でも切れ味が衰えていなかった。オタクで良かったと思わせてくれる、いつもの『ネプテューヌ』の味
entries.description: We bring you a preliminary play report of "Super New Space-Time Game Neptunia ∞ (Unlimited)".

entries.title: Real road construction sim "Road Construction Simulator" announced. Fully equipped with dedicated heavy machinery such as tandem rollers, a one-operation construction plan that “does everything” from ground leveling to white line marking
entries.title_ja: リアル道路工事シム『Road Construction Simulator』発表。「タンデムローラー」など専用重機完備、整地から白線引きまで“全部こなす”ワンオペ施工計画
entries.description: On August 18th, Aerosoft announced ``Road Construction Simulator'' by Caipirinha Games.

entries.title: Closed beta test recruitment for new magical administrative RPG "Astrae Oratio" begins. You can experience the days with the magical girls in “Tokyo 1989” ahead of time.
entries.title_ja: 新伝奇・魔法行政RPG『アストラエ・オラティオ』クローズドβテスト募集開始。“89年東京”での魔法使いの少女たちとの日々を、ひと足先に体験できる
entries.description: On August 19th, NC began recruiting participants for the closed beta test (CBT) of Astrae Oratio.

entries.title: Up to 4-player cooperative/hunting open world "Hunting Simulator 3" to be released on October 29th. Living in an unexplored real ecosystem, even reproducing “changes in group order” during aging and reproduction
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力・狩猟オープンワールド『Hunting Simulator 3』10月29日配信へ。老化や繁殖に“群れの序列変化”まで再現、未開のリアル生態系を生きる
entries.description: NACON announced on August 19th that the open world hunting game ``Hunting Simulator 3'' will be released on October 29th.

entries.title: ``Arco'', which was lamented as ``not selling well despite its popularity'', successfully recovered its development costs by reaching 100,000 units in two years. Hidden masterpieces that challenge “newness” are gradually bearing fruit.
entries.title_ja: “好評なのに売れてない”と嘆かれた『Arco』、2年越しに10万本到達で無事開発費を回収。「新しさ」に挑んだ隠れた良作、じわじわ実る
entries.description: ``Arco'', which was released in 2024, received high praise from both the media and users, but struggled in terms of sales. However, on August 19, two years after its release, the number of units sold reached 100,000, and the development costs were recovered.

entries.title: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+, the complete console version of The Binding of Isaac, will be released on November 19th. Supports "up to 4 people cooperation", crying underground exploration with friends
entries.title_ja: 『アイザックの伝説』コンソール向け完全版『The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+』11月19日発売へ。「最大4人協力」対応、仲間と泣きじゃくり地下探索
entries.description: Nicalis announced on August 19th that the roguelike action RPG ``The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+'' will be released on November 19th.

entries.title: "BeastLink", a city-destroying battle between monsters and humans that attracted attention, got off to a rough start with an unpopular reputation. The developer is urgently making improvements with a “frame rate dramatic improvement patch” etc.
entries.title_ja: 注目された「怪獣vs人」都市破壊バトル『BeastLink』、不評の目立つ厳しいスタート。開発元は“フレームレート劇的改善パッチ”などで緊急テコ入れ中
entries.description: Grove Street Games began distributing "BeastLink" in early access on August 18th. The game received many negative reviews due to technical issues, and a patch was immediately released to improve the game.

entries.title: Irem's baseball fighting game Belsk ACT ``Baseball Fighting League Man'' is being remade in HD for the first time in 33 years. “Baseball Fighting Leagueman Bases Loaded” announced, to be released on December 10th

entries.description: City Connection announced ``Baseball Fighting Leagueman Bases Loaded'' on August 18th and announced that it would be released on December 10th.

entries.description: Noenoe Games announced on August 18th that ``GRID/ (Grid Slash)'' will begin distribution on September 15th.

entries.title: 90's Japanese style pachinko roguelite game "Pop! Pachinko” to be released on September 17th. Even though it's chilly, your brain juices won't stop. Build an explosive score.

entries.description: Pangolin Interactive announced on August 18th the pachinko/roguelite game “Pop! It was announced that ``Pachinko'' will be distributed on September 17th.

entries.title: The new character "Zanji" in "NTE", which is free to play, is a sexy and murderous older sister (CV: Kikuko Inoue). A distorted relationship with a “former boss character” that you can call home and choose whether to love or throw away.
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料『NTE』新キャラ「残虹」はセクシー殺気ムンムンお姉さん（CV井上喜久子さん）。愛するか斬り捨てるかを選べる、自宅に呼べる“元ボスキャラ”とのいびつな関係
entries.description: I played an advance play of "Zanhō" which is currently being picked up in "NTE: Neverness to Everness".

entries.title: The Japanese translation of the healing floating island colony sim "Kumogurashi no Tami" has been completely revised with the first major update. No battle, cooperative development life with natives is easier to play
entries.title_ja: 癒しの浮遊島コロニーシム『雲ぐらしの民』、初の大型アプデで日本語訳が全面刷新。戦闘なし、原住民と協力発展ライフがより遊びやすく
entries.description: XinZhi has released the first major update for the colony sim “Kumogurashi no Minami”. In addition to a complete review of the Japanese translation, various elements will be added that will increase the degree of freedom in base construction.

entries.title: Steam ninja covert roguelike "Ninja Simulator" has resumed development after four years, and playtests have begun immediately. Infiltrate with a different ``ninjutsu'' each time, and don't show yourself to anyone.
entries.title_ja: Steam忍者隠密ローグライク『Ninja Simulator』4年越しの開発再開、からの早速プレイテスト開始。毎回異なる「忍術」で潜入、誰にも姿を見せてはならぬ
entries.description: RockGame began playtesting the stealth action game ``Ninja Simulator'' on August 18th.

entries.title: Interact with Hololive talent on the beach! Slow life game ``Puchi Holo Village - Swords, Shops, and Country Life'', major summer update released on August 24th
entries.title_ja: ホロライブタレントとビーチで交流！ スローライフゲーム「ぷちホロの村 - 剣とお店と田舎暮らし」，夏の大型アップデートを8月24日に配信

entries.title: “THE BOOM” goods featuring Nijisanji “Hachimana” and “Inami Rai” wearing summer-themed costumes will be released on August 20th.

entries.title: Shochiku Games is participating as a co-publisher of the haiku adventure "OKU". Featured works with over 300,000 Steam followers will be exhibited at TGS 2026
entries.title_ja: 俳句アドベンチャー「OKU」，松竹ゲームズが共同パブリッシャとして参画。Steamフォロワー30万超の注目作がTGS 2026に出展決定
entries.description: Shochiku Games announced today, in conjunction with ``Haiku Day,'' that it will be participating as a co-publisher of the haiku adventure ``OKU'' developed by Irox Games. It is a notable work that has over 300,000 followers on Steam, and allows you to travel through a beautiful world while composing haiku by combining words. It has also been decided to exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2026.

entries.title: "NTE: Neverness to Everness", update Ver. 1.3 has been implemented that adds the main story "Mist Nest Yugi" and new character "Zanji" etc.
entries.title_ja: 「NTE: Neverness to Everness」，メインストーリー「霧の巣遊戯」や新キャラ「残虹」などを追加するアップデートVer.1.3を実装
entries.description: HottaStudio today (August 19, 2026) released the latest update Ver. 1.3 ``Return to the Stars on a Misty Moon Night'' for the open world RPG ``NTE: Neverness to Everness''. This time, multiple contents have been implemented, including the new main story ``Mist Nest Yugi'' and the S-rank character ``Zanho''.

entries.title: “Arcade Archives 2 Youma Ninpocho” will be distributed on August 20th. A shooting game released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
entries.title_ja: 「アーケードアーカイブス2 妖魔忍法帖」，8月20日に配信開始。1986年にニチブツが発売したシューティングゲーム
entries.description: Hamster announced today that ``Arcade Archives 2 Youma Ninpocho'' will be distributed on August 20, 2026. ``Youma Ninpocho'' is a shooting game released by Nichibutsu in 1986. As a young hero, Shinbei, he uses eight types of ninja techniques and aims to rescue a princess who has been captured by an army of evil spirits.

entries.title: Arcade Archives “Cyber ​​Cycles” will start distribution on August 20th. Namco's futuristic bike racing game, which appeared in a large bike-shaped case, is being reprinted.
entries.title_ja: アーケードアーカイブス「サイバーサイクルズ」，8月20日に配信開始。バイク型大型筐体で登場したナムコの近未来バイクレースゲームが復刻
entries.description: Hamster announced today that the arcade archives version of ``CyberCycles'' will be released on August 20, 2026. ``Cybercycles'' is a racing game released by Namco in 1995. Set in a near-future motorcycle race, players aim for the goal by choosing one of the machines with different performance.

entries.title: Disco punk space horror “RetroSpace” where you can enjoy the retro-futuristic atmosphere of the 60s and 70s, scheduled to be released on October 1st
entries.title_ja: 60〜70年代のレトロフューチャーな雰囲気を味わえるディスコパンクスペースホラー「RetroSpace」，10月1日に発売決定
entries.description: Kwalee announced today (August 19, 2026) that a new title in development by The Wild Gentlemen, ``RetroSpace'', will be released on October 1st. This work is an ``immersive disco punk space horror'' in which the main character, who used to be a mere janitor, becomes the last hope for all humanity and fights against strange creatures.

entries.title: The 7th edition of the stuffed toy mascot “Nijitaun” “Nijitaun 7 Choume” will be released on August 20th

entries.title: "Console Archives Little Princess Doll Princess of the Kingdom of Mar 2" will be distributed on August 20th. A musical RPG depicting the adventures of Krul.
entries.title_ja: 「コンソールアーカイブス リトルプリンセス マール王国の人形姫2」，8月20日に配信開始。クルルの冒険を描くミュージカルRPG
entries.description: Hamster today announced that ``Console Archives Little Princess Doll Princess of the Kingdom of Marl 2'' will be released on August 20, 2026. ``The Doll Princess of the Kingdom of Marle 2'' is a musical RPG released by Nippon Ichi Software in 1999. Set in the Kingdom of Mar 12 years after the previous work, Krul travels in search of her ideal prince.

entries.title: In a town locked down due to the spread of an epidemic, the player makes hamburgers while identifying infected people among the customers. Management sim x horror “Eddie’s Final Shift” announced
entries.title_ja: 疫病の蔓延でロックダウンされた町で，ハンバーガーを作りながら客に紛れた感染者を見極める。経営シム×ホラー「エディの最終シフト」発表
entries.description: RaikoStudio has announced the horror game ``Eddie's Final Shift'' for PC. This work is set in a town that has been locked down due to the spread of an epidemic called ``Silent Plague.'' The player runs a hamburger shop that is open late at night and identifies infected people among the customers.

entries.title: PS brand wireless speaker for gamers “PULSE Elevate” will be released on November 12th
entries.title_ja: PSブランドのゲーマー向けワイヤレススピーカー「PULSE Elevate」が11月12日に発売

entries.title: ``Among Us'' introduces a new role, ``Judge,'' who can ignore voting results and decide who to banish. However, if you make a mistake, you will be expelled.

entries.description: Innersloth today (August 19, 2026) updated the space werewolf game "Among Us" and added new roles. What has been added is the role of ``judge,'' which allows players to freely decide which players to banish by ignoring the voting results of the meeting.
