entries.title: Up to 4-person cooperative magical girl roguelike ACT “Kernel Hearts” to be released on September 18th. An apocalyptic rescue story of girls who live as “weapons”
entries.title_ja: 最大4人協力・魔法少女ローグライクACT『カーネル・ハーツ』9月18日配信へ。“兵器”として生きる少女たちの終末世界救出譚
entries.description: Whitethorn Games announced on August 18th that Ephemera Games' ``Kernel Hearts'' will be released on September 17th local time. Due to time differences, it seems that the release date in Japan will be September 18th.

entries.title: Announcement of ``Card Make Arena'', a competitive card game where you fight using self-made cards. A game where you can make the entire deck yourself, where the illustrations and effects are up to you, and “making it weak” is also a strategy.
entries.title_ja: 自作カードで戦う対戦カードゲーム『Card Make Arena』発表。イラストも効果も自分次第、“弱く作る”のも戦略になるデッキ丸ごと自作ゲーム
entries.description: On August 18th, PLAYISM announced ``Card Make Arena,'' a competitive card game where players create their own cards. The developer is Lizardry, known for works such as ``7 Days to End with You'' and ``Refind Self: Personality Testing Game.''

entries.title: Cthulhu survival horror "The Sinking City 2" received "95% positive reviews" immediately after its release. Crazy underwater city exploration, series sequel has a better “bio-feel”
entries.title_ja: クトゥルフサバイバルホラー『シンキング シティ 2』発売直後から「95%好評」。狂気まみれの水没都市探索、シリーズ続編は“バイオ感”マシマシに
entries.description: Frogwares released ``The Sinking City 2'' on August 18th. It has received favorable reviews from early access players one after another, and has recorded a high positive rating.

entries.title: Call for large-scale offline playtest of new game for gamers to be held in Tokyo. Recruitment is based on conditions such as playing 20 or more games and playing a specific genre for 250 hours or more.
entries.title_ja: ゲーマー向けの新作ゲームの大規模オフラインプレイテスト募集、東京で実施へ。ゲームプレイ20本以上、特定ジャンル250時間以上プレイなどの条件で募る
entries.description: Game testing platform Plithus is currently recruiting participants for offline test play of new games to be held from September 15th to 16th.

entries.title: MIXI's indie developer support program "LVLZero Tokyo" has started accepting entries for the second period. Full support for global expansion, this term you can apply from “anywhere in Japan”
entries.title_ja: MIXIのインディー開発者支援プログラム「LVLZero Tokyo」第II期エントリー受付開始。グローバル展開をまるっとサポート、今期は“日本全国どこからでも”応募可
entries.description: On August 18th, MIXI Global Investments began accepting entries for the second phase of ``LVLZero Tokyo'', a support program for emerging game developers.

entries.title: PlayWay, a mass-producer of Steam sims, has released ``16 new titles'' this month alone, 12 of which utilize generation AI. Rapidly accelerating “quantity” strategy
entries.title_ja: Steamシム量産メーカーPlayWay、今月だけで「新作16本」の異常なペース、うち12本が生成AI利用。急加速する“物量”戦略
entries.description: PlayWay has released 16 new games since the beginning of August. The company, which has been following a strategy that could be called a "prolific type" for some time, appears to be accelerating that policy even further.

entries.title: ``Ski-E-O!'', a ski resort management sim with ``real snow accumulation system'', is attracting attention. The snow quality and climate are recreated in detail, and the ski slopes that can accommodate up to 15,000 people are created with outstanding technology.
entries.title_ja: 「リアル積雪システム搭載」スキー場経営シム『Ski-E-O!』が注目浴びる。雪質・気候も細かく再現、技術力光る“最大1万5000人規模”ゲレンデ作り
entries.description: Falling Damage Games announced on August 18th that the ski resort management simulation game ``Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon'' will be released in early access on November 13th.

entries.title: An update will be released today in conjunction with the first large-scale DLC for the Sengoku death game "Nio 3". Many useful features have been added, such as a large-scale upward revision of all existing weapons and a powerful close-up camera.
entries.title_ja: 戦国死にゲー『仁王3』大型DLC第一弾にあわせアプデを本日配信。既存武器軒並み上方修正の大盤振る舞い、大迫力近接カメラなど便利機能も多数追加
entries.description: Koei Tecmo Games announced on August 18th that it will be releasing an update today to coincide with the first DLC, ``Keian Jigokuhen,'' for the dark Sengoku action RPG ``Nio 3.''

entries.title: Steam's new pachinko-style roguelike "Splat Pachinko" will be released by the end of this year. Pachinko, synergy, planet destruction, and lots of “feel good” stuff
entries.title_ja: Steamの新たなパチンコ風ローグライク『スプラット・パチンコ』年内配信へ。パチンコ・シナジー・惑星破壊、“気持ちいいもの”ドカ盛り
entries.description: Stratos Gaming announced on August 18th that it will release the pachinko-style roguelike game ``Splat Pachinko'' later this year.

entries.title: Merciless Souls-like ``Mortal Shell 2'' is a huge success with ``20,000 Steam subscribers'' right away. A high-difficulty action game that has evolved into a fierce attack with the elimination of stamina.
entries.title_ja: 無慈悲ソウルライク『Mortal Shell 2』、さっそく「Steam同接約2万人」の大盛況。“スタミナ撤廃”で隙あらば猛攻、進化を遂げた高難易度アクション
entries.description: Playstack is scheduled to release "Mortal Shell II" by Cold Symmetry on August 20th. Many people seem to be playing the game through early access before its release.

entries.title: Gene Co., Ltd. is actively recruiting mid-career employees at its Osaka base. We are looking for designers and programmers who will be responsible for developing consumer games, and we also have a moving support system in place.
entries.title_ja: 株式会社ジーンが大阪拠点で中途採用を積極採用中。コンシューマーゲーム開発を担うデザイナーやプログラマーなどを募集、引越し支援制度も用意
entries.description: Gene Co., Ltd. is currently recruiting mid-career personnel.

entries.title: "Unavoidable" bullet hell roguelite STG "PNR: Point of No return" to be released on August 28th. If you're going to get hit, just defeat the enemy first, and you're a survivor who just pursues firepower.
entries.title_ja: 「避けない」弾幕ローグライトSTG『PNR: Point of No return』8月28日配信へ。被弾するなら敵を先に倒せばいい、ひたすら火力追求サバイバー
entries.description: COKIRI Works announced on August 18th that the roguelite shooting game ``PNR: Point of No return'' will be released on August 28th.

entries.title: The “Esports Nations Cup” game competition between countries has been unexpectedly postponed by one year and will be held in November 2027. In response to the situation in the Middle East

entries.description: The Esports Foundation announced on August 18th that the first Esports Nations Cup (ENC) will be postponed.

entries.title: “Clock Tower” Respect “Chased” Horror “Remothered: Red Nun’s Legacy” to be released on October 27th. Run, hide, and sometimes fight back. Akira Yamaoka is in charge of the music.
entries.title_ja: 『クロックタワー』リスペクト“追われる”ホラー『Remothered: Red Nun’s Legacy』10月27日発売へ。逃げて隠れてたまに反撃、山岡晃氏が音楽担当
entries.description: Stormind Games announced on August 18th that the survival horror game Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy will be released on October 27th.

entries.title: There is speculation that “the founder of Godot provoked Unity in a lecture.” ``Burning Unity logo photo'' goes on its own, and the person explains the situation
entries.title_ja: “Godot創設者が講演でUnityを煽った”との憶測が出回る。「燃え盛るUnityロゴ写真」が独り歩き、本人が事情を説明
entries.description: A scene from the lecture was shared on the overseas bulletin board Reddit, giving rise to a misunderstanding that the co-developer of Godot was disparaging Unity.

entries.title: The only weapon is a shotgun. The reason why the macho and destructive rogue-lite shooter "Badassgard" was able to use only one shotgun [BIC2026]
entries.title_ja: 武器はショットガンのみ。マッチョで破壊的なローグライトシューター「Badassgard」がショットガン1本に振り切った理由［BIC2026］
entries.description: At "BIC2026" held in Busan, South Korea, I played "Badassgard" developed by THECOVE. It's a roguelite shooter where Vikings shoot shotguns in a world based on Norse mythology. We talked about the game's unique design, in which there are no classes or multiple weapon types, and all players have in their hands is a shotgun.

entries.title: Kanata Hongo and Ryogo Matsumaru appear in the first episode. A new program “Guguple Channel” to enliven the smartphone game industry will start on August 18th.
entries.title_ja: 本郷奏多さんと松丸亮吾さんが初回に出演。スマホゲーム業界を盛り上げる新番組「ぐぐぷれちゃんねる」が8月18日にスタート
entries.description: Google announced today (August 18, 2026) that it will start a new program ``Gugu Play Channel'' on GooglePlayJapan's official YouTube channel to enliven the smartphone game industry. The first broadcast on August 18th at 18:00 will be titled ``A Night to Talk About Smartphone Games,'' and Kanata Hongo and Ryogo Matsumaru will be invited as guests.

entries.title: What is the goal of the graduation game created by 14 Korean students? Interview with the development team of “Soom”, which won two rookie categories at the Busan indie event [BIC2026]
entries.title_ja: 韓国の学生14人が作る卒業制作ゲームのゴールはどこか。釜山のインディーイベントでルーキー2部門受賞の「Soom」開発チームに聞く［BIC2026］
entries.description: "Soom" is an action adventure game for PC that attracted attention at "BIC2026" held in Busan, South Korea. We spoke to 14 students from Tosei University about this work, which they worked on as their graduation project, about the development process, team composition, and the goal of the production, which aims to be exhibited at G-STAR.

entries.title: Anime style extraction “Void Diver: Escape from the Abyss” is a new challenge from the man who served as the creative director of “Maple” [BIC2026]
entries.title_ja: アニメ調エクストラクション「ボイドダイバー：アビスからの脱出」は，「メイプル」のクリエイティブディレクターを務めた男の新たな挑戦［BIC2026］
entries.description: ``Void Diver: Escape from the Abyss'' combines pixel art visuals, anime-style characters, and Extraction's game design. At the venue of one of Korea's largest indie game events, we spoke at length with Baek Ho-young, who heads the development studio.

entries.title: Introducing the puzzle-solving adventure "The (Other)World Syndrome". Young people suffering in the real world are healed in the other world of books [BIC2026]
entries.title_ja: 謎解きアドベンチャー「The (Other)World Syndrome」を紹介。現実世界で苦しむ若者が，本の中の異世界で癒やされる［BIC2026］
entries.description: Let's introduce The(Other)WorldLab's new PC game ``The(Other)WorldSyndrome'', which was exhibited at the Korean indie game event ``BIC2026''. This is an adventure game in which the main character, who has lost his place in reality, becomes a character from a book. The story progresses with some serious mystery solving in between.

entries.title: On "RADIO 4Gamer Tap (tentative)" which will be broadcast from 10pm tonight, we will introduce "4Gamer Summer Fes 2026" which is currently being held.
entries.title_ja: 今夜22時から放送の「RADIO 4Gamer Tap（仮）」では，現在開催中の「4Gamer Summer Fes 2026」を紹介します
entries.description: From 22:00 on August 18, 2026, the 305th episode of "RADIO4GamerTap (tentative)" will be live-streamed on Nippon Cultural Broadcasting's original distribution platform "QloveR" and YouTube channel "4GamerSP". This time, we will introduce "4GamerSummerFes2026" currently being held at 4Gamer.net.

entries.title: Launch of ``Cat Attendance Record Work Record Nya'', an app that counts your ``own work'' that doesn't get paid, such as creation, study, etc., with your cat.

entries.description: Illustrator c-cya today (August 18, 2026) released the work efficiency app ``Cat Attendance Record Meow''. This app is an app that allows you to count your ``own work'' that doesn't get paid, such as creating, studying, etc., along with your cat.

entries.title: ``HYPERDROP'', a roguelite pachinko game that allows you to customize the board and create the strongest platform, has been announced
entries.title_ja: 盤面をカスタマイズして最強の台を作り上げるローグライトパチンコゲーム「HYPERDROP」が発表に
entries.description: DevolverDigital today (August 18, 2026) announced the new title "HYPERDROP" being developed by DarkDarkGoose and started distributing the demo version. Release is scheduled for 2027. This is a roguelite pachinko game where you aim for a high score by customizing the neon-lit board.

entries.title: "LVLZero Tokyo", which supports the overseas expansion of indie games, has started recruiting for its second term. Participation is possible online from all over the country
entries.title_ja: インディーゲームの海外展開を支援する「LVLZero Tokyo」が第II期の募集開始。オンラインで全国から参加可能に
entries.description: MIXIGlobal Investments today began accepting entries for the second phase of "LVL Zero Tokyo," which supports the overseas expansion of indie games. Five teams are expected to be selected, and participants can participate in the program online. Applications are accepted until September 6, 2026.

entries.title: Are the characters in “Foamy Euclonia” and “UN:LOGICAL” the type that can stop time? Do you want to rewind? “LicoBiTs FESTA” daytime performance report that takes a look at love
entries.title_ja: 「泡沫のユークロニア」「UN:LOGICAL」のキャラたちは，時間を止める派？ 巻き戻す派？ 恋愛観ものぞけた「LicoBiTs FESTA」昼公演レポート
entries.description: A real event was held for ``LicoBiTs'', a gaming brand for women created by Broccoli and Tiz Creation. We will introduce reading plays and live performances of ``Foamy Euclonia'' and ``UN:LOGICAL'', projects that explore the values ​​of the characters, the excitement of the event venue filled with the latest information, and plenty of highlights of the daytime performance.

entries.title: Announcement of "Card Make Arena" where you can challenge PvP with homemade cards. A competitive card game where you can freely set effects, costs, and even illustrations.
entries.title_ja: 自作カードでPvPに挑む「Card Make Arena」発表。効果やコスト，イラストまで自由に設定できる対戦型カードゲーム
entries.description: PLAYISM today announced ``CardMakeArena,'' a competitive card game created by individual game developer Lizardry. Create original cards by freely setting card names, illustrations, effects, costs, activation conditions, etc., build decks, and challenge PvP. Steam Early Access is scheduled to start in 2026.

entries.title: ``Hotel Is Hungry'', a psychological horror game where you run a living hotel while devoting guests to it, will be released in the second quarter of 2027
entries.title_ja: 生きたホテルに宿泊客を捧げながら経営をするサイコホラーゲーム「Hotel Is Hungry」，2027年第2四半期にリリース
entries.description: ChocolateDungeo will release the Japanese-compatible PC game "HotelIsHungry" in the second quarter of 2027. This is a psychological horror game in which players run a hotel in a world where humanity has turned into a horrifying state. Players stand at the front desk each morning and choose whether to accept or reject guests. However, only one customer can be turned away per day.

entries.title: ``Go-Go Town!'', a multiplayer city-building SLG that "references Japanese urban architecture and its style of efficiently utilizing space" [Developer interview]

entries.title: "Internet Survivor Survivors" is now available on Steam. Roguelite where Flandre, who became a distributor, survives while increasing viewers

entries.description: On August 16, 2026, COOL&CREATE began distributing Touhou Project's derivative game ``Internet Survivor Survivors'' on Steam. This work is a roguelite action game in which you control Flandre Scarlet and complete the stream by defeating enemies and increasing the number of viewers. Strengthen your weapons with likes and coins and survive with the aim of reaching 1 million registered users.

entries.title: The stage is a world where the hero has been defeated. The Steam store page for "The Demon King of High Brasil", a top-down 2D command RPG that takes you on a journey to defeat the Demon King, is now available.

This work is a top-down 2D command RPG in which the player goes on an adventure to defeat the Demon King in a world where the hero has been defeated. The release date is 2027.

entries.title: He becomes a prisoner with a box head and completes his quota in an underground evacuation shelter in exchange for parole. Cooperative survival horror “Hakoatama” announced, trailer also released

entries.description: Mutsumutsu Project has announced the cooperative survival horror game ``Hakoatama'' for PC and has released a trailer. In this work, you play the role of a prisoner with a box head, ``Hakoatama'', who in exchange for parole inspects and delivers packages at an underground evacuation shelter.

entries.title: A new employee who makes terrible mistakes but is passionate is cute. Korean romantic comedy visual novel “Mina-san, a crappy employee at a game company” [BIC2026]

entries.description: At the Korean indie game event "BIC2026", the new work "Mina-san, a Punk Employee at a Game Company" was exhibited. This is an office romantic comedy about a new employee assigned to a game company's planning team who causes a series of accidents just out of passion.

entries.title: "STRANGER THAN HEAVEN" begins accepting advance applications for theater screening at Tokyo Game Show 2026. Three different performances for each character are available.

entries.description: Sega will hold a "STRANGERTHANHEAVEN" theater today (August 17, 2026) at the Sega/Atlas booth at Tokyo Game Show 2026. At the same theater, you can experience the music video of this work, including unreleased songs, as soon as possible. Ahead of this, we have begun accepting advance applications for screenings from September 19th to 21st, the public release date.

entries.title: A beautiful world based on the Japanese tradition of "kintsugi" drawn by a French student. Puzzle platformer “Kintsugi” [BIC2026]

entries.description: I played a game called "Kintsugi" at the BIC2026 venue. As the name suggests, it is a puzzle platformer based on the traditional Japanese repair technique ``Kintsugi''. This work is released on Steam as a free work of about 10 to 15 minutes.

entries.title: Pain is salvation, and death is the highest honor. Horror adventure of escaping from a cult facility “NAME OF THE WILL: Mass Aftereffects” [BIC2026]

entries.description: At the BIC2026 venue held in Busan, I saw a demo of ``NAMEOFTHEWILL: Collective Aftereffects'' being developed by Zeitgeist Studio. This is an adventure game in which the protagonist wakes up with no memory in a cult facility, acts as a believer during the day, and investigates the building at night to find a clue to escape.

entries.title: A small robot uses magnetism as a weapon to navigate an abandoned city. "Poreia" is a 3D puzzle ADV that combines cuteness and a disturbing world view [BIC2026]
entries.title_ja: 小さなロボットが磁力を武器に廃墟の都市を進む。「Poreia」は，かわいさと不穏な世界観が同居する3DパズルADV［BIC2026］
entries.description: A small robot named ``Soma'' wakes up in a ruined city and sets out on a journey in search of her lost memories and family. ARDORBIT's new PC game "Poreia" is a 3D adventure featuring magnetic puzzles and a disturbing worldview. Let's introduce what we played at BIC2026.

entries.title: Once you create a game, can you continue developing it forever? Report on a session where three indie developers spoke honestly on the themes of creation, survival, and sustainability [BIC2026]

entries.description: The core question is, once a game is developed, can it continue to be developed? Three groups of developers who started making games for different reasons took to the stage and answered questions solicited in advance from visitors in three sections: CREATE, SURVIVE, and CONTINUE.

entries.title: The main character doesn't fight. "Ratocalypse", the next creation by Cassel Games of "Ratopia", is an RPG that designs the behavior conditions of soldiers in a rat kingdom full of zombies [BIC2026]

entries.description: ``Ratocalypse,'' currently being developed by CasselGames, is a strategy RPG that automatically fights by setting conditions for using skills on each rat soldier. This is the studio's third mouse game, following ``Ratropolis,'' where you protect a city with cards, and ``Ratopia,'' where you create a city. We spoke to the developer at the "BIC2026" booth.

entries.description: On August 14, 2026, the indie game festival "BusanIndieConnectFestival2026" (BIC2026) opened at BEXCO in Busan, South Korea. entries.title: What do publishers see in indie games? Shuhei Yoshida talks with two Korean developers about pitch and the secret of choosing a publisher [BIC2026]

entries.description: On August 14th, at the South Korean indie game event "BIC2026," a session called "TALK with Shu" was held by former SIE member Shuhei Yoshida. We welcomed two Korean indie game developers and talked about what publishers look at in terms of pitches and what is important for long-term relationships. It is a practical content with concrete anecdotes.

entries.description: According to Kirill Akimkin's analysis, the number of wishlist registrations per day is important for being featured in Steam's discovery queue.

entries.title: Yuzusoft's beautiful girl game ``Sanoba Witch'' sold over 500,000 copies. It has received a lot of Chinese reviews and is extremely popular on Steam with "overwhelmingly positive reviews".

entries.description: On August 7th, Yuzusoft announced that worldwide sales of ``Sanoba Witch'' exceeded 500,000 copies. This is the first record achieved approximately 11 years after its release.

entries.title: In the new SRPG "Genseiroku Remake" where you are "killed by greed", I died a lot even though it wasn't a death game. Magical dopamine in SRPG, battlefield goes crazy with “up to 5x experience points system”

entries.description: "Genseiroku Remake" is a work that has the intense "fun of leveling up" that is unique to SRPGs.

entries.description: KURO GAMES announced on August 7th that the major update version 3.6 of ``Narushio'' will be released on August 20th, ``Shadow of Light Clad in Phantom Clouds, Heart of Worldly Melancholy and Sword''.

entries.title: GRAIN ROT, a cooperative horror game where you can prank your friends as much as you want, is now available on Steam. Explore underground ruins full of monsters while riding on a worn-out wooden body that burns and shatters.

entries.description: Neem Interactive began distributing ``GRAIN ROT'' by Beck & Branch Games on August 8th. This work is a cooperative horror escape game that supports solo play and online cooperative play with up to 4 people.

entries.title: The "factory operation sounds" in "Arknights: Endfield" are actually full of original ideas. The key to saving money is “sound source synthesis” and resource management using proprietary technology

entries.description: In ``Arknights: Endfield,'' which has a lot of factory equipment, the developer has revealed some ideas for managing sound.

entries.title: Low reviews on Steam tend to be ``short play times and tend to be long.'' Large-scale analysis of differences in “writing style” with high ratings
entries.title_ja: Steamの低評価レビューは、「短時間プレイかつ長文になりがち」な傾向。高評価との“書かれ方”の違い大規模分析
entries.description: Research has revealed that the timing of posting a review, the length of the text, and the emotions that are likely to be expressed tend to vary depending on the level of evaluation and the type of play.

entries.title: Otama Korokoro open world exploration game "MARBLE SOULS" announced. A ball hurtling through a vast world, brought to you by the talented developers who have created a series of unique games that have been "overwhelmingly popular"

entries.description: Stuffed Wombat announced ``MARBLE SOULS'' on August 6th. This work is an open world exploration game that combines elements of Soulslike and games where you move/explore by rolling marbles.

entries.title: When I revisited "Arknights: Endfield" for the first time in half a year, I couldn't find an end to the profound industrialization and automation.
entries.title_ja: 「アークナイツ：エンドフィールド」半年ぶりに再訪したら，奥深い工業化＆自動化で止めどきが見つからない
entries.description: ``Arknights: Endfield'', which began service on January 22, 2026, is a 3D real-time strategy RPG in which you become the manager of Endfield Industries, explore undeveloped lands, fight enemies, and promote industrialization and automation in the meantime. Now, about half a year after the service started, I visited the planet again.

entries.title: Appraisers gather in Ikebukuro in midsummer. "NTE" offline event "The Great Adventure of Meme Village" is being held at Nakaikebukuro Park. Until August 9th

entries.title: "Lies of P", the latest video that talks about the behind-the-scenes of development has been released. How was this unique Soul-like action RPG created?

entries.description: NEOWIZ today released a video introducing the development process of the action RPG "Lies of P", which is currently on sale. NEOWIZ's development team NOUGHStudio, which was in charge of the production, talks in detail about the behind-the-scenes development of this work, which tells a dark story inspired by the fairy tale ``The Adventures of Pinocchio.''

entries.title: Summer is not only the Seven Wonders, but the "Seven Disturbances" that will make you forget about the heat - 7 apocalyptic, gloomy, and dystopian games that will help you chill out.
entries.title_ja: 夏は七不思議ならぬ“七不穏”で暑さを忘却の彼方へ――涼しくチルアウトできる終末，陰鬱，ディストピアな7つのゲーム
entries.description: Even if it's only for a short period of time, it gives you a strong shiver, and even after you're done playing, you'll have a strange feeling that sticks around you. Works that slowly distort everyday life, quiet apocalypses, and vivid dystopias... Introducing seven disturbing games that will help you chill out in the hot summer, as well as a sense of the coming end.

entries.description: BANJIHAGAMES has announced a new mystery ADV, "The Ninth Record." This work is a work in which the player restores eight incident records that were charred by a fire by inputting keywords and searching. It is scheduled to be released in 2027, and will also support Japanese display.

entries.title: “Gate to Die,” a retro-style game where “the main character dies quickly,” will be available for free on Steam on August 7th. Explore a mansion full of wanton deaths, inspired by the beloved game Shadowgate.

entries.title: The latest work of the popular “Nichiasa” style game “Kokoro Clover Mugen Hen” has been announced. In addition to new rogue-lite elements, the theme song is also sung by Hideaki Takatori, known for his roles in the Super Sentai and "PreCure" series.

entries.title: ``The Eternal Life of Goldman'', a slimy and dynamic action film with hand-drawn "cane uncle" in every frame, is rapidly gaining attention. The adventure story of a highly mobile grandpa who uses a highly functional cane.

entries.description: THQ Nordic announced on August 5th that the number of wishlist registrations for the action-adventure game ``The Eternal Life of Goldman'' has exceeded 500,000 across all platforms.

entries.title: Devolver Digital, a popular indie game company, has announced its intention to go private, amid a "share price decline of approximately 96%" since going public. Even if the game is a huge hit, the stock price will not rise.
entries.title_ja: 人気インディーゲーム連発企業Devolver Digitalが株式非公開化の意向を発表、上場以来“株価が約96％下落”するなかで。ゲームが大ヒットしても株価は上がらず
entries.description: Publisher Devolver Digital has announced its intention to delist and go private.

entries.title: "Approximately 870 books" have also been added to the sale for Nintendo Switch 2/Switch. ``Harvest Moon'' series is up to 80% off, ``Dragon Country Rune Factory'' and ``Power Wash Simulator 2'' have been updated to the lowest prices, and other discount rates are also available.

entries.description: BlareByte announced "CLEAR RED" on August 6th. This is a first-person roguelike action game where the player aims to stop an alien invasion of Earth.

entries.title: ``The Tenth Mosaic'' will be held on September 22nd and 23rd where you can experience gaming culture. Featuring famous creators such as Fumito Ueda and Taro Yokootaro.

entries.title: Live broadcast commemorating the anniversaries of the “Harvest Moon” and “Rune Factory” series will be held on August 24th
entries.title_ja: 「牧場物語」シリーズと「ルーンファクトリー」シリーズのアニバーサリーを記念した生放送が8月24日に実施決定

This live broadcast will include a look back at the history of both series, as well as several other events such as announcing the results of character voting.

entries.title: Washagana TV's latest video introduces the latest Koihime series, "Koihime† Taisen." Mafia Mr. Kajita is locked up!?

This time, we will be introducing EXNOA's "Koihime† Taisen." In the program, Mr. Nakamura challenges Mr. Kajita to ``Washagana Taisen'' in order to return Mr. Kajita, who has become ``inferior,'' to his original state.

entries.title: Nintendo announces financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. Although sales and Switch 2 unit sales were lower than the same period last year, operating income increased by 150.5% due to tax refunds, etc.
entries.title_ja: 任天堂が2027年3月期第1四半期決算を発表。売上高とSwitch 2の販売台数は前年同期を下回るも，関税還付などにより営業利益は150.5％増
entries.description: Nintendo today announced its financial results for the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 2027. Although sales decreased 9.5% year-on-year to 517.8 billion yen, operating income increased 150.5% year-on-year to 142.5 billion yen due to factors such as tax refunds based on the US IEEPA. Nintendo Switch 2 hardware sales were 3.82 million units, a 34.4% decrease from the previous year.

entries.description: PowerverseStudio has announced a new title for PC, ``MidnightClass,'' and released an announcement trailer. entries.title: “Which is longer, the past or the future?” Have you played the Steam game “2236 A.D.” that explores the relationship between self and others?
entries.title_ja: 「過去と未来、どっちが長いの？」自己と他者の関係をフカンするSteam『西暦2236年』をもう遊んだか
entries.description: ``2236 A.D.'' is set in a grand science fiction setting, but it also deals with themes of personal emotion. Its theme becomes clearer now, more than 10 years after its release.

entries.title: "MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA", the new "MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA", is equipped with a new operation mode that supports "one-button special moves". Combos by repeatedly pressing buttons have also been strengthened, making it even easier to play.
entries.title_ja: 『メルブラ』新作『MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA』には「ワンボタン必殺技」対応の新操作モード搭載。ボタン連打でのコンボも強化されて、さらに遊びやすく
entries.description: TYPE-MOON released the latest information on "MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA" on August 2nd. In addition to implementing a new control system that allows you to perform special moves with the press of a single button, this game also features a new mode, ``Grand Scenario Mode.''

entries.title: A research report states that whether a personal FPS will be a hit for a long time can be predicted by the number of streamers/video contributors "as of the third day of release." However, it's not just that ``it's good enough to be seen a lot.''
entries.title_ja: 対人FPSが長くヒットするかは「リリース3日目時点の」配信/動画投稿者の数で予測できるとの調査報告。しかし単に“たくさん見られればいい”わけでもない
entries.description: According to Gamesight, when it comes to predicting the long-term success of PvP FPS games, the ``number of players'' rather than the amount of time content is played by streamers or video contributors can be a more effective indicator.

entries.title: The reason I made the remastered version of ``Metal Saga: Season of Steel'' was because I felt that ``salvation was necessary.'' We asked the passionate producer about everything that went into production and what would be different from the original.
entries.title_ja: 『メタルサーガ 鋼の季節』リマスター版を作った理由は、「救済が必要だ」と感じたから。熱き心を持つプロデューサーに、制作までのあれこれや“オリジナルからどこが変わるか”を色々訊いた
entries.description: We asked the ``passionate fan'' who will be working on the remastered version of ``Metal Saga: Season of Steel'' in detail about the development process.

entries.title: ``Splatoon Raiders'' has been focusing on the ``Aerial Fluffy Frozen Chop Blaster'' build for a while. The ``Iconic village life'' at ``Honogurashi no Niwa'' is surprisingly safe. This week's gaming
entries.title_ja: 『スプラトゥーン レイダース』はしばらく「空中フワフワ凍結カチ割りブラスター」ビルドに専念。『ほの暮しの庭』での“因習村生活”は意外と安心感あり。今週のゲーミング
entries.description: Every Sunday, Now Gaming is a corner where each writer loosely writes about the games they played that week. This is the 555th time.

entries.title: The glitch in the uneasy village living sim ``Garden of the Heartwarming'' fits perfectly with the worldview and is treated as a ``real monster.'' “Village rules” increase due to bugs
entries.title_ja: 不穏村暮らしシム『ほの暮しの庭』、不具合が世界観にピッタリで“リアル怪異”扱いされる。“村の掟”、バグで増える
entries.description: For some reason, it seems that the currently reported bugs in ``Garden of Heartwarming'' are being ``rated'' by players.

entries.title: Although it is a high-speed TPS from China, ``EXILEDGE'' is a TPS, its melee combat combos are also refreshing. I tried out a stylish battle that makes full use of “motorcycle self-destruction”
entries.title_ja: 中国発ハイスピードTPS『潜閾限界（EXILEDGE）』はTPSなのに近接戦闘のコンボも爽快。“バイク自爆”も駆使するスタイリッシュバトルを試遊した
entries.description: I tried out ``EXILEDGE'' which is nearing completion. I could feel that the quality had improved from before, and I thoroughly enjoyed the exhilaration of combat.

entries.title: "Fate/Grand Order (FGO)" Servant enhancement limit has been raised to 3000. The servant is even stronger with Jinri/Anri Fou-kun.

entries.description: On August 2nd, it was announced in ``Fate/Grand Order (FGO)'' that the upper limit for servant enhancement will be lifted, and the status will be able to be enhanced up to 3000.

entries.title: "Super Mario Sunshine" will be released for Switch 2 on August 13th. A serious tidying up game that allows you to use “human sea tactics” will be released on August 14th. 7 must-see gaming articles this week
entries.title_ja: 『スーパーマリオサンシャイン』Switch 2向けに8月13日配信。“人海戦術”もできる本気お片付けゲームは8月14日配信。今週の見逃せないゲーム記事7選
entries.description: We have picked up 7 articles, focusing on game introduction articles that received a great response from this week's AUTOMATON. This week, in addition to the Nintendo Classics version of ``Super Mario Sunshine,'' ``Tidy Up Together'' and ``Shinovi NEXUS -Senran Kagura-'' were talked about.

entries.title: The production of "Second Super Robot Wars Z: Hakaikan Remastered" has been announced. The latest DLC for “Super Robot Wars Y” will be released on August 5th.

entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment held a live broadcast to commemorate the 35th anniversary of the ``Super Robot Wars'' series and announced the production of ``The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z Hakkaihen Remaster.'' Furthermore, the release date of the DLC ``Anniversary Expansion Pack'' for ``Super Robot Wars Y'' has also been revealed.

entries.title: Shooting doesn't have to be severe. Try out the intuitively enjoyable casual hero shooter “Kei” (Lumeshift) [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: 撃ち合いはシビアじゃなくていい。直感的に楽しめるカジュアルなヒーローシューター「代号：对決」（Lumeshift）を試遊［CJ2026］
entries.description: Nuverse's new smartphone shooter ``Lumeshift'' was played at the ChinaJoy2026 venue. So far, small-scale tests have been conducted in some regions, and this is the first playable exhibit in China, where the development is based.

entries.title: The second collaboration event of “Wilderness Action” x “Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba” starts today. A limited mode “Infinite Castle Battle” has been implemented in which you can control “breathing” and fight demons on a 3D map.
entries.title_ja: 「荒野行動」×「鬼滅の刃」コラボイベント第2弾が本日スタート。3Dマップで“呼吸”を操って鬼と戦う限定モード「無限城激闘」が実装
entries.description: NetEaseGames today (August 2, 2026) started the second collaboration event with the anime "Kimetsu no Yaiba" in the battle royale game "Wilderness Action". In this collaboration event, a limited mode called ``Infinite Castle Battle'' will be implemented, in which players fight demons by manipulating their breathing while exploring a 3D map that looks like an infinite castle.

entries.title: While massaging the ghost's brain, it loosens memories from when it was alive. The student work “Dai脑 Massage” played with a brain-shaped controller is strangely unforgettable [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: 亡霊の脳をマッサージしながら，生前の記憶をほぐしていく。脳型コントローラで遊ぶ学生作品「大脑按摩」が妙に忘れられない［CJ2026］
entries.description: At the student work exhibition area ``AcademicGameShow'' of ``ChinaJoy2026'', which is being held from July 31st to August 3rd, 2026, ``Dai脑Amasa'' (Brain Massage), a game played while massaging a brain-shaped controller, is on display. I actually played at the venue, so I'd like to introduce you to the strange and unforgettable experience.

entries.title: “Goddess of Victory: NIKKE” will be collaborating with the “Persona” series from August 13th. Preview key visual also released
entries.title_ja: 「勝利の女神：NIKKE」で「ペルソナ」シリーズとのコラボを8月13日より開催。予告キービジュアルも公開
entries.description: LevelInfinite announced today (August 2, 2026) that a collaboration between "Goddess of Victory: NIKKE" and the "Persona" series will be held from August 13th. Three works will appear: "Persona 3 Reload," "Persona 4 The Golden," and "Persona 5 The Royal."

entries.title: ``Ryu to Mahjong'' is a roguelite that builds decks using mahjong tiles. You can play without any knowledge and learn how to play naturally [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: 麻雀牌でデッキを構築するローグライト「龍と麻雀」。知識がなくても遊べて，自然と打ち方が身につく［CJ2026］
entries.description: ``Ryu to Mahjong,'' which I tried out at ChinaJoy2026, is a deck-building roguelite that uses mahjong tiles as decks to form roles and fight against enemies. We will introduce the combat system using mahjong tiles, the stacking of roles, strengthening elements that change the tiles, the modern fantasy worldview, and the aims of the developer.

entries.title: Why does MOONDROP create collaborative products at the cost of cutting into profits? We asked about the brand's origins and commitment [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: 水月雨（MOONDROP）は，なぜ利益を削ってまでコラボ製品を作り込むのか。ブランドの成り立ちとこだわりを聞いた［CJ2026］
entries.description: MOONDROP, an audio brand from Chengdu, China, exhibited at ChinaJoy2026. What is the reason for creating collaborative products even if it means reducing profits? We asked CEO Suigetsu and Vice President Xu Dali about the history of the brand's creation, the development system, and the uncompromising approach to manufacturing through IP collaboration.

entries.title: ``Hope of Elements - Journey of the Witch and the Dragon'' is a turn-based strategy RPG with elements of extraction. What is the role of publishers that connect Japan and China [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: ターン制戦略RPGにエクストラクション系の要素を加えた「Hope of Elements − 魔女とドラゴンの旅」。日中をつなぐパブリッシャの役割とは［CJ2026］
entries.description: At the ChinaJoy2026 venue, I tried out the turn-based strategy RPG "Hope of Elements - Journey of the Witch and the Dragon." In addition to the gameplay that combines elemental reactions and extraction elements, this work is supported by Harrison World, a publisher that has been deeply involved in the creation of the work since the early stages of development and works in both Japan and China. We also heard about this initiative.

entries.title: Vibrant colors stir the spirit. A different type of horror in “The Color Beyond: A Zeroth Kind” that looks around at a 360-degree panorama and interferes with the thoughts of others [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: 鮮烈な色が精神を揺らす。360度パノラマを見回し，他者の思考に干渉する「The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind」のひと味違う恐怖［CJ2026］
entries.description: InfigoGames is exhibiting a playable new title for PC, "The ColourBeyond: AZerothKind", at ChinaJoy2026. This work is a cosmic horror ADV that emphasizes the story. I was able to experience the beginning of the story and the mechanism of mental interference at the venue, so I would like to introduce the contents.

entries.title: Wielding the power of water, he dashes freely across land and air. Clash with Xingtian in the demo for “Ancient God: Na’zi” [CJ2026]
entries.title_ja: 水の力をまとい，地上と空中を縦横無尽に駆ける。「太古の神：哪吒」の試遊で刑天と激突［CJ2026］
entries.description: GenigodsLab is showcasing a playable demo of its new action RPG, *Ancient Gods: Na吒*, based on Chinese creation myths, at the major gaming event “ChinaJoy 2026.” At the venue, attendees were able to experience the exhilarating action of battling using the power of water and magical artifacts, as well as a boss battle against the formidable foe “Xingtian’s Proud Bone.” Let’s take a closer look at what the game has to offer.

entries.title: After the announcement of ``Final Fantasy VII: Revelation'', the ``FFVII'' series seems to be ``selling really well''. We asked D Hamaguchi about his thoughts on the reaction to the new release and user reactions.

entries.description: In this article, we talked about the reaction to the announcement of ``Final Fantasy VII: Revelation,'' how they are dealing with the feedback they received from users, and even the current sales of past titles following the announcement of new releases.

entries.title: The "freeze bug" whose cause has been unknown since the release of "Path of Exile 2" has finally been resolved. Mysterious bug that is difficult to reproduce, persistent investigation to create a “dedicated replay system” bears fruit

entries.description: It has been revealed from the company's financial statements that a "new version" of Frictional Games' "Amnesia: The Dark Descent" is scheduled to be released at the end of 2026.

entries.title: Marvelous and Tencent subsidiary to end capital and business alliance that lasted about 6 years. Development of the smartphone version of “Harvest Moon” has also been halted.

entries.description: Marvelous announced on July 31 that it will terminate its capital and business partnership with Image Frame Investment, a subsidiary of China's Tencent.

entries.title: A cheater is appearing in the PS5/PS4 ported version of ``Call of Duty: Black Ops II'' that allows others to ``max out their level'' without permission. Too much unnecessary care

entries.description: It has been reported that there are cheaters using the PS5/PS4 ports of ``Call of Duty: Black Ops'' and ``Call of Duty: Black Ops II'' that affect users' account levels, causing a stir.

entries.title: We asked the developers of the popular "Chinese court death game" live-action ADV "Rise of the World: The Road to Empress I & II" about their ingenuity to keep you entertained even with "more than 100 bad endings." A balance of reality and entertainment refined over 3 years of production and 100 days of filming.

entries.description: We spoke to the developers of ``Rise in the World: The Road to the Empress I'' and ``Rise in the World: The Road to the Empress II'' to learn about the behind-the-scenes stories and details of their production.

entries.description: On July 30, 2026, GreyState Studio (formerly Aurora Studio), a subsidiary of Tencent Games, released the latest trailer for the PC game ``Rules of Engagement: The GreyState.'' This work is a cooperative horror shooter that is basically free to play. You can enjoy PvE and PvP in a world called the ``Horrorverse,'' where there are terrifying monsters and relics left behind by unknown alien civilizations.

entries.title: [Meat Takeshi] I'll do what I can. I won't do what I can't do.

entries.title: ``Prospice'', a horror driving simulator where you are tasked with transporting supplies on an isolated island eaten by gods, begins open play test on Steam
entries.title_ja: 神々に蝕まれた孤島で物資の運搬任務にあたるホラードライビングシミュレーター「Prospice」，オープンプレイテストをSteamで開始
entries.description: Forklift Interactive and CodeWakers today (July 29, 2026) started an open play test for the new PC title "Prospice" on Steam. The official release is scheduled for sometime in 2027. This work is a horror driving simulator in which players are tasked with transporting cargo on an isolated island that has been corrupted by the gods.

entries.title: Steam store page for “Genkai Sabaibu!”, a slightly harsh PvE escape shooter where girls fight for survival on a deserted island, is now available
entries.title_ja: 無人島で少女たちがサバイバルを繰り広げる，ちょっぴり過酷なPvE脱出シューター「限界サバイ部！」，Steamストアページを公開
entries.description: On July 25, 2026, ZephyrStudio, an individual game production circle, released the Steam store page for the new title ``Genkai Sabaibu!'' scheduled to be released by Wakuwaku Games. This work is a PvE escape shooter in which a girl is forced to participate in a survival game on a deserted island and cooperates with her friends armed with a gun and a few supplies.

entries.title: Tag Team: SNK Arcade Legends, a tag battle board game featuring SNK characters, will be released overseas in the second quarter of 2027. Terry and 6 others will participate.
entries.title_ja: SNKキャラクターによるタッグバトルボードゲーム「Tag Team: SNK Arcade Legends」，海外で2027年第2四半期発売へ。テリーほか6名が参戦
entries.description: ScorpionMasque announced on July 28, 2026 that it will release the two-player board game "TagTeam:SNKArcadeLegends" in the second quarter of 2027. Six characters are scheduled to participate, and currently only Terry Bogard's appearance has been revealed, and all other characters are silhouettes.

entries.title: "Battlefield Fuga" now available for iOS/Android. Enjoy simulation RPGs developed for PCs and home game consoles on your smartphone.
entries.title_ja: 「戦場のフーガ」，iOS / Android向けに配信開始。PCや家庭用ゲーム機向けに展開されたシミュレーションRPGをスマホで楽しめる
entries.description: CyberConnect2 today (July 29, 2026) began distributing the smartphone version of ``Battlefield Fuga''. The price is 2400 yen each (tax included). This work is a simulation RPG released for PC and home game consoles in 2021. The smartphone version includes the in-game benefits of the deluxe edition and DLC volumes 1 to 3.

entries.title: Sandcastle, a sandbox game where you can build sand castles to your heart's content on a tropical coast, will be released as a trial version in August
entries.title_ja: トロピカルな海岸で心ゆくまで砂の城を作るサンドボックスゲーム「Sandcastle（サンドキャッスル）」，8月に体験版を配信
entries.description: FutureFriendsGames announced that it will distribute the demo version of "Sandcastle" developed by Bubblebird Studio on August 6th. This is a sandbox game where you build a sandcastle on a sunny tropical beach.

entries.title: ``Commander, it's a horde of orcs!'', a tower defense game that protects your base from an impossible number of orcs, now available on Steam
entries.title_ja: ありえない数のオークから基地を守るタワーディフェンスゲーム「司令官、オークの大群です！」，Steamで配信開始
entries.description: On July 28, 2026, MumpitzGames released a new title, ``Commander, Orc Horde!''. This is a tower defense game in which players use a variety of equipment and base reinforcements, such as machine guns, orbital lasers, and nuclear bombs, to take on overwhelming amounts of orcs.

entries.title: Unraveling the laws of materials and creating fantastic compositions. Logical alchemy puzzle “Miriam’s Synthesis Note” now available on Steam
entries.title_ja: 素材の法則を解き明かして，幻の調合物を創り出す。論理的な錬金術パズル「ミリアムの調合ノート」，Steamで配信開始
entries.description: ReoGames today began distributing the PC software ``Miriam's Synthesis Notes'' on Steam. This is a logical alchemy puzzle game in which the player, as an apprentice alchemist, unravels the laws of materials. Players prepare unknown potions while completing daily requests (quests).

entries.title: We, Junk Artists, a multiplayer game where you make a collage of junk and guess what you're making, will be released on August 7th

entries.description: SpiralUpGames will release the Japanese-language non-Japanese PC game ``We, Junk Artists'' developed by PerfectDay Studio on August 7, 2026. This is a game where you try to guess what you are making by collaging junk. You can play multiplayer with up to 6 people.

entries.title: "Daily Life of a Conveyor-belt Sushi Restaurant" is now available on Steam. A management simulation where you make sushi, grow your restaurant, and weave the stories of your regular customers.
entries.title_ja: 「回転寿司屋の日常」，Steamで本日配信開始。寿司を握り，店を育てながら常連客たちの物語を紡ぐ経営シミュレーション
entries.description: RogueDuckInteractive today began distributing the conveyor belt sushi management simulation ``Daily Life of a Conveyor Belt Sushi Restaurant'' on Steam. While enjoying making sushi, choosing ingredients, and building a restaurant, you will get to know the stories of regular customers through interactions with them. A 25% off launch sale is also being held to commemorate the release.

entries.title: PS5/Nintendo Switch/XBOX Series X|S version of ``The King is Watching'', a simulation that monitors citizens who slack off as soon as they are not watching, released today
entries.title_ja: 見ていないとすぐサボる国民たちを監視するシミュレーション「The King is Watching」，PS5 / Nintendo Switch / XBOX Series X|S版を本日発売
entries.description: tinyBuild today (July 29, 2026) will release the PS5/NintendoSwitch/XBOXSeriesX|S version of "TheKingisWatching" developed by HypnoheadStudio. This is a simulation game in which you play as the king of a country and monitor the labor of lazy citizens. Without the king's supervision, the people would easily slack off and production would come to a halt.

entries.title: He steals a golden apple from a witch that can grant any wish, and fights to resurrect his dead sister. Touhou-style vertical scroll barrage STG “SANASANA” to be released at the end of October 2026

entries.description: STUDIOCHARON has announced that it will release a new product for PC, ``SANASANA'', at the end of October 2026. This work is a Touhou-style vertical scrolling bullet hell shooting game. The main character, Sana, embarks on a journey to steal golden apples from three witches in order to revive her deceased sister.

entries.title: “Console Archives Doraemon” starts distribution on July 30th. Doraemon uses secret tools to explore space, demonic regions, and the ocean floor.

This title is a reprint of the action game released by Hudson in 1986 for 8-bit home game consoles, and allows you to enjoy an adventure in which Doraemon makes full use of his secret tools and searches for his friends who have been sent to space, the demonic realm, and the ocean floor.

entries.description: It has been announced that the official Discord server of ``Meccha Chameleon'', which was hacked, has been restored.

entries.description: Ememe reported on July 27th that it is currently continuing to develop the AI-NPC behavior observation variety game ``EmemeTown'' while reviewing the experience and specifications.

entries.description: Hound13 announced on July 27th that it will be distributing the DLC ``Direwolf of the Abyss'' for ``Dragon Sword: Awakening'' for free.

entries.title: Approximately 200 books added to the sale for Nintendo Switch 2/Switch. ``Final Fantasy VII Rebirth'' and ``Dragon Quest VII Reimagined'' have been updated at the lowest price, and the rare countryside Yakuza open world is also cheap

entries.description: On July 27th, a new sale for Nintendo Switch 2/Nintendo Switch titles began on the Nintendo eShop. Approximately 200 titles are eligible.

entries.title: Hidden beneath a water attraction is a research facility with a horrifying secret. Announcement of 3D horror ADV “CALL OF CUTIE” that combines eerie atmosphere and comedy
entries.title_ja: 水上アトラクションの地下に，恐ろしい秘密を抱えた研究施設が隠されている。不気味な雰囲気とコメディを組み合わせた3DホラーADV「CALL OF CUTIE」発表
entries.description: Jesse Kasdo announced a new title for PC, ``CALLOFCUTIE''. This work is a 3D horror adventure set in a research facility beneath a water attraction. Players will explore the vast facility, rescue captured people, and aim to escape.

entries.title: A collaboration map with “Garten of Banban” has appeared in “Meccha Chameleon”. 12 new emotes and the addition of the character “Plump”

entries.description: On July 25, 2026, individual game developer LEMORION released update 3.1.0, which adds a new map ``Banban Kindergarten'' to the hide-and-seek game ``Meccha Chameleon.'' Additionally, the update on the 26th introduced new elements such as 12 new emotes and a new character, ``Fukuyoka.''

entries.title: ``An Eggtremely Hard Game'', a two-player cooperative physical action game where you transport eggs in a nest without dropping them, now available on Steam

entries.description: On July 24, 2026, DevotionInteractive released a new title "AnEggstremelyHardGame" developed by BBearStudio. This is a cooperative physical action game in which two players each control a goose to carry a nest containing eggs by holding both ends of it in its mouth.

entries.title: 6-player cooperative gambling game "Gamble With Your Friends" now supports Japanese with update. A popular work that sold over 2 million copies within one month of release.
entries.title_ja: 6人協力ギャンブルゲーム「Gamble With Your Friends」，アップデートで日本語に対応。リリース1か月で販売本数が200万本を突破した人気作
entries.description: On July 25, 2026, TENSTACK distributed version 1.0.30 to "GambleWithYourFriends" developed by TEAMGWYF. This makes it compatible with many languages ​​including Japanese. This game is a ``casino crawler'' in which up to six players work together to climb a creepy casino tower and meet quotas set by loan sharks.

entries.title: Announcing the Steam version of the ADV “ZOMBIE Disaster Prevention Training”, which teaches you various ways to deal with a “zombie disaster” that may occur someday.
entries.title_ja: いつか発生するかもしれない“ゾンビ災害”を想定し，さまざまな対処法を学ぶADV「ZOMBIE防災訓練」，Steam版を発表
entries.description: MAGES. today announced the Steam version of ``ZOMBIE Disaster Prevention Training'' currently on sale for Nintendo Switch. This is a point-and-click adventure game that simulates a "zombie disaster" that may occur someday, and teaches how to deal with it using familiar tools.

entries.title: Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo and Pikachu Sweets, which were temporarily closed, will reopen on August 24th. Entry restrictions will be implemented after reopening

entries.description: Pokemon announced today (July 27, 2026) that the temporarily closed "Pokemon Center Mega Tokyo" and "Pikachu Sweets by Pokemon Cafe" will reopen from August 24th.

entries.title: To commemorate the 3rd anniversary of the release of "CRYMACHINA", we are holding a sale where the download version is up to 90% off

entries.description: To commemorate the 3rd anniversary of the release of the action RPG ``CRYMACHINA'', Furyu today launched the ``Hanamaru Summer Sale'' where downloadable versions are up to 90% off. To commemorate the series' cumulative sales of over 770,000 copies, we are also releasing new illustrations and holding a giveaway campaign.

entries.title: Sale for the "Paranoma Site" series has started at the Nintendo Store. “FILE38 Ise Mermaid Story” is 30% off, “FILE23 Honjo Seven Mysteries” is 50% off
entries.title_ja: 「パラノマサイト」シリーズのセールがNintendo Storeで開始。「FILE38 伊勢人魚物語」は30％オフ，「FILE23 本所七不思議」は50％オフに
entries.description: Square Enix today (July 27, 2026) started a sale for the "Paranoma Site" series at the Nintendo Store. ``FILE 38 Ise Mermaid Story'' is on sale at 30% off, and ``FILE 23 Honjo Seven Mysteries'' is on sale at 50% off.

entries.title: He becomes a building manager who works the night shift and responds to calls from tenants who are worried about strange things. Trailer released for horror simulation “Kaho Hotline Midnight Manager”
entries.title_ja: 夜勤のビル管理人となり，怪異に悩む入居者からの電話に対応していく。ホラーシミュレーション「佳宝ホットライン 真夜中の管理人」，トレイラーを公開
entries.description: BadTapeStudios has released a trailer for a new title currently under development, ``Kaho Hotline Midnight Manager.'' This work is a horror simulation set in the Kaho Building, an apartment complex filled with secrets, in which the player plays the role of a night-shift manager who responds to calls from residents. While listening to the calls and checking the instructions, you will find answers to the strange consultations.

entries.title: Strategy card roguelike game "Kinny and the Nameless Oden Shop" officially released on Steam. Focusing on the “hard to describe chemical reactions” caused by ingredients
entries.title_ja: 戦略カードローグライクゲーム「キニーと名状しがたいおでん屋」，Steamで正式リリース。食材同士が引き起こす「名状しがたい化学反応」に注目
entries.description: Kinnymoms officially released ``Kinny and the Nameless Oden Shop'' on Steam on July 27, 2026. The price is 1,700 yen (tax included). This work is a strategy card roguelike game where you boil randomly falling ingredients in a ``cosmic cauldron'' to earn scores.

entries.title: Washagana TV's latest video brings you the extra edition (3) of the "Bandai Namco Cross Store Tokyo" business trip edition. Introducing recommended ways to eat Shabuha
entries.title_ja: わしゃがなTVの最新動画では，「バンダイナムコ Cross Store 東京」出張版の番外編その（3）をお届け。「しゃぶ葉」でのおススメの食べ方を紹介
entries.description: Today (July 27, 2026), the latest video of the web program "Washagana TV" by Yuichi Nakamura and Mafia Kajita was released. This time, as part (3) of the ``Bandai Namco CrossStore Tokyo'' business trip edition, we will be presenting a dinner party at ``Shabuha'', a specialty restaurant that serves all-you-can-eat shabu-shabu.

entries.title: 5-player cooperative FPS "Codename CURE II", which is free to play, is now available on Steam. Master 5 classes and survive America full of zombies.
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料の5人協力FPS「Codename CURE II」，Steamで配信開始。5つのクラスを使いこなし，ゾンビが溢れるアメリカを生き抜こう
entries.description: On July 25, 2026, indie.io began distributing "CodenameCUREII" developed by RaptorByte on Steam. This game is a free-to-play FPS that supports multiplayer for up to 5 players, and the game is set in the United States, which has been infected by a brutal zombie infection.

entries.title: New Soullike x Roguelite “Resurgis: Rise of the Dead” demo to be released on Steam in August
entries.title_ja: ソウルライク×ローグライトの新作「Resurgis: Rise of the Dead」，デモを8月中にSteamで公開
entries.description: GoldArrowGames has announced that the demo of its new PC title ``Resurgis: RiseoftheDead'' will be released on Steam in August 2026. This work is a 3D action game that combines Souls-like combat with roguelite elements. A teaser movie will also be posted where you can check out gameplay scenes.

entries.description: Square Enix held the MMORPG "Final Fantasy XIV" event "FINALFANTASYXIV Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin" on July 25th and 26th. entries.description: Dat Japan announced today (July 24, 2026) that the turn-based RPG "Arena Remake" will be released on Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam) in winter 2026. entries.description: The ``1/35 American Light Tank M24 Chaffee (European Front)'' (hereinafter referred to as 1/35 M24 Chaffee) released by Tamiya on July 11th is a plastic model that really caught my interest at this year's Shizuoka Hobby Show. The M24, which was deployed on the European front at the end of World War II, is a compact tank, but the gun it carries is said to be the same as the gun mounted on the B-25 bomber. A lightweight and powerful gun was developed, and with its powerful engine, the M24 was able to travel around the European front as a light tank, playing an active role in reconnaissance, and even competing against huge tanks.

entries.title: The trial version of the elemental “chain explosion” roguelike strategy RPG “Hope of Elements” is now available. An infinite build strategy where you can chain each other with just one spell and make enemies fly away.

entries.description: Harrison World began distributing the trial version of the roguelike strategy RPG ``Hope of Elements - Journey of the Witch and the Dragon'' on July 15th.

entries.title: Animal cafe management sim "Tailside: Cozy Cafe Sim" officially supports Japanese with an update. A heartwarming cafe management where you can decorate to your heart's content in a relaxed manner with no time limit.
entries.title_ja: どうぶつカフェ経営シム『Tailside: Cozy Cafe Sim』、アプデで公式日本語対応。時間制限なし、ゆったり心ゆくまでデコれるほのぼのカフェ経営
entries.description: Coffee Beans Dev announced on July 14th that the cafe management sim ``Tailside: Cozy Cafe Sim,'' currently available in early access, will be available in Japanese. With the July 14th update, this game can now be played in Japanese as well.

entries.title: Roguelite “PvE Escape” “Raiders of Blackveil” Large update with 2 new characters and tons of new elements. A handsome bow fox, a dynamic hammer female rabbit, and new equipment and interrupted saves make the build even more intense.
entries.title_ja: ローグライト“PvE脱出”『Raiders of Blackveil』大型アプデで新キャラ2体＆新要素どっさり。イケメン弓狐、豪快ハンマー女子ウサギ、新装備や中断セーブも実装でさらに濃厚ビルド沼

entries.title: ``Fight Only'', an RPG where you can get through just by ``fighting'', is now available on Steam. The princess, who only uses her fists, can also punch allies and window frames to advance.
entries.title_ja: 「たたかう」だけで切り抜けるRPG『たたかう だけ』Steamにてお披露目。拳しか使わない姫は「味方」や「ウィンドウ枠」も殴って進む
entries.description: On July 15th, Heaviside Creation released the Steam store page for ``Fight Only''. This work is a short RPG where you go to attack the demon lord just by using the "fight" command.

entries.title: The developer, who was excited about implementing the game in Arabic, was overjoyed to receive serious advice from the local community. ``Husshah is better than dialect'' ``Numbers should be written from 0 to 9'' - Reflecting real voices
entries.title_ja: ゲームの“アラビア語実装”で悲鳴あげた開発者、現地からの本気アドバイスに大喜び。「方言よりフスハー」「数字は0～9表記がいい」生の声をしっかり反映
entries.description: Apothema talked about the story of adapting the puzzle game ``Hexzen,'' which he is currently developing, into Arabic. Apparently, they received a lot of advice from local users.

entries.title: Large sale “SUMMER SALE” for PS5/PS4 begins. ``Battlefield 6'' is half price, ``Resident Evil Requiem'', ``Monster Hunter Wilds'' and many more at the lowest prices

entries.description: Sony Interactive Entertainment launched the first "SUMMER SALE" on July 15th at the PlayStation Store.

entries.title: Reports are spreading that a 25-year-old Microsoft account has been permanently suspended, and XBOX games and OneDrive data have been wiped out. Unable to recover from “account hijacking”
entries.title_ja: 「25年使ったマイクロソフトアカウントが永久停止され、XBOXのゲームやOneDriveデータが消し飛んだ」との報告が波紋広げる。“アカウント乗っ取り”からの復旧叶わず
entries.description: Angry posts from users who were victims of account hijacking and had their Microsoft accounts suspended without being able to recover have become a hot topic.

entries.title: The free-to-play ``city'' open world ``NTE'' has exceeded ``33 billion yen'' in sales in about two months. Hot global popularity even before the Steam version was released
entries.title_ja: 基本プレイ無料「街」オープンワールド『NTE』、約2か月で売上高「330億円」突破していた。Steam版が出る前から熱いグローバル人気
entries.description: In the business forecast for the first half of 2026 announced by Perfect World Games, it was reported that "NTE" had achieved sales of over 33 billion yen.

entries.title: Announcing ``Paper Shredder'', a document disposal game. Cutting hell begins with a “hand-cranked shredder,” a virtual office Zen experience where you empty your mind and chop paper.
entries.title_ja: ひたすら書類処分ゲーム『Paper Shredder』発表。“手回しシュレッダー1台”から始まる裁断地獄、心を無にして紙を刻むバーチャルオフィス禅体験
entries.description: Embers announced the incremental game ``Paper Shredder'' on July 15th.

entries.title: ``KAZ'' is a roguelike action game in which ``all you have to do is use the movement keys.'' Despite its ``very well-received'' start, many people complained that it ``does a lot of damage to your hands.'' “Keyboard replacement report” also

entries.description: While HAKURO released ``KAZ'' on July 14th, it has received positive reviews, but has also received complaints such as ``my hands are cramping'' and ``my fingers hurt.''

entries.title: High-speed shooting ski "DIEATHLON" announced. Extreme shooting action where you run through snowy mountains while fighting monsters.
entries.title_ja: ハイスピード銃撃スキー『DIEATHLON』発表。モンスターと戦いつつ雪山を駆け抜ける、エクストリーム射撃アクション
entries.description: Long Void Games and Loopr Partners announced DIEATHLON: Death Race on July 15th. It is scheduled for release in the fourth quarter of 2026. This is an action game in which you drive down a snowy mountain while fighting off monsters.

entries.title: A surreal and crazy horror film that you can't understand anything about, ``Hen: The Dream Of A Cockspur'' will be released on July 22nd. Everything makes no sense, the dog is the only comfort

entries.description: PLAYISM, the publishing brand of our company Active Gaming Media, announced on July 15th that it will be releasing ``Hie: The Dream Of A Cockspur'' on July 22nd.

entries.title: Glen Schofield, the creator of Dead Space, announces his retirement. The veteran who led ``CoD:AW'' and ``The Callisto Protocol'' ends his 35-year career.
entries.title_ja: 『Dead Space』の生みの親Glen Schofield氏、引退を発表。『CoD:AW』『The Callisto Protocol』などを率いたベテラン、35年のキャリアに区切り
entries.description: Glen Schofield announced his retirement from the gaming industry on LinkedIn on July 15th.

entries.title: The Switch 2 version of “Once Upon a Katamari Damacy” will be released on October 8th. New paid DLC “Rolling Live Highlights” will also be released at the same time.
entries.title_ja: Switch2版「ワンス・アポン・ア・塊魂」，10月8日に発売。新たな有料DLC「ローリングライブハイライツ」も同時リリース
entries.description: Bandai Namco Entertainment announced today (July 15, 2026) that the Switch 2 version of "Once Upon a Katamari Damacy" will be released on October 8th. Additionally, paid DLC ``Rolling Live Highlights'' will also be released at the same time.

entries.title: ``The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu'', a 4-player cooperative action ADV in which Cthulhu-like terror attacks, is now available
entries.title_ja: クトゥルフ的恐怖が襲いかかる4人協力アクションADV「The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu」，配信開始
entries.description: Nacon released a new title "The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu" today (July 15, 2026). This work is a first-person action adventure that supports multiplayer for up to four people and is based on the short story ``The Mound'' by H.P. Lovecraft, known for ``The Call of Cthulhu.''

entries.title: Full HD gaming LCD display "TITAN ARMY KG257H PLUS" that supports 300Hz display and costs around 26,800 yen including tax will be released on July 18th
entries.title_ja: 300Hz表示対応で税込2万6800円前後のフルHDゲーミング液晶ディスプレイ「TITAN ARMY KG257H PLUS」が7月18日発売
entries.description: On July 15, 2026, Lynx International announced that it will release the 24.5-inch IPS liquid crystal display "TITANARMYKG257HPLUS" with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 dots on July 18. Although it is relatively inexpensive, with an estimated actual selling price of around 26,800 yen, it is unique in that it supports 300Hz display.

entries.title: The biggest feature of the monster collecting RPG "Animo" is that you can not only capture mysterious creatures, but also "see the world from a monster's perspective" [BW2026]
entries.title_ja: モンスター収集RPG「アニモ」は，不思議な生物を捕まえるだけでなく，”モンスターの視点で世界を見られる”ことが最大の特徴［BW2026］
entries.description: At "BilibiliWorld 2026" held in Shanghai, China from July 10th to 12th, Pawprint Studio's open world monster collecting RPG "Animo" was on display as playable. The biggest feature is that you can "see the world from a monster's perspective."

entries.title: Historical RPG "Expeditions: Samurai" starts early access on Steam on August 7th. The latest trailer introducing the eight friends who fight together during the Sengoku period has also been released.
entries.title_ja: 歴史RPG「Expeditions: Samurai」，早期アクセスを8月7日にSteamで開始。戦国時代をともに戦う8人の仲間を紹介する最新トレイラーも公開
entries.description: THQNordicJapan today announced that early access for the historical RPG "Expeditions: Samurai" will begin on Steam on August 7, 2026. This work is set in Japan at the end of the Warring States period, and the protagonist moves from Europe to Japan, builds bonds with eight friends, and carves out history as he makes numerous decisions. A new trailer introducing the friends has also been released.

entries.title: Google Play fees in Japan will be reduced by September 30, 2026. Simplified installation of app stores that meet standards will be available at the end of the year
entries.title_ja: 日本におけるGoogle Playの手数料は，2026年9月30日までに引き下げに。基準を満たしたアプリストアのインストール簡略化も年末に提供開始へ
entries.description: Google announced on July 14, 2026 that it will reduce fees for the Google Play Store in Japan by September 30, 2026.

entries.title: “Console Archives Glory of Hercules II: Fall of the Titans”, released on July 16th. Become a hero and fight alongside your friends against monsters plotting to rule the world.
entries.title_ja: 「コンソールアーカイブス ヘラクレスの栄光II タイタンの滅亡」，7月16日配信。勇者となって仲間とともに，世界の支配を企む魔物との戦いに挑む
entries.description: Hamster today announced that ``Console Archives Glory of Hercules II: Fall of the Titans'' will begin distribution on July 16, 2026. ``The Glory of Hercules II: The Fall of the Titans'' is an RPG released by Data East for 8-bit home game consoles in 1989, in which the player becomes a hero, goes on an adventure with his friends, and takes on a battle against monsters plotting to take over the world.

entries.title: ``Cat Chess'', a chess game using cute fluffy cats as pieces, is now available. You can play with cats while waiting for your opponent's turn.
entries.title_ja: かわいいモフモフネコたちを駒としたチェスゲーム「Cat Chess」，配信開始。相手のターンを待つ間にネコと遊べる
entries.description: CapriciaProductions today (July 15, 2026) released a new title "CatChess". This work is a board game in which cats play chess and fight as pawns. It is said that elements unique to cats have been added to classic chess, making it more fun, cute, and chaotic.

entries.title: The store page for the meta-RPG ``Fighting Dake'', whose main character is a princess who can only attack, has been released. You can hit not only enemies but also allies and windows.
entries.title_ja: 殴ることしかできないお姫様が主人公のメタRPG「たたかう　だけ」，ストアページを公開。敵だけでなく，味方やウィンドウも殴れちゃう
entries.description: Today (July 15, 2026), Heaviside Creation announced a new title under development, ``Fight Only'', and opened the Steam store page. The release date is scheduled for 2027. This work is an RPG in which the main character is a princess who can do nothing but "fight" and confronts terrifying monsters.

entries.title: "Persona 3" 20th anniversary sale is underway. "Persona 3 Reload" is available at up to 60% off from 3,071 yen (tax included). The highest discount rate ever

entries.title: Win in the “real world” in the age of AI. Lost items, VR, and rice balls: the strongest mote of muddy smell from three companies [IVS2026]
entries.title_ja: AI全盛の時代に「現実世界」で勝つ。落とし物・VR・おにぎり，3社が語る泥臭さという最強のモート［IVS2026］
entries.description: Now that AI is the biggest trend, there are entrepreneurs who are daring to bet on a return to the real world. Find lost items, CinemaLeap for VR experiences, RicePlatformer for rice balls. Even though the AI ​​was used to its fullest, what ultimately spoke volumes was the sloppy atmosphere and the warmth of the people who entered the field. Three entrepreneurs talked about contrarian thinking and how to create barriers to entry.

entries.title: Is Sovereign AI and Domestic Cloud a Win for Japan? - Talks by the Government, Startups, and Domestic Cloud Operators [IVS2026]
entries.title_ja: ソブリンAI，国産クラウドは日本の勝ち筋か――政府，スタートアップ，国産クラウド事業者が語る［IVS2026］
entries.description: One day, an overseas AI service suddenly became unusable. With this ``shock'' as an opportunity, discussions about sovereign AI and domestically produced clouds are rapidly heating up in Japan. A panel discussion held at IVS2026 discussed how Japan will compete in this area from three perspectives: the government, startups, and domestic cloud providers.

entries.title: The masterpiece puzzle-solving game "Rusty Lake" is available for 20 yen, the hack and slash game "Titan Quest" is available for 18 yen, and an unprecedented "Mega Sale" is being held on the Google Play Store. Almost free

entries.title: Heavy weapon maid Hilda, voiced by Haruka Tomatsu, appears in a major update to ``Duet Night Abyss'', which is basically free to play without character gacha. A loyal and elegant maid who “cleans up” all those who get in the way of her master.
entries.title_ja: キャラガチャなし基本プレイ無料『デュエットナイトアビス』大型アプデでCV戸松遥さんの重火器メイド「ヒルダ」が登場。主人の邪魔者はみな“掃除”する、忠実で優雅なメイド
entries.description: Hong Kong Spiral Rising Technology began distributing a major update to ``Duet Night Abyss'' from June 30th. Heavy weapons maid "Hilda" has appeared as a new playable character.

entries.title: ``Sexy No. 8 Like'' for adults, ``Densha No. 45'' suddenly explodes in popularity and sells like hotcakes. There are naughty incidents and tears.

entries.title: The sandbox MMO that ``raised 10 million yen on Kurafan'' ended its service and sales just three months after its release. An overly ambitious game full of “doubt”

entries.title: Steam's next co-op game, the hospital sim Night Shift Hospital, announced. ``Up to 10 medical mistakes allowed'', hellish night shift operation full of strange illnesses
entries.title_ja: Steamの次なる協力プレイゲーム、病院シム『Night Shift Hospital』発表。「医療ミス10回までOK」、奇病大集合な地獄の夜勤オペ
entries.description: On June 30th, Polden Publishing announced ``Night Shift Hospital,'' a medical simulation game that supports up to 4 players for cooperative play.

entries.title: Zombie survival "7 Days to Die" large update 3.0 officially released, "hack and slash random reinforcement" implemented for equipment. Lots of additional elements, including a significant expansion of world setting items to “150 types”

entries.description: The Fun Pimps officially released version 3.0 of ``7 Days to Die'' on June 30th. Various elements have been added, such as the implementation of item reinforcement status.

entries.title: The 2nd development participation crowdfunding presentation for "Shibuya Scramble Stories" was held. In cooperation with CAMPFIRE, the second challenge will be held from July 1st.
entries.title_ja: 「シブヤスクランブルストーリーズ」の第2回開発参加型クラウドファンディング発表会が開催。CAMPFIRE協力のもと，2度目の挑戦を7月1日より実施
entries.description: The second development participation crowdfunding presentation for the live-action adventure ``Shibuya Scramble Stories'' by game designer Jiro Ishii was held on June 28th. It was announced that the second crowdfunding campaign would be held from July 1st, and there were also reports that the scenario for the five main characters had been withdrawn.

entries.title: The Steam version of ``Bravest!'', a popular RPG from the flip phone era, is now available. The adventure of a NEET hero who was summoned to another world returns to the present day
entries.title_ja: ガラケー時代の人気RPG「Bravest!」，Steam版を本日配信。異世界召喚されたニート勇者の冒険が現代に復活
entries.description: Indie game developer nazenaninadesico will start distributing the Steam version of the single-player RPG "Bravest!" today (June 30, 2026) at 20:00. This work is a popular work that appeared on the i-mode official website in 2006 and has been ported to the current environment. The story depicts a NEET who is summoned to another world and goes on an adventure as a hero.

entries.title: “Deadly Trick,” a Steam multiplayer “exposing the murderer” class trial game, will enter early access on July 14th. Cooperation or betrayal? Up to 8 people risk their lives in an investigation and seriously debate madamisu.
entries.title_ja: Steamマルチ“殺人犯あぶり出し”学級裁判ゲーム『Deadly Trick』7月14日に早期アクセスへ。協力か裏切りか、最大8人で命がけ捜査＆マジ議論マダミス

entries.title: "Sister, Others, Paranoia", a new work from the developer of "NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE", will be released on August 15th. A visual novel about the codependent life of a sister who will drive anyone to death.
entries.title_ja: 『NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE』開発者が放つ新作『妹、他者、パラノイア』8月15日発売へ。“嫌な奴”は死に追いやる、妹と共依存病み生活ビジュアルノベル
entries.description: Serenity Forge and HazeDenki announced on June 29th that "Imouto, Others, Paranoia" will be released on August 15th.

entries.title: The reality-altering Metroidvania ``SHADE Protocol'' is attracting a lot of attention. Crisp pixel art cyber action that changes your destiny with “stage rewriting”

entries.description: Little Legendary's Metroidvania action game ``SHADE Protocol'' is attracting a lot of attention.

entries.description: We asked Masahiko Nakamura, an expert on Unreal Engine, about NTE's technical commitment.

entries.title: Commentary on "Camille" from "Arknights: Endfield". An attentive SP-spinning operator who can play both the roles of “Wolf Guard” and “Akekuri” at a scorching party.
entries.title_ja: 『アークナイツ：エンドフィールド』の「カミーユ」解説。灼熱パーティーで「ウルフガード」と「アケクリ」両方の役割をこなせる、SP回し気配りオペレーター
entries.description: Camille is a supporter. Furthermore, he is ``a supporter who smoothes the movement of the team with the effects of chain-reaction combat techniques and the frequent supply of SP.''

entries.description: According to foreign media reports, Microsoft is planning to lay off up to 400 people and four studios are in the process of closing.

entries.title: 2-character simultaneous operation action game "REUNION" unveiled on Steam. A multitasking game where when you look at red, blue collides with you, creating a “brain traffic jam”

entries.description: Game developer Utayo released the Steam store page for ``REUNION'' on June 29th.

entries.title: Steam cooperation "Moon surface" escape survival craft "Moon Crashers" will be released on July 28th. A low-gravity, accident-prone rocket building game where both people and vehicles are in trouble.

entries.title: [Play report] Otomate's first story depicting the Omegaverse between a man and a woman, "Bewitched by You, Drowning in You." A fateful love story, a summer day spent with loved ones.

entries.description: The Switch software ``Bewildered by You, Drowning in You'', which will be released on July 30, 2026, is Otomate's first otome game based on the ``Omegaverse of men and women''. In this article, we will introduce the highlights and systems of the story, focusing on the common route.

entries.title: "Lies of P: Complete Edition", Switch2 package version will be released one day earlier on October 1st. Complete version including the main story and the highly rated DLC “Lies of P: Overture”

entries.description: U&I Entertainment Japan today announced that the release date of the packaged version of the Soul-like action RPG ``Lies of P: Complete Edition'' for Switch 2 will be moved up one day to October 1, 2026. This work is a complete version that includes the main story of ``LiesofP'', additional content ``LiesofP: Overture'', and bonus items.

entries.title: Collaborate with up to four players to explore the dangerous lunar surface and build a rocket to return to Earth. “Moon Crashers” to be released on July 27th

entries.title: "Mammon King" Switch 2 version will be released on October 8th. A package version with limited benefits will also be released at the same time.

In addition to the download version, a package version in the form of a key card will also be released at the same time, and a limited sticker set will be included as an early purchase bonus.

entries.title: Anime "Blade & Bastard", released in 2027. Teaser PV and comment video from Robert Woodhead also released

entries.title: All prizes for "Ichiban Kuji Pokémon 30th ANNIVERSARY vol.2" have been released. A lineup of many goods with themes from the Unova region to the Paldea region.
